Author: Justinlyh
Title: Worst service
Review: Seated in a very congested, cramped area, has been waving hand to call the waiters, no waiter wants to bother you. Food served very slow even the restaurant not crowded. Bad restaurant management.

Author: Lee R
Title: It's normal fried rice not nyonya!
Review: The nyonya fried rice is terribly tasteless, so as the fried meehoon. Only the spiciness of the sambal can be tasted in the sambal fried rice. I dun think the fried rice has any special compared to normal fried rice as it was really tasteless. Personally think they shouldn't use the word "nyonya" in front of the fried rice in the menu to mislead the customers. However, the "hat" was very delicious and it really amazed me.

Author: 88sh8
Title: Great service
Review: Pros:- view of KLCC (ask for a window seat of KL tower when you make a reservation)- service - food (crispy rice with spicy tuna and the dessert selection)Cons:- menu has changed from when it first opened- can get pretty noisy when it's quiet so not really somewhere if you want a more intimate venue

Author: mandyb864
Title: Average M'sian cuisine
Review: Sorry but I had better ayam bakar & penyet in JB. But I give a thumbs up for the deco and friendly service. I really want to try the pisang goring cheese, however it's only avail after 5pm.

Author: Caryn YLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Fresh seafood at great prices
Review: We were really happy with the quality of food, prices and service at this casual, open-air restaurant. It was so good we didn__ bother to try/find a different restaurant throughout our stay and dined here 4 nights in a row. We tried a good number of dishes and our favourites were:1. Clams with ginger and spring onion2. Steamed fish in soy sauce3. Fried flat rice noodles with seafood4. Baby kai lan

Author: JimC619Spencers Wood, United Kingdom
Title: Not so awesome restaurant
Review: My girlfriend had read rated reviews for the decor and food at this restaurant and our first night in Penang on our trip through Malaysia. on the outside it was almost impossible to get in with cars and bikes squeezed together making access ponderous. We were given a choice of tables and menus. That's where I thought it went downhill. no explanation of this paleo concept and left us. 10 to 15 mins no one came back. we had to find someone to order food and drink. I wasn't impressed as we were starving. Given there were 3 tables of diners service was shocking. we ordered the paleo chicken and normal beefburger. A small menu but it encompassed the food groups on both paleo and non paleo. we didn't wait too long give me so few diners in. but not even napkins are offered unless you ask. A bit shoddy really since the cutlery is on the tables in a small bucket room reinforce the urban nature. Food was fine you have to go grab your own condiments. Part of this hip thing? We finished our food and no one around service side. I was pretty disappointed at such a lack of service as no one came to clear up or ask whether we wanted anything else. we walked back to the cashier...apathy isn't the word as they looked so disinterested in serving as they looked at their phones. It has a concept just poorly executed. I wouldn't go back there if it was like that again in a hurry.

Author: Faisal1091
Title: Excellent except Terrible Staff
Review: It was unplanned visit to this restaurant but we I and my friends was satisfied with the foods and drinks they served. But, one staff their who is thin and tall and if im not mistaken the name is Jayson he shows his rudeness to us when my lady friend calling his attention and we are pretty sure that with his awareness he just ignore and make a face to my friend. Then, when he passes in our table I notice he walked like a woman though his not by then I learned why he ignored my lady friend. We will try to comeback we hope we dont encounter him anymore.

Author: cochleartraveller
Title: very stuffy!
Review: The place feels uncomfortable but the food is true local indian stuffs!  Getting pricy though! I liked the fired chicken here.

Author: macnettoKl
Title: One of the best in town....
Review: this spot is popular and one of the better dining experience in this nice town. Highly recommended. Bar like concept with Chinese styled seafood. Fresh and delicious. Been here many times and never fails to disappoints. Do book as its always packed. Outside seating is free and easy altho can be humid.Price is decent, although locals complain its pricey. Three seatings for dinner reservations, if not mistaken.Guiness on tap helps!
Restaurant: The Museum New Concept In Tow

Author: Ctan53Singapore, Singapore
Title: Not worth the visit
Review: Ordered the bbq meat, but meat was cooked in the kitchen and served on a hot plate which was not hot.. Chicken ginseng soup was very diluted and tasteless. Side dishes was jus acceptable. The bean paste for the meat was a miserable teaspoon. The price paid the same as competitors nearby which had better values and food quality. Will not visit again.

Author: dCaroline_69Ile-de-France, France
Title: The most disappointing desserts!!! Shame!
Review: I have visited this wonderful restaurant every year since it was first opened in 2012, since then me and my husband have became a fan for the food served at thirty8 and are very fond of all the desserts served. I have first came to know the pastry chef Brett when i first came here for a family business and i visited grand hyatt kl for more than 3 times a year and there are no other hotels that could measure up to grand hyatt kl. But recently, on my first visit this year at this restaurant , i found the desserts very disappointing and i could not understand why it is in the menu. My husband and i decided to have dinner , we ordered the signature crab cakes, the wagyu steaks, and the famous thirty8 cake. My husband couldnt help but to order one more dessert and we decided to choose the lavender cheese cake. The moment it came to our table, i swore to god it smelled like soap, and i took a bit of the cheesecake , i almost threw everything out. What has happened to the old strawberry cheesecake on the menu? Why have they changed to this one? The manager apologise to us and offered another desserts, the macarons sliders. It looked very pretty and beautiful but we wonder how could we enjoy this so called desserts. This one too, has a very strong fragrant taste and i couldnt help but to wonder, have you changed your pastry chef? We finished the dinner with disastisfaction and we took a round to the restaurant and the live kitchen, this hotel really are in need of help. It is very much obvious you are lacking of staff as we could see only 2 service runner run from one section to another just to deliver the food, not once, not twice but more than 10th times. We sorely missed the environment we used to enjoy the previous year on our visits. And now we have nothing to remember but the disastisfaction feelings and the newly experienced we just faced.

Author: iti_94
Title: Good cake and coffee
Review: The coffee was good and it was big also we ordered caramel cheese cake which was lovely.The weather was good and we sat outside and enjoyed

Author: JonathanlolKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Midwest redneck experience
Review: This lady waitress refused to change our french fries to mash despite it being more expensive than the other dishes that offer mash potatoes. Is it so hard to twist an order a little? are they robots or something? it wasnt even a busy evening. Furthermore, the baby back ribs were extremely dry. When asked when was it made, the waiter simply says it is freshly made. When i asked another waiter, he said it is made in the morning. serving reheated food are we?? never again.

Author: Shammy17Kuala Lumpur
Title: Tasteless food!
Review: This place was recommended by some blogs so I decided to give it a try. It was an utter disappointment! I ordered Ayam Goreng Makko, Asam Pedas Fish, Mixed Vegetables and Sotong Masak Lemak with pineapples. The Asam Pedas fish was tasteless, it was neither sour (as claimed by its name 'asam') nor spicy (pedas). And for that, they charged a bomb! The sotong was full of coconut milk and I couldn't taste anything else. I really don't understand why this place is so hyped up. I have definitely tasted better nyonya food in other places around Malacca.

Author: SGK10Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Reasons not to dine in Miss Kwan's @ KLCC
Review: 1. Staff not friendly...3 staff chatting away behind counter and ignored customers and when called, lady approched rudely and the guy ignored me and was more interested withnhis smartphone...2.Forgot 1main dish and 1 drinks....dont like to fuss but it was only 2 dish and 3 drinks...and when asked, staff started to argue and reluctantly made my order and not even a apology......3. When complained, all staff started to show rudely attitude like thug....except for one lady who was the only one working and clearing table....the guy stood over the counter to see the floor....and guess what .....?..its the same counter that they prepare drinks....not even a smile...and all of them are foreigners that are working in Malaysia.....4. Being in the same Hospitality industry for more than 20 years..its sad and shameful that the Malaysian Warm Hospitality that we were proud of is fading away....

Author: M B
Title: Great for young people
Review: This is a great place for young people to gather. The coffee was just OK, but the music was good and it was obviously very popular. Get there early (6pm) to grab a table on Fridays and Saturdays when they have live music.

Author: TriStupe
Title: Bar and Pub Grub
Review: Want a quick bite? this is the place to be. Want a drink to while the time away while watching sports? Great place to be. A simple "bar" which offers full menu and choices of food to suit kids to adult.

Author: IshDewyn
Title: Excellent burgers!
Review: The burgers, excellent! I would also rather heartily recommend the chicken wings. And the drinks aren't too shabby either. ;OD

Author: riaankrugerauSydney, Australia
Title: Luck of the Irish ___
Review: First and foremost, I have to give Priti, the champion waitress from India, kudos for awesome service! Food is great, various drinks to choose from and the atmosphere is absolutely electric. I can highly recommend Healy Mac__ to anyone looking for a casual night out, and be sure to make a reservation for the Semi & Finals of the Rugby World Cup 2019.

Author: Jinhe LShenzhen, China
Title: Awful and embarrassing dinner

Author: Frank0870
Title: Food comes in a good quality...
Review: ...but service is very lousy. No __ood evening!_, no __hank you and good bye!_. Need to wait long time until they take your order without a smile in their faces. Delivery of drinks and food takes ages, even if the restaurant is almost empty.

Author: Puvaneswaran S
Title: Short staff
Review: Food is excellent....plesant enviroment. Need to increase staff during peak hours. One of the restaurant you should have come...

Author: joann_yeenMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Nice food , average service & atmosphere
Review: Wa Zen definitely is one of the Japanese restaurants that serve good food. Reserved for a table in April and the designated seat is in a darker area. Space to walk is limited and the dimmed lighting made the whole dinner time a little bit uncomfortable. Make sure you reserve your table before you come.Their curry rice is good!

Author: macaiwarKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Just plain average
Review: There was nothing exceptional that I experienced here. The quality of food was average. So was the service. It's my first experience at a Nobu. I was really surprised by the reality vs the reputation from the many comments I had read and heard about. They must be the exception rather than the norm. I would be very very surprised if this outlet was intended to be representative of its famous reputation.

Author: Kiara19Seattle, Washington
Title: Vegetarians beware!
Review: We used to rave about the food at Rock Bottom Melaka and were regular customers here right since the day it opened. The staff used to be friendly and provided good service as well. However, there seems to be a grave concern in the way the kitchen is functioning in this place. Yesterday I visited this place for lunch with a friend and being a vegetarian, I ordered the dishes I usually did here - Garlic Naan, Puri, Aloo bhojpuri, and a Paneer dish. We were almost done eating, when we were shocked to find a piece of meat in the vegetarian Aloo bhojpuri dish. We brought this to the notice of the staff, who immediately took the piece of meat with them, took it to the kitchen to talk to the cook I guess, then came back and apologised. We were so appalled by what had happened, however the damage was done and there was nothing that could be done to undo or reverse it. The damage control they tried to do was, they dint charge us for that ONE dish, but made us pay for the rest of the food. I am vegetarian for personal reasons, but can one imagine what would have happened to someone who was allergic to certain foods and the dietary requests were not implemented and they ended up in the hospital ?! If people were vegetarian for religious reasons, consuming meat like this would be a major transgression and offensive to their faith. This restaurant says they are halal, but who knows what is being done in the kitchen and what the customers are being served ? Who knows how many times this may have happened in the past and gone unnoticed by the patrons, especially since one cannot even see what they are being served or what they are eating considering the dim lighting in the evenings in this place. I will never visit this place again, since my trust in them is completely destroyed. Kitchen sanitation and food separation is so important in the restaurant business since customers place their blind trust that the food they are being served is clean and authentic (it should be what they say it is, for example, vegetarian or halal or sea-food free etc), and customers have no way of verifying it first hand. Let our experience serve as a warning to those who care for what they are being fed in this restaurant. Wishing them good luck to fix their kitchen and cook, but I am not taking anymore chances here.

Author: amyjellenCloghran, Ireland
Title: Average
Review: Food served fast, ordered pigs in blankets, and chicken wings for starters, which were both nice. Ordered burgers for dinner, neither of us were a fan. Staff were very quick to take our plates away, we were still chewing our food it was very average. I don't think I'd go back.

Author: alexahunter89Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Waitstaff/Management Need To Be Schooled on Customer Service!
Review: Their waitstaff is what__ wrong with this place. Appalling service. They hire foreign workers whom are not properly trained for a restaurant that caters to mostly middle to upper class patrons. We waited almost 30 mins for the food and then when we finally asked them to check on the food, they returned and told us that they forgot to put through the order WITHOUT even an apology. We left immediately. I could only expect the food to be equally as bad. First and last time!

Author: Poh Ming N
Title: It's Just Another Pizza Hut
Review:
If you loves Pizza, there's another Domino's Pizza at driving distance of 2KM away.

The menu is just same as all other Pizza Hut outlets and service is on par with others too.

There are many other restaurant choices inside the mall.

Author: nurincheeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Portion too small
Review: Never seen such a small portion of pho. Any other vietnam pho I have in many parts of the world is usually served in a big bowl with a full plate of fresh bean sprout and basil by the side. This one looks so pathetic.... ban MI portion is so small it looks more like an appetizer. Summer roll is dry and not fresh. If this is one of the top vietnam restaurant in jb. I feel sad for jb.

Author: 625jakewStaines, United Kingdom
Title: RATS, TERRIBLE FOOD, EXPENSIVE
Review: We decided to have lunch here and I wish we had gone hungry. The greeting from the staff was good and they made me laugh but unfortunately that__ where the pleasant experience ended. Food was terrible and over priced. Top it all off a rat was roaming the restaurant as if he was taking orders. Again though I have to mention how wonderful the staff were

Author: tudora380Slobozia, Romania
Title: If it's crowded, don't come in
Review: We had our order late, mixed up, partially fulfilled. You could see the staff was friendly, but they couldn't keep up with that many tables. They forgot our rice, a whole dish, a drink and we waited almost an hour. The food wasn't really good either.

Author: Geoffrey L
Title: Local foods for supper.
Review: Cheap local foods, late night vendor, friendly, serve beers and quiet place to have supper. Friendly and helpful staff is the selling point.

Author: Vic_hlh
Title: Overrated
Review: Me and my family go there at 29/1/2017. Queue up 45 minutes for dine in. They do not provide any vegetables that day due to not enough manpower. The chicken rice ball and asam fish are really disappointed. Any of the chicken rice stall at Selangor and WP area that I had, the taste is much more better than here. Feel that this is a place that for tourist only, local people might know the better place.

Author: Dave JNew Market, Alabama
Title: Overpriced for what you get
Review: Not a great buffet...at least not for someone with basically American tastes in food. The view was good, but in the middle of dinner, these people came by and disturbed what we hoped would be a romantic dinner together. They made us get up to take pictures, which they wanted to sell to us later at ridiculous prices. Personally, I find it offensive that I paid $65 per person for a dinner that was interrupted by someone trying to make money by selling me tourist-trap photos. They really need to get better entertainment...the duo singing and playing music was significantly less than impressive...They were so loud that my fiancÃ© and I could hardly hold a conversation...and they just weren't that good.

Author: Russ F
Title: Malaysia 2018
Review: Don't waste your time. Very hot, most stalls closed and smelly. We were looking for the one star michelin restaurant but it was closed? When we left here we found it had moved across the road. Ordered chicken curry. Very ordinary and full of bones!

Author: Christopher MSydney, Australia
Title: Tasty Nyonya food, and a peek inside the culture
Review: Don't know about Nyonya? Don't worry, by the time you've dined, and watched the dancing or other forms of entertainment (depending on time of day), you will understand the fusion of Chinese and Malay cultures.The food is the star. If you don't recognise, or can't choose, the staff were happy to guide you on an eating journey.During lunch and dinner, there is a small cultural display, which is pleasant without being overly long or detailed.

Author: 272ahmaduKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Over Priced Lunch Buffet!
Review: Really disappointed with the variety of foods. Not what like people have reviewed and recommended.Weird taste of roasted chicken and duck. Meat was hard. I love sushi but here lack of options, only salmon sashimi but no salmon sushi.It says "International Lunch Buffet", actual taste is local. Maybe localizing the taste. But even local foods, like the Ice Kacang fail so much all you can taste is water.The only few things I like is the oyster and the gravy lamb on the western section.I had quite few buffet foods served in hotel, this is very far from my expectation. There are other hotels serve slightly cheaper lunch buffet with much better taste and variety of foods!

Author: Leo DGlasgow, United Kingdom
Title: Average Food, Terrible Service
Review: Visited this restaurant for lunch with high expectations as per reviews, we got hit but an awful service and very average food!!! We ordered chicken satay as a starter and it was served almost raw inside, I then asked for it to be replaced but the supervisor lady was so rude and acted angrily, she took the plate to the kitchen to send back another one 30mn later!!! we also ordered Nasi lemak and it was the worst one we had in Malaysia...to top it up the bill was so pricey for the awful food and service we experienced!! we had to Lunch a second time somewhere else. Sorry Madam Kwan NEVER AGAIN!!

Author: AnnaKalraSingapore, Singapore
Title: Was closed for lunch
Review: We were highly recommended to visit this tapas bar. We scheduled it for our Sunday lunch (we had only 2 weekend days in Melaka). We can around 2 pm and the place was closed, they said "chef has not come".

Author: pooisze93
Title: Random drop off
Review: The surrounding and music are so relaxing. Good place to chill urself here with desserts ~. Matcha cheesecake is ok.

Author: Corky5788
Title: Great Night Out
Review: Excellent food, the steaks were cooked exactly as we asked. The vegetables were perfect, not over cooked. The staff is excellent and very friendly. It has a great atmosphere. What more could you ask for!

Author: alcoholicbananadrink
Title: Daylight Robbery!
Review: This place will charge you four times more than normal, and smile as they take your money.I can get a good Cendol outside for 4 Ringgit, one bowl of Cendol was 15.90!!! Coupled with the fact we did not ask for Sago but they added it to bump up the price. Had huge lumps of unappetising Sago floating in it, with very few beans or actual cendol inside it. Way, way overpriced and clearly capitalising on Malacca's Cendol reputation.Ordered 2 bowls of Laksa with chicken strips inside. Heaven help me, the stock was more bland than water. Asked for Chili paste to add more flavour, the owner refused saying that it already has been added in. The longer I ate the more I was thinking how drain water would be more appealing. Noodles also were undercooked and hard. Contrast this to another Laksa stall just down the road, where they are generous with their fish meat, prawns and add-ons. FOR A CHEAPER PRICE. In summary, this establishment is a tourist trap. Does not, repeat, does not reflect the true essence of Malacca Cuisine. Stay away from this place where the owners are wolves predating on tourists who don't know better.

Author: KabirKhan007
Title: Dinner
Review: One of KL's top Chinese restaurants. Fabulous ambiance, dedicated staff, Jane the manager was excellent! Huge vegetarian/vegan selection. Love it and will be back soon!

Author: Goh HJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Spicy sambal
Review: Should put up a simple signboard for identification. Just park your car by the road side. Good crowd business is good. Most customers come for the Nasi lemak. Overall it is ok with a bit spicy sambal which is nice to me. But nothing specifically exception.

Author: Dammie O
Title: Expensive!!!
Review:
I dont really like Asian Cuisine but I like the steamed fish(Siakap). In other branches I have been to its 49.90rm but its 59.50rm at the Gardens, almost 10rm difference I think thats absurd. 
Definitely never going back!!! Never!!!

Author: h_michikoDublin, Ireland
Title: Poor dish with expensive price
Review: The food here are very expensive. We don't have any issue paying expensive food, but it was not really up to our expectation to what was served. The menu need to be revised again. Also, when we went there, we were served uncooked chicken, the chef did came to us and apologize. The environment of this restaurant is very peaceful, to our surprise, we never bitten by mosquitoes!

Author: jeffo547Ipswich, Australia
Title: My Local
Review: I was working in Kuala Lumpur for a couple of years and the first thing I did was find a local watering hole. Someone recommended the Social and it became my local for two years. The staff were great and always remembered your drink of choice. They had a number of great dishes with Peking Duck being one of my favourites.

Author: 810yannickw
Title: looks nice but wasn't tasty
Review: Probably the worst chicken satay I had. The chicken from the chicken rice was ok but the rice was also not a success.

Author: idrus2015Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: a generous spread to choose from
Review: Restoran Hatinie is located in section 10 where the Blue Mosque of Selangor can be seen very clearly. It is a favorite haunt of Shah Alam residents especially for breakfast, and its nearest rival is Azura just round the corner. Hatinie has one of the most generous spread to choose from for breakfast: nasi dagang (east coast specialty rice taken with tuna curry), mee soto (soupy noodles with the mandatory begedil or potato cutlets), a host of lauk (fish, beef, squid cooked to accompany rice), plus sweet desserts such as bubur kacang (pea porridge) and pengat pisang (banana porridge). we opted for mihun soto (vermicelli soupy noodles), nasi dagang and i experimented with a cabbage dish cooked in white sauce on which i dumped a slice of omelette, fried beef in black soya sauce and chili sauce. dessert was pengat ubi (cassava porridge) and kueh ketayap (a green roll with sweet coconut filling. In all, it was a hearty breakfast outing especially with the morning drizzle making us hungrier than usual.only complaint is, unlike Azira's, the need to queue in order to pay before eating-not so good if one's stomach is crying for food. Recommended

Author: Winson CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Disgraced to Greyhound Bangkok , no quality control of the food....it was really bad!
Review: I have been to Greyhound Cafe in Bangkok numerous times, and I loved the food there, so when I got to try the Greyhound Cafe in KL, I was utterly disappointed with the quality of food there. It just tasted bad and not the same like what I had back in BKK. If you want to bring a famous brand to KL , please make sure the quality of the food is as good as the original. Do it right, and dont cut corners. It does give a bad name to the branding of Greyhound Cafe. I dont even mind the high price of the food if it is good but it was really bad. I hope the management could do something to ensure the quality of the food. Until then, I wont be stepping my foot in Greyhound KL anymore and also warn my friends not to go there too.

Author: 551erik
Title: Good experience very nice during sun down
Review: Very very helpful staff at the beach, every wish is their command, a lot of choice in food and drinks, happy hour and often live music. Qayyum is very kind.

Author: LittleCucu
Title: Good view of KLCC
Review: Leng zai Elvin Wong is too friendly! I can't resist his friendly! Best! Best view and best everything. You won't regret!

Author: ZylangKlang, Malaysia
Title: average
Review: the dim sum is good especially siew mai. but the customer service should be improved. one of the staff was hesitate to entertain me at first until my husband came in then she start to entertain us. you should treat your customer thoroughly despite what race they are. the rest is ok.

Author: Fearless819664
Title: Bad experience
Review: The food was good. Nothing special but overall ok. The staff on the other hand was probably one of the worse I saw in the last few years. Very pushy, serving the main course while still eating entry, etc..

Author: mahp107Singapore, Singapore
Title: Beyond disappointing: appalling service and terrible value-for-money
Review: The service was the worst I have experienced in any restaurant anywhere in the world. I do not say this lightly. It wasn't merely inconvenient, "a bit busy" or "part of the atmosphere". It was so deeply disorganized, disinterested and rude that it left us, and the diners at the tables around us, looking at each other, from table to table, in complete disbelief.We arrived at around 8pm. Strangely there were no staff to show us to our seats. We made efforts to get the attention of passing staff for 5 minutes but they had no interest at all in showing us to our seats and seemed to deliberately ignore us. We had to venture as far as the kitchen and physically block a waiter's path before we were acknowledged and grudgingly shown to a nearby table.Menus followed 10 minutes later. Having made our choice, vigorous waving for some 15 minutes secured us a rushed 20-second slot with the busy staff to place our order.Our earlier trip to the kitchen proved to be one that had to berepeated on no less than three occasions throughout the night. The staff were unwilling to make eye contact or respond to our requests to deliver our drinks, which arrived 40 minutes after the first main course.We were not alone. A steady stream of customers seemed to make their way to the kitchen, in search of their waiter, the chef, the manager, someone, anyone, who'd be willing to deliver their food or even let them pay the bill. One poor man stood there for a few minutes and after numerous staff had walked past him he gave up hope and placed a pile of notes under a nearby bottle of kitchen spray. I doubt it included a tip.The food was ok but basically very average and didn't even come close for making up for the service.I understand that restaurants can be busy (even on a Sunday night). But service like this shows such a complete lack of respect and, frankly, of basic decency, that it left us with a very unpleasant aftertaste.The whole experience was beyond disappointing.

Author: apkusa
Title: Great Atmosphere, Great Food
Review: Ii have come here several times for lunch when in town.  Great food, true to culture.  Highly recommend for an elegant meal.  Crisp linens, excellent service.....  don't miss this gem in KL.

Author: smacklsmJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: 10% poor service charge
Review: No comment about the food as they are hotpot meals. But the issue is they don't practice safety concerns. The hotpot was not placed to the convenience of the diners and there weren't any insulated materials/cloths in which to move the hotpot. It was an uncomfortable lunch. On top of that, I suppose the management didn't train the waiter/waitress to oversee the needs of the diners. All of them were glued to their smartphones. To our dismay, we had to pay 10% service charge just for bringing food to our table.

Author: Henry HKuching, Malaysia
Title: Amazing
Review: We went to this restaurant for lunch with a group of ten. The speed of the order taking and delivery was fast. They provided us with some good suggestions on local dishes to try. The sea food was fresh and tasted great. They have a great assortment of wines from all over the world. The fresh fruit juices are a treat. I recommend to try the sour sop juice of which it has been said it cures cancer. No parking fees

Author: Keongsoh
Title: No MSG!!!
Review: One of the EXTREMELY short list of restaurants in Malaysia that doesn't use Ajinomoto (MSG) to create great taste. Enough said.

Author: WinnieW785
Title: Nothing special
Review: Too crowded. Bad Service. Staff there was not polite. Food not nice. Not recommended for family with childs. surrounding hygiene was not good.

Author: tony12cuKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very Good BKT in KL
Review: One of the best BKT this side of town, unless you want to go to Klang.The price is on par with the rest of the BKTs in town. The restaurant could do with a cleanup, the grease spots and stain marks are not reflecting well on this restaurant.Parking is a real pain, but there are some spots around the back, or you can park in Dynasty hotel next to it.

Author: Vishnu407Seremban District, Malaysia
Title: My experience in colonial cafe
Review: Firstly I must mention that I dined here on august 3rd 2014 wt 7 friends. The pricing on the menu was ridiculously expensive,and the service was rubbish, the waiters got the orders mixed up and the food, hmmm not impressive. I highly recommend 'not' trying the chicken chop or chicken rice. They are both villainously horrible in their own way, I must say that they mentioned that the recipe had survive through the test of time but it rightfully belongs in a trash can. The ambiance is nice but that's the only positive comment I can come up with.perhaps afternoon tea may be a better deal but lunch definitely would be an mistake.

Author: HughwilliamKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: High Price but Poor Service
Review: Waited 45 minutes for 2 drinks even though the place did not seem overly busy while the waiter keep playing with his smartphone. At last, we cancelled the rest of our order. When we were leaving, we spent another 15 minutes to receive the bill. Avoid this place if ypu don't want to spoil your holiday.

Author: pianocelloShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: In KLCC
Review: If this was a no-frills restaurant in a suburban neighbourhood charging average prices, I'd give this an excellent review. Service was fast and food was actually decent. However this place promotes itself as a high - class restaurant so it's just average. The decor is average. For the price, you would expect something spectacular not something you can find in a good open air Thai restaurant in the streets. While the rice and noodle dishes are not too expensive, the drinks and desert is too expensive.

Author: Carlos D
Title: Terrible mexican food.
Review: I went with my wife to Fresca Mexican kitchen on May Friday 13th and ordered two simple dishes. Guasacaca chips, and chicken tacos.-The guasacaca and chips, had two problems: 1) The chips were too oily and 2) the Guasacaca was flavorless, they should call it instead smash avocado (No salt lemon, onion, tomato.. NOTHING!!). - The chicken Tacos: I was expecting when I order... a traditional Chicken taco, instead I got what looked like a fried spring roll filled with chicken. I am very open, to food interpretations, but this was a terrible one, very oily and the chicken was completely dry and flavorless!Very dissappointed with the food they served.On the bright side I can say that their beers are pretty cold and the place is nicely decorated.Summary: Good to grab a beer but don't order any food!!

Author: Jamie O
Title: Terrible Ventilation and Arrogant Service
Review:
Arrogant service from the manager. Very! 

Ventilation is bad with so much of halogen lightings not balanced with proper ventilation. Halogen lights are non environmental friendly anymore. 

Horrible!

Author: Chai E
Title: Bad experience
Review: Please bring back the old junk !!! Miss the good old days when the junk are started , when the food is good and services is awesome. But now too commericalize. The quality really can't compare with last time

Author: Z M
Title: delicious
Review: They offer variety of delicious meals. The quality good. Taste good. Amount of the food good. place is ok. about the negative points I can only refer to the prices which are a bit high and in pick hours the place is compact.

Author: dkiat
Title: Standards dropped (beef noodles)
Review: Been going here for more than 15 years as I love their beef noodles. Was disappointed with the recent visit as the broth lack flavor. Won__ be back for a long, long time.

Author: JerryThirteen
Title: Chendol ?  ____
Review:
The chendol we eaten there is really bad. Plenty of ice shavings and some red beans + green gelatin jelly. Is that all ?It tasted so mild. Why? 

The quality of the food there obviously has gone south.
:(

Author: quahy2015
Title: Delicious laksa and cendols!
Review:
I love the laksa and cendols!
a must visit and i think it's the best so far!

the laksa is full of flavours and spicy..just love it.

Author: Shruthi CCanberra, Australia
Title: Excellent
Review: We stayed at CDM for 6 nights and had breakfast, lunch and dinner at La Sal for most of our stay days. We loved everything and could not fault it. Our favourite was prawn dish which they served with mango and avocado (cannot remember exact name) and whole fish served with rice, pappadum and salad. We also had tempura prawns, tandoori chicken skewers, fresh bread served with hummus, Daiquiri cocktail was amazing. For breakfast we had malay omelette, Mediterranean omelette, yoghurt with fruit, their freshly made breads, chocolate croissant, freshly cut fruits and juice.I would like to mention that if you do get a chance try La Luna degustation because this was a stand out for us.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: ChanwengcheongCyberjaya, Malaysia
Title: Invigorating and Inviting
Review: What__ not to love? Open spaces, relaxing atmosphere, you are forgiven to think it__ nestled on a beach front if not for the honking of the cars. This is referring to The Social in Bangsar. Lovely spot to have a few bevvies. Food is alright and waiting staffs are ok. And oh, Guinness is on tap. More than justified!!

Author: Poh Ming NJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Much more to improve!
Review: This should be the worst hotel restaurant I've ever been and this was the 1st visit there. The salad served after the main dishes. No water given until requested. Even the drinks coupled is not provided.The dishes served were not heated at all and took more than half an hour to serve (there's only 1 more table after us), the restaurant is not crowded at all, maybe 2 to 3 tables but have finished the lunch.We went to the restaurant because it's my birthday and wife's suggestion to try out. Totally disappointed. I hope the hotel could be improved, the tourism is badly hit and I supposed the service should be top notch with current situation. Maybe the sentiment now is not good but since it's in the service line, buckle up!

Author: shaunlisle90
Title: Fantastic little street bar with great staff
Review: Found this little cute bar while exploring. Comes alive at night with live music and a great happy hour. Reasonably priced drinks and great vibe. Lovely decorated throughout. Been here for the last 3 nights, highly recommend for a few evening beers in Penang ______

Author: ahleongsanSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good and Interesting dishes
Review: We had roast duck porridge, fried egg with fungus, emperor vegetables and steamed fish. All are well cooked and the outstanding dish is the fried egg with fungus. Tasted like a local fried rice dish but fragrant. The porridge is tasty and the roast duck meat is just right for the porridge. Will be back when we go Malacca again.

Author: jeffchia88Singapore, Singapore
Title: The Peranakan Food was not fantastic but it was Crowded.
Review: We were quite surprised that we had to book a place and it was packed full as we understand that if you don't book you will not get a table.As a fourth generation Peranakan, who loved eating and cooking Peranakan food I am always keen to try Peranakan food. Unfortunately, very few restaurants have met my expected standards although Have eaten a very good one in Penang recommend by a prominent Peranakan lady Aunty Annie from the Peranakan museum. There are a couple of good ones in Singapore but some have left the cooking to Filipino cooks who cannot cook Peranakan food for lack of skill as Peranakan food requires skill and taste and not exact measurements as the flavours change with the quality of and taste from the ingredient bought the day__ cooking.The ambience and decor is nice at the restaurant displaying lots of Peranakan wares.The service was good with busy Amy supervising. We had ordered Hee Peow Soup - Bad choice! Each of us had a fishball, a quail egg and some fish Maw, this should be rich soup with prawns, different kinds of fish cakes, meat balls and meat. The broth was not at all rich.The Ikan Gerang Asam was sugar sweet. Ayam Buah Keluak was also sugar sweet and the Buah Keluak meat were stuck in the shell and required a lot of digging to get the meat of the Buah Keluak out. This dish is a normal highlight of a Peranakan but it was real disappointment served here.Bendi Kukus was so much different from that shown in the menu. In the menu it looked like Dried spicy prawn toppings but it was served with Sambal Chinchaluk. The Chap Chye was just like stirred fried cabbage - terrible disappointing, this dish is normally a stewed vegetable with shiitake mushroom, black fungus, dried bean curd, carrots, small slices pork belly, prawns in a broth made with fermented soya bean paste. This dish is a complete wash out better called stir fried vegetable to better meet the expectation of an ordered dish.We note that this was porkless restuarant and the likely result of the taste of the food. Peranakan food is not tasty without pork.Dishes like Liver roll or Goh Hian typical Peranakan dish were not served.The Cendol dessert was far from satisfactory as it was fairly diluted and did not have the rich taste of coconut milk with Gula Melaka.

Author: 81scottyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average
Review: With so many restaurants to choose from in and around KL, this TGI's did not set the world on fire. Staff could have done with some 'real' customer service training rather than the pretend niceness that they probably got off Google. Got a few orders wrong and had no idea how to apologise.

Author: ian_the_gripThornton Heath, United Kingdom
Title: Stunning setting, but pricey.
Review: We took three lifts up to the 57th floor of Petronas 3 to be confronted by an amazing nighttime view of Kuala Lumpur and the petronas towers. It was stunning. We went through to the bar which served all kinds of beverages, but was slightly seedy. Very loud music considering nobody was dancing. A few single older gentleman sat around.We were then lead through to the restaurant where the service was, I have to say impeccable. The food was quite expensive but really good. Portion sizes were small but all the food tasted spectacular. Wine was very overpriced and the service of the wine was a little forced. Service was very formal which I don't think helped. It was difficult to relax. All in all though and worthwhile visit due to the setting. Would recommend a visit to the bar before eating as the view is incredible.

Author: harper287Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great food but CS dismal
Review: This used to be a local haunt of mine. There was fantastic customer service with a Scottish man running the front of house. I understand he has now moved on and the customer service has constantly dropped and declined since then. (Seriously every time I go back it is worse) The service is slow at best - which I am not sure why as they never seem to be super busy (after a table of 5 left we where the only ones there). We waiting for over 35 - 40 minutes for our meals. The plate is plonked down and then the team wander back inside to play on their phones. The food is great. We really enjoying their twists on the Bao (however their fried chicken one which was the best has not made their new menu). The price point is very reasonable for the quality of food it is just the CS that lets it down so badly. When we left to pay no one asked how was our meal, did you enjoy the food. There was a Chinese girl playing on her phone and had 0 interest in serving us. The other two staff a women had 0 interest in being at work and was busy chatting and giggling with her co-worker. The better was the Indian man who was more customer focused. Ugh this place is so frustrating - if you just sorted out your service you would be getting a 5 star review. PLEASE PLEASE sort out your CS!!

Author: vivienatengKuching, Malaysia
Title: reunion of ex colleagues
Review: 4 of us ordered avacado salmon rice (replaced by mash potato this include very nice presentation of the dish with beans), warm potato salad, chicken chop, oglio and salad with chicken. delicious.enjoyed our time from 7.30 pm to 10 pm. the people at the next table are very friendly so are the staff.

Author: carefulhowyouserve
Title: Neat and cozy
Review:
Nice cozy restaurant /bar on the end of Cenang beach if you are looking for a peaceful sunset drink or dinner. Great view great service and reasonable pricing. 

Its a great getaway from the crowds on Cenang.

Author: DrZeeCanada
Title: A covered bazaar for affordable shopping
Review: The feeling of walking under a covered roof when raining and bargaining with the street vendors is appealing and enjoyable.

Author: zoem882London, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely Durian puffs
Review: There is obviously a lot of interest generated for this place because of the trip advisor reviews, with lots of tourists seeking it out to taste the puffs. As a durian lover I was sceptical, as many 'durian flavoured' products do not tend to compare to the real thing. I was pleasantly surprised with how beautifully flavoured the inside of these puffs were. The texture is very close to durian, without being too heavy. The pastry is light and airy.A great discovery, I went back everyday of my stay in Melaka to have my daily fix.

Author: timeway
Title: DELICIOUS DINNER AND DRINKS !
Review: I would like to say thank you to Gedeon the manager for the great service and recommandations, the menu was excellent and the cocktails delicious. Very nice place for dinner.

Author: SleepsInCatPajamas
Title: nice seafood, good price
Review: The place serves nice seafood. with good price too.but the environment wise, some may not like it as it is a bit dirty. drains are always not far away from you.there's a lot of restaurant inside, but only few that is worth the visit. good thing about this is there's lot of car park space available.

Title: Don't get the hype? Greasy & dry.
Review: Good points first... the view is beautiful and the bar looks good and modern. Live music goes down well. Staff were smiling.Bad points... We wanted to enjoy our last night in Langkawi somewhere with great reviews so we could have a special final meal. This place seemed a winner. We arrived early, 6ish, and ordered chicken satay, chicken wings, fries and wedges. The portion sizes were big, we could easily have shared the fries/wedges if we'd known, but the quality was poor. There was no way the chicken satay was cooked fresh for us, it was dry and very hard to get off the sticks, even with our teeth. None of the food was piping hot when it came out which confirmed this to us. The wedges were greasy, we both really needed to wash our hands afterwards. The food also comes out with clingfilm wrap all over it which the staff have to take time carefully unwrapping. We were suspicious of the reason for this - never seen that before!! Also, at a time when the world is reducing its use of single use plastic, we did not think this was good to see unless there was a justifiable excuse. All in all, a huge disappointment on our last night.

Author: robkazandyPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Worst experience in a restaurant!
Review: 1.5 hour wait for food. Understaffed. Manager disappeared after staff couldn't cope. 6 of us ordered and all got food at varying times. Definitely not worth the wait! Showdown with staff member who said that this was "Malaysian Service" but as we said can't tar people with the same brush and that gives all Malaysian service a bad name, which definitely isn't true. Ordered drinks and beer was flat. Our friends's food came and it looked like it had been scraped from a plate that was already finished with from someone else. Served everyone around us and kept telling them we'd arrived before the people they were serving. Total chaos. Won't ever be returning and if anyone does go in the near future, take sandwiches whilst you're waiting for your meal to arrive!!!
Restaurant: El Toro Langkawi - Mexican Bar & Grill

Author: Polo_and_Marco
Title: Happy hour cold beers
Review:
We grab a couple of cold beers here to give it a try as they were showing the rugby and we got a seat. 

Service was pushy as it seems to be in all the bar along this street. 

There was free wifi.

Author: HighadventurerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Over rated and not worth the money you pay
Review: Used to like their traditional dishes but the standard has fallen sharplyThe Fatt put for rm30 is not worth the ingredients that are in nor is the fish head for Rm 69 .We also ordered the wantan noodle which came with fish ball and roast pork . Very bland.Overall, not value for money and you are better off eating the same dishes in your neighbourhood tai chow (eatery)

Author: Prazanna L
Title: Worst service ever..
Review: Service is very slow.. we waiting one hour for our food to arrive.. i will never recomand anyone to go to this place..

Author: Gail BMonmouth Beach, New Jersey
Title: Place is not what it use to be..
Review: I have been here 3 times in the last 12 months, and this place is terrible now. The fish and chips were previously excellent... Now the dish is terrible, the oil is overused, the fish comes out mushy and tasting a bit old in the batter, and the chips are soaked in oil and not crispy. And the portion of fish is small when it was previously large. Such a disappointment because I previously had given this spot 5 stars, but it's just Poor now, don't bother going until they change their ways! Get the old manager back, because this new manager id ruining the food!

Author: Sally WSunshine Beach, Australia
Title: sally
Review: We went to Shook on Monday night.The bar and service were very good but that's where it ended.Kitchen staff were apathetic and their hands and fingers were all over the food as they prepared. If kitchen is on display to public they should not be messing about..eating the food and talking on their phones!Calamari was flowery...too much flour in batter.... very ordinary.Wine list was expensive and over the top.This place is at risk of becoming another shopping mall food outlet.Would not recommend on a week night.

Author: Michael1052Armidale, Australia
Title: Nice spot to take a break from the market
Review: We stopped in here a few times, and in general, I can say it was quite pleasant. Their location is excellent, and the service is friendly and helpful. We tried their iced coffee drinks which were fine, except of course for that ubiquitous scourge of iced drinks all over Malaysia - filling the glass with ice, so you get precious little substance to your drink. So long as you specify 'small ice' you should be OK.We also sampled their pastries - pie and pastie. Nice try at Western food, but as usual, they just don't get it. Nonetheless, acknowledging that beforehand, we were not unpleased with the offering. But when I saw the cakes, my stomach heaved a bilious wave - cakes are definitely not an Asian thing, and God knows what they put in these weird things they sell, aside from copious sugar, it certainly isn't what a Western person would expect. Chinese tourists should be fine with them, as I notice they seem to be quite fond of the sickly sweet in much of their interests.So by all means, if you can't take the great local restaurant right outside the markets front entrance, by all means, I can recommend Secret Recipe for an AC drink and snack.

Author: E_ng1972
Title: Nancy__ Kitchen
Review: First time to Nancy__. Made reservation hence don__ hv to queue.  Food is a little ordinary.  Ordered our fav Petai Udang but was disappointed as there were v few petai. Chendol is not as wat we have expected too. __

Author: N9512DJstuartm
Title: Very good food but
Review: Really disappointed that the toilets were out of action, for a restaurant like this, this should not be the case. but staff and food was tasty.

Author: RemligWestern Australia
Title: You can't judge the food in a restauraunt by its location
Review: Secret Recipe Central Market is but one of many eating places in the Markets. I selected it from the many mainly on my experiences in other cafes' of the same franchise.True it is smaller than others, has basic furnishing and has minimal staff but I found the standard of food on offer and the friendly attitude of staff to be the same as any where else in the franchise. Don't let the location put you off.

Author: H9501ZMrosea
Title: worst service ever seen
Review: Since the patron were not allowed to dine in, my family and I was waiting for a long time to place an order to take a away. There were many assistance hanging around but refuse to assist the patrons. Most of them are not friendly at all. They give you the impression that you are troubling them. We will never go to this place ever again..

Author: CynfulwordsKuching, Malaysia
Title: Excellent If You Know What to Order
Review: This place has a wide variety in the menu, so your experience of it falls to know what to order. The roast duck and roasted pork belly are superb. This is all I ever order when I go. So do NOT miss this. There are a few other good things on the menu. The roast chicken is not bad. The tofu too. It's a Hong Kong style eatery, so expect a lot of din, throngs of people during lunch hour and very typical Chinese style busyness. Not the place to talk business in privacy, but great experience for good old fashioned Asian eating.

Author: Hui-Hui PWinterberg, Germany
Title: Disappointing...
Review: We passed by by accident while visiting China Town. It's full with tourists, and perhaps it has been good was... We were unlucky... The nyoyna chicken rendang was sour, and would have made us sick if we didn't returned it to the kitchen... Instead we got the beef rendang, which didn't even got close to a real rendang. The beef was tough and not falling apart as it should be, next it tasted as if the had some beef tausi (black bean sauce) left-over, were they poured some rendang sauce over it... Nothing like normal Indonesian rendang or real authentic rendang as we had at madam Kwan's later that they when out Malay friend took us out for real Malay food..Service was extremely slow, but I've noticed that's quite normal here...The pie hats were nice though and the decor of the restaurant as well.

Author: cher1010Singapore, Singapore
Title: Overrated
Review: Ambience was average. Food was nothing great. Tandoori pizza - disappointed that the tandoori pieces were absent. Just chunks of chicken and some sausage looking meatChicken chop - oily and spicy sauce didnt go wellChicken swarma - too dryLamb with saffron rice - lamb was too salty Shisha was good though. Its place you can go ONCe just for the view while you shisha and chill with friends. Thats abt all.

Author: Mimi KKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Ramadan buffet
Review: My only gripe with the food serve was especially the meat section , the meat served was cold and it was very difficult to eat. They have some good varieties to showcase the malaysian cuisine but unfortunately most of the food was barely tasted because it just too cold. To be fair, the restaurant manager and his staff are first class, they are good in their job and I actually felt they did very well, their genuine warmth in serving their customers was well worth a mention.

Author: PriscillayeeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice place to unwind
Review: This is a nice Cafe that is near the Concubine lane in Ipoh. It's a cozy place to have some food and enjoy your afternoon tea relaxing. The service is really good and their food is pretty sumptuous too. Their afternoon tea for two is really worth trying. The food provided can feed up to 4 persons and it comes with 2 pots (note : not cups) of either tea or coffee. It's RM58 excluding taxes. Their chocolate truffles are really good, not sweet but just the ones that I looked for when eating chocolates.I would recommend this place to have an enjoyable time in the hot afternoon.

Author: Daniel J
Title: Terrible service and average food, veggies were great
Review: Very convenient If your staying at the Sheraton Imperial Hotel. But if it's reasonable food your after don't bother. The Indian waiter lacked even basic understanding speaking English which did not help. The mains were all delivered at different times and the quality of the food was poor. On a good note the veggies were probably the most freshest I have had since I have been in KL. Wouldn't go back or recommend this place to anyone.

Author: eirikl2016
Title: normal italian restaurant which is budget friendly
Review: The pizza is good, but the pasta is so-so. Service is quite lousy, with most staff is unattentive. Thanks

Author: AnggunLim92
Title: TASTLESS
Review: Your spaghetti carbonara was tasteless. Sorry. I__ a fan of carbonara but sadly yours is the worst so far.

Author: DhennverNg
Title: Not quite impressed
Review: Came to know about this place from social media. So we decided to try the mama tom yum but it was far from satisfactory and expensive for such a small portion. They have kids menu... Kids eat for free. The ambience was cosy and comfortable.

Author: EatherepleaseFlorida
Title: Upscale Indian
Review: We had a great meal here. My husband is Indian so we are used to eating Indian food. Everything was good. Not spicy but still flavorful. They have free table water. Service was decent and the building is nice and clean. They have a full bar.

Author: 914faraha
Title: Definitely recommend this place
Review: visited this restaurant a couple of times in my visit to kuala lumpur. food was always good as well as the shisha ____. would definitely recommend this place for people who like shisha and lebanese food. service is slow when the restaurant is packed.

Author: JamieS781Aberdeen, United Kingdom
Title: Great Place - But avoid Lim Kee stall
Review: Our usual place Meen Kee (10 out of 10) was closed for Chinese New Year so used the next stall Lim Kee. Waited 40 minutes after our order before leaving. Paid for our beer to a rude, fat lady who shouted abuse at us including our 6 year old daughter. Place was half full so I did not understand why ours and other peoples food had been taking so long. Never got to taste the food - hence the poor rating.

Author: FaizalP61Sungai Buloh, Malaysia
Title: Best Steak and Cake
Review: Was here for family birthday dinner. On first floor of Bangsar Shopping Centre. Second time in a week. Best Steak i have had in Malaysia. The lamb cutlets are also great. The service is attentive and helpful. The cakes and coffee are great and servings large.

Author: Louly TCalgary, Canada
Title: Food is mediocre at best
Review: On my first day at Batu Ferringhi, I decided to have dinner at Enca Cafe as it was right across the street from my hotel. Needless to say, I was very disappointed with the food here. I ordered tandoori chicken that came with __alads_ and a couple of chutneys and naan, mango juice, and veggie raita. Don__ even bother with the mango juice unless you like drinking sour mango juice. Tandoori chicken clearly had food colouring in it, tasted ok but nothing to write home about! The __alads_ that it came with was a tiny portion of raw white and purple onions and shredded carrots. Naan was not fresh, it came cold not even heated up! Raita was a completely different story as I__ very particular about my raita! How could you mess up raita?! It came very thick almost Greek yogurt texture and sweet???!!!! I asked the waiter if it had sugar, he said yes so I gave it back to him, asked him to fix the sweetness and the thickness. He took it back, disappeared for 5 mins, and brought me back the same raita! He fixed absolutely nothing! I was very disappointed not just with the food but with the service as well! I also killed two bugs, one was on the table making its way to my plate, the other on my elbow.

Author: ANSingaporeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Ate at the Hilton Buffet
Review: My extended family and I had a celebratory dinner at the Hilton Buffet on a Saturday night at approx RM200 per person amd it was a disappointing experience. This was my 3rd visit over the last few years and where it was kinda ok before with sone nice highlights.. ... It has descended to really disappointing standards. I stay at many hotels and Hilton are usually on the top of my list of favorites.. But the Hilton KL failed this time miserably. There was NO parking available even for Valet services! I had to park at Aloft with NO assistance or directions from the hotel staff.. Who apoligised very sincerely but gave no advice more than... 'you must park outside'. he could have been better prepared with some guidance if this was an expected situation on busy nights.. Back to the buffet which was popular enough to enforce a 2 seating rule that night. We took the later seating at 8.30pm and it was HORRID. Food was running out and not replaced promptly, food quality was very average, the hot pasta station that previously made fresh pasta for you on the spot (a small highlight for me) ... was closed only leaving large servings of quickly soggy pasta for guests. For a premium price at a premium brand, there are much better options in KL. Until the Hilton picks up their standards, GO ELSEWHERE!

Author: RichardDeeJR
Title: Authentic Malaysian Food
Review: I've been told that this cuisine hails from the state of Melacca, the origin of nyonya cooking. We arrived just in time for lunch and the place seems packed. Luckily there was still a vacant table. Thanks to the friedly staff who cleared our table in a second.The food here is definitely worth mentioning as they were excellent. The flavor and aroma that came out from our Asam Curry was out of this world! Will recommend to friends.

Author: Khaled M
Title: Terrible food, terrible food & terrible prices
Review: As an honest Tripadvisor review, I post more positive reviews than negative, however my recent dining experience at The Texas BBQ at Publika was a disaster. A friend booked us in based on the high recommendation of one of their friends. Service was incredibly inept and slow. Some orders were wrong, some were staggered beyond belief. The onion loaf that we ordered to share ended up being a big plate of onion rings (the waitress said the picture in the menu was for guidance only... FIRST RED FLAG!). As the evening progressed we witnessed what can only be described as 'The Muppet Show - Live on Stage!' as more botched orders arrived with staff who clearly had no idea what they were doing. Food (especially grilled meats) was way below the expected level. My friend ordered a medium-rare ribeye and received a thin (about 1cm thick) cut of grey soggy meat that looked like it has been cooked in a microwave (not a grill mark in sight!0. It was sent back only to be replaced with an equally soggy piece of grey meat that was red in the middle. Cost was about RM 80+++ The meat was cut way too thin and had no signs of ever being near a grill. Another friend had lamb chops, which must have been harvested from the most anorexic lamb in history. The menu said it came with side of potatoes and carrots. When my friend received their emaciated lamb chops (RM 75) and a few potatoes, they enquired about the carrots. 10 minutes later a small sauce bowl with four chunks of cold carrots (they were hot on the outside and cold and hard on the inside... clearly microwaved) were dumped at her side. The smoked/bbq meats were not nice at all. Some drinks took a quarter of an hour to arrive and cocktails were very weak. The only saving grace is the view, but that does not make it worth it. The location is also quite hard to find. I do not ever wish any restaurant bad fortune, but the Texas BBQ @ Publika has got a long way to go before it can consider itself to be a decent restaurant that commands the outrageous prices that it does.

Author: Nicole S
Title: Yummy pizza
Review: Was very surprised to find this little place on the corner! Really good pizza, cooked to perfection in a pizza oven. My boyfriend had the Greek salad and was equally impressed. Best westernised meal in Malaysia.

Author: Onthego28Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Awful food for high prices
Review: I visited this restaurant for the first time for Sunday lunch. There were 3 of us and we ordered five dishes plus a dessert. Just to cut the story short, not a single dish was up to average standard in terms of flavor and portion. I can accept if one or two dishes out of five weren't up to scratch but for all of them to be poor is saying conclusively how inferior the quality of cooking is. On top of this, the food came heavily loaded with MSG, which both me and my wife, who ate with me, were sensitive too. We felt the effects of MSG during the whole afternoon. And the cost of this meal (RM200) for three was very expensive considering the substandard food we had been served (RM15 for a small coconut fruit was explotative I would think). I certainly won't be returning.

Author: ericexploreshotelsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lunch Over Dinner
Review: One buffet in town I really prefer the lunch over dinner. Usually dinners are the ones to go to. But here at Contango, the lunch is extremely amazing. The choices are great and huge spread! The most popular choices are the Japanese options. I personally love the Indian options. And the coffees are just mind blowing. And again, I wished the glasses used are bigger. But I am just being picky.

Author: wtm55Kuching, Malaysia
Title: Very Dissapointed
Review: Decided to give Magenta a go after receiving good comments for this place. No doubt the setting for the ambiance was good but the service and food was very disappointing. There was not a lot of people in the restaurant, only 3 tables occupied and yet the food came real slow. Portion of food was smaller than usual for the price you had to pay. For a western place, I will only rate it at 3 from a scale of 1 to 10.

Author: dianavY9115ZA
Title: AVERAGE food__
Review: Very average food, duck was hard, I had a problem cut it. Table in the middle of room overlooking on the wall and escape corridor. The best was chocolate praline at the end. Nothing special, no more! The quality of food doesn__ match the price.the request for a table With a view was not met even though was made in advance. Poor food and a very poor ambience in the restaurant

Author: stefaniecstPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Well worth lunch bento
Review: Been many years since I last came here. Nothing much has change. Still casual homely Japanese restaurant First time trying their lunch set. Very worth and not overpriced. The sashimi set that I order was fresh with sweet juicy ebi, but the kampachi are just average, not the kind that melts in my mouthThe additional order of tuna sashimi are thick and juicy, but sashimi salmon are cut very thin though. Total bill for 5adults are rm300 plus with 5 lunch sets. Do come here for some value lunch set. Service are prompt as usual

Author: merk_klPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Go elsewhere..
Review: This place is one of the many restaurants serving chicken rice, bean sprouts etc. around this area. As my regular place is not open during these times, my family and I decided to try this place. What a mistake this was! The chicken is tough, rice is soggy, beansprouts is super undercooked and worst of all the (lack of) service and (lack of) SOP adherence. the restaurant doesnt check on the patrons's vaccination status, MySJ checkins or temperature (I had to make it a point to show it to them!) And the worst is the waiters wear their masks over the mouth and under their chin only. One of the waiters actually smoked while serving food! Will I be back to this so-called famous restaurant? Definitely no! A touristy place at best.

Author: lindypicotin01
Title: Horrible experience
Review:
Had a breakfast noodle soup and unable to swallow the awful smelly soup.
Unable to forget the taste of it until today!

Author: Michael C
Title: Staff is not attentive & sensitive
Review: Me & my friends are going for some drinks & snacks that night,,we enjoy a lot but something happen when we try to call the attention of your staff he didnt recognize us that was so terrible & disgusting ; ( when we found out he was using his cellphone all the time,sorry for him his name was Jack,,did your manager tolerate him during his duty its ok to use phone during his duty in your resto bar?,only him is busy using his celphone,,but thank you also for the girls who recognize us for taking our needs that time,,we think we never back again we pay for the services that your company rendered to us as a customer..be sensitive & attentive thats the only thing we need as a customer...

Author: Markm1972Ashford, United Kingdom
Title: Monday evening
Review: Went on a Monday evening and absolutely no atmosphere. Food was average and for Malaysia very expensive. Portions were very big though.

Author: MaxCX1
Title: Enjoyable
Review: Went with family. Service polite and efficient, had beef and lamb ribs. Serving sizes are relatively small for the prices charged.

Author: Jack101213Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Patience and good Wantan Noodles will come.
Review: As a kid, my dad used to bring me to Ho Seng Kee when they were operating in Johor Bahru town at Jalan Meldrum. That was more than 45 years ago. Now, I still go with my dad and also my family to their present location. In the old days we had to wait quite a while and fast forward to present, the wait is still the same but a bit longer. Don't eat there If you are in a rush otherwise it is worth the wait. Personally, I can say that they serve one of the best wantan noodles around. The customer service is really something. The owner is busy preparing the noodles non stop and yet he makes an effort to greet and thank customers for patronizing his business. Just like his dad when he was running the business back in the old days!

Author: Sileefoodcritics
Title: Chocolate soufflÃ©
Review: The dark chocolate ice cream tastes good. The portion is a bit too filling for two person. The soufflÃ© is warm and eggy taste. Goodncombination with the fruits. The strawberry balance the sweet taste of the whole soufflÃ©. Worth a try I can say.

Author: Sumayah50
Title: Good
Review:
We tried the lava cake, crepe & cappuccino they were good
The waitress was a bit on a hurry but she was nice

Author: Natalie_craig01Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Delicious!!!!
Review: We__e been in Malaysia for 10 days already and have had a variety of great food but this place has by far been our favorite!! We__e been in Langkawi for 2 days and have come for dinner twice already! The meat is juicy and well prepared with spices and the salad is both beautiful and delicious!!!! We__e had the mixed grill, fish, and lamb burger all of which we loved. The watermelon lychee juice was so well presented and thirst quenching as well! The staff are all super friendly and can help you make the best choice if you can__ decide. Will definitely be back again!!!

Author: Z3255FDalexandrebJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Called before but when we reached they told they're closing
Review: We called to ask what time they close they said 10.30 but when we reached 10mins later at 10.10, They said they're closed. We rushed there for nothing and was left frustrated as we could've saved us the hassle if they just informed us that they're closing.

Author: SyamsyulRoslan
Title: Hidden Cafe with beautiful Art Craft Studio
Review: The staff here are so friendly and even Chef keep sharing menu how to make Nasi Lemak. So clean, taste good and very recommend for Nasi Lemak Ayam Cili Padi, Honey Toast Bread and Tempe Goreng. Affordable price and easy to find location behind Pos Office / Chinatown

Author: pianocelloShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Decent Bah Kut Teh marred by surroundings
Review: We came here at 11.30am on a public holiday. The area here was total chaos with a traffic jam at the junction of Teluk Pulai Bak Kut Teh turning due to the immense traffic. When we came here hoping to avoid the crowd at Teluk Pulai Bak Kut Teh, the crowds here were just as bad. It is impossible to eat peacefully without people hovering near your table hoping you will finish fast so they can sit at your place. We had to cramp into a small corner and the whole restaurant was stuffy with the huge crowds. To be fair, the service was reasonably fast (but rather impersonal) considering the crowds. The meat was juicy and thankfully reasonably free of msg. However while I would consider the food good (but not so outstanding that it is a must - go), I can only recommend that you go during a non - peak. I'm guessing a better time to go will be early evening.

Author: cikpandaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overrated
Review: The food was a disappointment. I ordered fish and chips, it was too dry, seems like pre-cooked few hours ago. No wonder the food was served quite fast. And there was nothing fancy about the drinks as well. Too runny and tasteless. The condition of the shop is a bit too stuffy, no air ventilation. The only good point of this place is the food was served fast.

Author: activebassSingapore
Title: Decent burger, mixed service.
Review: I just visited The Daily Grind and need to bring some balance to the reviews which can be found on this joint. The burgers are decent, but certainly not as good as some of the reviews would have you believe. Several of the "very good" reviews are a bit older which might explain it as KL now boasts other eateries which offer MUCH better burgers. One of the joys of eating a burger is actually being able to eat it with your hands and the ones at Daily Grind doesn't hold. I've eaten bigger burgers which were simply assembled better and thus could be eaten with your hands. Service-wise it was a mixed bag. A male waiter was courteous, on the other hand a female waitress dumped the bill on my table without me asking for it. There are better options if you're looking for a good burger in KL.

Author: Magnusmw22
Title: Beware of the 6% tax in this bar, since they dont show you, when they lure you in for happy hour.
Review: We ordered two big beer towers off of their menu, which didn__ provide any information about a 6% service tax. The bar tried to charge us 50 ringit for a beer glass that we unfortunately broke. Definetly won__ visit this place again.

Author: TWInChinaBeijing, China
Title: The only good thing was the bag
Review: The evening started with being assigned a wobbly table. The server promised to get someone to fix it. We tried to order a bottle of wine but the server couldn't tell us the vintage. She had to ask for a colleague who brought a bottle out to show us the year of the wine. The first server was only focused on taking down our food and didn't follow up with fixing the table problem. We had to grab someone else to ask for a change of seats. The food quality fell below expectations. The seafood tower appetizer was served on a slanted tray tower. There lobster was just crayfish. The oysters were very soggy. To make it worse there was a fly hovering around the tray tower. We couldn't finish our bottle and they made a fuss about us changing tables causing them to misplace the cap. Finally they capped the bottle somehow and gave us a bag for it. To top it all, the server chastised us for leaving a 5 Sen tip when we actually gave exact. She probably didn't recognise the old Malaysian currency we gave. Overall a really bad dining experience.

Author: beingshaikh_Doha, Qatar
Title: Is it worth it ? Let me Answer
Review: Ok so i was in kl for 7 days and wanted to do something special for my gf and wat better way then to take her to a 360 revolving restaurant so i booked my dinner in the restaurant. So wen we went there they asked us if we wanted to sit by the window and i said yes so we have to pay 50 ringgit more ( i was ok cos it was a special night) . On our way up to the restaurant they informed us that we can go have view on level one then proceed to the restaurant and i was amazed cos now i didnt have to book a seperate ticket for the kl tower view we had a view , the city is beautiful in the evening . After this we went to the restaurant we were shown our seats .. the ambience was amazing and the food was nice too also the view everything was great but one thing which i didnt like was the staff they were nice until one of then came to ask for the drink we didnt really wanna drink anything Nd also the drinks were additional charge so we denied and the his attitude changed towards us no one would come to our table to ask if we need something .. the drinks wich include in the charge is water and tea and coffee ... anyways there was a pasta counter so my gf wanted a pasta so we waited almost ten mins but no one came so i looked inside if i could get someones attention so i saw the pasta guy he got surprised wat i m doin inside ... anyways in short dinner is amazing view is awesome in the everning but staff are bad

Author: DamienCorgi
Title: Not as expected
Review: Ordered fruit juice RM9, so we expected a fresh blend juice, but we get juice from a box or bottle, so it doesn't worth the price and we feeled the standard isn't as expected. RM9 isn't cheap, and we receive lousy juice? Ordered wedges and it was salty and burned. We ordered for spicy wedges, but we didn't get it spicy. There is also a big banner with various foods on it, but there are not in the menu. Overall, not as expected.

Author: GerardgroovyDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Souled out - You Mean "Sold OUT"
Review: Had Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner here, about 20 times now, I live in the apartment upstairs. There has not been a time that i have ordered for dinner that i have not been told, Sorry "Sold out". So i am starting to believe that the spelling on the name is wrong. The upstairs indoor area is closed up for Breakfast and lunch, and only open for dinners, this means that you are forced to sit outside in the heat in the open area on the street. The servers block out areas of the restaurant that is too far for them to walk and you are not allowed to sit there even when there is no Reserved plates on the table. You simply just get told to move. Service is slow. Items on Menus are not available all the time, no curries etc available for lunch, only certain foods available. Desert menu has only 2 choices available. In the evening it becomes a very rowdy and noisy pub than a restaurant. The positives is COLD Beer, and a good Butter Chicken with very good Naan.If there was any other choice close by, i would not eat here at all, and this is the biggest problem with this place, Owners know they have business from the residency upstairs and don't have to bother with service, or quality of food.

Author: cattyrawrs
Title: Average steak but the price is fine.
Review: Tried their beef steak sandwich and it was fine. The portion is generous and the price for it was worth it. Service is good too.

Author: sammi934George Town, Malaysia
Title: huge disappointment
Review: was attracted by the unique of its name. went in for lunch during peak hours...only to find out surprisingly we were the only three guests . food presentation and taste was overall way below expectation .. nice authentic peranakan building .. great strategic location BUT , what can i say, pls dont go :S

Author: dharroshan
Title: Best Place For A Meal In Central Market
Review: Looking for a great ambience, quiet, clean, friendly staff, fast service, affordable good meal than this is the place to be. Probably this is the only good restaurant in Central Market. From deep fried  to steam fish to tomyam are among the many choices

Author: Charles H
Title: The BEST service ever in my life
Review: That's is my most memorable dining together with my family while celebrating my daughter' birthday at Haroo+. The service is excellent and the lady boss is so nice with the free birthday dish (seaweed soup) which os specially for birthday girl. The food is tasty and we really enjoy that moment.

Author: Charles B
Title: Food ok but price is too expensive
Review: Food average but price is too expensive.  Just order duck, roast pork, hotplate tofu and 4 drinks and they charge me RM65.

Author: fongh881
Title: Solo lunch (avrg price RM35/pax)
Review: Dined on the first floor of Todd's.
