This statement is given to allow readers to know that the 1st and ground floor , honestly are very different .Ambient is comforting , had a cup of Hot Lemon Tea (RM9) which was soothing (but pricy as u can see).Was alone in the entire shop so the service was quick .For my meal i ordered a Bacon Chips Pizza (RM22) . Most of you would be thinking why i stated an avrg of RM35 , but these are the 2 cheaper end dish and drink u could possibly order here . The pizza took apx 13 minutes to come . The portion as per pic is regular in size but fantastic . A nice crispy base and generous amount of cheese . The topping is also generous but the bacon being decent .The bill being a nett RM 37.30(after the gst) .I would rate due to the following reasons-clean and comfortable .-pricy .- taste wise is great atleast for these 2 .- portion of dish is decent . - presentation of the dish is regular.-availability of space is limited .

Author: Rum7Toronto, Canada
Title: An unpleasant experience
Review: Visited with colleagues who were craving Japanese at lunch. I'm vegetarian (meatless), so usually go and speak to the manager or the chef, and explain that I do eat eggs, and don't mind meat broth without meat. I'm not fussy when I have don't have a choice. But here, I was confronted with the manager who outrightly mentions that they don't serve any vegetarian dish at all, and walks away. My colleagues were looking forward to eating here, so I didn't want to be a spoilsport and spoke to the manager again. She suggested they can prepare a Soba noodle soup with extra veggies and an extra egg. You can't go wrong with that, so I was happy we didn't have go to another restaurant. But what she didn't mention to me was that the extra veggies and egg would come at an extra cost - all other restaurants would certainly inform you. Anyway, we sat at the table and I look at the menu again, and in the lunch specials was a vegetarian egg and tofu dish. When I asked the manager, she brushes me off by saying that it contains Sake. Apparently, Sake contains meat. :) or so it seems. We had a good laugh over that. It doesn't end there. When the bill came, I was charged extra for the veggies (it seems vegetables are more expensive than meat) and the egg (RM33 total), without being informed earlier. I only had the Soba soup, and like I mentioned, you can't go wrong with it. It was decent. But the whole experience left me with an unpleasant experience.

Author: joselyn715Chicago, Illinois
Title: Monster burger
Review: We went mostly because of the monster burger challenge. I however opted for a regular burger. It's ok nothing special just "ok". The guy who served us was really polite and nice. Would probably go again to try their other menu items. We saw the food that other people ordered and it looked yummy! I did order a mango drink I think it was called a mango lassi which was amazing !

Author: Y6193EEkevinsHong Kong, China
Title: Comfortable and authentic, but not the best
Review: Nice authentic Mexican food, comfortable place to enjoy dining. Tried nachos and would love a little more quacamole instead of so much bean paste. Tortilla soup was abit different taste, found it interesting. Fajitas was acceptable, has better ones before. Overall it's okay to try but don't set your expectations so high.

Author: AKIMOHRI
Title: Poor quality for service mind
Review:
Not suitable for Personal usage ( not for Individual usage) ,
might be good for Group and Package tour ( Group or Large number
oriented service mind, included food quality)
Food material quality also is not in Premium quality.
Not in our expectation.

Author: Matrix55Ipoh, Malaysia
Title: Not so fantastic food and bad customer service. Only for classy people.
Review: I only went there once, but the food is not nice, particularly the mushroom soup, lava cake and green tea latte. Reviewed by posting a comment in facebook. The management seem to be unhappy about it. I feel that they emphasize on service higher class of people such as royals, tourists, professionals and not normal regular ipoh customers. Very very bad impression that I would like to write it out. They dont deserve a tripadvisor award of excellence. They have given impression that they look down on normal customers and do not welcome return customers. They use all premium ingredients, no doubt, but we could not feel how grand is the entire dining experience at STG cafe.

Author: CarolChinYY
Title: Way too noisy for a restaurant
Review: It was full to the brim, doesn't help that the walls were glass so noise was just bouncing off. The food is too fusiony for me, most items have an unusual ingredient just to have the quirky spin.

Author: Harith A
Title: "Past its prime"
Review: Arrived at Marriott Miri on 15 Nov 2017. Attempted to settle deposit with credit card but was informed by frontline counter that the card was rejected when in fact it was actually about the hotel's credit card machine problem. The receptionist was kind enough to let us in without deposit payment.The room was average clean, but the ice box still has leftover food from previous customer (obviously it wasn't looked at by the cleaner). Asked for extra blanket and was given in time, but asked for extra towel, they never came. The room didn't have standard toiletries ready so I had to request and waited for them to come.Requested in room dining and it was provided without much hassle and the menu were quite good.On 16 Nov evening, we found that the room was still average clean. There were still minor debris on the floor, the ice box was not looked at with leftover food from previous customer. The pool's water was quite dirty too.Upon check out on 17 Nov, the frontline counter struggled when queried about GST ID. At last I got the information and settled the payment. Tax invoice was handed to me in an envelope without thanking me for my stay there.So clearly Marriott was not prepared for my booking, and maybe that day all staff in Marriott were in bad mood. I feel quite frustrated with their recent performance and I could see that they are already past their prime. Their customer service were was like our previous year's stay and getting worse now.Maybe it's time for us to forget about this "past prime" hotel and start trying new hotels like Pullman Miri and Jinhold Serviced Apartments.

Author: FN8822London, United Kingdom
Title: Great food!!
Review: Love this restaurant. Both food and service are good...if you like pork....This is the place to go...Their pork knuckle is delicious. juicy pork burgers (though the burger is small, just enough for a snack :p)...Pansit Beehoon - Filipino noddles YUMMY!!!Weekends it does get really packed and service is a little on the slow side.

Author: nlinamahli
Title: Birthday dinner
Review: the food was great, the ambience was nice, the service was good, will definitely drop again for another visit.

Author: Hiker788
Title: Nice decent bah kut teh..
Review: Always packed. Be early. once went there at about 2pm, and was told food finished. decent environment. as for the taste , i wont say its the best in town as i have eaten much more better bah kut teh.

Author: PikaPikaa
Title: What__ wrong with the new Dewakan since they moved ????
Review: We visited the old Dewakan years back when it first opened and had a fond memory of it. It was simple, unassuming, passionate, experimental, very creative and delicious. Been wanting to go back many a time but the distance was a major put off. No words can describe our excitement when we got wind of it moving to a new location in town, and in Naza Tower too, brilliant! But, our experience with the new Dewakan got off on the wrong foot right from reservation : 1. There was NO telephone number on their website (obviously not wanting to be disturbed by calls) only a reservation form with credit card pre- authorisation (debit cards not accepted) at RM200/head, though not charged at the time of booking, it__ chargeable for any cancellation less than 48hours notice . Good luck to those with last minute hiccups.2. It was a birthday celebration we made minor request like a 3-word birthday message __appy Birthday x_ on dessert. Also a non beef eater amongst us. Our booking was made 3 weeks ahead, no one from Dewakan ever checked back with us. 3 days before our dinner i got worried and took the liberty to shoot them an email with our booking details as a soft reminder . What I received was a stone cold Hello from someone by the name of Sean,(addressing customer by name is a basic etiquette in any service industry), followed by a series of house rules like __e do not offer personalised candles or writings._ __ou are welcome to bring your own celebration cake, however please check with us in advance so we can try to allocate adequate storage in our fridges. Please be advised that we cannot guarantee to have fridge space available for all cakes._ __irework Sparkling Candles cannot be used in the restaurant due to the sensitivity of our Fire Prevention Equipment.__inner : there were only 4 tables, 3 were couples, we were the only table of 4. 1. Deep fried white rice cakes instead of bread basket, with an array of condiments, vegetable jerky is a win! The rest is best described as interesting but not the most harmonious match with one another. Our qualms : Rice cakes slightly too oily and too sticky to the bite. As an opening course, we all concur a homemade bread basket with flavoured butter would be just nice. 2. A selection of veggie dishes : our favourite course of the night, every dish is stunning ! Am a die hard carnivore but these greens totally won me over. 3. Crabs 4 ways, apart from crab salad, all 3 others are overly salty with crab claws being the epitome of sodium marinade. Tell our waiting staff (a bespectacled girl) about it, she says she ll let the chef know.4. Lamb 4 ways, just when we__e hopeful of better things to come BAM! The goat hearts (a picturesque floral version of miang kham) is a major attack of salt invasion ! The soft bits of heart are practically pearls of salt that corrode away what__ left of our palette ! Feedbacks to the same girl again, she only reacts with a simple OH this time, asks her if the chef tastes the food, a plain YES in exchange, she carries on tidying up our table and walks off. No further conversation never mind a word of apology. When she comes around again, I couldn__ help but to ask if she__ upset, the nerve of her telling us __o, I__ not, the chef is more upset haha_, after which she sort of keeps a distance from our table, as with other staff. Other goat dishes : baby goat too chewy and sinewy we couldn__ finish, porridge not exactly to our liking we couldn__ finish, goat tartare passable. 5. Pre dessert, an ice granita with some teeny slices of plum. Staff says granita tastes of lychee, turns out it tastes more of a strong vinegar.6. Desserts, there__ ice cream in a sphere chocolate casing with mulberry sauce, casing too thick too hard. And a rambutan drizzled in jackfruit juice , a dollop of caramel coconut cream on a wood spoon, and a rose candy ( a v sharp and sour version of Sugus in rose powder), last but not least, a few sips of salty and sour cucumber juice which none of us finish. P.S. : for all the unfinished items, no one ever bothered to check with us if anything is wrong either.Billing : it was stated in their website all Prices are inclusive of Service Charge & any Government Taxes. We discovered at a later stage that there was an additional service charge in our bill. A mighty let down in all areas right from reservation, food and service . Everything screams impersonal. For an establishment of this calibre, ALL THE MISTAKES ARE UNFORGIVABLE ! It__ a shame what comes with a title is nothing but entitlement at all levels. Mistakes aside, the obsession of all things local has gone loco, the new menu was more of a mish mash of experiment on local finds with little correlation with one another, let alone featuring meat of sub par quality all for the sake of being local. Trying to be different should never be at the expense of the pleasure of giving customers a true blue fine dining experience. The attitude, the thinking process and execution are all seriously off track now.

Author: Fion515Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Poor quality of chicken to be eaten
Review: Now this shop is full with tourists. You need to queue up for at least half and hour or even longer hour for you to go in for meal. However, this long waiting queue didn__ make us feel worth to queue. When I saw the way of lady boss cooked the chicken and I feel it is poor cooked. After I tasted the chicken, I really feel food didn__ taste good. The chicken they use are not __ampung chicken_ and the texture of chicken is too __oft_. No doubt their price is cheaper than Restoran Tauge Ayam Lou Wong, but I really feel the quality of food is really . After I left Restorable Cowan Street, we straightaway proceed to __ou Wong_ for 2nd round to fulfill our appetite to have good quality chicken. We won__ go back to Restoran Cowan Street Ayam Tauge again.
Restaurant: Restoran Cowan Street Ayam Tauge & Koitiau

Author: BSKumar26
Title: Great Taste, nice ambiance
Review: Many choices, good service. If you plan to visit Melaka, this is a place alternative you must try other thn local food.

Author: RENERONO
Title: ALWAYS ENJOYABLE WITH OUR MEAL
Review: Nice food and nasi kandar with selection of food but more to indian syle food, free parking and ample dining space. always enjoy our meal, there

Author: SimonKhng
Title: Bad service
Review: Food a bit disappointed and the price reasonable. The most cant accented is the service. They come to collect plate without asking and during that time we still having our food. When we complain, they just act like nothing and didn__ apologize at all. This kind of restaurant better don__ go.

Author: Arthur Elfin CSingapore, null, Singapore
Title: Wanton noodles is good
Review: Take out lunch @ Zhong Tai Don't be deceived by the plain look of this wanton mee! The egg noodles were springy with a good texture. The sauce was piquant unlike those in SG that are normally mixed in ketchup. The wantons are nice too but quite small. The roast pork that came with the noodles were a little dry and wasn't succulent. But for SGD 2, there's absolutely nothing to complain about! A second helping anytime! Bonus: The cashier was honest. I misheard her and gave her (a lot) more but she corrected me and returned the money.

Author: siewkhPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Used to be good but no more
Review: Tuck Kee used to be a famous restaurant for Chinese dishes in Ipoh but it's quality has dropped tremendously in the recent years. In fact I wouldn't recommend it anymore to anyone trying to find good authentic Chinese dishes. This place is famous for it's roast chicken and duck (You can also take away as chicken/duck rice in the counter in front). The service is so so and sometimes you may encounter some rude staff. The restaurant also offers some signature dishes but you might want to be cautious especially if you are ordering fish as the price tag might be on the higher end. As a rule of thumb, always ask the price first (per 100g)One thing I would still recommend in this restaurant though is the "yuu sang" but that's only available during the Chinese New Year period.Overall, there are a lot better places to dine and you can most likely skip this even with the hype surrounding it's name.

Author: S DSydney, Australia
Title: Acceptable food and exceptional value
Review: This is reviewed as one of the best banana leaf restaurants in KL. Lunched here today, it was half full. The food selection and quality was decent. The food is served on stainless steel trays and not on banana leaves.While exiting and wandering in the neighbourhood came across Sri Nirwana Maju which is less than 30 metres away and had a queue of people waiting to get in. Given that they seemed to be all locals, I can only assume that the food here is better.Will try it perhaps on a subsequent KL visit

Author: GomaamDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Do not even bother
Review: The food here is terrible the amount of oil they use is rediculous you get sick from the first few bites. I have had Thai food in many places this is the worst by far. When I pay money like this i expect good quality food in return keep away from this one

Author: Reslimpan
Title: Sub-Average buffet
Review: Really not much to say other than the buffet didn't hit the mark. Tasteless, lack of quality selections and poor service in a cantina environment. The only plus is that the price is low, which in this case should have been a warning sign.
Restaurant: Cafe BLD at Renaissance Johor Bahru Hotel

Author: Arvin A
Title: Subpar food with tiny portions
Review: Absolutely fantastic lamb shank biryani. We also had the lamb roganjosh, chicken makhani , another vege and some bread. While the curries are good, they seem to be muted or lack the usual amount of spice associated with each dish. The real challenge here is how small the portions are. While you're paying twice the cost for some so called higher end dining, you're getting about 1/3rd the amount of meat you'd get at normal North Indian restaurants. Atmosphere was pretty weird and unappetizing too with the restaurant being black and gloomy. Understand it used to look much more alive. Service was slightly off too with us constantly needing to remind them to refill our water apart from missing people out when refiling.

Author: X173VJannac
Title: Delicious Hainan food
Review: This is the best Hainan chicken chop that I had ever tried. The sauce just make you wanted more of it. Didnt expect to be able to try something like that at the outlook of the restaurant.

Author: Mary192014
Title: Overrated restaurant
Review: Bad experience dim sum tasteless but price at five star rate.  Derive is also poor standard.   Would not recommend anyone to try.

Author: jothirajap
Title: Horrible Service
Review: I have eat Thosai here today, the staff service is horrible and don't know how to respect customer. Please don't eat at this low class restaurant

Author: Huang Y
Title: Chloe
Review:
Food is not bad but the serving time was too long waited 
Only 3 tables customers and I__e wait for almost 50mins for the 1 dish came. Not recommend for family who bring kids with.

Author: angry_customer0111Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Terrible attitude!
Review: I went to the restaurant with my family but unfortunately it was fully booked.However, the restaurant is still empty so I suggest the uncle boss to let us have a quick dinner.With hesitate, he kept giving plenty of excuses but I am still fine with it.The worst thing was he replied in a really unfriendly way to me and blaming me for not listening to his explanation.I understood you might have limited capacity and you might be rich enough or have more than enough customers to forgo me and my family but the terrible attitude is what I couldn't accept!Sorry to say no matter how good is your review I will definately boycott such impolite service, and please be assured this experience will be shared with my friends and family.Good luck!

Author: Bobthetaff
Title: Very disappointing tasteless food and expensive
Review:
Food all tastes the same and has no heat or discernible flavour
Far too dear better food at the hawker stalls on the street at a fraction of the price

Author: Kristin T
Title: Scrumptious little chinese buns!
Review: Love their Xiao Long Bao! Don't really fancy the la mien though.
Restaurant: Din Tai Fung at The Gardens Mall

Author: amytay46
Title: Poor dishes. Not what we expect of nyonya dishes and the staff are not friendly in servicing.
Review: Nyonya food could be better but since we got recommendations, we decided to try it out but the food was not to our expectation.

Author: UmarubanKuala Terla, Malaysia
Title: Excellent
Review: Excellent location - after a long day of shopping in the Pavillion. The place was cool and comfortable. Catered for couples and families as well. I was there with my 11 year old boy. The menu was adjusted for his taste. The waiter was attentive and the meal was delicious. The food was very fresh and they even had a vegetarian bento set. Great!

Author: caesar1956Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: not interested in business
Review: we arrived at the restaurant at 920 pm, sat in the open air, for about 5 minutes, no one attended, tried to grab the attention of the staff, who intentionally ignored us as if we were invisible, at 930 pm, a waiter approached us told us they close at 930 pmjust walked out,,,asked to see the manager, were told the manager off for the dayjust walked out,

Author: Sherise VKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best Indian restaurant in KL
Review: We have been dining at a couple of indian restaurants in the KLCC area looking for the best place to go to. Bombay palace exceeded all expectations! The food was delicious, and the staff were incredibly friendly and professional. I wish all restaurants were as well run, and had friendly staff like this. It was also very clean and organized, had a variety of options on the menu, as well as a very relaxing and authentic atmosphere. I love indian food, and I have finally found the place I can now frequent for my weekly treat.

Author: ThomasSoySingapore, Singapore
Title: Rubbish hype
Review: The shop has all kinds of photo of TV guests from all over the world doing food shows there, but either they're all lairs or the standard dropped overnight.The rice is too stick and tasteless. The chicken serving is so small not even my cat will get full. Menu is messy and needs lots of work.Only thing is service is good, menu is explained, and order served quickly.

Author: jasl80
Title: Good but pricey ___
Review: Went 2 time to Go noodles during my visit in KL. Really enjoy the spicy broth soup noodle & the Hakka sauce konlomee with centurie egg. Must try the bursting meat ball!

Author: rosiem333Melbourne, Australia
Title: Best Margaritas in KL!
Review: Fantastic location, perfect flavoured margaritas (I recommend the lime) and a wonderful set of staff and host. Would happily return here.We spent New Year's Eve here and had such a wonderful time.

Author: FoodLover554Bangsar
Title: Amazing Food, Lovely Ambiance and Great Service!!
Review: The food at Manja is superb!! The flavors and presentation is amazing. I have been there a couple of times and each time i'm there, i have not been disappointed. My favorite dish is the Lobster Slider, Gunda Gunda, the lamb, Negambo crab and to be honest many more. Each time i'm there, i try a different dish and its been amazing.From the food to drinks and to service is good. Would definitely recommend friends and family to visit Manja.

Author: benyee01Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overall good experience - Recommended!
Review: The overall experience was good. Ambience, service, and especially the food was at an excellent standard. Specially, the service is worth mentioning. Miss Sandra, the Assistance Manager, and Miss Azura, the Team leader, displayed excellent service, politeness, friendliness and made the overall experience better. Food is consistent in quality and is worth coming back again. Recommend this place!

Author: jimachia
Title: THE WORST RESTAURANT WITH RUDE STAFF!
Review: The location is good, near Low Yatt plaza and facing the main road.The food was okay (we were hungry at the moment, pretty sure the taste will be different if we are not that hungry).Most importantly, the staff are incredibly RUDE! We encounter 3 of the staffs and none of them gave us a warm welcome, not even smile back to us. When we asked them, does it take too long to cook our meal, she replied "Yes, have to wait" with a high tone.

Author: SkaramooshEdmonton, Canada
Title: Average Fare
Review: Service wasn't too bad. The decor and atmosphere was quite enticing.Food was average.Typical American/Western cuisine. Most of the side dishes like onion rings, fries etc. are of the frozen kind so you kinda know what to expect.Prices were at the thicker end of the mid-range category.Beverages offered were normal. Beers weren't very cold.....they gotta get their act together when it comes to cold beers!I'll be pretty hard pressed to step in here again but who knows.

Author: Rdatcna
Title: Hens night
Review: Amazing hens party with perfect view and good services _¤ï_ The service is on the top. They always take care of you   Love this place

Author: msar92London, United Kingdom
Title: Nothing special
Review: Ordered a mix platter for starters which included tempura prawns, which was the only saving grace. Beef with ginger - dry and chewy beef and bland gravy, vegetable which accompanied the dish was also dull.Glass noodles with prawn - hardly any prawns in a massive portion of noodles, however there was a nice taste to the noodles.The starters and main for some reason comes together.The restaurant advertises free wi-fi which doesn't work.Wouldn't recommend it

Author: weiwankuala lumpur
Title: great ambience, average food, bad service
Review: the ambience was fantastic and unique. however, the service was appalling with mainly part timers and foreign staffs. i brought a good wine there, but OMG, the stemware and service was below par. I ordered the squid ink pasta, which was highly recommended and i stopped after my second bite...It was that bad.however, the lambshank was pretty succulent and tender...

Author: Wikki87
Title: Amazing experience
Review: Great food, unique environment and superb service! Staff was really helpful and friendly especially our waitress, Ho! Good photography skills!

Author: Li Jia T
Title: Hygienic steamboat and quality food
Review: The best way to eat steamboat is not sharing the pot of soup! Arashi is the best steamboat place as you get to drink from your own choice of soup base! We usually order the pork and beef set with Tomyam soup base (additional RM2) and vermicelli. Family members would also order the salmon and chicken set with miso soup (no extra cost) and rice. We would also add a side (fishballs). Their fishballs are not the plain fish balls but those that contain fish roe within each fishball. Extremely tasty. Love their iced citron tea and hot fruit tea too. It is worth it to sign up as a member if you eat there more than 4 times a year, (assuming each time with at least two pax per bill.) Membership is rm30 for a year and you are entitled to a welcome gift (like a water bottle, can opener etc) and a 10% discount with every transaction. The place has free wifi (just turn the table service device around and you will see the password pasted there).

Author: CmozziePenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Delicious
Review: Early dinner and they were just opening. Food was fantastic. The darling wife is celiac and they made her a special dish. My 8 year old was feeling adventurous and so we ordered the grilled tiger prawn. Cheap by Aussie prices but expensive here it was well worth the spend. My son ate the whole prawn sucking the last of the meat out of the shell. Probably needs a freshen up but seriously tasty food. Don__ judge the book by the cover here.

Author: KimberlyK1611
Title: Value for money especially their lunch sets
Review: Value for money especially their lunch sets. Worth it particularly if youare working around the area. And their sashimi is very fresh.

Author: cheechong02
Title: Dining
Review: very nice lobster and good servicesï¼_obster very fresh and nice to eat. very friendly and recommended foods

Author: Ishita BSingapore, Singapore
Title: Need more service orientation
Review: A fast food restaurant in the fine dining section. Very little time was sent by the person who took our order to explain to us what we can have. They are more focused on clearing up tables . I felt lost with my family and would not recommend the restaurant to foreigners

Author: retiredGoaCambridgeshire, United Kingdom
Title: Slow service, poor food
Review: Sad to say this cafe does not live up to expectations. As I spend most of the year in Penang I have visited Living Room many times. Amy is a lovely lady but sad to say the food is now over priced for here and of poor quality. There was a queue for tables which does not make sense in Batu Ferringhi as there are hundreds of better cafes. I am sure it will get better again but the prices certainly are way too high

Author: rickleusybhPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Slightly Overrated Branded Food Service
Review: I am an Ipohan, and one of the food's royal customers.I personally like this chicken they produced. But it used to be better.Now it tasted with more MSG rather than traditional Chinese herbs.Drive-thru is an innovative and convenient way to allow customers to get this delicious chicken fast and finish it while hot. Yummy!But I don't like the drive thru bay being unmarked and always occupied by traffic or travel bus. Bus should stop in side road for travelers to go down to purchase, not jamming the main road. Traffic, no choice, the shop is right corner on the main road!For food quality wise, I can eat the whole chicken and still craving for more!

Author: Gebu303Miri, Malaysia
Title: Nyaman
Review: Restaurant can accommodate a group of 6 people though it looks small from outside. The quality of food is dependent on what you ordered. The local fried rice is nice but very spicy, fish pahsuh is nicer than the chicken. Don't order the midin though it is a local dish as it was bad and I love midin. Cash transaction only. I will come back, perhaps with tapau midin.

Author: goofy1008
Title: Steamboat
Review: Good food with many choices of veg and items. Value for money. Service is good and prompt as well. ..

Author: y0gelStockholm, Sweden
Title: Horrible dinner
Review: Really don__ understand what the hype is about for this place! The squid had a 1cm layer of frying crust. The chicken was inedible and tasteless and had funky smell to it. The local fish was ok but way to much sweet sauce! Poor service and not to mention the horrible band!

Author: HellbraunWalchwil, Switzerland
Title: Excellent, Excellent, Excellent
Review: The food was superb and the fact that it was reasonable price made it even more enjoyable. Both for dinner and lunch. The staff was always helpful and tentative. For dinner we tried several dishes - one was a local beef dish our waiter's suggested, which was to die for and another the Australan beef steak with chive mashed potatoes, which just melted in our mouths. Even the kids menu met the approval of our 6 year old daughter. The size of the dishes will not disappoint even the heartiess of eaters. The drinks selections and prices are good too. And eating on the beach is so romantic. Also nice was that you could come casually dressed or as smart as you wanted without feeling uncomfortable or being treated unequally.For lunch the selection is brillant too. You can't go wrong at this restaurant at any time of day.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: FlorenceH626Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Pricey Malaysian Food
Review: We were just there two days ago. the place was crowded, as expected, as it was a weekend in KLCC. The lines moved quickly and within 10 minutes we were given a table. We ordered Nasi Lemak, Curry Laksa and Nasi Bojari (x2). Overall, I found the taste above average, although over priced. They don't offer free water and one has to buy bottled water as well. There was not much service in the sense that that there is one unsmiling person who sets the table, and then the next time you see a server is when the food is served - without any smile. Just put the food on the table and walk away. This is my first time at Madam Kwan's and probably my last. I can get more value for money meals in other places.

Author: jessicatant
Title: Disappointed
Review: Had a birthday dinner at sirocco yesterday, a few things to point out:1) service was slow and staff honestly didn__ register or understand what we were saying , had to ask them to refill water like a few times, even getting new cutlery, had to be asked a few times 2) the chef hat items were not available and we weren__ told at the booking had to op for other dishes, we weren__ told thAt the main meat dishes took an hour to prepare 3) the garlic bread ran out at 7.45pm and we were told there was no more, I think you guys should have enough that last till the restaurant closes or if there still is customers 4) was quite strange that the red sauce pasta__ we ordered even though different on the menu all had the same sauce , even the risotto and it was way too spicy 5) the restaurant at first couldn__ find the birthday cake and they froze the cake in the freezer ! Good points: The blue cheese pasta was great

Author: KLchronicKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Unpredictable
Review: Yes, it all depends on when you decide to eat here. Only dine here during lunch hours. Otherwise you can't be sure if the meal is freshly made. This is because all restaurants here can't be trusted entirely. They may use unsold chicken made earlier. Chickens are small, little meat. Mostly skin and bones, imho.

Author: Vijayan P
Title: Very disappointed
Review:
Waited 1 hour to get my order.

Satay was dry and almost tasteless.

I come from Kajang where satay is famous. Kajang satay still better. Cheaper too. 

Not worth the wait and experience

Dr. VJ

Author: 540philippep
Title: Nice location lousy food
Review: This place looks lovely and it's location is perfect, but that's it. We had lunch here. The food is awful and for lousy food it's too expensive. The service was okay but that was it. Don't bother going here unless it's just for a glass of mineral water.

Author: cherrie y
Title: Not bad but not too good
Review: I would to say the dessert/ pastry is nice (ordered salted egg caramel cronut and salted egg croissant). Nice ambiance. However, there are some areas which need to be improved. Firstly, the oven is out of service when I requested to heat up the croissant. Hence, the croissant was served cold. Secondly, I ordered a Magnum Coffee Frappe too. I waited for 45 mins but it never came. We followed up with the waiter twice as well but, they served my drink to another table. Eventually, I requested for a refund.

Author: Superlight88
Title: Typical Malaysian restaurant.
Review: That entails: poor service, food arriving at different times so no one can eat together, long waits for simple dishes, waiters with a lack of training and menu knowledge, no children's menu, disturbing music, very average food.

Author: ben_c20Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Comfort Food for locals!
Review: I have been frequenting Ho Seng Kee for several decades now in 2 other locations and his son has carried on his father's legacy in their latest (and my least favorite) location. I must say I am bias as Johoreans find HSK's spicy wontan and sliced pork egg noodles (dried) to be an original that cannot be improved upon. In many ways, HSK is Johor Bahru's unofficial Heritage food (making this up as we don't really have such an award but we ought to have one!)The only saving grace of this location is that it's air conditioned!Tip: order the small version as it is tastier and has a more balanced wonton/pork/noodles in a bowl. Order a second bowl if you need a second helping!

Author: TheWoodyPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Very disappointed food.
Review: Came here last month and the food was very good and warm.As for today it is a let down. The food is cold and the sausage is burnt. The food is also very oily. Thumbs down.

Author: Nomad BLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Horrendous Lunch ! Cold and bland Kim chi rice and fly in the hot chocolate!
Review: There has been a bit of hype in the city about this Resto and we decided to give it a try. As first timer, we played it safe and ordered the signatures such as falafel wrap and Kim chi fried rice with soft shell crab besides the cauliflower soup and coleslaw. The coleslaw came first and it was so bland and it only had mayonnaise taste in it. My falafel came and it was very ordinary and the only thing good was the sweet potato fries. Subsequently the Kim chi fried rice came and it was cold, bland and hard. It was so bad my 5yr old niece would have done a better job. The soft shell crab however tasted good. We asked for the bill and credit to the manager he kindly offered his apology. Thats not the end... the hot chocolate came and there was a small fly in it!!! We complained to the manager and he offered his apologies again and gave us a discount. Besides the food quality I observes that the staff were also not well trained. Our soup came without a soup spoon and staff weren't able to answer our questions on the menu. I will give it a big skip in future and avoid it at all cost. Noticed there is good crowd in there to have coffee and some light bites and hope the standard will improve in future.

Author: Chris QSingapore, Singapore
Title: Go early
Review: If you are thinking of visiting this place, do two things. 1. Make a reservation 2. Reach before 530pm. It is hard to imagine how long one will need to wait to get a table and for food to arrive if he didn't do that two things. Ordering is done by a lady. So wave frantically to get her attention too. Anyway, I went for the cheese beehoon. So here are the reviews. 1. Cheese beehoon. It is not bad. But I couldn't taste much cheese in there. The only hint of cheese was the colour. There was too much fried onions and it overpowered everything. 2. Salted egg tofu. Mediocre. Not much taste of salted egg too.3. Garlic squid. Quite difficult to go wrong with a squid and lots of garlic eh? 4. Vietnamese pork. Kinda salty but it is still considered tasty. 5. Vinegar fish. I think this will be my favourite. The fish was fried nicely and it is easy to eat with no bones. Paid 200rm for four pax. We Left pretty satisfied.

Author: guna KCheltenham, United Kingdom
Title: A so-so experience
Review: My wife & I had the occasion to book this establishment for our Malaysian family outing. Promised email for confirmation of booking were not forthcoming to begin with. It was an overall disappointment. This was M$700+ lost for what could have been a memorable meal for us. Where shall I start? The staff in general were unresponsive, lacking in common courtesies and friendliness. We had to constantly ask for delivery of drinks that were ordered at the very start. The guy who took the order was requested to lay on the starters first and then the main course but to our amazement both appetisers and main courses were laid on at the same time on already crowded tables ( we had two for a party of 16).All in all their approach to customer satisfaction was sloppy to say the least.The only bright sparks were the ikan tengirri and petai friend rice.Not to be recommended.

Author: Islandgal09Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dinner
Review: After arriving from a week of business travel I was looking forward to a sumptuous dinner in iketeru. Been here many time before and was impressed by quality . Tonight I ordered the sashimi, it was fine , 5 pieces for RM 68 and then I ordered the chicken breast teppanyaki in mustard sauce . My description , over cooked dried pieces of breast meat , lacking in flavour . I had to dip the dry pieces in soya sauce . I did eat it , but shall not return ! Step up iketeru , for the premium price you charge , your quality is disappointing !

Author: lindalF1078EPJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Street Eats buffet big let down
Review: My group of friends decided to give the Street Eats buffet a try. It was a Thursday evening and the restaurant did not have a crowd which we liked as we thought that would give us more chance at the food.My friends quickly set out to scan the food selection which was divided into 3 sections-chinese, malay and indian. One by one, they returned to their seats with barely filled plates and a look of disappointment on their faces. I finally understood what they felt after taking a walk around the restaurant myself.The menu selection was...miserable. I could not find any of the iconic street fare represented in the buffet presentation. There was no laksa, satay, ayam percik - nothing. What there was were poorly executed and a pathetic excuse for local food. Even my neighbourhood hawker stall served chicken shreds and fresh prawns in their noodle soup. Here at a Hilton property, my choice of ingredients for my noodle soup was restricted to fishball, fish cake and processed crabsticks.As I wandered around, a restaurant employee approached me. He was friendly and was nice enough to suggest that I start my meal with a double boiled lotus root soup from the chinese section. The idea brightened my mood and when he offered to have the soup served to my table, I began to grow hopeful....alas, the bowl presented to me was a watercress soup. It was good-don't get me wrong. But I was bemused that the staff could not get their food knowledge right.I took pinches of as many dishes as possible just to make sure my review would be a fair account. Cold food, sorely lacking in variety, horrible pistachio and banana flavoured ice cream - DISAPPOINTING.If you are a traveller and want to experience local street food, go visit the street hawkers for the real deal. If you are a local hoping for an upgraded version of our local favourites, you won't find it at the Makan Kitchen.
Restaurant: Makan Kitchen at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: specialmineSingapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointed with the size of chix drumstick
Review: I love their red pepper chicken and tried it in bangkok, seoul and kl. This was my 2nd time visiting the branch. 1st time i ordered takeaway chicken parts. This round, we dine in. As we were not hungry, we ordered 2 sets of 2 drumstick. Really shocked to see the drumstick almost the size of a drumlets. Though i love the taste but I find its not value for money, near rm30 for 4 drumlets size of drumstick.

Author: AlbywonSydney, Australia
Title: In the heart of the city
Review: Cute little glass house on the sidewalk outside Farrenheit 88 and opposite my hotel. Arinya Shiraz 2004 at RM20 for a glass was a real bargain - so good I had a second glass!The Ribeye for RM58 was good - not the greatest cut of meat but nicely cooked and nice sides.Definitely a recommendation from me.P.s. you can catch a glimpse of the Petronas Towers from the outside tables (see photo), but building works are underway which will quickly remove this view.

Author: sucinoe
Title: Bad service
Review: I was here lastnite really bad service they just service western people first only not a lady :( not greeting n also just weatern have a napkin on him self n let them the lady do it her self dispointed

Author: MorrellBrosna, Ireland
Title: Still as good as ever
Review: Last visited Olive Kitchen in April 2016 and was glad to find on my return that the food is still excellent and very authentic. The staff are helpful and friendly. A little on the noisy side but that adds to the atmosphere. Well worth a visit

Author: AlexSayok1Kuching, Sarawak, Malaysia
Title: Great food with reasonable price in middle of old Padungan Township
Review: We had been going to this restaurant after our club's committee meeting at least 6 times a year for the last 5 years or so. Though the price are lower than a typical restaurant, the food are no less delicious and with various kinds of drinks.

Author: job v
Title: Transitions in the kitchen are no good
Review: We stay in the hotel and wanted to eat in the restaurant. A new chef has started couple of weeks ago and today she had off. So only local dishes, three as normally. We ordered all three. The dishes came after each other with more than 15 minutes between them. No good for families. two of the three courses were ok, but the food at the neigbours foodcourt is better. One dish was too much fishsauce, and stayed untouched. The waitress was friendly but had too much tables too serve, So she forgot serveral things. It happens but van be avoided. The setting is excellent, cosy and in a small jungle garden. It has potential but needs a lot of improvement.

Author: RayC0528
Title: Not Bad Japanese Restaurant
Review: Food not bad and food serve fast also. Price also reasonable. Just the Service need to improve a bit.

Author: darryldrazen
Title: Food quality degraded, bad service
Review:
The food quality been degraded a lot since opening, very crowded during holiday which i felt is so overrated.
Dim sum too much of pork.
Service is very bad, staff impolite.
The opposite restaurant is a much better choice.

Author: JosieL404
Title: So So
Review: Popped in for brunch twice as it was not crowded, service and environment is kind of lack.Food quality is average.

Author: moirvolleyPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Awesome cafe with great food and wonderful staff
Review: We went to the Living Room Cafe as a place with vegan options. It did not disappoint, I had the vegan laksa on the recommendation of Amy and had it another 4 times it was that good. They were happy to advise what was suitable for other friends with dietary requirements. We organised a large group dinner there and the food was well appreciated. Highly recommended for food, drinks and the hosts.

Author: Hijaz Kamal HKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Found a fly in one drink and flooded kiycjen.
Review: Visited this place with my cousin from Switzerland observations.1.Manager,a lady was a inprofessional. She wore a zebra stripe top and black pabts and we were intimidated when the manager which looked like a normal attited person come barging at us and demanding is to follow her.2.Menu book was incomprehensive.we have to fill an order form where we annotate the quantity of dim sum dishes. Some of the menu are not described,no pics,important since we are not familiar with the variety of dim sums.3. The drink came together. The dim sums came at different times. Abit confusing for our group of 8. We were not impressed with the undescribed dim sum dishes.4.GRAND FINALE. Found a fly in the drink of our Swiss cousin. My mom blew up at a waiter. The half finished contaminated drink was whisked away,the manager didnt come. My mom asked for the zebra lady and dressed her down when another clueless Filipino water came to apologize. The affected drink replace5. The best part we were still charged for the drink with the fly. My mom refused to pay for that drink, the zebra shirt manager was nowhere to be found6. You will pass the kitchen when you exit through a narrow corridor. I notice the kitchen is flooded and stinks. I believe this place is not properly managed and hygiene is below KLCC area standards.ConclusionThe dim sum are nothing to shout. Overpriced and mediocre. Better eat at a seafood restaurant. We came here because it was near to our cousins hotel.Manager unprofessional and uncouth. Still charge us for a drink with a fly in it.We will never come back .

Author: Pip CTe Awamutu, New Zealand
Title: Amazing meal
Review: In KL as part of a month long tour around Malaysia. The food and the service was superb. While not the cheapest meal on the block. The decor and atmosphere is just the escape from the madding crowds. Can't say enough about the staff their depth of knowledge about the food and the flavour combos presented in the amazingly prepared food

Author: johndeards1947
Title: Just for cocktails people watching
Review:
Three lifts to this floor worth the visit just for the view of the twin towers so close 
You must respect the dress code as you are to pose as others are with their cocktails

Author: CrystalismKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Decent place to live by
Review: Decent food and place. Looks better after revamping / renovation. Food - only had the iberico ham and the grade is poor. Maybe that__ why it__ not too expensive. Service was alright. Happy hour deals are not cheap, plenty of other more attractive places in town..

Author: Bhavin_AthaMumbai, India
Title: Authentic South Indian cuisine in Little India
Review: Located in the heart of Little India near Masjid Jamek, this is a famous eatery chain which cooks up one of the most authentic South Indian food. I had my office very close by so used to drop in for 2 cups of Filter coffee or Tea daily for nearly a month. Occasionally, I did dine in as well. A very satisfying experience especially if you are away from Indian food for a long time. The service is quick & food is great. No nonsense place. Must visit if you have trouble looking for good veg food.

Author: fancyeaters
Title: Poor service and exhorbitant prices
Review: Went there for dinnerThere were only 2 tables with customersThe soup was good but the presentation was poorThe main course was small and inadequate The desert was stalePoor service - had to call out for cutleries, Little choice of beverages - mainly wine selection, no beer

Author: CrIsIsYKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: one event done badly
Review: i was visiting this place all time for a favourite kicking shrimps and other meals . but there was a huge disapointment happened in one time only the food was smelled really bad , i wouldnt like to judge such resturant from one faulty . but i have to highlight this , they retrieve the meal with no need of paying . the service was fine , but there was no sorry or compensation . S one slip would break a huge treaure , im just scared to come back . but i will be back someday definitely.

Author: CatherineKLGKlang, Malaysia
Title: OMG It's not mum love, it's more like Hate Mom!
Review: Heard so much abt the tasty food n the wonderful owner so I was eager to try. Walked wrongly into the kitchen while looking for the toilet. The foreign workers stared angrily at me. Quickly I walked out of it and heard a woman who looked like the owner yelled sharply at me ' I HATE people walking into my kitchen!' I was so embarrassed as the crowd was looking at me and left without even trying its so well loved food.

Author: RazzaqSulaimanKuala Lumpur
Title: HORRIBLE SERVICE
Review: Orders kept getting messed up. Ridiculously slow for a restaurant that wasn__ full. Only 4 tables occupied including us. Kept having to ask for our orders numerous times as they kept forgetting. Flavour of food is nothing like the old kampachi. Don__ bother coming.

Author: Notch8Kuching
Title: Eat Elsewhere avoid at all costs
Review: Rude uninterested staff service terrible my wife and I ordered the same dish they were served 45 minutes apart. The waiter was rude when asjed and said I told you i ordered two and walked away. The long list of beers is impressive but only 2 types were actually available at a very high price. Food is very average but the rude staff and poor eservice pisses me off we had dined here before about 5 times and each time the sefvie and food got worse. Never again. Doo yourself a favour and try Oinks across the road. Sure its a bit more expensive but food is great service friendly and fast and the ber list is extensive and a great price Tiga RM30 for 6 compare to Porkies 18RM a bottle. Never vidit Porkies again honestly I cant see them staying open much longer

Author: stevenhah30Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Terrible experience
Review: I went to anzu for my family dinner on Sunday night 20th May. I reached there about 8pm and there are plenty of table available but the waitress does not let us in because we are 6 person and the table only fits 4 person. I do understand that they try to leave a social distance among all the customers and resulting plenty of tables empty but still could not fit us 6 person in. So we waited for 45 mins for our seats, meanwhile we did an order for 4 sets of maincourse as we knew that rice and vegetables are free flow, there are one pregnant women and one elderly who does not want to have the fullcourse, So we plan to do sharing. But what i have got from the waitress is that they gonna charge us extra for refilling rice and vegetables if they see us sharing food. This is fxxxxx disgusting like I cant pay for that extra rice? I felt so much offended. Less trained staff. Free flowing rice and vege experience is no longer feeling great at this moment. Sucks service

Author: alison yjohor bahru
Title: Good atmosphere, yummy food
Review: We have been living in JB for 12 months now, and this is a regular for us. Food is high quality each time we go, never been disappointed. Good steaks, risotto, fish, and pizza. If purchasing wine by the glass, can be a little hit and miss. They also accommodate children.

Author: Jooellee
Title: Disappointed
Review: I've been here three years ago and came back now. Realising that they reuse their satay stick and straws. Totally disappointed and not going to come back here anymore.

Author: sengweyPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Breakfast
Review: Food is average. Has been quite frequent here. But service has deteriorated and badly manifested this morning with a staff (probably new but clearly untrained) doesn__ understand orders at all. The other more experienced staff enjoyed talking to a paid customer whilst ignoring my request to be serve. I__ very surprised that the owner just let such a good place deteriorated. Shall look for alternative now.

Author: komododeesingapore
Title: Quite decent but skip the pineapple tarts
Review: Quaint restaurant decor and we enjoyed most of the dishes we ordered. We arrived at about 11.20am and managed to get a seat after waiting about 20min. The more memorable dishes were the laksa (packed a punch and was generous with ingredients), otah, chap chye and fried fish with ginger and spring onion. The ondeh ondeh was yummy too. Regret buying only one pack but three bottles of pineapple tarts which turned out to taste rather bland.

Author: Jayakaran MPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: The service is better than the food
Review: I've known the Hilton for a long time. And it used to be really good place for a meal. The buffet is not something I look forward to in any hotel but if it is with entertaining people then sometimes it becomes necessary. They have a huge buffet spread and it is very difficult to make decisions. So I do some sampling, small portions and I find the food just about above average, no dish standing out as spectacular. The service however is still excellent!

Author: DenAndBelGlenmore Park, Australia
Title: Disgusting
Review: We decided to try this charming looking restaurant inside the markets but really should not have. It took the waiter a seriously long time to come and take our order. When we finally ordered food and drinks it took a while for the drinks to arrive. I ordered a beer and was served a glass with lipstick on it. I called the waiter over and told him "if you cant even check something as simple as this I dont trust your restaurant to serve clean food". I offered to pay for the drinks which he did not want and we walked out. I understand lipstick is hard to get off a glass (I was once a barman when I was 21) but it is extremely simple to have a quick glance at what you are serving customers before you serve it.

Author: Laney BSan Francisco, California
Title: Good for View
Review: Only one there and still got bad service--had to hang out at the counter and wait for someone to come by to get a menu and later to pay. Food just okay but the view is great hence the rating. Might be better just for beverages and people watching.

Author: Malaysiantraveller68kuala lumpur
Title: A cosy place
Review: Somehow, I've always been attracted by this cafe in the Langkawi Fair mall, been there on at least 3 different occasions. Maybe it's the art, the smell or both.... the art is not particularly great but provides some visual interest nevertheless. OK for a drink or salad/sandwich but not sure about the other food they offer. Had Indonesian bakso (noodles with beef balls in a broth/soup) this time; it tasted OK, the portion was large and the ingredients seemed fresh but I didn't think that it was what you would get in Indonesia. My friend had the tuna salad, no complaints there. Pity the mall has become rather quiet with many shops closed/vacant.

Author: 106junefMalaysia
Title: Dine like beggars
Review: First, you have to stand,wait and hunt for vacate table.Secondly, you have to queue (long queue) and grab the food (most of the time the food you wanted might not be available when it's your turn,is annoying)Thirdly, not easily accessed for those on wheels. The only slope for wheelchair connected to the road are parking lot. Most of the time is not vacate.Lastly, the food quality has degraded and overpriced. The poor service makes us felt like beggars, first we begged for seat, then begged for food.. :-/I hope the food ordering system could be improved like those dim sum restaurants in Hong Kong. please don't make your customers queue for food. That's awful.

Author: jean l
Title: Great service
Review: Celebrated other half's birthday here as he is a huge japanese fan. Great food: salmon fish head; pork bun; etc. They also served a huge bowl of mocktail as birthday drink on the house. The pork bun was absolutely delicious. Bought a cake from bakery upstairs and got their help to arrange that cake with their own cheesecake, done beautifully. Service was impeccable. Well done!

Author: KennyC1964
Title: Discrimination
Review: Had been here for meals many times but this is the most disappointing meal ever. There were 6 of us but the side dishes given were all in the portion of 3 instead of 6. And the reason given by their staff was because our order is not enough which means the side dishes given are based on the amount of dishes placed. We ordered a pancake, kimchi fried rice, potato noodles and kimbab which is enough for us. Never knew side dishes are served based on quantity ordered. This isn__ the culture in Korea. Same staff also roughly pushed the plate towards us (with more effort than necessary)just to fit the dishes ordered.

Author: emsijayne87Sheffield, United Kingdom
Title: Good dessert
Review: Went to kebaya last night and had really high expectations after reading the reviews, unfortunately it didn't really live up to them. It's a lovely restaurant and the food is good but a few things let it down, first of all we were talked out of getting two of the same side dishes as they said it would be good to have something different, we wish we had gone with our initial choice as the veg tempura was lovely and the other salad thing wasn't really to our taste. Second, our main courses were given to the table next to us by mistake and we had to wait longer for one of our mains to come which meant the rest of our food was getting cold on a stand near us. No one apologized for this and it was just brushed over. The atmosphere is also lacking a little. The desserts almost made up for this though as they were delicious, my partner had the chocolate fondant and he loved it, but my pandan creme brulee was amazing, I just wish it was bigger! Cocktails are pretty tasty too. Overall it was a nice meal out but Im not sure it deserves to be number one in George Town, I've had better dining experiences elsewhere.

Author: ScottishTraveller3Edinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Quite something! And really good value.
Review: I__e been working in Kuching for the past two weeks and I__e eaten here twice. It__ centrally located and the prices are very reasonable (I don__ want to say __heap_ because this food is anything but __heap_). This place serves outstanding food; I__ go so far as to say it__ been the best food I__e eaten whilst I__e been in the Kuching area. I can recommend the Chicken Tikka Masala and the Lamb Shank Biriani, because that__ what I had, but their selection of naans is fantastic too. If you__e in Kuching, you MUST eat here whilst you__e here; you__l be glad you did!

Author: AnnaC11878
Title: Awesome place to hang out!
Review: Neighborhood cozy bar in TTDI that serves really good food with great ambience. Serves variety range of cocktails and beer from the tap, and also various type of liquor, this bar is certainly very famous among those who enjoys quiet time with loved ones or even with those who wants to have a romantic time with their loved ones! They even make the extra effort to decorate a lil for any celebration that you might have! Steaks, chicken wings, tacos, pizza and many more! Rahman the manager with the cute lil MrPotato moustache, is really helpful and funny!

Author: 145arranhKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Raw Chicken
Review: Have been here a few times and have been generally impressed with the quality and taste of the food. However, visited today and was served a completely raw chicken burger. I'm glad I cut it open with a knife, rather than blindly taking a bite. Very unpleasant experience. Item was removed from the bill but no other discounts or remedies offered.

Author: FowlerY
Title: Disappointed even before my visit
Review: Trying to call the restaurant for reservations on numerous occasions but nobody seems to answer the call from morning till evening. Email sent was not attended and as such, decided to choose another dining location. No restaurant with their ratings should maintain this kind of standards hence, not recommended.

Author: leestravel
Title: Avoid this place. Really (really)
Review: Avoid this place. Really (really) slow service and felt unwell after eating here, have to walk through the kitchen to get to the toilet. Good reviews are confusing? Really poor.

Author: daderaderChicago, Illinois
Title: Huge buffet. Mostly bad
Review: Huge buffet. Mostly all bad except for the dessert. Sushi is okay. Wok noodles are meh. Meats are all dry. Drinks are cheap yellow sweet sparkling wine and water that is so lemon soaked it is basically lemon juice. The carbonara and bolognese are an injustice to pasta.

Author: Adeeb K
Title: Dead as a door nail!
Review: Staying at the Westin for few nights. Thought the bar downstairs would be right place to go on a Friday night. Remember it being very "happening" when I last visited several years ago.The world has obviously moved on since my last visit! The place was dead as a door nail at 11pm. Was served by the lone waitress there, who obviously was not trained to smile at customers...or had been told that bars are generally meant to be happy places.For a place with a bar, the set up was slightly strange. Only two bar stools at the otherwise reasonably long bar. That itself gave an "unprepared" look. Would not recommend it at all. If you plan to stay in...raid the minibar (which only has two sad beers)...switch on the tv; that will be more "buzz" than the trek downstairs!

Author: AccidentalTouristTGBan Chang, Thailand
Title: Disappointing
Review: Pretty average food that is clearly aimed at westerners (the seemed obsessed with pointing out to diners that dishes were 'spicy'), indifferent service (food sent to wrong table, had to ask for bill 3 times) and the feeling that this is a restaurant resting on its laurels. Starters were OK ('Top Hats' and some greasy dumplings) then had an extremely chewy and fatty chilli-pork dish and Ikan Asam that could have been turned into flip-flops. The mock-distressed interior is quite atmospheric, but this is a completely phoney experience - expect to be surrounded by Europeans and to order from menu entirely in English. Not expensive, not cheap. Came here based on Lonely Planet review, but I reckon things may have gone downhill since their writer visited.

Author: APisME95Philadelphia, Pennsylvania
Title: Great bar in Bukit Bintang
Review: My wife and I were staying in a hotel nearby, and decided to check out the many bars on Changkat Bukit Bintang. Whisky Bar definitely stands out as one of the best! Their cocktails are great value, and actually taste great and strong! Our waitress, Rachel, was extremely kind and took great care of us. Highly recommend!

Author: P K
Title: Local taste for visitors
Review: Nice restaurant in the mall that serves local food and has a well explained menu, with nice pictures of the dishes, making the choice much easier.

Author: Klutch41London, United Kingdom
Title: Not Too Bad if Staying at the Hotel
Review: We ate here for lunch after having a lazy morning by the hotel pool. We were surprised to see one girl (maybe 16?) doing EVERYTHING. That is, cooking, cleaning, taking orders, serving drinks etc. I ordered the chicken pie, which came out okay. Good western food is generally quite hard to find in Malaysia, but Basaga did it okay.

Author: OuiOui_8Sydney
Title: Exceeded our expectations!
Review: We visited Favola restaurant tonight. Our group was composed of 2 adults and 2 kids. As soon as we arrived we were immediately welcomed and seated at our table. The staff took our drink orders within a few minutes and we were served a plate with hot bread and oil_. The staff were very attentive without being over the top which I appreciate. We were very impressed with the atmosphere, style and decoration of the restaurant. The food was matching perfectly the atmosphere and as our family is Â½ Sicilian I can confirm that the food served was exactly like in Italy without any twists. Our children ordered spaghetti Bolognese. The serves were more adults serve than kids size. Both children loved it (which is hard for them as they love Nona__ pasta). My husband had the spaghetti vongole and I had the gnocchi gorgonzola. Both mains were amazing and good size dish as well. I really loved my pasta. For dessert we had the cassata and profiteroles and again both dish did not disappoint. The menu had a bit of everything and also covered different style and taste.I would definitely highly recommend this restaurant. Also, we are staying at The Hilton next door however the wait staff advised us that we could get our bill charged to our room (next door__ hotel). That was another good thing and good to know.

Author: manhattan64Hong Kong, China
Title: Itt is Not Bad but Far from Really Good Too
Review: We walked by and it looked decent enough for a casual lunch. The combo rolls is very good although the dips is a little lame. The chicken salad with lime and basil is also good quality but as little bland in the dressing. The mixed bed noodle got the right condiments off lime, raw bean sprouts and basil but the broth and the mixed beef ingredients is also mediocre. But overall still pleasant and a safe bet for a quick Vietnamese meal.
Restaurant: Du Viet Vietnamese Restaurant, Kuala Lumpur

Author: Terrylmh
Title: Highly Recommended
Review: Food and services are wonderful. I personally like their Grilled Baramundi with angel hair. So far I have the best angel hair in town. Highly recommended

Author: klowhm
Title: Good food and service
Review: Came here for father's day dinner. Veal is good and so is the lamb cooked 3-way. Service is also good and staff are well trained

Author: PenangBillAyr, United Kingdom
Title: A lovely experience
Review: I passed this place by chance this morning and decided to try dinner there with a friend this evening. It was a good decision!We shared the roast chicken and it was perfect. I loved the accompanying dauphinois potatoes, roasted garlic and the mushroom sauce but perhaps some green beans or another vegetable would have been nice as well.We didn__ have much room left for dessert but shared the profiteroles with ice cream. I found them a bit heavy but I guess that couldn__ be avoided because of the ice cream.The service from all who attended us was great. Friendly and helpful but not obtrusive. I will be back to try some of the other dishes on the menu.

Author: Escape17407264347
Title: Breakfast
Review: We had included breakfast and it was continental. Big dislike for the choice of food there. Also drinks were quite pricy.

Author: bhatku101Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nice ambience, ok food
Review: We went to have dinner at Holy Guacamole after observing that the place seemed full all the time. Also there did not seem to be many Mexican food options around. We found the food to be lively and crowded. The food however was average. Really nothing special.

Author: PramodNanjareddyBengaluru, India
Title: Why Nero Nero is Authentic Italian Restaurant in KL?
Review: Happened to Visit KL two weeks back and it was already decided that I will be visiting Nero Nero because of the Chef. I know the Chef Giuseppe who had worked in Bangalore, India earlier and now in KL at Nero Nero. So visited here and then got to know more about the food and ingredients from the Chef.. What I learnt is they import most of the ingredients from Italy to give the best Italian Cuisine to Malaysians. Had amazing time eating the splending Pastas, Pizzas, Wine, Olives, and the most Delicious Truffle Paste Pasta...with exotic Italian dessert to end the meal. It was easy to locate the restaurant as it was in a Mall called DC Mall (if I am right). Must Try : Talk to the Chef and place the order, you will understad why you should eat specific and if you are interested, ask him to tell the history of the particular dish. :)

Author: Arshaad2010Sharjah, United Arab Emirates
Title: Very poor service and unlike other branches
Review: Already tasted dishes at Utama1 shopping mall and at Midvalley ,thought lets try here,so i brought my parents along...but first we were given the corner most end table and then saw that no one came to take order from us though they took from two other table where customers came after me.I had to get up raise my voice a bit to tell them that our family was unattended...the Pai thee was too small sized,the lorbak had skin on in the dish,disgusting....none of the dishes I had was good,also more expensive than other branches,i will not eat here again nor recommend this branch....

Author: noisyminor
Title: A bit disappointed in the service this time
Review: This is THE steakhouse we must visit when we come to JB every time. No exception. We came for a piece of tender juicy steak cooked to perfection on our last night here.We didn't have reservation but we arrived early so there were still tables available. Note to self. Book a table before coming especially on a weekend night.I was quite disappointed in its service this time. The servers from Philippines rushed to explain its separate and somewhat confusing steak menu the moment we were seated. I had to tell her please wait till the other party returned from the restroom. Or else she would have explained again!Then the onion blossom was served with bbq n mayo (sour cream? Didn't taste exactly like either one). I had to ask for the cheese sauce that was supposed to go with it then it was served.Even before we finished the onion, another male server wanted to remove the onion as he said our steaks were coming up in minutes! What was that about? We didn't have the reservation so rushing us to finish the food thus the table could be yield for another group?I have zero complaint about its steaks as they were fantastic but the service crew could have had some training on "not rushing its customers". People come here to relax and enjoy a good meal. Not rushing to chow down chunks of meat.

Author: Wong2080
Title: Good Prices but Bad Service
Review:
Good selection at reasonable prices.
However service is bad as staff are very busy running around tables.

There should be a SOP for staff to check on tables regularly.

Author: peterjlondon1London, United Kingdom
Title: Ignored
Review: We stopped by yesterday during a walk along the beach for a drink, as the restaurant was thinning out after late breakfasters and looked good. There was a welcoming sign saying __ome in and take a seat_, so we did.We were totally ignored by the several waiters busy chatting amongst themselves.After 15 minutes, we felt rested and left. Yes, we could have waved to get attention, but we were the customers, and the waiters could not care less. There was no sign of any management at all.

Author: alizoebDar es Salaam, Tanzania
Title: This branch is an insult to the franchise
Review: I have stayed in usa for 6 years and there has not been a single disappointment in my entire experience , however the chili__ in petronas tower is horrible , my steak was over cooked (I honestly feel they don__ know the difference between different done-ness) - one of my friends did not get his food over 40 minutes despite reminding them multiple times - chili__ u need to investigate this branch !

Author: Traveller_SGG
Title: Tasty Food @ 17.50
Review:
Requested for drumstick. Food served within 15 minutes. 
Quarter chicken + 3 side dish + 1 muffin => 17.50 
Half chicken => 26.95

Author: HengSKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Love the desserts
Review: Generally the food are good especially the desserts. However, there is an issue with the staffs, very unprofessional, give no attention to the customer, you are lucky if you get their attention after 5 times calling and waving hand. and at the end they will forget everything about you and you have to repeat the stupid movement one more time.

Author: Johorean
Title: Out from your list
Review: Price not worth for their food. Charge too high and food not nice.. I can said is bad. Very salty and taste not even 10% like Malaysia local food. Local come will definitely disappointed. 4 star price but 1 star quality.

Author: hammyjames1980Mantin, Malaysia
Title: Large order for delivery 45km away
Review: Made a large delivery order of a range of products - sausages, meat, burgers, bakes and biltong - for a group of friends. The order came as arranged, with individual orders separated out for convenience this end. Biltong was amazing, sausages (which I've bought before) were great - and everything looked fantastic. As we are based some distance away in Negeri Sembilan, it's a great service in these troubled times. Always good to support a small business as well - have recommended to lots of staff I work with.

Author: devonc918Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: 2nd visit and loved it again!
Review: My 2nd visit and still love their laksa! A little and humble place, run by a sweet and kind owner. Service was excellent and the food was super tasty, we finished our bowl to the last drop.Overall, a pleasant experience and highly recommended if you're in Penang.

Author: PBRinger
Title: Great Breakfast
Review:
Stayed at Holiday Inn Glenmarie many times and the breakfast never disappoints. 

Plenty of choice for Asian and Western tastes and a great start to the day. 

Always look forward to having breakfast.
Restaurant: Kites Restaurant at Holiday Inn Kuala Lumpur Glenmarie

Author: dannyyusuf
Title: What an amazing restaurant
Review: Celebrate my birthday dinner here. The food were amazing, never tasted such good salmon belly. Will definitely come again. The crew, especially Ms Azura, Ms Zuraini, Ms Aishah and Mr Ben were so helpful in explaining the menu. Will definitely come again

Author: amyyberriesKuching, Malaysia
Title: The food were nice but....
Review: love their chicken butter since I tried it first time here. they have variety of food choices and seafood at night. The only downfall for me is the prices are rather quite expensive for me. Service : 3.5/5Price:2/5Quality of food : 4/5Overall: 3.5/5

Author: Maizatul Akmam BKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: That's one huge pizza...
Review: The restaurant is cosy but need more tables to cater for the crowd esp groups. The pizza is huge, enough for 5 people (if cut into 10 slices). It's quite pricey for 1 pie..then again it's in Bangsar, where all the yuppies and expatriates go. However, the taste is good n fresh. Do not compare to those pizza chain.

Author: MelodyMaker29
Title: SUPERB
Review: We ordered spaghetti carbonara and that was one of the best I've ever tasted. You guys should try. Theres a guy I think his name is Jeeva. He has good communication skill and very friendly! Nice place to eat!

Author: paulryan1982Tokyo, Japan
Title: Definitely not the best Italian restaurant in KL
Review: Have been here with friends recently and it is safe to say that although the atmosphere is quite nice the food is not the best in town. I've personally been to Naples quite a few times, and the pizza is definitely not what this restaurant is offering.

Author: Steven-KKKPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Last Lunch before MC0 3.0
Review: Well, it is sad that we unable to dine for the next 2 weeks. Before Mco 3.0, we had our lunch there and the food never disappoint us. Nothing Is better than having the freshest food direct from 5 stars quality kitchen. Specially thanks to Mr Kai Chi for the warmest service.

Author: rogmassoud
Title: Amazing Spanish food
Review:
The Gmabas and potatoe croquettes were delicious and the tiramisu to die for 
Great service thanks guys

Author: laosiz
Title: Over rated
Review: Sad to say that the place is over rated. The Nonya laksa tasted more like curry laksa. The fried meehoon was over powered by the garlic. The mee goreng was no better. However the queue doesn't seem to stop at lunch time.

Author: sviu j
Title: Waste of Money
Review: The meat was overcooked and cold, including the GARKIC SAUCE the feelings was eat and leave this place as soon as possible, they are not welcoming at all...the sense that American lady gives you it's only give me your money! I was being stolked by the service while I was on the phone, as they thought I would not pay. Basically one of the worst dinner ever! Average spending 250 per person! If they are not passionate in what they are doing I suggest to fund them an alternative job!

Author: TennysonHiiKuching, Malaysia
Title: Poor service
Review: We went in with 4 person but 1 person food was delay. When we were half way through while still waiting for the last order to arrive. we saw them busy serving other table's orders even though the guest just came in. We confronted the waiter and the guy at the counter said that the guest ordered through watapps and they r regular customer. Can u believe that. After serving all of their food including some takeaways then our last order arrived, ha..ha..ha...what kind of restaurant is that.

Author: DHwangShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: No longer my favourite, not even close
Review: Lemon Garden's seafood buffet used to be my family's favourite - especially around Christmas time where we expect spread of varieties esp. desserts and Yule logs. It's quite disappointing to see how the food quality and choices have gone down so much. Dessert bar is such a let down that my kids had felt such disappointment. Restaurant also made 2 slots for each dining session, which they make you finish within 1.45 hour. It's not a place for you to enjoy and chit chat over dining tables. Very mechanical eating session where you will just be rushing to complete eating.Still surprised how can a restaurant go down its standard so much. For us, most likely never again to Lemon Garden

Author: 802ericgBell Buckle, Tennessee
Title: Not impressed. Bad service too.
Review: The restaurant has a good atmosphere. Now onto the bad:The service is really poor. We sat down and nobody came by again for 20 minutes. It was not busy at all. There were plenty of workers but none seemed interested in serving us. It didn't get much better. No drink refills. No check. I had to almost walked out because I could not pay and our ride was waiting. Now, I don't normally complain about service, I'm there to eat not be pampered, but this was quite poor. The food could have been amazing and the night would have been ruined because I was angry about the service. The food. It was ok. Not bad. Nothing special. I would say it was the worst meal we had in KL even compared to mall food. Not terrible just ok.

Author: ymt888Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Severely over-rated
