Review: My friend told me that you will need to queue for about 2 hours to get in here. Therefore i was expecting something really amazing. They do have a pretty efficient system to queue. You take your number and check with the screen provided how long you would need to wait. Many people opt to go for a walk before coming back to check on their queue number.Decor wise, Ho Kow is very charming and has plenty of lovely spots for a photo op. Food wise, I could not find anything nice about the food served - the half boiled eggs are pretty much the same anywhere else, the toast was too cold when it arrived to my table and not fresh. And the noodles with curry chicken tasted very bland.

Author: Ahmad Fakhrul R... Y
Title: Too slow.
Review: Service was too slow. After more than 1 hour still hungry waiting for the food end up cancelled some of the order. Even need to wait for the menu list as they dont even have enough menu. Im not sure if anyone willing to wait that long. The staff seem quite stress but i think its due to lot of complains because too slow.

Author: ShiIan CIpoh, Malaysia
Title: __hanks for the experience._
Review: Food was of interesting combination and plate ceremony was attractive. Staff were friendly and accommodating. Ambience was cosy and warm. Appearance wise there is nothing to complaint about. Well done in this aspect. However, the food quality is mediocre and overpriced. Drinking water is not complimentary. Attention reviewers, do not be like me who is sometimes very blatant in comments. This is a second review I am writing. Only give them compliments they want to hear. They harassed and threatened me for giving detailed criticism beforehand. Sorry for any harsh feelings to the restaurant. Note that criticism is a stepping stone for greater success. This life lesson for me overpowered whatever I ate here. Thanks for revealing El Cerdo__ true colours. 1/5 is the lowest possible rating. P.s: The star rating is final.

Author: lenardc2014
Title: Maintaining standard.
Review: Generally pleasant and efficient service.  Steaks are still good - but seem to lack the zing of my earlier visits.  Sides are huge though!  In the end, we left satisfied. And, will be back.

Author: DandaDanielPrague, Czech Republic
Title: Average
Review: Recommended by Lonely P and TripA we went and were a bit disappointed, bit pricey, fast tourist change oriented. The seafood kari was nice but my wife waited for her meal 15 min longer and forgot to prepare one dish. Moreover her Fried Calamari were very dry. Service was not very polite and we had a feeling they wanna close soon and we annoy them. Average experience. Malay places can do better still cheaper.

Author: Littlepods18Singapore, Singapore
Title: Smells better than taste
Review: Love the smell. Will attract you there to try for sure. Lots of people buy from them - maybe the locals like it that way but as a Penangnite who can cook Assam Laksa, I find it too diluted, lacks the fish flavoured soup and lacks spice ingredients. But those first timer, good to try as it is not strong and Assam Laksa is an acquired taste.

Author: hartfamilyinsingaporSingapore, Singapore
Title: Worst meal!!!
Review: We were recommended by friends to try Limestone's Fine Dining so we gave it a go!! What a huge disappointment. Where do I start?We were told there was no apple juice follow by there were no chateaubriand, even though these were on the menu. Seconds later the staff came out and said they have chateaubriand but no wagyu beef!!! So I changed my order to the trout!Chateaubriand came out looking nothing like what it should and a meal that should have been for two, it really was a meal for one at a cost of MYR$125!! My Austrian trout was disgraceful! It was clearly not fresh and cooked from frozen by admission of the Chef!! The Roast Lamb was average and the Yorkshire pudding clearly came from a ready made packet!! The Angus Ribeye was average - portion was good but more fat than meat and the only decent dish was the Salmon!! Even though they did not charge us for the Trout we are still appalled by how this restaurant can be rated as No 1 in Ipoh and a meal that cost us over MYR$600 I would have expected a lot more!We were told the chefs are European but clearly she was local and the service was appalling!! We have to asked for our wine twice and the dishes did not come out together!!! Took the staff 15 minutes to clear up after our main courses and almost 25mins to clear my dish!!!It was the worst meal and what a huge disappointment for my 13 year old that was celebrating his birthday!!!

Author: joelbrown91Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Just don't
Review: Doing everyone a favor here. Just don't come to this place.Waited quite some time for our dessert, so looked at the guy preparing it. He casually removes his cap, runs his gloved hand through his hair, puts the cap back on and continues working. At this point we decide to forego dessert, went to the cashier to pay. He put on another show for us. Dropped a sliced banana on the floor, picked it up and put it into the bowl. Done with this crap hole for good.

Author: rajamirul01
Title: Prawn
Review: The condiments inside the food especially seafood so bad __ prawn too small even fish ball more big but overall the tease is fantastic ____

Author: mbahidraRiyadh, Saudi Arabia
Title: The best english breakfast so far
Review: I didn't expect that place have a restaurant inside but, what i liked about it the feeling of london old school.The food was fresh and really delicious. The staff also super friendly. I give my salute to the chef too. If you will ask me if i will again. I will diffiently.

Author: Mukesh70Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Tasty Indian food in Brickfield.
Review: Nice and spacious restaurant just across Central mall in Brickfield. Very convenient location. Food is very tasty. Paneer Kofta and Tawa vegetable is excellent. If alone you can try Thali which is combination of North and South Indian food. Staff is very good. Good service. Rates are also very reasonable.

Author: Lnurb
Title: Plastic found in rice
Review: I made an order for thai fried rice for take away. I__e always ordered the same in other dolly dim sum outlets such as avenue k and ioi city mall. The taste was bland not like the other outlets ive been to and the most dissapointing part was that i found plastic in my rice. Dissapointing how careless their staff is with the cooking.

Author: shavaunne
Title: Superb!
Review: This is a must to visit if you want authentic quality food. Had the best mango salad! Well presented and authentic.

Author: Manis10Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Discriminated by rude hostess and the food was tasteless
Review: I am a frequent customer of Bens and today experienced the Worst treatment and n food ever. 1230pm on 20 April @KLCC the hostess was extremely rude and discriminatory. When it was my turn at the queue, she asked the caucasian couple behind me, can i help u? She took their request for table for two, being Asian i didnt interrupt and when she finished i said excuse me, table for four. She asked for my name and when she couldnt spell it and asked me again, I replied again, she put the pen down and looked away as though in sheer frustration. Later, another caucasian party of 3 arrived and she noted their request.When the tables were available, she called out to and seated the party of 3. I asked whether my table was ready and she said yes. Why then wasn't i called, I wondered. As i walked in i asked where the table was and she said they will show you. But there was no "they" to show Me. I had to ask another waiter where my table was.When the food arrived, softshell crab pasta, it was tasteless, there was no chilli padi, just chilli flakes. Not as per menu.

Author: r2thebizelPattaya, Thailand
Title: Usual Decency
Review: It's the smallest Hard Rock I've been to but still great food, service, music and items on show - would still recommend.

Author: HPWu
Title: Not suitable for family with young children
Review: It is located along Jonker Street. Easy to find but it's too crowded. Good place to have a snack and rest.

Author: EmmaFromFinland
Title: One of the best restaurant experiences in a while
Review: Just extremely delicious food, especially the bibimpap was amazing and authentic and superb service all the way!

Author: Yang Ykl
Title: Nice restaurant but poor service!
Review: We used to dine here with families and friends as we are staying around here. Love the food here but this time we were very much disappointed with the service! Maybe this time we didn't order wine by bottle as we used to instead of juices as we brought kids over! They seemed to treat us better before when we ordered bottle wine, same goes to other guests!Their so called fresh lemonade was filled up with a fulled glass of ice with artificial lemon juice and charged at rm16 ++per glass which is supposed the price of a "Fresh Juice " in fine restaurant or hotel! With this kind of price, they should have given customers a fresh juice rather than a syrup lemon juice and fulled of ice cubes! We feedback to a lady named by Jamie, but she didn't even care about it and gave us a non friendly look! When we pay the bill, she just put down the bill folder and never even smile or say thank you but with a very long facial expression that we felt not that pleasant ! It's just a juice for a kid, lady... Service industry come on....Well, it is not easy to operate a restaurant in this area and I believe with this kind of attitude, maybe it's time for this restaurant to think about what lies in the future!

Author: anliza
Title: Prefer the Selangor branch
Review: The Selangor branch is much better than at JB. Hope they can serve well like Selangor branch. Besides, the taste also very different.

Author: chunchongbehKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Serve One of the best Carbonara in town
Review: Ante is one of my favorite restaurant because of the quality of it's pasta, especially the Carbonara. However, it is famous for other porky dishes. The location of restaurant is a bit difficult to find as it is located at a few floors below the Publika Shopping Mall, facing the side road and not very visible signage. Please remember to make reservation for weekend dinner, especially Friday and Saturday night as it is always full. Week days are fine.

Author: V8598MGmarinar
Title: Not recomendable place :(
Review:
I expected a lot more because I saw the restaurant between de first 20 ones at KL
So... service was slow, cocktail was Oka, nothing impressive, and food is not so good, I justo try the Capellini Seafood, the overall experience is not worthless.

Author: EzLiivaPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Perfect for Mamee lovers
Review: It was okay, a very novel idea to have a themed cafe based on Mamee, brings back memories. I studied in Malacca and the smell from the Mamee factory tells me I'm almost there. However, I'm afraid that was the only charm. The food and drinks are okay, everything was okay! I wish there is something else to add on to the business, but I have no idea too!So I guess it is what it is, a tourist attraction. Malacca definitely has tonnes of other amazing places for foodies. I would recommend this venue for the experience, not for the food or desserts.

Author: Multidrop G
Title: Terrible and Horrible
Review: Went to the Setapak Branch after reading about their " Best Cheese Naan" in town. It's actually very very average, nothing special compared to other Mamak Cheese Naan. But the worst of the worst is their Tandoori, its a disgrace calling that piece of chicken Tandoori. The idiots some more charge us for the Dhal and chicken curry. How are we supposed to eat the Naan without any gravy. Service was bad, food was a disaster and price was ridiculously high. That trip would be Our First and LAST to this shop.. Ever Period. We would advise other people also to shy away from this place.

Author: S DSydney, Australia
Title: Disappointed
Review: The buffet spread for both dinner and breakfast is expansive but unimpressive. I also detected dishes that seem recycled from the previous night for breakfast. Given the immense culinary delights that Malaysia possesses, this buffet seemed to miss every opportunity to capitalise on. Particularly disappointed as the buffet offerings at their properties in Jakarta, Manila etc are simply outstanding.

Author: Henry HKuching, Malaysia
Title: No Have
Review: Twice i have been here and must say today was an absolute disaster. On my first visit the did not have one of the items i wanted. Ok, can happen. However today from the 4 starters did not have 3 of them. From the 2 salads on the menu did not have any. From the 3 soups they offer only one. This is absolutely a bad score for a restaurant with this reputation. In Bangalore - India was much better. Service is slow due to minimum manning.

Author: 23Euphric_TravellerMumbai, India
Title: Average experience
Review: We had been there as part of group tour buffet. Initially on day 1 the food was good but later on till the day 3, the food quality deteriorated probably due to rush. Variety had diminished and the curries became watery. The ambience was good but the watery curries marred our experience there.

Author: AdammikaeelJohannesburg, South Africa
Title: Unclean prawns
Review: We had heard about this place before coming to Melaka.We had already eaten, but decided to sit anyway and snack during the evening. It is tapas after all.The menu looked great, as did the place itself. Alas, they only offered about 6 savoury items from their whole menu for that evening. That was sad, and offered very little in the way of vegetarian or seafood (we are not vegetarian but enjoy a variety with tapas, which is the point of tapas isn't it).One of the plates we ordered was the garlic prawns. Given the look and feel of the restaurant (trendy and upmarket), as well as general food standards in Malaysia, we assumed that the prawns would be cleaned. They were not and we have now learned the hard way.We ate the part of the prawn below the vein, and did our best to avoid the vein. It tasted ok, but the meal itself was spoiled. Shocked that a place of this calibre does not clean their prawns.We will however try to give them another chance. Hopefully they serve more than 6 savoury items off the extensive menu!

Author: Melissa CPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Bangsar outlet review
Review: Service was very good - the waiter could memorise our order and the food service was prompt. Gorgonzola pizza and scallops are recommended. The mac and cheese is tasty, however the fried beef bacon on top could be interesting or ruin your experience. Nice selection of wine at reasonable prices and decent corkage for our own wine. Creme brulee was sadly overcooked but other than that it was a very pleasant experience.

Author: MengL212Chiyoda, Japan
Title: Dim Sum and Mexican!
Review: In the mall opposite KLCC there is a restaurant where you can find traditional dim sum and also order Mexican fare such as quesadillas and chips with guac! How unique is that! The servers are really friendly and we enjoyed our food with a pitcher of classic margarita. Not expensive for the quality of food and service offered.

Author: AlocalExPatKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A great beer
Review: Always a great place to meet and share an ale plus some reasonable "home country" food. Watch out for the cranky Scottish owner Dougie (kidding) - he will make a friend of a total stranger and have you laughing till you cry.Typical ex-pat pub, with great service and good food / beverages. A must if your missing something from home

Author: RyunamiMalaysia
Title: Halal and delicious - try it at Bukit Bintang branch
Review: I was told about this halal Hainan outlet in Bukit Bintang and so .. every time i stay in Bukit Bintang, i will go to have my lunch and dinner there. Normally i dont eat steamed chicken but it is exceptional for Chee Meng; i really love the steamed chicken because being cooked properly and you wont find it half-cooked or blood in the chicken. Other than that, you get lots of crunchy peanuts in the chicken soup!! Other than the chicken rice, i love its wantan soup too! Hao chi!!

Author: Ultra MPetaling Jaya
Title: Good for Afternoon Tea
Review: We decided to rendezvous at this cafe for a quick meeting in Ipoh. First impression, eclectic (read disarrayed knick-knacks all over the place) interior furnishings in a semi restored air-conditioned colonial building. So far, its passable.Tea was served, products from Sabah Tea. A welcome change from the usual Darjeeling and Lapsang Souchong. The fragrant tea was refreshing, a respite from the blistering heat outside.Snack and sandwiches were delicately prepared. Crusts were discarded and neatly arranged in a three-tier contraption. Patrons were mainly ladies-who-lunches, killing time.All in all, it was a welcome change from the usual fast food offerings. Concept was good, and the restaurant manager tries hard to sustain and maintain the ideas perceived by the owner.I wouldn't mind to drop by if I happen to be in Ipoh again, but not too frequent must go place, I hasten to add.

Author: AbdNor R
Title: Local Malay Cuisine
Review:
A buffay style, lots to choose from plus there's an entertainer while you having your meal.

Price reasonable about $50 ringgits per head but all you can eat love it!!!

Author: myjackyling
Title: No good
Review: I have dinner with my family. The food no nice and salty, don't have menu, you need order the food at outside. Expensive.

Author: KLRocketManAyer Keroh, Malaysia
Title: Average food but nice decoration
Review: Parking was not a problem. For me, food were just average. Had meat ball spaghetti, pineapple fried rice and oxtail soup. Only liked the meat ball as it was tasty. Price was expensive though.. nice decoration and very cozy. Good for relaxation but dont expect too much from the food especially those i mentioned above.

Author: G4932SWkarensKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Tasted Good
Review: Very crowded but we got in really quick. They are very efficient in how they do their wait list. They give you a playing card and when that card it called you get seated. We sat with another asian women who spoke no english but it was fine. Food tasted really good and was reasonably priced and served quickly. However, I did get sick that night. Not sure it was the food though. My husband was fine and he ate the same thing.

Author: 256chuaz
Title: NICE FOOD.
Review: The food is very nice and good to eat. the fast food is very near to the V8 hotel.  the place is very clean

Author: KumaraguruVJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Wanted to have a quick lunch (15.01.2016) about 1.55pm
Review: This will be my last visit to this place, the basis why is the supervisor (slightly bald) guy refused to take an order of masala tea at this time as he said they only serve after 3pm, he said only juices available. Thus order lassi and sambar rice. Upon paying I as the cashier why u don't serve tea at this time. He said no such thing!!! hence I approached the supervisor on this and he gave me a lame excuse of the drink maker not free!!! Guys i will make sure none of my family members nor my friends step into this place anymore. Sheer cockiness by the supervisor time to change him or We are not coming anymore. I specifically wanted to have masala tea and this is what i get, RM 9 for lassi and 7 for sambar rice what a disjoint in pricing.

Author: Hairyscot1314Amersham, United Kingdom
Title: Disappointing
Review: The restaurant is all shiny surfaces, hard edges and bright lights and is very noisy, which means that it has all the charm of a factory cafeteria. Roast meats were substantially overcooked and dried out and much of the rest of the fare on offer was lukewarm and unappetising. The cost for two with a glass of wine each was over _100, which is expensive for Kuala Lumpur, especially given the quality of the fare on offer. I have eaten in Shangri La buffets in the past and have always enjoyed them, but this was the poorest by far. It also allowed my wife to tell me that it reminded her why we should never eat at buffets!

Author: colin1201
Title: Come here if you want to get away from the chaos of Jonker Street
Review:
Chill relaxed atmosphere.
Has vegetarian options.

I liked the fact that the food was not heavily salted.
Lots of fusion options too

Prices were competitive.

Author: ind3cisiv3MY
Title: Hi-Tea Buffet with lots of variety & an exceptional waiter.
Review: First and foremost, all the 5 of us stepped in to Essence on 28 Nov and were impressed with one of their waiter. I would like to compliment one of the Malay waiter working for Essence. He's probably one of the most polite, friendly and well mannered waiter we've ever met in my life. Sadly he did not have his name tag on otherwise I would be able to name him here. Now, talking about the food, we love the variety of food essence have. They even have gluten free bread! We tried every single dish that they have and concluded that the food is above average with only 1 not even up to an average standard. The Japanese food is bad. Taste bad, not fresh and it's the most disappointing food presented. The Roast Duck, satay and the prawns(yes, it's so fresh) are a must with their cranberry gelato.

Author: Jennychiew
Title: Nice Vegetarian Food
Review:
Fantastic dinner,great food choices, friendly staff.
We ordered a few things to share and really enjoyed it! 
restaurant is very very clean and cozy.
Highly recommended.

Author: bowin93Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worst experience
Review: It was the first visit but i definitely will not visit anymore. It took too long for the foods to be served, and the foods do not taste good with the price we paid. They allowed customers to smoke even though we are sitting in an area with air conditioning.

Author: ameyajoshi
Title: Decent food
Review:
I visited this place for dinner a few times last month. I quite liked the taste, but the menu was same more often than not
What was really strange was that the change was not given back

Author: moderateguyKlang, Malaysia
Title: Unpleasant Experience
Review: Went there with my family for breakfast, space was limited and the area had very few available parking spots. Entered the restaurant and owner seemed to be having a bad day, does not feel welcoming at all because her face was so long the whole time, she kept staring at us. Service was horrible and we were treated as if we were going to eat the food and run without paying. Beverages were prepared and served in glasses that were still dirty. No gravy/curry was given with the appam, anything extra had charges. Appam was soggy and sour. Menu had very limited variety of food. Overall, i would not recommend this place. Many better places to have breakfast in klang.

Author: Foodie1978London, United Kingdom
Title: A very unfortunate affair
Review: I visited this restaurant this evening with 6 other members of my family and we were sat at the "Chefs Table". The restaurant itself is nicely laid out, although for a "Fine Dining Experience" there are way too many tables in the dining area.This restaurant claims to offer the highest standard of dining currently available in Malaysia, unfortunately it fails to deliver.These are just some of the points which led to this review:1. Dress code - There were a number of people in the restaurant who were dressed in jeans, one person was wearing a football shirt!2. There is a smoking room adjacent to the dining room which is not ventilated and so the smoke filters very quickly into the dining area.3. The staff have no idea what each course is, how it's prepared, how to pronounce it and serve people in a first come first served attitude instead of serving the ladies of the group first, and even serve the food if the customer is absent, i.e. gone to the loo!4. The cutlery is not silver, and the staff do not seem to understand the difference between a steak knife and a fish knife.5. The "Bottled Water" served is from a $2 plastic 500ml bottle which is charged at more than $10 a go, it isn't even decanted.6. One course of ours was accidentally served to another table, and instead of the chef remaking it he ordered the waiting staff to recover the plates from the table and served it to us!7. We were sat at the chef's table, but the chef did not once talk to any of us, we were never asked if we were enjoying our meal once, not even by the Maitre__. From the start this was a terrible meal, only one course was halfway decent and we left the restaurant wanting and hungry, this is a shame as the restaurant has the potential to be an exceptional place to visit, but unfortunately; for now this is definitely one to avoid.

Author: ayajoe1173
Title: The portion is too little..
Review: Order for fried mee hoon. Small quantities and no taste. Not happy with it.. Not happy of the quality of foods.

Author: Alpina_B3_LuxWincheringen, Germany
Title: Gorgeous setting, fantastic food
Review: We spent 6 days in Langkawi, and used each evening to visit another restaurant recommended by Tripadvisor. We really liked all of them - but the La Sal stood out even among such excellency. As we were staying in a hotel in Pantai Cenang, we walked there which is quite fun in the evening, as there are people everywhere and restaurants galore in any direction. We were greeted very friendly at the reception of the Casa del Mar (which also seemed to be a really nice place to stay) and were directed towards the restaurant. The best spots to have dinner are the tables placed directly on the beach - although you'll also have a nice view from further inside, the atmosphere is really best when you're close to the sea. The staff was friendly, enthusiastic and attentive, and the decoration of the tables simple but luxurious; in fact, if it were not for the exotic location, it could also have been a high-end European restaurant. We ordered a cocktail for starters while waiting for the food and enjoying the gentle sounds of the sea. The menu itself is well put together and has a lot of variety, with in particular excellent fish and seafood dishes. We went for a menu and loved every dish - the quality was really fantastic and had nothing to envy to really good restaurants that we are used to in Europe. We also had wine to accompany our dishes (a white wine from Australia which was really excellent) and immensely enjoyed the whole evening. Warmly recommended, in particular for couples who want to spend a nice romantic candle-light dinner at the beach!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: 33anujgMumbai, India
Title: Not pizza
Review: We got a takeaway kids pizza for my son cause he wanted to eat in the room.The pizza size was appropriate for a kid. But the taste was horrible. They use barbeque sauce as purÃ©e. Disgusting. And they put at least 500gms of cheese. I'm not joking. It was rubbery and my kid could only eat a little over 1 slice cause was so heavy. The cheese felt as though they cut a block of cheese and just put it on the pizza. Was at least 2 centimetre thick and white (uncooked).Wouldn't recommend. Quite terrible. The in room dining pizza is marginally better.

Author: cheriechee
Title: Birthday dinner
Review: We had birthday celebration in the private dining. The food was excellent, the place has great ambience for friends chatting comfortably.

Author: HongYawJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Great food, great ambience
Review: The restaurant offers greatnorthern indian food and comes with a good fine dining ambience. It is located slightly off greentown, one may bring their friends and family here for fine dining experience.One minor advice is to improve the customer service. Please have your staff to be more attentive and enthusiastic. With that, the restaurant will be better.

Author: sellyjunita
Title: Bad service
Review: Bad service. The waiter is the old lady with glasses. Please learn how to talk with customers. Im staying for 2 nights.

Author: Rayleen H
Title: Terrible
Review: Loved the look of the this place but very disappointed with the portion size of the food. The pork ribs was a big disappointment and looked like beef ribs at first when it was brought to the table. We ordered sizzling chicken but there was no sizzle. Food is expensive not worth going to eat there.

Author: awaywiththefaeEngland, United Kingdom
Title: Attraction food...
Review: Expensive as expected as at an attraction.Food very bland. Meat was not very good. The curry tasted off.The food also did not sit well, so we were glad we only ate half of it!Service was average, was hard to get hold of a waiter.

Author: Wyntn
Title: It was ok. Service slow...
Review: Staffing is so important. They took our order fast, food speed was bearable, but the ice creams took awhile n the receipt !!! That took ages!!!!!

Author: johnny5iceSimi Valley, California
Title: Super friendly service and delicious food
Review: Arrived earlier and the place was pretty full. We were able to get a table by agreeing to eat in 50 min before another reservation party showed up. This worked out great for us given we have young children. So we ordered quickly and the food came out in 10 minutes. Every dish was good. Loved the option of half portions to allow you to try more dishes. Gets 4 stars only because of the ambiance isn__ that great. Anyone staying at the Golden Sands resort should try it one time.

Author: HRHSoraya
Title: Dining in fine style in the Rain Forest never gets better than this
Review:
My review is very biased as my partner Chef Conny Andersson spearheaded the reopening and the exotic menu @Gulai House 
However don't just take my word for it .
A romantic spot .Luxury Dining .Food that stimulates your every sense.

Expensive ,but worth it .

Author: johannc385
Title: Terrible food!
Review:
It looks nice from outside, it is well located but the food is terrible, if you want to eat something nice it is a definite NoGo!
Perhaps coffee or a beer would do

Author: JT88888888Brooklyn, New York
Title: Luke warm Sui Long Bao.
Review: (SUI LOONG BAO) aka Soup dumplings should come as they get out of the pot. They arrived at our table lukewarm and dry up.(left standing too long and staffs no where to be near by) Next table got theirs steaming hot.Have eaten in Singapore four years ago, there's where we first discovered this branch that first started in Taiwan.Service attitude was don't care ...instead of a smile to greet. Charged organic snow pea menu price but bill came without the org snow peas on receipt. Cold chicken with wine and century egg with ginger is ok.
Restaurant: Din Tai Fung at The Gardens Mall

Author: TripperTechKuala Lumpur
Title: Affordable Asian fine dining
Review: A pleasant family outing indeed for a birthday celebration. Food was generally good, full of local flavours with selected Western ingredients thrown in. A unique fusion of east and west in a locally adapted fine dining setting. Would recommend to senior citizens who would like a change from the usual restaurant fare.

Author: CorkLike
Title: Excellent
Review: Fabulous food, superb service, very reasonable prices. If you like Arabic food, you will love this place. One of my favourite restaurants.

Author: jukebox0101Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overpriced, over-rated and very average food
Review: We booked a table for two after hearing the hype and reading some reviews. The menu is beautifully crafted like a book - glossy, attractive photos of the food with interesting and valuable information about the ingredients, how the dish is made and food intolerance. The waitress almost immediately asked if we were ready to order (maybe she didn't appreciate how much time it took to read the menu). The menu mentioned a 20-25 minute wait but the entree arrived within 5 minutes which was a surprise? Table wear/utensils were classy and elegant. THE MEAL: We had mango chicken and stuffed mushroom to start. The mango chicken arrived cold and tasted rubbery and old. The stuffed mushroom wasn't as bad however, the spices were not well integrated and tasted raw. On to the mains - goat curry, tomato paneer, prawn, chicken briyani, green lentils and sorghum bread. Most of the curries/sauces tasted the same (same masala base??) and lacked flavour. Perhaps they were trying to escape the tyranny of curry houses, but to say that the food was bland would be an understatement. The goat was flabby and fatty and the curry (sauce) tasted liked it was cooked separately from the goat. The tomato paneer sauce looked and tasted like baby food; the paneer however was fresh. The prawns were a healthy size but completely overcooked and the soghum bread tasted bland and had the texture of cardboard. They got our lentils mixed up and brought us black lentils instead of the green and by the time they replaced it, we had almost finished our meal. The green lentil was mediocre - never a good sign if the basics are not done well. The only saving grace was the chicken briyani - the rice was tasty and fluffy though the chicken was a little hard and again, tasted old. WINE LIST - very limited for a fine dining establishment. Only one entry level at RM190 with the others being exorbitant. SERVICE: The staff seemed eager to please, however, they lacked the tact, refinement and finesse that would be expected of fine dining. AMBIENCE: It has a French restaurant/bistro vibe - pleasant with nice lighting and relaxing music. The gold winged unicorn at the entrance did seem out of place and the gold toilets were a bit OTT. Each to their own.....after all, The proof of the pudding is the eating and FLOUR failed to deliver. PRICE: EXPENSIVE. Quality of food certainly did not commensurate with the steep prices. Being an Indian and having grown up eating Indian food (I do have street cred!), the dining experience at FLOUR was a disappointment. Even if trying to position itself as serving Modern Indian cuisine, FLOUR does not come close to what constitutes good modern Indian food.

Author: JessOkpkPerth, Australia
Title: Good Food and Great Service
Review: Had dinner here with my husband and some friends and thoroughly enjoyed ourselves. The food was great and the service exceptional, our waiter Alam was excellent and went above and beyond to ensure we were happy and catered for. We easily spent hours there and into the early morning. Would highly recommend.

Author: Jess218
Title: Best Italian Cuisine in town
Review: Im a local. This has been one of me and my sister favourite place to dine for italian food for years. Although the price is a lil expensive compare to the other dining place nearby, bit it really worth every single penny spend. Try their seafood spaghetti and pizza, they are awesome. Not to forget their mushroom soup, you wont forget how awesome it taste.

Author: Vacation166261
Title: Horrible Wantan Mee Seller
Review: The wantan mee seller at Kedai Kopi Lai Foong was horribly arrogant and stucked-up. The young boy taking orders was very sarcastic when I started ordering. Wasted I did not video record of how rude he spoke to us. We are not from KL and we came all the way despite the holiday traffic and parking was limited. Shame on you.

Author: smatth31
Title: Wakatepe Baboon !
Review:
Stuming Colonial house. Menu very simple, only burgers and 2 salad. 
Backpacker style. The juice of the day was amazing, and the burger was great. Just too much spice in the meat for my taste.
Waiter friendly
Nice Place !

Author: keanpohSeremban, Malaysia
Title: Good environment, decent food
Review: Nice environment with marina view. The food is not up to expectations and mostly felt more like precooked food except for the pizza and spaghetti. Car park is bad as it gets water ponding where it rains. Carpark area needs to be rectified. The view alone is not good enough for my return.

Author: Nuriyahali
Title: Brunch
Review: Ambiance and decor is nice. Love the cutlery and the sakura soufflÃ© pancakes. Very light and delicious. Aesthetically pleasing. However, only served after 11.30 and half an hour waiting time and only able to make three servings of soufflÃ© pancakes at a time so this should be advertised or improved to maximise customers. Generally pleasing experience.

Author: MiriSandyMiri, Malaysia
Title: The coolest place in Miri
Review: This is such a popular venue and deservedly so. Its an open air, lively and innovative, friendly and fun casual eatery with a huge variety of food styles freshly prepared from open stalls and brought to your table. Good beer and cocktails too. Everyone loves it - expats, tourists and locals alike. If you're visiting Miri its a must. Try the Masala dosa and tandoori chicken. Kilkenny and Long Island iced tea.

Author: Z2427ILrobertm
Title: Great place, good atmosphere and food
Review: Always good at Havana Bar.. good drink selection , reasonable prices , great ambience and excellent food ..... very casual place, lot of business people go there after work for drinks and a meal so dont tend to get a bunch of young kids there.. wifi good and strong as well.. highly recommend

Author: 30atikaa
Title: Dinner at Cielo ! Recommended!
Review: Everything was fine ! The food was so good ! Anyone like seafood can try at this dining area ! And my recommendations look for Bella ! She was good !

Author: kevinwchan2018Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Pan Mee! Good Pan Mee! But I wouldn't say extremely Good!
Review: I had been patronizing this shop for years - every now and then when I crave for 'Pan Mee'!It served averagely good Pan Mee - with lots of chillis to select from (up to you) - thus, it is good for an afternoon meals or a quick simple dinner.The dried Pan Mee or the soup Pan Mee are equally good.

Author: Akinobu-RayPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Standards are so low the curry house next door is a better option
Review: I have been coming to this place for almost twenty years. First they lost the Sashimi and Sushi and then the roast counter of various western style roasts which used to be the highlight for me.Service is spotty although the staff do try their best when you do get their attention.I've now decided the buffets at Pullman Bangsar's Link and Sunway Resort Hotel and Spa's Resort Cafe offer better value.

Author: AnaihKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice ambience, delicious food
Review: Highly recommended:1. spaghetti meatballs2. Salmon and rice (cant remember the name)3. Teh Tarik Tiramisu..!! _¤ï__¤ï__¤ï_Just ok:1. chicken burger2. cafe latte3. watermelon juiceNot sure what all the fuss was about:- fries and salted egg dipOverall, great place to dine in with the kids and a big family.

Author: BenMoraisPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Marini's Falls Short on Our Expectations
Review: This is a much talked about restaurant, right next to the Petronas Twin Towers and right across from the Mandarin Oriental Hotel. Had been wanting to dine there and an opportunity was presented last Friday.Marini's is situated on the 57th Floor of the building. Getting to it was quite a process. We had to take two lifts, one after another to reach it. But just like in an airport, we had to go through security screening, airline style and had to empty our pockets before passing through a scanner.The first impression on entering Marini's literally takes your breath away.There before us was this impressive, dazzling night skyline of Kuala Lumpur. We felt like we were dining among the clouds!We were greeted promptly and shown to our table right next to the huge floor length glass window. After the four of us sat down, we were warmly welcomed by Izzat, a capable, friendly and knowledgeable supervisor. He was previously a chef. He gave a brief introduction and we proceeded to place our orders. The two men chose a Squid dish for starters and the ladies chose Hokkaido Scallops. Later the men opted for Black Angus steaks ( 180 gm ) and the ladies chose an Italian dish and Lobster Tail. This was where Marini's failed to deliver a superior experience, food wise. The two steaks appeared slightly ' burned ' on the top and I could not detect the unique Black Angus taste. One of the ladies also commented that her Lobster Tail was under cooked. The other dish was fine. Was this because the relief or trainee chef was doing the cooking? The overall service, however, was top class all the way.

Author: Travelicious_K
Title: Just average
Review: The food was alright - just average and nothing to shout about. The service was not the warmest. If you need a quick meal and have no where else to go, this might be a quick in and out option for you.

Author: bcheongShanghai, China
Title: A little bit of Penang
Review: This place comes recommended by my local colleagues. We ordered the usual - fried noodles, Rojak, pie tee etc. overall, they were alright - not bad, and not great either. The specialty noodles that are cooked upon order and takes 20 min didn't taste that special

Author: BartV750Kapelle-op-den-Bos, Belgium
Title: Great location with good food
Review: Had a weekend getaway from KL at Meritus hotel and decided to go for dinner at La Sal next door, based on the food ratings. Perfect sunset location in combination with good food. Pricy nut classy with good food. The Surf and Turf starter was a bit disappointing, dish looked great but meat was dry. The Mek Mek Mek dish (lamb rack) was good.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: jerhewsMorschach, Switzerland
Title: Tasty Eurasian Portuguese Gourmet
Review: Nice set-up and rather friendly place.Good suggestions from staff concerning what to eat. Food from mild to spicy to hot. You can place your request according to your taste buds. Just fire away your orders. Very cooperative. Also recommended though the prices of some dishes are quite expensive. Still worth a try!

Author: Seana L
Title: Disappointing second visit
Review: Went 2 years ago and enjoyed the session even though prior booking is required. This time round, no booking is required, just walk in. So I guessed popularity has decreased. But it doesn't bother us a bit. Then came the most annoying part. My group consist of 6 young kids ranging from 3 to 9 years old. They said they only allow 2 to 3 parents for my group of 6 kids! And some of them are the only child. I told them this wasn't the case 2 years ago! Who is going to handle my 3 year old kid! The answer I received was RIDICULOUS. "What if 1 kid bring 20 adults into the class?" Excuse me, we only have a set of parents for 1 or 2 kids each. I believe the staff should do more observation. In addition, which is the most impt thing, the staff there are obviously not trained to handle young kids. I think my 3 year old will surely get her fingers "rolled" into the noodle machine if I didn't insist my presence in the class.I hope either the management could step up to review the rules or train up their staff to be responsible for young kids' safety.

Author: Mumbai2Johannesburg, South Africa
Title: Beautiful experience
Review: Went to this restaurant with family who lives in Malaysia. . We waited for family in the bar area as this would be a nice place to absorb the ambience of the restaurant before dinner. Seating was for 3 and we requested 1 more chair. Jenny the maÃ®tre dee suggested we have our pre dinner drinks at our table.Not a good suggestion: as we got to our table the waiting staff was rather quick to take our meal order. The waiting staff was pleasant but the whole dinning experience became a little rushed. When eating at a venue like this one would think that the dinning experience would be slower. The meal was mediocre as I think I had better in Penang.the venue actually overshadowed the actual meal.

Author: Sailormoon12Seremban, Malaysia
Title: Terrible & pricey sandwiches
Review: Went to the outlet in 1 utama for the first time. I ordered a plate of sandwiches. The food was indelible and horrible especially the beef bacon as the fillings. It was not cooked well and tasteless. Overall the service was bad and food was not up to standard. I don't really understand what is so special about this restaurant. Also the price is considered quite high. Totally not worthwhile! I wouldn't come here anymore.

Author: Sohailraf
Title: Disappointing
Review: We booked a table for two for our anniversary dinner. We went to the 9pm dinner and the restaurant was 10% full. There was no atmosphere within the restaurant and staff are non engaging. It defo needs a revamp. The food choice was awful. Very little option considering how much you are paying per person you would expect alot of food choices and warm food however it was very dull. There are separate stations where you can get pasta and lamb chops however this was disappointing. The food was cold and the pasta was underwhelming. I would recommend highly against going to this restaurant as you will be disappointed and its money wasted. We ended up just going to macdonalds afterwards as the food didnt fill us up. They gave a complementary anniversary cake which was a nice touch however it was very dry and crumbled when digging it.

Author: woodylightyear7
Title: Delightful setting. Perfect after seeing the Cheong Fatt Tze Mansion
Review: A quiet spot off Muntri street near the Cheong Fatt Tze Mansion (Blue Mansion). Food was reasonably priced and of very high quality. I had the Nasi Lemak and was not disappointed. Also has very good air con and free wifi. Would recommend.

Author: MarcL3608Singapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointing
Review: Having read that this place was voted best restaurant for Chinese food in timeout KL, I decided to skip all other oriental restaurants, and even chynna, for this to celebrate my moms bday, which I truly regretted. Service was unbelievably poor - for a moment I wondered if this was HK Cha chan teng where service level don't matter. We were served by a dedicated waitress (and for once I wish we didn't have a dedicated waiter) who pretty much sulked throughout our time there. She also made it obvious she is not happy by banging the utensils on the table, being rude and rolling her eyes when we made requests for our guests. I Guess service level can make or break a deal to me. And honestly it was a stressful experience as I had guests and this lady waitress was not trying to make it nice at all. What could get worse was that there was somehow a bad smell in the room we were given. And then the food... which I had hoped would be the saving grace but to my disappointment I can only say it's a hit and miss. Several dishes were overly salty and while certain dim sum was quite good, the overall experience is still poor. It's a stark difference from the ming room I frequented for business just 1-2 years ago. At the price I paid, I certainly don think this place is worth a 4-5 rating at all.

Author: Foodieme247London, United Kingdom
Title: The Tom-Yam soup is life changing :)
Review: We went to Absolute Thai @sunwayputramall which was absolutely amazing! The best, most authentic, Thai food u will find without actually being in Thailand. The Tom yam soup, is life changing. The depths of flavour in one soup is just delicious! The pad Thai, Thai fried rice, pineapple rice, prawn Thai omelette, the spring rolls filled with glass noodles and served with home made sweet chilli sauce, the Thai salads (especially the green Mango salad, with crispy catfish), to name but a few dishes are absolutely amazing the best food we__e eaten in a while.... highly recommend if u love Thai food!

Author: NickM254London, United Kingdom
Title: Drinks only.
Review: I'll caveat this review by stating that I've never eaten here; however, I've unfortunately been here for drinks many times, as my boss inexplicably likes it.Maybe I'm getting old (34), but these days I like to find a bar where you can get a table and enjoy the company of the group you're with. Sure, if some of you want to break off to the dancefloor, then it's great to have that available, but I find it nearly impossible to do that at 21, unless you're sitting outside.We tend to go in here a lot as we have clients and investors to entertain outside of business hours. My boss seems to like 21, so we tend to go here every couple of weeks, especially if the meeting we'd had with the clients was particularly boozy. The problem is, if you can't get a table outside, it's almost pointless having any company there at all as you won't even be able to understand the incoherent screaming in each other's ears as the music is so loud. It's also impossible to stand in a group of more than 5-6 due to the bar area being so small, so you're kind of spread out in a line, getting buffeted by people who have had far too many cocktails - especially on Wednesday (ladies night) where the ladies drink for free.The owners/management of 21 also seem to think it's in a far better class than it actually is. One particular evening I was working a late one in the office. I'd been at my desk for 15 hours, so changed out of my suit and into my jeans, a collared shirt and sandals. around 10pm, I get a call from the boss asking me to meet him and one of our newer strategic partners there. Not thinking anything of my attire (after all, I was looking relatively smart), I walked from our office to 21 only to get turned away at the door for wearing open-toed sandals. When I pointed out that we drink in there regularly and had spent close to RM2,000 in the past week alone, the guy on the door got the "manager" who looked about 14. He told me it was policy that no open-toed shoes would be allowed in after 9pm; even though there were drunken tourists staggering around in jeans and Bintang t-shirts, that was ok because they were wearing closed-toe trainers... Come on guys, use your heads.I called my boss who was equally baffled, and also pretty annoyed that he had to leave so we could take our guest elsewhere; I just hope he finally sees the light from this and we don't have to go to this dive again (dive being the operative word, as it's an absolute meat market on a Wednesday), which I'm pretty sure we won't.Drinks prices are relatively high for the area, and you'll be waiting a while to get served as there are too many customers for the staff to handle most evenings.It's a real shame that this place turns out the way it did, as 21 in Bangsar used to be great fun.I'll be more vociferous in deciding NOT to go here for business in future.

Author: crens
Title: Completely overrated
Review: Ate dinner here, both pizza and pasta dishes, and while the pasta is decent enough, the pizzas are incredibly average, and yet not cheap. Each slice has a completely unmemorable crust and absolutely no flavour.

Author: SARALAEJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Nothing great. Average .
Review: I feel that this place is over rated. i went to this place many years backwhen they first opened and decided to go again with my family after lookingat the high review. Well service was average; food was nothing great acceptfor the mushroom soup that is to die for. We waited almost 40 min plus forthe food to be served. Well i don't have much to say about this place. Itlooks like this place is visited by the regulars.
Restaurant: Chez Papa French Bistro and Wine Bar

Author: harishbalaMuscat, Oman
Title: Not worth the money, overpriced and no great taste to call it tasy chapathi
Review: Regret eating at this restaurant. The ambience is very good and definitely looks welcoming. Did the mistake of ordering the thali set. Never in my life have I eaten such a small thali set, still feel hungry after paying a not so small amount. They give only chapatti or a small portion of rice. Its totally insufficient and they are very stingy with portions. The sweet must be the smallest I have ever seen in any restaurant. If at all you have to go here then don't order thali set but others also were not so satisfied with their food. Will never go here again.

Author: claud1ne
Title: Great food, great hospitality
Review: Great food and great hospitality. However, I recommend fellow tourist using a grab instead of driving on their own as the restaurant is not very obvious from the roadside (if you don't look closely you will easily drive pass the place)

Author: KreeshaKateC
Title: Kids Friendly!
Review: The staff greet us and was very friendly. From the service to cashier they all been friendly to their guest. They have a huge clean playroom for my little one to enjoy while Im sipping my coffee. Will come back again for playdates. __

Author: ccl2000v
Title: Found this Restaurant on the average
Review: We patronized this rest last May.  Found the quality of food on the average.  The only dish we enjoyed was the spring rolls, the rest pretty standard.  Menu choice is also standard compared to other Thai Rest around town.

Author: azrin73
Title: Good chinese food
Review: Nice place very comfortable.. service was good staff very polite n attentive..food was above average.. very recommended

Author: Mouse-PrincessSingapore
Title: Surprise if that is the best in Meleka
Review: I was invited to Meleka for wedding dinner n my host booked this restaurant for our lunch. He said this is the best Teochew restaurant so maybe my expectation was too high, kind of disappointed after I tried the food. All the food were average. I only like the yam paste dessert....one of the best I Hv tried. Their specialty black noodle with vinegar taste ok too. The fish was well cocked but not tasty ...

Author: GloriaSomeHobart, Australia
Title: Great atmosphere good food, great value
Review: We visited Thirstday Bar three times during our five day visit to Langkawi. We really enjoyed the relaxed atmosphere and the fantastic views , particularly at sunset. This venue is very popular and you can't always get a beach view seat or table but if you let the staff know they will move you when one becomes available. The food is tasty and reasonable, I was happy I could enjoy sparkling wine by the glass and it didn't 'break the bank'! The staff are pretty busy but we didn't feel neglected at all. I particularly enjoyed going to Thirstday for a pre dinner drink as it started the night off really well.

Author: CJS_in_KLKuala Lumpur
Title: Still smoking?
Review: Food was pleasant, but small portions for the price. Issue was with the staff / owner sitting at the back table of the restaurant (inside) puffing away at a cigarette. So much for the new smoke free environment. Staff sat at empty tables and were watching their customers. Really kinda creepy.

Author: RRla
Title: Just ok
Review: Service is attentive but a little slow. Food was just OK. Not bad but nothing outstanding except for the fried vegetables with lily which is pretty good.

Author: Athirah J
Title: Nice view... Strategic place but not the food...
Review: I came here based on the recommendation from my friend... She know that I am The food lover.. She ask me to taste and give a feedback about the food. Whether we have similar opinion or not. The result totally the same. To get a very a very nice view... Yeahhh here is the place... My First impression through the view was like Wowwwwww.... So beautiful and I love the view.. Enjoying the river view... Beautiful surroundings.... Unfortunately the foods spoiled me. Dutch Harbour crew... Please do something because u have a very nice and strategic place that can attract local people and tourist to come. Keep it up!!

Author: 322vanithas
Title: Soul food made for the discerning
Review: The food is divine, the staff are friendly and the ambience is amazing. Highly recommended for couples, small groups and everyone with a love for a perfect dining experience!

Author: Legal_itinerantKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Ostensibly Japanese but not really
Review: More a stall than a restaurant. You pick a small selection of tempura dishes on display which you take to the cashier and he charges you for your selection. You then help yourself to tempura sauces served from a large thermos flask together with some condiments and tea. Noodles are optional. You take your selection on a tray to nearby tables as you would in a fast food restaurant.

Author: 193michelleqKuala Lumpur
Title: Rude staff worst experience
Review: Nice place to watch sunset but truly the worst ever as a restaurant due to it non professional and rude staffs. My friend order a drink from them and another friend came with an opened can of beer to join us. She was chilling at the other part of the beach with the beer before we called her to join us. Therefore, she has not enough time to finish the beer. As she sat down, one of the staff came and warned my friend to get rid of the beer by saying "I don't want to see that in 5 minutes". I was shocked. How can a waiter talking to a customer in that manner? Fine. After 5 minutes the staff came again and tried to snatch my friend's can. My friend became angry as the staff was really rude to snatch her drinks. The staff started to raise his voice and sounds threatening. My friend requested to see the manager to solve this problem. Unfortunately, the manager defended the rude staff and humiliated my friend in front of other tourists. He even chased my friend out from the restaurant. I am really disappointed with that kind of staff in such a wonderful restaurant. They caused humiliation and embarrassment to my friend which affect my friend's emotion and mentality. They're such a humiliation to Malaysian. No proper manners. Not professional. The worst staffs ever.

Author: sivam127
Title: lunch
Review: service ok, indian vegetarian food not up to standard, Dhall curry plain and flat taste.friend ordered fried mee mamak , very plain .

Author: Vanijey
Title: All time favorite
Review: My favorite nasi lemak and petai fried rice with lychee drink..not only that..the starter meal..satay & otak otak.Good service but always busy and have to queue during Saturday and Sunday lunch hours..price was reasonable with the potion of every served food.I been here more then 5 times but it's my first time to post review.My last visit was before Deepavali 2017, Oct first week.Thank you Madam Kwan.

Author: Sizuka W
Title: Melaka local signature food
Review: I went to this shop at 4.30pm to avoid the crowd. Ban Lee Siang well-known for satay celup. It's bite size food put on a stick then let it cooks inside a hotpot which filled with satay soup. The aroma of the satay soup is amazing. Watch out if u allergy to peanut because peanut is the key ingredient. Price is reasonable only cost rm1 per stick. There is another shop just next door which owned by his brother. I tried the one with blue color signboard. I would recommend that and personally I love the Fu chew meatball. The meatball has filling of another small meatball inside. PS it's little bit spicy.

Author: travelchick202Washington DC, District of Columbia
Title: Incredible restaurant
Review: My husband and I came here for dinner on our last night in Penang and were very impressed. The service was impeccable - I believe one of the owners greeted and waited on us. He was very friendly and gave us the best service we had in Penang. The restaurant itself is gorgeous and full of history and vibrancy. My favorite part was the stained glass windows and the place mats, which had press releases on it. The food was very delicious. We ordered netbread as an appetizer and were very pleased. Our entrees were also very good. The prices are very reasonable - we would have gladly paid more for such a fun experience. It was raining when we were leaving, and the owner called a cab for us, then walked us out with his umbrella. You seriously cannot get better food and service!

Author: serendipity1959Singapore
Title: Poorest service anywhere...
Review: Poorest service anywhere in KL lazy staff who need close supervision. You pay for extra for the bread in this place! We had the seafood for two, langoustines not fresh, neither were the prawns. Lasagna stodgy. Pizza was the worst ever - thin, undercooked crust, scraping of tomato base, one anchovy. Slow food, bcs staff too busy gossiping. This was 7.30pm on a Monday. Beautiful decor is all I can say that was good. Needs a manager. Stay away until they get one. Worst Italian in KL. I saw three customers in nearly two hours : says it all really.

Author: YC L
Title: Delicious Balinese Food
Review: It serves nice Balinese foods, especially the pork ribs. However, the roast pork or the suckling pig has been "Malaysianised" where you don't actually find such dish in Bali. The famous Balinese "Babi Guling" or roast pork is not found here.

Author: AhmedK786Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
Title: Love it and Shisha (hookah) is very good
Review: I loved this restaurant while the food quality is good. location is fantastic and the service is good.it's really near a lot of malls and perfect for arabs who looks for privacy and familiar food.the location is very good and walking distance from multi malls and cinemas..

Author: b00thenendIstanbul, Turkey
Title: Not great but reliable, okay food, okay service, one of the better options in KLCC
Review: Have been going here on and off since 2004 on occasional visits to KL. The eating options in KLCC are pretty uninspiring but this place is: a) convenient, on the ground level b) pleasant with modern decor and a relaxed outdoor area [outdoors is classified as the smoking section -- I'm a non-smoker but it's not a problem] and c) reasonably priced. The food is quite good quality, and very consistent over different visits. The staff are generally helpful and responsive.

Author: FionaLuxKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Anniversary
Review: Pros:1. food was decently good (we ordered the Rib eye, Tagliatelle, and the Risotto) 2. allowed children in the restaurant (big plus since we had a baby and needed a baby chair) 3. We observed that they had prepared some light decor of rose petals and a _38 Signature Cake_ for those celebrating birthdays4. Open-kitchen concept was a nice touch5. Waitstaff & kitchen team got our order preferences right. (we ordered fries non-salted for our daughter and w the parm cheese on the side. It came out exactly as we requested.) Cons:1. Restaurant was too dim it became more like a bar than restaurant setting. 2. service was adequate but nothing beyond expectation, which isn't sufficient for a restaurant of that standard. For instance, we were greeted by the host and shown to our table, but it would've been appreciated if the host had inquired whether we were celebrating anything (seeing as how most of the diners there seemed to be celebrating a special occasion). We were in fact there for our anniversary and my baby's first birthday. 3. Our water goblets were not refilled and we had some difficulty even getting the waitstaff's attention as they were so scattered rather than attending to allocated sections.4. Would__e been nice if they provided children__ dining set5. no staff checked in to see how our dinner was going6. food took quite awhile to arrive (approx 30 mins); there was a bread basket but the bread was nothing memorable or impressive. Would__e been nice if some light canapÃ©s were served between dishes to entice diners while also providing some form of distraction to make up for the long waiting time for dishes7. Lastly, we had a terrible experience with the reservation. A week earlier (on Aug 18), we had called to make a reservation for the previous Saturday (aug 22) but we were informed that they were fully booked, so we opted for the next Saturday (today, Aug 29). As our reservation was made more than a week in advance we forgot whether it was for 7PM or 7:30PM so we called to inquire. Lo and behold, when the staff answered the call, the response was that our reservation was nowhere to be found and all their tables were fully-booked. We were extremely upset as we had been waiting to dine there and see what this hype was all about. The staff then informed that he would check with his manager if they could still accommodate us; thankfully they managed to. We are mentioning this because had we not called to confirm the timing of our reservation and just showed up at the restaurant at 7:30PM just to be informed that our reservation is nowhere to be found, we would've been hugely disappointed and dissatisfied with the whole experience. It would have been appreciated if someone came to address the matter with us and apologize for the mistake, rather than jjst brush it under the carpet and expect the guests to ignore that such an issue happened. This was really the biggest disappointment of all. Thankfully the food and the scenic view saved the day.

Author: DT8888Singapore
Title: Innovative, creative, bursting with flavors, simply delightful.
Review: Nadodi__ contemporary approach to Southern Indian cuisine is a dining adventure. The well thought out 9 or 11 course Degustation menu are a culinary journey you won__ forget. First class Ingredients with meticulous preparation and a highly knowledgeable service team makes this a must try restaurant when in Kuala Lumpur.

Author: IcebergMelting
Title: Great Local Food
Review: Great place to try local food. Need a bit of courage because this place is kinda dirty.

Author: tienkoon1990
Title: Great Ambience and Service
Review: The food is fantastic, had the porterhouse steak. The ambience is great and also thumbs up to Andy and Arif. They really served us well

Author: DrJZSingapore, Singapore
Title: Can be better
Review: Agree with previous writer on the Tiffin. Ordered veg version. 1st tiffin: small potato quartered, 2nd: half potato sliced, 3rd: 3 tiny button mushroom quartered, quite tasteless curry. Big bowl rice, lots papadam sticks and 5 long marinated cucumber shavings incl skin! Not to mention about other disappointing dishes. The bread was tasty. Staff are generally smiling except one female spectacled-staff who at times exchanged verbal frustrations at her colleague and stared at us when we made a request. Similarly, the beer promoter who ignored the female guest if she might be interested to order. Given the hotel reputation and price, one would expect more on food and staff professionalism. We believe Malaysia has excellent food.

Author: DustNox
Title: Very disappointed
Review: Pretty disappointed with this place as we saw the review was pretty high. Food:Food was average, found scales in my salmon and our group was served at different time. More than an hour gap from chicken to salmon to vegetarian main dish.Service: The worst part was the servers_ attitude, super bad service. Server stopped serving drinks before 10pm, we had to self service, WHAT A JOKE for a fine dining restaurant! The air conditioner was turn off befire 10.30pm, as if chasing the customer out of the restaurant. How rude is this? Overall, I would never come back for any event celebration nor I will introduce this place to my campus friends. Cane with food expectation, leave with horrible dining experience.

Author: RoadtripWardAlmere, The Netherlands
Title: Food is great. People are great. Service is great.
Review: Food is really good for an excellent price. As in all other cafÃ©s, the Western food is a little more expensive (but you don't go to Melaka to eat Western food right?). Local food is great as well.We've had breakfast and dinner there, both very good and very nice people.

Author: WoonWGMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Quality and Price
Review: Apparently the 'Kai Mei' or the chicken rear side portion of the chicken is more expensive than the Drum stick or any other parts of the chicken. For RM17.50 will give you a plate of rice with a rear portion of the chicken, some cucumber, a saucer of chilly, and a Bowl of plain black bean soup. It's extremely expensive in Melaka (for that matter any where else) for a plate of Hainanse chicken rice ! Quality is so so. Very disappointed that such shops exist in a tourist city of Melaka!

Author: Caren LKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Delicious Pork Ribs
Review: Is a nice place for friend to hang out and gather. Pork ribs is their signature dish where you must have a try!! If you have no idea what to order, you can ask assistant from their waitress. They are very helpful and will explain all the dishes from the menu.

Author: TJLimSingapore, Singapore
Title: Standard has dropped tremendously
Review: Looks like there has been a change of owner or chef at this reataurant. Food quality and standard has dropped so much that you could hardly recognise any nyonya flavour. The chinchalok omelette was so salty as if the whole packet of salt was added. A replacement came but it was plain omelette without the chinchalok. The sambal kangkong tasted burnt. Ordered fried fish with chilli but what came was assam gravy fish.The rest of the orders were just as bad.Will not step into the place again.

Author: Candymastergirl
Title: Excellent food
Review:
Excellent food
Excellent service
Fresh food 
Friendly staff
But very expensive price
Food with good quality

Author: 211keziahc
Title: Food was ok
Review: You can find the normal Chinese breakfast dishes here. Best to come in the mornings before the crowd gets there. the waiters are pleasant and attentive. The food was good. But it's a little expensive than other dim sum restaurants.

Author: hidayahsazali
Title: Perfect place for dinner
Review: Having dinner and celebrating my birthday here. Their food really really good! Excellent service especially their crew (Liza) very helpful and friendly. Will definately come back and recommend this place!

Author: SexyStern
Title: Horrible Experience
Review: This is my first time visited this restaurant and one word to describe, disgusting. I have waited for 35 minutes until I was served for the first dish, for the fact that few tables beside me came later than me have already been served. The food is nothing more than dining in a hawker stall. The portion is small and it is extremely expensive. Feels like day light robbery.

Author: Jaypee C
Title: Good food in every bit. Good service.
Review: We order their spicy ramen and Chicken Karaage Bento meal. We can say that the food is very good. To the soup, to the side dish, to the bean curd, and of course the main portion. Another thing I like about this restaurant is the very polite and accomodating lady waitress/servers who attend to our orders.

Author: zitasharmani
Title: Ok only lah!
Review: The food was ok only lah! Nothing to shout about. Their new location is not impressive, the whole feel of dining is like any other restaurant.

Author: mt55555
Title: Best middle eastern food
Review: Best middle eastern food ever : they give the boys on edgeware road a run for their money. Couldn't find food  this authentic even in middle east !

Author: foodiesyo
Title: Dim Sum Brunch
Review: We tried their DimSum brunch last week, not much variety of DimSum, however the quality of dumplings were great.The price of their brunch is only RM98+, free flow of dumplings and other main dish which you can try out. Thanks for the team giving such attentive service. Can__ wait to try out their new DimSum soon.

Author: Companion694483
Title: Unprofessional
Review: When we got there , we wanted to see the menu for prices and food etc but the waiter said there isn't one and was very loud/rushy. It was intimidating/pressurising. However one waiter was nice but most are rushy. Food was nice.

Author: TH T
Title: Oasis
Review: It was so cool and comfortable inside this cafe. The staff were fabulous and so very helpful recommending places to visit in Georgetown. We went there several times to use the wifi, drink coffee and escape the heat.

Author: zzoggieKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: You wait for average food!
Review: After reading all the stellar reviews, Wonderland was a must visit for my family. We arrived around 830pm and the place was packed on a Monday night! There was no clear system, some people waited on the sides and others in line holding a menu. You wait in line for a good 20-30mins before placing your order and thereafter you are taken to your table. We waited for about an hr before our food came. While I don__ mind the wait if the food was good, this place was average. Here is what we ordered:Stir fry kang kung / fried egg - normal Steam prawns in egg whites - prawns were large and fresh but unfortunately it was a little over cooked so the meat was rubberyChicken in soy sauce & ginger - nothing greatDeep fried Salted egg squid - deep fried to death until the meat was chewy and too much batter was usedSteam fish in lime garlic - the worst dish of the night. Not only was the fish beyond over cooked, the meat was so so dry! the lime sauce tasted too artificially sweet and I__ pretty sure instead of fresh lime these idiots used lime cordial to cut corners. Overall a very disappointing dinner! Waited an hr and 20mins for nothing. While reasonably priced, will NOT return even if there was no wait. AVOID, not worth the time!

Author: Ms Emma O
Title: Proper hygien/very pathetic ratings
Review: I dine becuase the higher reviews on tripadvisor,. When i first see this resto. I dont even imagine this kind of place,. I didnt expect that the highest reviews on tripadvisor take my feet on this kind of place. So eventhough i have doubt to go and dine, i try to understand maybe the place is old thats why it looks dirty,. But i was wrong,the food is not so good,proper hygien must be implemented on this. i feel that i eat on a street food, maybe a foreign people like me will not appreciate the food, . The food is not so good.. so i go back home dissapointed.. never comeback again.. over ratings take you a high expectations...

Author: marcushmm
Title: Had the Bao-Tea-Ful High Tea
Review: Had the Bao-Tea-Ful High Tea today. Great food and fantastic service from the staff, especially our server Mr Kabir. Definitely will return for more!

Author: cybreed
Title: Disappointing dinner
Review: Had dinner on public holiday, their specialty, ribs, ran out and had to wait 30 mins to defrost and cook. Portions and taste is average. Service was average.

Author: xshaznishahy
Title: Festive afternoon tea
Review: Food: 4/5 (hot dishes is delicious)Ambience: 3/5Service: 4/5 (very thoughtful) Overall: will repeat soon

Author: hayesy2015
Title: Deicious
Review: This fantastic restaurant serves the most mouthwatering steaks in the city washed down with ice cold Tiger beers. Tan Tan the barman was the most fantastic host and was the one to ask for info on the sites and attractions around the city

Author: Prasad_NadkarniBengaluru, India
Title: Excellent food - heavenly place for vegetarians
Review: We tried this restaurant twice in the month of October 2016 and am eagerly waiting for the next visit.We tried a paneer dish with some rotis during the first visit. Our second visit was on a Sunday afternoon when the restaurant had arranged Gujarati food. This experience was awesome and we are looking forward to the next special event at the restaurant.

Author: MankiwiSunshine Coast, Australia
Title: Dolly
Review: Ordered siu mai, har gau, beef ball, lo mai gai & scallop cheong-fan for 11am solo brunch today.Half of the restaurant is 'Mexican' - the other aspiring to be Chinese, one presumes - both are halal. I Iearned a long time ago to avoid 'fusion' restaurants - just do one thing well and the accolades will follow, so unsure why DD has attracted anything other than average reviews given the eclectic food choices in this wonderful city.Cheung fan arrived first - with no scallop in one half - across 3 skimpy rolls, so I sent it back to the kitchen on a round trip which took over 10 min. The embarrassingly tiny portion for 16 ringit was quite doughy instead of being cloud-like & fluffy - this is a benchmark dish for me, and cheung fan is best when done simplest.In 45 years I've also not once found cheong-fan to contain green capsicum cut into squares - that's just plain wrong. Make the rolls a proper size - and leave them intact rather than cutting them into thirdsStaff seemed quite uninterested and didn't engage much - service wasn't slow - but it certainly wasn't fast either.Har gau - 6/10Siu mai - 7/10Lo mai gai was ok - Malay style so no leaf wrap - 6/10Beef ball is w/lemongrass rather than trad ginger - 5/10

Author: boeis
Title: Nice food
Review: Food is nice,the staff are helpful,this is my second time visit,never fail me,it is authentic as the food cooked by natives of the cuisine,this is the reason why people give high rating.it is better not to drive to here as there aren't many parking here but in the complex only,there is only one toilet there so we need to wait a bit when it is crowded,overall the food and service are tip top.

Author: NCNGSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Nice ambience but ok food
Review: Tried their pork belly pasta, seafood pella, signature ribs, Iberian ham salad and pork pizza. I think the ribs dish is the best among all ordered, I had higher expectation on others but it turned out so so. Low possibility I ll visit again unless they have changed and people loves it and write good review about it.

Author: PalaniNarayanan
Title: Chaotic service and inconsistent food
Review: The management really needs to work on staff training both on the floor and in the kitchen. There were three of us- our food did not arrive together, my frond had finished his meal before my salad arrived. The waiter stumbled and spilled water on the table and on me. When he came back with the napkins he left it on the table... (for me to clean up?)Even one of our drinks was left out and when we asked why, well apparently they lost the order sheet.On the good side, the spaghetti was pretty good as was the glass of wine. Lets hope the service improves!

Author: Gloria KLancashire, United Kingdom
Title: No coffee!?!
Review: Just happened to be walking passed as staying at local Pullman Hotel. Looked inviting so thought it would be good for a drink and cake.Unfortunately no coffee at all so very disappointed. If you market somewhere as a cafe/ coffee shop really you should stick one of your core products.

Author: Bas dRotterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Absolute CRAP
Review: Bad service, very untasty pizza, the mozzarella sticks were still frozen, after complaining, they gave me the SAME plate where i already took a bite off. The pizza that we ordered tasted like cartboard. They did not bring any of the dishes at the same time. Although the restaurant was empty. You should avoid this place

Author: brooklynbridge2013Bangkok
Title: Disappointed with Change
Review: I used to have a favourite dish at this restaurant. It was their Gorgonzola pasta. The sauce was flavorful and full of the formaggio I love. Last evening I ordered it from their new menu. What the served me was a bland and flavourless dish with chicken and mushrooms. More like Alfredo or carbonara. You couldn't taste Gorgonzola. The manager tried to say the dish hadn't changed. It has. I won't be ordering it again.

Author: Pratyush R
Title: privacy in midst of crowd
Review: Its near famous bukit bintang, but due ot its location, its still very quiet and cosy. Decent ambience. Friendly staff. Wifi. 2 floors, nice food, specially finger food

Author: Jet705700
Title: Sweet, sour & spicy
Review: It was my second place to eat in George Town and i walked in because it was super busy. Sometimes you just follow the crowds and it was not a place i could give 5 stars. The food is mostly sweet and it does satisfy the taste buds but it's a use of simple counter sauces, nothing fancy. Hopefully the next crowd restaurant will be better.

Author: swee leng TKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Tokyo Kitchen in IKON, Taman Connaught
