Review: There must be a few outlets of Tokyo Kitchen. I had the misfortune to try out the IKON outlet. Total write off. Service was poor. The food was not good. Even the staff attitude was lacking. Definitely not worth the price that I paid when I have so many other better Japanese Restaurants around town.

Author: arai33Singapore, Singapore
Title: Not impressed
Review: Was there in the evening and there were plenty of mosquitos which marred my visit! Plus service was rather slow and the staff there including the manager had no concept of what is an extra shot of espresso in my Cappuccino despite selling an extensive array of gourmet coffee. Guess what, they charged me for the full price of a cup of espresso. Hmm... I made some noise to the staff whom served me and he insisted all is in place and even brought over the menu and pointed out to me that a cup of espresso is like say RM7 and he's perfectly correct. So my cup of coffee perhaps became like an exorbitant $15. I went over to check with the manager and was given like a dirty look suggesting that it was me whom was ignorant... Hmm... Oh well... I'm definitely not going to come back here after this experience.

Author: fragrantmoon
Title: Dim sum and buttered prawns with melon
Review: Do play some modern music instead of the oldies!!!

Author: Bigall1
Title: Great for a break from the heat
Review: We really needed a break from the heat of KL while urban walking. This was ideal, cooling fans cold beer and white wine, good service and a competitive price. Well worth a visit if in the area.

Author: vincentdN9490WGGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Great
Review: Super kind staff, but the food was disappointing. The prices don__ match the quality of the food. Too much cheap white baking bread and small portions regarding the starter and main course.

Author: ReginiaCordellAbu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
Title: Good looking restaurant; service, what service.
Review: This restaurant is in a prime location with access to thousands of tourists daily. You would think that they would be on top of their game to keep the dollars rolling in. I assume that they are banking on customers who hadn't heard of their terrible service, rude staff, and stale food.Stay far away from Chinoz. It's not worth it.

Author: kno1218a
Title: Half shot
Review: So I stopped in here for a Jameson neat and got what looked like about a third of what it should be. For 26R! I have pics and I__ a bartender. Wow. If that__ what they are putting in their cocktails as a shot save...More

Author: samgiraffesHull/Manchester
Title: Great place
Review: We chose to visit Opium due to the good reviews on TripAdvisor, and it did not disappoint. All three of us ordered the taster menu and a selection of different cocktails - everything was delicious, not one course was substandard. The service was prompt but not overly friendly, but this is understandable as the place was busy.I would most certainly recommend this place if you are staying in KL, it's the nicest meal we had on our entire trip.

Author: Pratzounparis
Title: Nice atmosphere but overpriced
Review: Was our first night and KL and we enjoyed it, specially chicken wings (try w.a.w. stall ), fried lala, dimsun.A good overview of what can be a food court, great atmosphere yet all prices are about the double you could pay in any other foodcourt in KL. Service is a bit in a rush and pushes you to order more.

Author: maksymm542Kyiv (Kiev), Ukraine
Title: Delicious pizza
Review: The pizza was amazing. Staff was friendly and helpful. Pizza 6 cheese was perfect. Highly recommend.

Author: NoraK1098
Title: Is not a fine dining standard
Review: I dont understand how they can call their restaurant a fine dining restaurant when they serve the ketchup sauce in a plastic bottle as what i saw in mamak stall and when i call the bill i have to go to the cashier counter instead of sending the bill to my dining table. The food is just ok and i eaten much more delicious foods in less pricey korean restaurant

Author: mosschopukMilton Keynes, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious food!
Review: We were intending to go to the Living Room next door, but thought we would give Helena's cafe a try instead, and we are glad we did! The service was warm and friendly, advising us about local dishes and providing recommendations. The satay was very tasty, and the beef rending was also very good. The prices were excellent and we will happily go back.

Author: modacostaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Surprisingly good penang food
Review: We ordered the steamed otak, assam laksa, char kway teow, cendol and pucuk paku. All exceptional except the kway teow was a big soggy but still tasty. Staff were attentive but our first dish they served was the cendol! Who eats dessert first? Will come and eat again.

Author: Lawrence188
Title: Geographer Cafe Melaka
Review: This restaurant have a nice atmosphere to have food and drinks. The food price is mid range. You can sit by the side walk or in air con comfort. Good place to unwind.

Author: russellj691Eccles, United Kingdom
Title: 1st Korean Experience - WOW Excellent in every way
Review: From our arrival we were treated fantastically by all the staff.The menu was fully explained to us by 'cash' including the recommended dishes.I have to say the service from all the staff was exemplary and the food was if a very high class (although we don't have anything to compare with).We had a starter to share and two main dishes (Chicken Tukbaegi & Beef Bokeum) which was sufficient for us.We had complementary Ice Cream and a small drink to refresh our pallette.The Manager even ordered a Taxi for our return home.We had a fantastic meal, a Fabulous night and we will be returning before we leave Langkawi.Please do not miss an opportunity.

Author: meixin
Title: Staff not attentive
Review: Found nothing special with this restaurant. Food is ok with big portion. Staff is very unattentive or I would say bad service. I have to order my beer twice eventhough my glass is empty for about 10 minutes. It__ a small restaurant with not that too many tables and guests at that time. No one offered to ask eventhough they saw and passes by. I was sitting just beside the counter about a meter away. Anyway will not return to this restaurant again.

Author: reviewer973London, United Kingdom
Title: Disappointed at Chillies KLCC
Review: Incredibly mediocre food, served at a snails pace and completely out of sequence. The Nachos and Salsa starter was disgusting, never before have I seen watery salsa with absolutely no salsa! I sent it back. The "special" concoction was strips of chicken, some limp salad, black beans and other bits, dry as a bone with absolutely no dressing. Chicken Fajitas passable, but only just. Bacon burger was dry, the meat patty didn't taste like beef! I really don't see why this restaurant is "successful" selling such poor quality and badly prepared food, poor. I will not come here again!!

Author: MickelT6
Title: Felt cheated!
Review: 2nd time there. Ordered the fried kurau again as the kids loved it. Waitress came back and said no kurau but substitute with grouper at same price $78. We received a normal grey grouper :(The petai dish $28....we could count the number of petai with our hands. There were so much more fried onions in there. First time there was end of 2016. Mum loved the babi chilli garam. Dad liked the Babi Ponteh. We all loved the fried petai. Food was tasty and savoury. Thought we had found a new Favourite Peranakan haunt. Alas, we were let down

Author: Annie C
Title: Great venue but not ood for welsh rugby fan
Review: Went with friends all welsh rugby fans when Wales were playing Ireland may be not a good idea. However had a very enjoyable night. Some of friends who work in KL use i as thir local.
Restaurant: Healy Mac's Irish Bar and Restaurant

Author: Ntarev
Title: Birthday Dinner!
Review: Family and I had my birthday dinner at Nizza and we were impressed from start to finish !The ambience , the food , the service were fabulous!Nora , Farouk and Firdaus were efficient, friendly & made us feel at home in this cosy restaurant . Just the type of staff every restaurant needs!Compliments to the Chef too ofcourse !!Thank you Nizza , keep it up & and we__l be back !Nish

Author: zerowaste with ... Ø²Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Diner show
Review: When the name is diner show, we expect that the diner serve during a show , but the diner serve 8and show starts at 10. Portions are so small and its pricy for the food you get. We had a set of 3 for price of 110 Ringet but my husband order more food as he was still hungry.Hope it ll help poeple to just go for show .

Author: Kw906
Title: Awful food - left after starter
Review: We went to chilis on a busy Saturday night and waited 50 minutes for a table. We ordered a starter and main however the main came before the starter. We told the waiter that we had ordered a starter therefore to take the main away. Whilst eating the starter, which wasn't overly pleasant as it was luke warm (nachos and chicken wings), I saw our main course brought out three times, for them to see we were still eating our starter and they took it back. Literally as we just finished our starter our main was brought to us again and I asked if it was the same main brought to us 20 minutes earlier to which the waiter replied "yes but it's been reheated twice" - i had chicken therefore told him he could make someone ill by reheating chicken so many times. The main looked absolutely vile so we told them to take it away, get our bill and the manager. The manager wasn't overly apologetic and still charged us for the starters and two cocktails - you would of thought that some money would be taken off for the inconvenience of us having to go somewhere else for dinner - we ended up going for street food in jalan alor which WA a thousand times better for food and service!! I have been to chilis several times in the states and it has always been fantastic. My chilis experience in Malaysia was absolutely awful and I would advise anyone not to wait such a long time for disappointing food and service. It's nothing like the chilis in the states - vile !!!!

Author: BonsaiKuang
Title: Highly overpriced
Review: Hard bread, not so soft as thought. Breads are expensive. I recommend Lavender or RT Pastry.

Author: Mayura_105
Title: Good Food at a Good Price
Review:
This is first restaurant I visited after I landed in KL. 

As we weren't sure what to order, the staff helped us. I loved the Otak-Otak and Prawn dumpling soup. The quantity was amazing and the food was flavorsome.

Author: DanielBris1982Brisbane, Australia
Title: Nice view, shame about the food
Review: We had lunch here once, plenty of drink options and we found one of the only places to get a drink close by. Food was a little disappointing though, prawns in the fried rice were battered and fried whole, head and all.. Service was a little average and in the middle of the day the music was being played that loud we had to nearly yell to talk to each other, this would be fine at night but this was the middle of the day and we were looking forward to relaxing by the beach and having a few drinks for the arv..we left after one drink and the meal as we were not offered more drinks, the beer wasn't that cold and the service just wasn't there.This could be a very nice place of a little more effort was put in as it has a great position with some nice comfortable seating

Author: sallymastizahaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good Chinese local cuisine
Review: Must try the Nasi Bojari, Nasi Goreng and Fish Noodle Soup to name a few. If you love dessert, then you must try its banana fritters with ice cream. The area is huge and can accommodate large group. Its normally jam packed. If you want to eat here, do come early to ensure that you get the seat. Otherwise you have to wait.

Author: Khaer74
Title: Food was good
Review: Portioning was okay. Taste was good to my surprise  but slightly on the high side  pricing.. Overall puas hati

Author: oliP21London, United Kingdom
Title: fresh fish stale
Review: this restaurant is literally right on the beach - take your shoes off and feel the sand between your toes. My party popped in a few hours before the meal to choose our 'fresh out the sea' fish, and decide how we wanted it prepared, a fun and exciting experience as the fish was literally still moving. the fish were cooked perfectly, so fresh! and were really delicious however everything else was a real let down. The sauces for the fish were too overpowering and the sides were a little confused and on the small side. The desserts were the low point of the meal - too fussy and complicated and didn't even taste good. Oh and the bread and dips to start were disappointing also. Overall then - worth it for fresh fish lovers otherwise I would check out the Datai for equivalent fine dining. FYI responding to every review is over zealous and unwelcome. Let us review in peace!

Author: Lee Ann YKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Used to think that they serve good food but the rude service spoils everything
Review: It's been a while since I'm back to this place, but I was really shocked by their treatment yesterday evening when I had my dinner there. Their food quality has not changed, the food is good but when my apple crumble dish was served, I was really disappointed. They maintain the usual 2 ice-cream scoops on top of the apple crumble, however I can see that they have tremendously reduced the amount of apple slices. Basically, I was eating the ice cream and the sweet filling (that was cooked together with the apple slices) more than anything else. When I have just completed my meal, 5 minutes later this uncle (whom I presume is the owner/owner's family) came and asked us if we need any additional orders with a smile. So we replied, "No and thanks for asking". He continued to smile and replied "Alright, we have a long line waiting outside. Do put your thoughts into it", smiled and walked away. My eyes popped up big and I was definitely shocked by how they treat their customers here. This is my first time being driven away just because they want to do more business. If you do not even know how to keep your customers happy, what makes you think you'll have more business? And just because you smile while you were asking me to leave does not mean you are being polite. I can smile back at you and reply "you're rude and your service is horrible", but does that mean I'm being polite too just because I'm smiling? Will definitely not return back here. If you do not have enough space to cater to your customers, then rent or buy additional space. Don't expect customers to leave immediately after eating just because of your own personal interest in gaining more business. That's your problem, not mine.

Author: Christian FPerth, Australia
Title: Geographers cafe_better left off the map
Review: Myself and my wife ended up here after struggling to find any local eateries open. We ordered the Thai mango fish and Thai mango chicken. It was pretty much impossible to tell what was Thai about it, deep fried pieces of fish and meat in a sweet chilli sauce, certainly no mango involved! It could have just been deep fried cardboard as you couldn't tell which was chicken or fish and accompanied by a 'salad' again disappointingly bland, the best thing about it was the boiled rice! We should have been aware things weren't all that good as the tables around us when we got there had lots of food left on the plates and the couple sat next to us had to repeatedly ask for their food and weren't impressed by what they got. All in all not a good experience, certainly shouldn't be deemed a tourist attraction! Strangely enough this being the only meal we didn't share I've since had a dose of food poisoning following our visit :(

Author: honey_mel
Title: Its Nice!
Review:
Take away service was quite fast.
The taste of this salt baked chicken wasn't too salty like some places. The chicken meat was quite tender too.

Author: alistair15
Title: What wrong Tuck Kee?
Review: Sad to say the old school dishes has gone. Cooking with their truth heart is no more in the menu. To try their dishes is like wasting your precious time of your life. A place only for tourists, IG or FB.

Author: mattl538
Title: Michelin star quality. Amazing price!!
Review: My girlfriend and I had the tasting menu (best of opium). It was absolutely fantastic. Every course was amazing. The staff were perfect. The venue was lovely. Impossible to fault. Go and enjoy!

Author: fazilathulj
Title: Incredibly poor service.
Review: Incredibly poor service.  A guest walks in and no one bothers, sits for 5 minutes just to have waiters stand looking at the ceceiling. Will ber

Author: yonagaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: What an EYESORE!
Review: You get what you paid. So for RM120, the experience eating IN the conservatory maybe worth the money, as all the reviews here telling you.The food quality is as expected. But what NOT is the view just OUTSIDE the conservatory. It__ just an EYE SORE. How could the management just leave all those stuff in full view for the guests to see. They could at least try to cover it. Come one The Majestic, I__ sure you could do better than that for people paying that much and for the __restige_ you claim.

Author: alresfordtouristLondon, United Kingdom
Title: dancing fish restaurant service
Review: A good restaurant but unfortunately the waiter that serve us must be in a hurry to get home. He wanted several times to remove our plates even though we told him that we have not finish our meal. We finally gave up after he came the third time and started clearing the table without asking if we had finished our meal. 0 marks for service....how unfortunate that waiters are not trained up to the standard that a good restaurant needed.

Author: Domchong
Title: Lunch at Jonker
Review: Went there for lunch. Chicken rice ball is tasty. Chicken smooth and yummy. Have not tried other chicken rice ball yet. So this restaurant tasted good to me.

Author: indobestcoffeeMedan, Indonesia
Title: Price not cheap anymore
Review: We have eaten since many many years ago and we always came to the restaurant each time we come to the town. But on our latest visit (actually today) we are a bit surprised with the price which according to is not worth it and not cheap anymore as their trade mark for many years, serve good food with reasonable price. Anyway the quality of the food still ok.

Author: DhennverNgPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Avoid if you are sensitive to MSG
Review: As you can see on the walls, this restaurant has been highly rated and reviewed. They have a good crowd. However, if you are sensitive to MSG, then you'd want to avoid coming. I suffered big time for the rest of the day after the meal there especially the fried chicken.

Author: wanderingoffagainSingapore, Singapore
Title: Got all bones :(
Review: The two person set we ordered had virtually no meat in the chicken and almost all bones, we were very disappointed. Not sure if we were just unlucky to get the bony parts but no effort was made to even give us a mixture of some breast meat to balance it out.The hor fun (thin rectangular noodles) were super "q" and chewy which is the icon of Ipoh (everywhere you go these noodles tastes superbly well) The bean sprouts ( a must-order dish) are crunchy and bursting with flavor, but all these still didn't save the star of the show which is supposed to be the chicken.Locals told us we should go to the store right beside as that's more well-loved by locals and has better quality chicken. Hope to try it next time!

Author: rubeneskKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not recommended
Review: Let__ start with the meal. The food was so and so. Tastes dry and quite frankly seems to be just microwaved. What was worse what the way the staffs managed us. Had to wait and call a few times just to get the menu. The food was just dropped/slide off to the table without so much as a smile. Lastly they have poor English command. I asked for cutleries and they don__ comprehend. Ask for a fork, they still don__ understand. Had to say __udu dan garpu_ to get what I want.

Author: AlvinTaikorKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best in "food, view n service". Fantastic !!!
Review: Very impressed even though its our first time dining here. Choice of food is great, taste is too delicious. Magnificent view of the Petronas Twin towers n surrounding. took some good photos, too. The staff are very friendly and helpful, well-trained. We met Mr Satoru (Exec Sous Chef) at the hotel lobby and he was so cheerful n helpful in showing us the way to the restaurant at level 38. Hats off to you, chef. Choice n variety of gourmet was wonderfully delicious. We even had "Yee sang" (Chinese raw fish)....great place to dine.

Author: Will L
Title: Better than ah koong
Review: No matter the noodles or the soup... All are lot more delicious than ah koong. Their laksa fragrant enough and suitable for those who cannot take too spicy but still love laksa.
Restaurant: Tian Xiang Yong Peng Fish Ball

Author: penangbatu
Title: The manager was hostile and arrogant!
Review:
The manager was hostile and very rude to us! This is unacceptable behavior to tourists to Malacca.The food was fine but really spoilt by the service and attitude!
i do not recommend if you are a tourist.

Author: Leng N
Title: Pathetic
Review: Yes, they said their chicken is smaller because it's free range without any sort of steroid injection but the chicken that were served is plain pathetic. I felt so cheatedFor the spicy one we ordered, it's lacking the punch we expected. I've certainly tasted better Korean fried chicken than this Not to mention the service is also poor with waiters not knowing their menu well enough. Dealing with them give me a rise in blood level First and last try

Author: MMAH10
Title: Cantonese Restaurant.
Review: Nice clean restaurant friendly pro-active service. Nice Cantonese dishes. Dim Sum is tasty. Roast pork good. Will definitely go back there again in my next trip.

Author: Evelyn EChatsworth, California, United States
Title: California "kids"
Review: We are from California and were visiting kids and grands in KL and they took us here. Being from California, we have robust and diverse cuisines available to us. We were seated quickly (there were 7 of us). I had crispy egg noodles with chicken, it was good, perhaps not great, but I certainly would eat here again. The royal golden fried rice and fried beef kway teow were also good.This restaurant shares space with Fresca Mexican Kitchen so you are able to order from either or both menus.

Author: jennier706Westward Ho, United Kingdom
Title: Slooooow!
Review: Only ate here once (and didn't try the buffet, but found when we stopped for a drink a few times that although all the staff are lovely, it took an age to get our order taken and even longer for the drinks to come! Very nice touch with the white wine though, glasses had been kept in the freezer and as soon as the chill mist had cleared, we were brought fresh frozen glasses to transfer our drinks into. Good cocktails too, just a shame about the wait times.

Author: carimakanman
Title: Clay pot serving Restaurant
Review: Food are served in hot and sizzling clay pot and charges are very reasonable. Food taste simply awesome. Not expensive at all.

Author: SandyZebrasTanjung Bungah, Malaysia
Title: We ate there every night for a week!
Review: Staying at the Hotel Sentral Seaview meant that Viva was a 30 second walk. We tried different places there over the course of the week but each night started off with the excellent satays. 5 beef and 5 Lamb satays came to RM 8-50. Fantastic value.Tandoori Chicken with a Naan bread was also a great choice. All up RM12-00. TRy getting that sort of value in Australia! The gentleman who ran the Indian place also cooked us a Chicken Korma and a Lamb Tikka Masala dish that weren't on the menu. Delicious. If you get a chance go and ask him if he'll do these for youOther places we tried were the Prawn Omelette stand and the Char Kway Teow stand.On one night I ordered the large serve of Claypot Chicken Rice. Big mistake. The serving was HUGE. Way too much for one person.As is the case with the food courts, the drinks people were always ready to get you another Tiger Beer or Skol beer. And with a couple of TV's there I was able to watch the opening match of the EPL season with a few young Dutch guys who were also staying at the same hotel.Sure we could have gone to other places close by to eat, but we enjoyed Viva that much that we simply decided to eat there each night. Even when we stayed for a week at Batu Ferringhi, we jumped on the 101 bus and went there for a last meal before we left to go home

Author: PipH95
Title: Terrible!
Review: We were so disappointed by this restaurant- rubbery, tough calamari, dry rice, chewy beef salad and poor service. Eat at the food court next door!

Author: ElinaL513
Title: Yucks , not fresh Frozen fish
Review: 2nd visit and no different from 1st visit one year ago. Their seafood basically all frozen and freshness is really bad.

Author: dyganonKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Rooftop is located on Second Floor. Not a restaurant.
Review: Canopy is a lowest floor rooftop bar in Kuala Lumpur. The bar is located on second floor. Traffic noise from Jalan Yap Kwan Seng is very much right at my face.Canopy only serve finger food. All the fancy photos displayed (courtesy of canopy themselves) are drinks, cocktails and ambience. There is no one order any food here. No doubt good place for Happy hour drinks (before 9pm). Shame no food that make me excited to list this on Restaurant list. Canopy should be listed on Nightlife list.

Author: ShahVeiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The Mediocre Fish and Chips Bar
Review: First impression of the outlet was amazing, being british and all, i loved everything about it, the theme the menu, i was very excited. But it all went downhill from there.My bf and i made reservations for lunch. As we arrived,we were not greeted by anyone. We wondered in to the bar area and told the waitress that we had reservations, and she just gave us a blank stare and told us to sit anywhere we wanted. She was too busy flirting with a white customer. I ordered icelandic cod and chips, while my bf had barramundi and chips. When the mains arrived, we were greeted by a big pile of soggy, sad old chips! And im no fish expert, but my cod fish was just all kinds of wrong! It was grey sogy and stinky! Its certainly was not fresh! When i told another waitress about it, we basically was faced with the like it or lump it situation!Come on guys, if your going to serve bad fish and chips with even worst service, maybe you should change your outlets name to The Mediocre Fish and Chips Bar.

Author: Brent_IbrahimOsaka, Japan
Title: Hip eaterie
Review: Very nice looking place. excellent bar and cocktails. i had a great time there. (it could be the alcohol talking)nicely designed interiors with modern furnishings and attentive staff. they also have live music and when i was there last, there were some jazz lady. pretty decent on the wallet too.

Author: pianocelloShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Lunch
Review: The service was extremely fast and staff were reasonably polite. Decor is so-so as it wasn't aesthetically pleasing. I ordered their famous chicken. The chicken and the mashed potato were okay but the coleslaw had a soggy overnight taste. I decided to give another chance and ordered the sausage. It felt like it was microwaved and again the coleslaw had that soggy flavour.

Author: David KKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The best Chinese cuisine in town
Review: Excellent food especially the Szechuan chicken on claypot and durian pancake is a must try dessert. Very friendly service and always fine ways to wow the guests.

Author: 545johne
Title: My revisit after 2 year hiatus disappointing and expensive.
Review: The outside patio dining area is certainly not the place for a quiet romantic evening. The noise from the hustle and bustle of passing shoppers makes for good people watching but it's far from relaxing. But the same could be said of all the eating and drinking establishments along the Pavillion walk. The spaghetti carbonara I ordered took forever to arrive at the. My dining partner had eaten two salads before it had even arrived. It was very rich as you might expect but also rather bland, the flavor of the mushrooms totally overpowered by the excess quantity of ham. The portion was generous and it was certainly filling. The draft Tiger beer was flat and not properly chilled and the glass was far from full. The bar staff need retraining but the wait staff were pleasant enough. I passed on dessert. Mostly because of the smell of smoking from adjacent table and the incessant Christmas jingle music from the surroundings. I used to like this restaurant before the menu changed and they dropped the Sage hamburger which was unique. I hadn't been back in two years. I won't be going back again.

Author: TheItalianTravelistBarcelona, Spain
Title: Incredible seafood place, a MUST GO
Review: I visited this establishment last Saturday and I was stunned (and felt bad I didn't visit here before!). The food is simply amazing, the seafood fresh, the service extremely attentive and the interior design simple, fresh and classy. I didn't expect it to be so good and I definitely going back (tonight for instance). To find seafood cooked in western style perfectly executed in KL is pretty impossible except this place, especially in terms of value - for what you get you really pay cheap. Menu is extensive enough for appetizers (2 of them can make a completely filling meal) if not go for the main course. Beautiful selection of wines. I can't find a single thing to criticize about this p-lace, and next door (actually part of the place) is their shop for sale of fresh fish/oysters and they truly have cheaper prices than anywhere else, beside such a great choice! Kudos!!!

Author: Ricardo SToronto, Canada
Title: Stunning views of downtown KL but food missed the mark.
Review: I was here on a business dinner in March. The food did not meet my expectations and was of course very pricey. The wine selection was very good and the views outstanding.

Author: annLo7
Title: Don't go!
Review: Food is terrible! Sushi are not so fresh ! If you want to eat good sushi never go to this restaurant.

Author: Jeffrey LStockholm, Sweden
Title: Good food with signature xiao long pao, falling short on service
Review: If you are looking for good xiao long pao in a comfortable environment, Paradise Dynasty will meet this need. Though the service level will leave you wanting. The signature 8-flavor xiao long pao is a fixed menu item, i.e. you will not be able to swap out even 1 flavor. Perhaps it may be a staff empowerment issue, but to raise a simple request such as this to the floor manager seems over the top.

Author: ennyasftKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice view. Terrible food. Lousy service.
Review: Truly disappointed and annoyed!! We went to vertigo for sunset dinner. I am a member of TABLEAPP Elite. As a member of the club, am entitled to redeem the free signature dish offered by the restaurant as one of the participating restaurant in the club. The free signature dish is served by Horizon grill Banyan tree and the same is listed in vertigo food menu. I then tried to redeem the free signature dish offered in Tableapp by this restaurant and I was told that I can__ have the offered free signature food in vertigo. I was further told that if I were to pay for the dish then I could have them in vertigo. They also offered me other option that is to have the redeemed food in horizon, that__ located one floor below and the paid dish in vertigo. They literally asked me and my partner to hv our dinner in two separate tables. Too much hassle. I then decided not to redeem the food and just paid for two dish. Now, we were seated in a very small table. We told them that we were to order more food and the table was too small, they told us that most of the table were reserved. Then I told them to bring the food one after the other. Few minutes later, they served us all the food at once and we had not enough space. What annoyed me the most was that we were told that they were going to place the foods in two different tables. Like wth. That was the most unreasonable solution considering there were so many empty tables. I refused ofc and told them to give us bigger table and let us eat the food like other normal human being. The manager finally agreed to relocate us to bigger table and it turned out the table wasn__ reserved after all. Shocking considering the image they are portraying to the public, being one of the high end restaurant. I can honestly say this, the food are terrible, the prices are rip-off and any other mamak restaurant can provide better service then this plc. A piece of advice, spend your money somewhere else.

Author: leo_leotai
Title: Don__ dinner there, Have lunch!
Review:
I arrived there at 8:30pm and the waitress told me that most of the signature dishes already sold out.

The food are average.

Not expensive.

Author: 336helgaj
Title: Great food and very good atmosphere
Review: We enjoyed a very great dinner here! Everything was perfect, including the service! This restaurant is a must visit if you are in Ipoh and you like Indian food!

Author: poyeew88
Title: Worst service ever
Review: Nice vibe, but, worst service ever. Asked twice for hot water, not entertained/forgotten by the servers. Unacceptable that it took more than 30 minutes just to get hot water refill for tea. When the server finally thought about refilling the hot water, she took away my teapot and didn't bring it back. Never coming back ever again. Does not deserve any star to be honest.

Author: 619chins
Title: Poor attitude
Review: The lady boss is very rude to customer! The food not bad but because of the poor attitude of the lady boss, I will not visit this shop again.

Author: AmerivoyagerBoston, Massachusetts
Title: Great food, but terrible drinks
Review: I was delighted by the omelette which was fresh and cooked just right, neither burnt nor undercooked. The bread was also very good, as I expected, given the name of the place. My compliments to the chef, who I suspect is only in charge of food. Drinks are a different story. I was disappointed with the overpriced fruit juice which tasted like concentrate, was half filled with ice cubes, and served in a small glass. Even 7-11 has better juice. Thankfully this restaurant is not called The Juice.

Author: harithcyrilKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Assam Pedas
Review: Was "pumped" up with all the reviews on this place. Keeps coming up first in all the #assampedas lookup. Quite laid back, not sure if the owners are really happy to see customers....just got that feeling. Food was simple, which is something i like. Good value for money. Beef was great. On the other hand, fish was horrible. Was continuously boiled for along time which made the sauce salty. Overall...average experience.

Author: TLChui
Title: Over Rated
Review:
Not good as commented here.

Food not served in hot.
Pineapple prawn not fresh and 5 pieces for RM30.

Very regretful to visit the shop.

Author: KZTravellerKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Terrible service
Review: Let me start that I'm from Kazakhstan. And I was so happy to find a restaurant that would serve food of my country. I thought it was a good chance to introduce my international friends to my country cuisine. After my first visit to this restaurant I was shocked to my bones.The food was very good and basically home-made. No complaint here, only thumbs up to the Chef!But the service was so horrible that it was beyond comprehension. Waiter and manager were eating their lunch ignoring customers. I mean literally they were eating one hour after the restaurant opened, on the table next to the customers. While they were eating, they ignored customers. And they continued to ignore customers all the time we were there. Waiter even left restaurant and was playing with his phone while we were sitting among dirty dishes and unserved. Not once they came and asked if we want drinks or tea or deserts. Not once they came and cleaned our table from dirty dishes. Not once they actually paid any attention to us.This was the most ignorant, arrogant, rude and plain unacceptable service I've seen in many years. And we were only two customers in this restaurant at the time.Unless you want to feel as lowly creature not worthy of attention of the service staff, don't go there.

Author: UKsam101London, United Kingdom
Title: Absolute rip off
Review: I came here with my girlfriend for drinks and to listen to the live band (who were average at best)Luckily, the bill was brought over after one round of drinks and I was shocked to see that 2 soda waters and pint of Carslberg came to 82 RM! 18.90 for a small soda water is ridiculous and upon questioning the price I was told that a premium rate is charged once the band comes on! not to mention the 10% service charge which is also added onto your bill! The service we received was poor and it would be nice to decide for yourself whether you'd like to leave a tip or not.

Author: MgdanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Refuge from the rain plus some of the best coffee in the KLCC area!
Review: I have stayed many times at the M&O over the last few years....but have not stayed recently or visited the lounge since its recent refurbishment. During my evening walk in the park the heavens opened and I found myself seeking refuge in the Lounge.Good coffee is surprisingly hard to find in the KLCC area. Even at the so called Kings, SB's and others. NOT SO at the Lounge on the Park. I ordered a Americano expecting the usual bitter , over roasted expresso style coffee that dominates most KL cafe's. Instead I was rewarded with a light to medium bodied roast , slightly acidic, with warm fruity aroma and a mild chocolatey Finnish. Service was superb, dispite the crowd from the rain. Live light piano music with violin was playing adding to the good coffe and great selection of cakes.. The rain stopped but i remained for several additional cups, each as good as the first! If you like good coffee in a pleastant sophistacted environment ...head to the Park !

Author: smileysmile36Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lots of room for improvement
Review: After reading good reviews about this place,we decided to give it a try for a Sunday family dinner. Upon walking in,the ambience was good and quiet. There were many beautiful Japanese decorations in place. We noticed the restaurant was only minimally occupied with 4-5 tables of patrons. Overall the fresh sashimi and sushi were good and generously sized. However the service was very much lacking. We were attended to by friendly,courteous but inexperienced staff needing to improve on efficiency. Food took an hour to arrive. And the last dish of a simple garlic fried rice arrived 1 1/2 hours after the order. Upon inquiring with different staff on the reason of delay,all they said was that they__l check on it. There was no follow up on the progress of orders. One of our chicken teppanyaki dishes arrived cold,giving the impression that it had already been cooked and left out on the counter for quite awhile. Unfortunately the overall experience did not live up to its expectations of the established brand of Sheraton.

Author: DrJZSingapore, Singapore
Title: Dinner buffet
Review: Indeed the buffet spread is big, however the food quality is just ok especially for Hilton's standard. You can find better restaurants within this hotel. Reception staff was welcoming.

Author: AidaBahariMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Terrible Service
Review: Captain on duty was very rude. Tables at the restaurant for MIA seminar participants were badly arranged. We were cramped at one corner of the restaurant making moving around difficult. We had to wait for other to move out the seat in order for us to do the same. Captain passed very sarcastic remark and didn't not make an attempt to apologize until we complained to the supervisor. We were treated like second class guests. We were not valued as customers.I would definitely vote against this hotel for our future seminars. We had a very unpleasant day due to the rude captain. I would never come back to this hotel until it reaches 5 star rating by its customers.

Author: TaufikN78
Title: Chicken is better than the rice
Review: Very simple eating here. only need to tell how many person to eat, want vegetables or not and what to drink. no menu book to see. the chicken and the juicy is very good. the rice somewhat dried.

Author: ainihr
Title: Too expensive
Review: Too expensive its ridiculous, just go to a normal shop at the roadside and eat....lolz.

Author: therightSYAIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Great Mee Rebus!
Review: Been here many times. I love the ambience. Easy to locate, easy to find parking. I love their mee rebus the most. My trick: order 1 mee rebus and mix it with 2-3 cucuk of satay daging, damn good! Hahahaha. Satay is average to me. Maybe because I can find many satay stalls in my city with are tastier and wit cheaper price. But still, I will definitely come again and again for their mee rebus!

Author: RoonishereMalaysia
Title: My worst experience in kula lampur
Review: The food wasnt good but the worst part that the bar tender was so rude when we told him we didnt like the singria he came and shouted on us So why did order it? And he charge us for a drink that we couldnt drink and he didnt even care to replace it! Bad food and bad cocktails and the worst experience i had,i dont recommand it at all!

Author: Martin BKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not as good as their other outlet in Bangsar
Review: Visited the Social in Publika for the first time with friends for dinner. Firstly the pros; the pub restaurant has a good lively atmosphere and is obviously very popular with both locals and foreigners, the manager and some of the staff were indeed very helpful; the menu is both large and diverse catering for Asian, Chinese, Indian and Western cuisines. The prices were fairly reasonable.Unfortunately there were also several negatives. The food was only OK and definitely not as good as in their outlet in Bangsar, my Lamb Rogan Josh was obviously precooked and only barely heated up. Although some of the staff, and especially the manager, were extremely helpful and attentive this was not the case with all the staff, on a couple of cases ordered drinks were simply forgotten. And finally and most damaging (to me anyway) was the volume of the music being played which made it very difficult to have a conversation (maybe I am getting too old).Although not bad, in truth we will probably stick to their other outlet in Bangsar which has always been a firm favourite of ours.

Author: sirenwandersBandar Puchong Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Not ready to Mingle
Review: Last Sunday at around 7 in the evening my friend and I decided to try Mingle cafe as it has been recommended by friends. The interior aesthetics are nice, it has a rustic/shabby-chic vibe and the temperature in the cafe was just right. Very Instagram-worthy. Good music too! After deciding what to order, my friend approached the counter. I wanted the Ulam salad with chickpea channa. I asked my friend to request __o onions._ When my friend came back to our table she said she had to order something else for herself as the dish she wanted was lacking ingredients. She also told me that they ran out of mushrooms for my salad, so I didn__ expect any... although the description on the menu didn__ mention mushrooms). A few seconds later, the cashier approached us to say that the onions are already in the dressing so I said it__ fine, I__l take it with onions. When my salad arrived, the first thing I noticed was it was swimming in salad dressing...some kind of lemon vinaigrette. I didn__ mind as I thought there was a purpose for having a lot of dressing...perhaps it will cut the other flavors in the salad. As I tossed my salad, I did not find any chickpeas and the ulam was not noticable. The onions were also freshly chopped so there was no way that it had already been in the dressing. I spoke to the cashier and asked about the missing chickpeas and all I understood in her explanation was __hey did not have mushrooms so they changed the vegetables._ She didn__ even acknowledge my question about the chickpeas. Since there seemed to be a communication gap between us, I asked her to talk to my friend. She then continued to explain that they had actually changed the recipe. My friend even told her that if they change something, it has to be amended on the menu. If not, they could at least explain the changes to the customer and make sure they understand before placing the order. The cashier seemed confused as we were talking to her and did not know how to respond. I told the cashier that my salad was not satisfactory and it was not what I was expecting and that I wanted it to be sent back to the kitchen. My friend tried to pacify me and when I calmed down I realized I did not want to waste the food. So I ended up eating it but not before I expressed my disappointment to the cashier. In verbatim I said, _ I am disappointed. This salad is not worth my 22 ringgit. I am not happy._ She then muttered a soft __orry_ and left. My friend was not happy with her experience either. Her salted egg pasta had a grainy texture but since she also hates to waste and it didn__ look like we can get proper resolution, she ate her pasta. She was just glad she did not get an upset stomach. Sure, we could have just ordered something else but we knew the food would just end up in the trash and that would be a waste. As someone who used to work in the food and beverage industry I am very patient when dealing with those who serve as I am grateful for their service. But also, I am quite particular most especially on how expectations are set and how the servers make the customers feel. There are a few things that I would like to highlight:1. If they had changed the recipe, they could have changed what was written in the menu.2. They seem to not know exactly what was in the salad... The onions were not in the dressing...there was no mention of mushroom in the menu.3. Since they seemed to not know what was in the salad, they were not able to set my expectations properly.4. There was no remorse whatsoever even when I have clearly expressed my disappointment. No __amage control._5. The dressing was too sour and two days after the unfortunate experience,my molars are still feeling sensitive.6. When I was browsing through your Facebook and Instagram account. I discovered that the guy sitting at the table across ours was actually the chef as indicated in the social media post.... although I did not make a scene in the cafe, my discussion with the cashier would have been audible to the nearby tables. I wonder if he did not hear or if he just didn__ care what was going on. He is the chef after all and any displeasure on anything that was coming from his kitchen should be his concern... or at least the cashier could have caught his attention.7. Our table was dirty and I had to call the table busser to wipe it. He missed a big spot with crumbs and I had to point it to him so he could clean it.8. When we finished our meal and were relaxing, I realized we were stepping on cake crumbs on the floor.9. My friend did not bother to complain about her food since my complaint was not dealt with properly. So in a nutshell this is how our first experience was at Mingle. Not something I would wish for others to experience when they visit. Your cafe is beautiful, with the promise of a wonderful encounter. But that promise was broken by the lack of attention in food and service.

Author: P87TKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Cheap drinks yes, bad food experience
Review: I think was a day no for Souled out in desa sri hartamas, went there with my girlfriend and the place was quite full, good price for drinks and quite big selection of food, order steak(55rm) and lamb shank and salads with seafood ... the steak came quite fast with vegetables , nothing special honestly, presentation no really cured and taste so so, after a while the staff advice us was the last call for the kitchen but we didn't get yet the shank.. the waiter forgot to place the order, never mind happens even in the best restaurants, we decide to go for the lava cake..... disaster, a cold flooded chocolate cup came .. we ask why the lava cake was like this and the answer was... this is our standard...I don't think so... anyway, could be a bad day...

Author: Aisyah S
Title: Overrated and expensive
Review: waiter was ignorant when we call them for order. charged my plain white rice MYR3.50. claiming it was an extra rice whereas it was the same as my friends. one of my friend took white rice with fried chicken costing her MYR5.50. but my white rice was MYR3.50. so the chicken cost her MYR2????? in what world??? call out the waiter and he still insists its extra rice with big plate, talking in tamil so that i wont understand.

Author: Elizabeth G
Title: Food OK but too pricy
Review: We ordered Soon Hock fish. When inquired the waiter told us it's RM 120 per kg, then he made a correction saying it's actually RM 130 per kg. However when making payment, they charged us RM 150 saying that they made a mistake earlier. A bit disappointed as they didn't even apologise for their mistake :(
Restaurant: Hoi Tin Lau Restaurant Sdn Bhd

Author: sushmitha09
Title: good food and best service
Review: Food is good (must have is the pizza and pasta) service was awesome specially one of the waiter palani were very helpful and smart dress up even others too... definitely will visit again with my family

Author: Kapitan007Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Hit and miss food, indifferent service, some menu items unavailable
Review: Went to their Solaris Dutamas outlet. Had to wait a while standing around before being greeted and seated. Service was slow and food delivered haphazardly - a starter was delivered after main course service had started and the last main course was served after some in the party had finished theirs.Food quality was hit and miss. They had ran out of chicken and beef pies and the available lamb pie was over seasoned. This outlet did not have salt beef sandwich on the menu. Burgers were ok. Fish and chips pretty average. Carbonara was good. Onion rings oily. Portions were decent.Did not try the dessert but they looked nice at the counter display.

Author: blackwidow2244Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing!
Review: As a big fan of Italian food, I cannot wait to try out this place. However i don't think i will be returning to this restaurant because the service is terrible, the floor manager is so arrogant and doesn't make us feel welcome, and not to forget the waiter messed up our order but they're being super rude instead of apologetic.

Author: Bluebunny2046
Title: Classic
Review: Nice decoration about this shop, feel comfortable. A bit pricey and the foods quality is just as normal. However is nice place to have a cup of coffee during tea times.

Author: iam-kelvintKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Bad service, good food.
Review: Food was as usual - Chili's fare. They do good but not exceptional Western.However, the service rendered was horrible. Waiters dropped plates on our table and wasn't attentive. We came as a party of 5 and told them as such, as we are rushing, 2 came later. They still gave only 3 sets of cutleries and wasn't even attentive when we asked for more. All requests were met with a shrug or the feeling that we were not welcome. Such a let down. The manager didn't ask how was the food but if asked I would definitely let them know how we felt. Disappointing.

Author: Sharp-LifeHornsea, United Kingdom
Title: Cheerful Chinoz!
Review: A great meeting spot, plenty of seating inside and out. On a sunny day its nice to sit outside under a fan with a view of KLCC park and watch the world go buy with a cold glass of wine. recently met some friends for breakfast and was reminded what a great place. Local dishes such as Nasi Lemak and Roti Chanai, along with western favourites, eggs etc. The coffee too is excellent.

Author: AinN195
Title: Must go!
Review: Really good food. Reasonably price and good service. Halal also. It's within the Kuah shop houses vicinity. One of the best seafood Chinese place I've tasted. The seafood fried rice and the tofu is the bomb.

Author: yuki8090
Title: Good food
Review: Best buffet ever... this restaurant has many food choice and nice environment...recommended tonthose who love to eat

Author: tonyh844Singapore, Singapore
Title: Very Tranditional
Review: The shop is closed on every Thurs. We reached it, from Weil Hotel, around 6.20am. Foods are just ok, but not presentable. I prefer the dim sum in Weil Hotel despite it is 2.5x more expensive but the dim sum size is 2x bigger and looks much better
Restaurant: Ming Court Hong Kong Tim Sum

Author: ElvinW26
Title: Nothing great
Review:
Pride of food should be lower considering the quality of food served.

Service is reasonable for Sarawak standard. Outdoor furniture is uncomfortable. Old folks would suffer on these chairs

Author: nzoutofofficeWellington, New Zealand
Title: Discrimination against being solo
Review: I intentionally came to this place for its riverside setting, tables by windows opening out over the river. I had planned a late afternoon drink and early dinner, however having arrived to all the window tables being full, I took a seat in the centre of the pub and ordered a drink. After 20 - 30 minutes, I noticed a couple with their baby were packing up to leave their window seat and so began to stand and take my drink/bag to the table, only to be stopped by the waiter and told I couldn't sit there as it's for a 2-4 people and I was on my own. The pub was most definitely not full and there were plenty of other tables for 2 - 4 people also (which coincidentally was the same size as the table I'd ben seated at already). I was speechless and so paid my bill and left to eat my dinner elsewhere along the river. As a solo traveller I accept there are some things I just have to suck up, like hotel room costs, taxi costs etc. but never in my 20 years of international travel have I been unable to sit where I would like to at a restaurant. (it's not like I was seated at a table for 8!)

Author: peiyeeeee
Title: Good food and reasonable price!
Review: In love with the Steamed Lived Mussels style with cream, garlic and fine herbs!! __ The freshness of Mussels perfectly matches with the house sauce.  Oysters are fresh! Delicious!! Will be back to this restaurant soon!

Author: nightlight1937Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Lunch Experience!
Review: Delicious and fantastic food always! (especially the Dim Sum's é»__ selections)A modern, stylish & unique ambiance for enjoying meal and relaxing! Service is friendly and helpful all the time! Special thanks to Elvin, Roxanne, Jae Woo, Jasmine & YEN Kitchen team for the wonderful and memorable hospitality experience!

Author: mahes752Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: food quality and service!!!! bad!!!
Review: yesterday 17th sep 2014 - 4.30pm - went there for food and told the waiter that i wantnoodle fried.."please cook well and add more veg. then told him to repeat what i told him,he did so exactly as i told him. waited and he came with the noodles- uncooked and no veg in it.i called him cooly and in very calm manner i showed him the noodles and asked why not cooked and where are the vege? He just said all done!!!! am uploading the food served.cost of that noodles was rm6.50.i have few dogs at home..will not get near to it!!!Angry for being polite and nice inspite of paying to get !!!!!!!

Author: jessicajames35qKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Tasteless food with ridiculous prices
Review: It really hurt me to say goodbye to hundreds of ringgit just for eating normal, not-so-great food. Do go check out this place if you do not mind deep holes in your wallet. Daylight robbery! On top of that there is no breakdown of prices. Should be reported to the authorities actually.

Author: NÃºria S
Title: Unkind
Review: At payment time our Visa wasn__ working properly because we were from a foreigner bank, we hadn__ even tried for a second time with our Other Visa (which bythe way worked perfectly) and they treated us as if we were thiefs, we felt very bad and uncomfortable, we think they should try to be more polite!

Author: Travellingartist1981Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Grab order
Review: I just ordered GrabFood yesterday from this place. Food was tasting weird and it looked like they threw a bunch of leftovers together. The chicken curry tasted funny and today I woke up with food poisoning. It was the only meal I had yesterday and today I had only dinner so I am 100% sure I got the food posioning from them. Now I have a rash all over my chest, neck and back from the food poisoning. Totally not recommend this restaurant

Author: r_gnr2003Los Angeles, California
Title: Delicious food in a quiet setting
Review: We came here having read some good reviews about the place. We ordered the original assam laksa and mixed assam laksa. Both were delicious and flavorful. The laksa has a nice balance, spicy, but not overpowering. However, the portion is a bit small and each dish has little or no meat in it, which is the only negative (hence the 4 stars). We also ordered desserts as recommended by the host. They were also wonderful, both in looks and taste. As for the restaurant itself, it is located in a quiet area away from the crowded tourist spots. A nice break from the street food scene typical of Penang.

Author: bmw740il2015
Title: Great and just out of the way
Review: Great service and not over crowded .  Good wines and other selections of drinks . Very good western food .

Author: yellowshaunSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great nasi padang!
Review: If you come during lunch hour, expect to queue for up to 15minutes, and sometimes in the sun if business is really good.The highlight for me would be the side dishes - fried bitter gourd (reminds me of goreng pisang) and the achar. The chopped long beans and cucumber salad thingy were very decent as well.In Singapore we'd never have the chance to have piping hot fried chicken at our Indian Muslim food outlets (most likely it would be fried twice and turn out tasting really bad), but the high turnover here ensures they turn out crispy every time.The white rice was slightly wet and the curries were not warm enough for my liking. The mutton curry was okay but the fried fish was just so-so.

Author: CrystalismKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food, badly managed place, horrendous service
Review: Food is good. Duck confit with caramelised onions, so yummy. But service is atrocious. Came in at 7pm but chairs were blocking the pathway to enter and staff sitting on the chair playing with his phone. Only turned on air conditioning when we entered because there is not customer. Place was super hot. Even till 8pm it was hot as heck. Asked for hot water he refused to serve even when we said we__l pay. Still refused to. The house pouring was from days ago but we had one anyway there__ not a lot of per glass choices. Why pay and dine in a place that__ so uncomfortable and being treated like that? No point having good food when the management ruins the experience.

Author: BengMenor
Title: Good food!
Review: Food quality is good. Satisfied with the service. Parking can be a challenge and seems to be fully booked. Perhaps best to call and reserve in advance.

Author: Cedricgoey
Title: Disgusting waitress
Review: Foods and drinks served were below the standard of Penang. Yet, the price is overly charged. I didn't eat the food served because I saw the waitress was picking her teeth while serving me the food. I expect this to be happened only in local hawkers NOT at the shopping mall with Little Penang Cafe - a reputable restaurant in Malaysia.

Author: jlchester0318Puerto Penasco, Mexico
Title: Accept a visa but doesn't accept visa
Review: Claims they accept visa but they have an outrageous minimum. If you look on Visa's merchant website it states "DO NOT SET A MINIMUM" normally I am ok with the minimum or a small 2-3% extra but they go completely against the purpose of Visa. Coffee wasn't anything special either!

Author: Pervtaku
Title: Tasteless
Review: Utterly tasteless. Very overpriced and inflexible as vegetables and meat must be separate. It is over commercialised.

Author: fionwong75malaysia
Title: Bad experience
Review: On dated of 4 Feb 2016 day called "lap chun" ç«__, my friend had been made a reservation earlier for our gathering of 6 person on that day.During the reservation conversation made, my friend had been mentioned very clearly that her requests were:- 1)To get a big round table whereby can fit to 7 pax, and2) Serving us "Yee Sang" when had confirmed with The reservation staff that they can serve "Yee Sang " on special request from customer even the menu was not stated . Please take highest attention also:- My friend is first person who reached the restaurant . But, shocked by her when the assistant manager name Amirul not allowed her to sit on the table that we had been booked early, and just allowed her sit at the small table. My friend clarified with him. He said and mentioning that whereby half of booking people reached then only allowed to sit in. So? What's the reason on making reservation early if u were not allowed to sit on the table that we had booked? After 3 of my friends had reached , we brought to a long table which we requested a round table. The waiter said they don't hv big round table for 7 pax people . Ask for the "Yee Sang". Waiter said we don't serve "Yee Sang " . But why all this promises can get during reservation make ??? We very disappointed on this kind of arrangment and this had been corrupted our mood on that day, that day was a big day to Lou sang for Chinese people. Finally, we managed to take away the "Yee Sang" from food court that we had waited long and eat at Dolly .We make a big complain to the staff named Mohd Hassan, he very patience and polite to make apologise and handle us. But, the AM (Amirul) never appeared and apologise at all. So sad that you have this kind of attitude staff that do not handle complain professional as an assist manager. Later, Jeannie (Manager ) had been called by my friend to log a complaint. She told my friend - our menu no Yee sang but we can serve.And we need to buy ourself .Means BYO. The reservation waitress (Philippines) never mentioned BYO to us. Jeannie said we had been misunderstood . Instead of blaming the customer can you pls brief the reservation waitress to explain to customer clearly when customer make an reservation and not just promised everything and end up disappointed the customers.First and the last time to visit this restaurant.

Author: TarynJana
Title: Noisy pub
Review: We went into this bar as we were walking past as it had live music and a good atmosphere. Drinks were on the more expensive side. Lots of staff to get you a drink quickly. Nice setting.

Author: GypsophilazplKlang, Malaysia
Title: Great but may not the best
Review: My first to enter a place with beer and cigarettes, so I didn't know how to compare with other similar places. Perhaps this is great. Is crowded yet I'm quite enjoy with it. Saw some family gathering here (with child and even babies). Anyway, reasonable price for food and drinks. I love the french fries btw.

Author: Antoni T
Title: Great cosy place to unwind with chums or family.
Review:
Great service , wonderful food (prepared by the chef AKA boss himself):) great place to be.Thumbs up.__and of course great life ______.
Cheerios:)

Author: vulynMaldives
Title: Lovely decor and food
Review: The decor is really nice here. Such vibrant colours and authentic design.Im giving it a four star rather than five is than i have had indian food with more depth in flavour elsewhere and the drinks were a little underwhelming. The rasmalai was amazing though and the prices are reasonable. Good to give it a try.

Title: Friendly staff! Good romantic spot!
Review: I like rooftops and etc. So I decided to check it out. It's a hidden romantic gem with a view towards the sea. I can't say that it's a beautiful view since it is blocked because of the trees around. But still look good.Food was ok. Since I'm a big fan of Mexican food I can't say that its actually satisfied me. Luck of spices in my point of view. Staff were friendly on the other hand but it took some time to get our food.Recommend place!
Restaurant: El Toro Langkawi - Mexican Bar & Grill

Author: josslerUK
Title: Overpriced & soulless. The
Review: Overpriced & soulless. The food was bland & tasteless. The restaurant was empty & the __ock music_ inaudible. We asked the staff to turn it up - after all it is a HRC - and they told us that they weren__ allowed to!Then the bill arrived... RM48 for a child__ small milkshake!!! More than a pint of Asahi beer! Utterly shameful.A rubbish, overpriced sham. Not consistent with the HRC franchise. Avoid.

Author: AhmetK1023
Title: Loved it.!
Review: Very popular place.. you got to wait but worth it .!! Only problem i wanted a glass of vine they run out .. food was great ..!!

Author: Eamonn B
Title: There's a reason why this is no.1 irish bar in the world
Review: A big shout out to Steve n anna, brought us in, sat us down, brought drinks over straight away, food was absolutely amazing! The service was top notch, theres a reason why ye are no.1 irish bar in the world! Highly recommend this place!
Restaurant: Healy Mac's Irish Bar and Restaurant

Author: Lucy CAlbury, Australia
Title: Good coffee
Review: Was nice to get a flat white coffee and the chairs were comfortable but compared to the rest of Malaysia, it was very expensive - $12AUD for 2 coffees.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: 765leslielKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing Birthday Lunch
Review: We treated my son to his 19th birthday lunch at this restaurant as he wanted a burger. The restaurant was empty when we arrived at 1 pm on Sunday. Service was good and the food came out very quickly. My chicken and cheese burger was tasteless and adding chilli sauce to the burger could not improve it. This was a rather disappointing burger. A Macdonald__ chicken burger would have been a lot cheaper and much tastier.

Author: sooz829Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: It Is Just a Normal Thai Restaurant
Review: I had their famous pad thai and my partner had the pineapple fried rice, the fried rice is quite fancy since it is serving in a real pineapple and it smells very nice. But for the pad thai it is just meh, this is because the pad thai is tasteless and the chef doesn't mix the ingredient well in it, and the one soul of the pad thai which is the peanut is only served in a very less amount.Food 3/5Ambience 5/5Service 5/5Value 1/5

Author: CriticalTraveller999Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Food Marred By Barrista Who Wasn't Taught Manners by His Mother
Review: Went there with my wife, brother and sister in law at 11am on a SundayAfter standing in front of the counter for a few minutes, my wife asked a waiter if we should wait to be seated or if we could go about it ourselves.A Barrista behind the coffee machine responded in a condescending manner"We are very busy now, just wait!!" My wife was taken aback but did not lose her temper, we still proceeded to have brunch. There were 7 tables and place wasn't even packed.Coffee - Run of the Mill Food was excellent, Eggs Royale and Gnocchi was the highlight of the dayThe young extremely Rude Barrista may have won awards but his mother definitely did not educate him in etiquette or communication skillsThe phrase "If you can't take the heat, get out of the kitchen" is perfectly apt for this establishment

Author: rickbM4897BNSingapore
Title: Not flexible and don__ get the burger
Review: My guest enjoyed her chicken and the service as OK overall. The burger had many hard pieces of hard fat / grizzle along with a poor taste.... avoid. Very poor. Fries good. What was very frustrating is they have a wine deal, 3 glasses for 56 (vs. 25 ringgit each) for the house red or white pour. As the white was not great, I asked for red instead..... However they refused. And despite insisting the price is exactly the same, they were adamant that they cannot serve me a glass of red wine (I must stick to what I started with...). I won__ go back.... Rick

Author: Francis C
Title: Beautifully decorated restaurant and good food
Review: It is a wonderful Chinese halal restaurant ... very comfortable and good service provided by the staff especially JoJo

Author: najihah922
Title: Pricy
Review: It__ pricy but delicious. If you have more money you can go here to eat their food.. they sometimes full house

Author: fredzipSouthern California
Title: Good food at the hotel
Review: Very good food, nice staff, good selection and best of all, right at the hotel. We came to taste the street food but found out there was this gem right in our hotel. The staff all spoke english and the food ranged from traditional Malay to a fusion of SE asian food. A great experience

Author: Foodie480BSingapore River, Singapore
Title: Unanimous Best!
Review: I try not to go overboard in my review but this is one time I am going to break my own rule. We went in a group of 12 and had the upstairs room for our gathering. We had food cooked to perfection - semi buffet appetizers of quiche Lorraine, Croques Monsieurs, Bulgur and Ratatouille- all bite-size; French onion soup that left me wanting more; choice of mains from Beef Bourguignon, Lamb, Roast Duck breast to Salmon; and dessert to die for. Yum and yum. The price is pretty reasonable for what you get - food, service and ambience par excellence. Highly recommended for anyone who wants to have a memorable dinner event without breaking the bank.

Author: Albywon
Title: Steak and Veges
Review: Not the best cut of meat. Small serving. Both wine and beer (even happy hour) were expensive so I just stuck to tap water for the beverage.

Author: Dachshundjan
Title: A must have my favorite calamari n Cantonese stir fried noodle.  Pleasant atmosphere with life band playing oldies. Good
Review: Need booking during weekend n especially during festive holidays & special occasions i.e. Valentines, Father, Mother's Day.  Excellent local & western food served.  Life band available. A favorite locals joint.  A must come visit n savior the high quality clean & well presented dishes

Author: CwwsimSingapore, Singapore
Title: Relatively good food but beware of dishonest valet parking guy.
Review: Went for dinner at Restoran overseas to celebrate friend's birthday. As it was a friday night and the roads were busy, we left our car to the valet guys. When we got the car back, we lost 2 Touch & GO cards with value in card of around RM200+. An expensive meal indeed!Foodwise, we liked the homemade tofu with winter gourd, roast duck with crispy skin, spinach in superior soup.We order a steamed fish and specifically told the waiter that we do not want fresh water fish (we are quite sensitive to the 'muddy taste') and to reccommend any sea water fish that they had with smooth textured flesh. She reccommended some fish in cantonese at RM220/kg and we said ok as long as it is not fresh water fish.When the fish was served and with the first bite, my friends and ! knew that the fish that we were given is a fresh water fish. A manager came in and confirmed that we were served fresh water fish but did not offer to remove item from list or a replacement. Instead she offered a plate of fruits instead? The fish came up to RM249 alone, much too expensive to pay for a cheap fresh water fish.I know many rave about their Char Siew, unfortunately I am not a fan. It is much too fatty for my liking.So remember to take out all your valuables, money, cash card, they even took my club's card (were they thinking that was a credit card????) when you leave your car to the valet's. Valet park at your own risk!

Author: NahneeRolla, Missouri
Title: You decide
Review: The moment we were at the front door the restaurant looks lavish and extravagant. Love the ambience. But we felt something funny because there were only one table were occupied during lunch hour. So we ordered chicken tikka butter, fish tikka, masala tea, watermelon juice and mango lassy for a group of 4 adults and 2 babies. My baby was crying and the servant was trying to stop him from crying by tapping the baby chair with his pen and i can see the servant was annoyed. I found that rude but i let that pass (strike 1). So the food arrived, i would say the only delicious thing we ordered is only the mango lassi. The servants served with no smile and we had to call them several times to take orders.but it's okay i will let that pass (strike 2). When I was about to pay for the food i gave my credit card and the cashier was obviously rude to me (strike 3) he was angry at me because he was not able to process the payment (obviously he doesnt know to handle th machine since i was able to use my card earlier). So we gather ed our cash paid and left. And the question of why there was only one table when we arrived is answered. We wont be coming back again, tasteless food horrible servants. If Moghul Mughal is reading this, please remember i was the one with a baby in a stroller, a toddler my husband and my parents. I hate your restaurant from the bottom of my heart. Have a good one and learn to smile !

Author: NanaSari
Title: Asam pedas hajjah mona
Review: Excellent food and good for those that like sour and spicy taste of asam pedas.But i think for me is too sour the taste is like a vinegar

Author: BenMoraisPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Service Standards Have Fallen
Review: This is usually an excellent restaurant to visit and have a meal in. But not on this occasion.We were met on arrival by fairly new faces...............not the regulars who know me and my wife. One of them tried to shove us to a terrible table placed in a most awkward place. We declined to move there. They seemed reluctant to give us a proper table. We were on the verge of walking out and visiting another good restaurant in the area when one of them saved the situation. They found us an acceptable table.Next a few of them could hardly speak or understand English. It was quite a frustrating experience for us. Then a pleasant, young Indonesian lady turned up and saved the situation. Her name is Shanti and she hails from Sumatra. She spoke English very well and seemed to understand our requirements easily. She was familiar with the menu and the availability of wines by the glass. She even recommended a new item on the menu i.e Deep Ocean Squid ( 200 gm ).Although I had come in for a Black Angus Steak, I decided to try the Deep Ocean Squid. It was good ( grilled ) but not quite up the taste and quality of the Squid Steak I had in Sandton, Johannesburg, S. Africa years ago.My wife went for her favourite - Dover Sole and it was lovely.............as usual.For dessert, we opted for the home made Rum and Raisin ice cream. It was excllent.

Author: Mark G
Title: Malaysian music night
Review: Place is great typical hard rock.Music that night suckered no rock and roll from around the world just Malaysian music all night.thumbs down

Author: RayC0528
Title: The food and soup just normal
Review: Here selling traditional Chinese soup and food. I with my family order the coconut chicken soup and herbal soup. The soup I taste is ok not so salty. But the food got a bit salty for me.

Author: roamingrover86Kolkata (Calcutta), India
Title: Good place to stop and grab
Review: Situated inside the Bird park, The cafe has a lot on offer from drinks to foods. If you choose to take a table by the balcony (like we did) be wary of the birds while having food . Some local Malaysian foods are served there which were quite tasty. Price was reasonable and food was good.

Author: XeniaSebastian
Title: Great experience
Review: Food was excellent and the ambiance was great. Friendly staff, especially Andrew. He was great! I enjoyed myself

Author: acerockollaJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Always Good Quality Food and Service
Review: When we first arrived in Johor (7 years ago), good restaurants were a very few and far between. What is now the Double Tree By Hilton (Home to Tosca) was still a depressing, dirty and 75% empty IT Mall. The food and service at Tosca and right at the top of the Johor food tree. Superb service and a manager that cares and checks in regularly. My Wife and I visit on average once every two weeks and we are always happy. You can either sit inside in air conditioned comfort or outside by the pool. The seafood options are delicious, great pizzas, nice steaks. Pretty much every choice is good and a fantastic selection of breads. The staff are also very good.One of my top three places to eat in Johor.
Restaurant: Tosca Trattoria Italiana at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: Limawarty
Title: Great Venue For Party
Review:
Booked the whole place for my bday and the service & food were excellent. 
Attentive to details in everyway. 
Will definitely be back for celebrations.

Author: KariAnnBearArvada, Colorado
Title: Mediocre food with a view ruined by unruly children
Review: All I can say is that I'm extremely glad I bought a groupon for the lunch buffet here. I would have been highly disappointed if I had paid full price. There are FAR better restaurants in KL and you pay the same price for 2 as you do here for 1 person.Food was mediocre. Edible, but stuff you would find at a college dorm. The desserts were inedible, however. Dry cake, terrible cheesecake, and banana fritters with ZERO taste. Bleck. The best thing I had was the Indian Naan. I went back for seconds.The view is great... except when you have obnoxious children running amok to ruin it. And parents who don't seem to care. But that's the norm here, I guess. The waitstaff was rather unfriendly and we had to wait 15 minutes to get a table because they weren't kicking out the group from the prior lunch seating. Overall, a terrible experience. I would NOT recommend this place at all! Just pay to go to the observation deck and save your money for a restaurant that isn't mediocre.

Author: Bru1Christchurch, United Kingdom
Title: "Well worth searching for this Restaurant"
Review: It is part of La Pari-Pari hotel just south of the centre of Pentai Cenang. Taxis are cheap and the driver found the place no problem. Food was very good and we sat outside in a pleasant quiet setting. Very acceptable bottle of Aussie wine about MYR75. Staff were excellent and will certainly come back March 2019 when we leave cold wet UK to return to the beautiful island of Langkawi.

Author: Leesa DJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Fresh and tasty
Review: My husband and I wanted to try something new and found about this place from TimeOutKL. I had the lamb taco, husband had the beef taco - the beef was better but both were good. Being from Melbourne I am a self confessed coffee snob so we ordered piccolos and hoped for the best. The barrista seemed to be pretty serious about the coffee he was making so we were hopeful. We were pleased that the coffee was really good. I only drink coffee at 3 or 4 places as I'm so fussy but will definitely have coffee (and lunch- the salads look amazing) here again.

Author: benwolf223Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: better than Hua mui
