Review: If anybody asked me, I will say that IT Roo's dishes and drinks are for more better and superior than Hua Mui. The food is not dry, oily and salty like Hua Mui. I would recommend to most people of IT Roo Cafe. Lastly, the price that I'm paying at IT Roo Cafe is worth it unlike Hua Mui.

Author: Viajero1199Singapore, Singapore
Title: Ok cafe food, good place to chill
Review: Had brunch at this place and have gotten the salmon benedict and Acme breakfast set. Overall quality was ok, but the salmon didn't feel fresh. Order some sweet potato truffle on the side. Would say that it's too thick, making the end-result of it to be charred, dry and hard. Not too sure if it's because of the vicinity, but even the indoor seats have got a few flies around. Wouldn't expect a good restaurant to have that.
Restaurant: Acme Bar & Coffee at The Troika

Author: madhavkudvakuala lumpur
Title: Mediocre Indian food in a very noisy environment
Review: Took some friends to the restaurant recently after reading a review in a local business weekly. The menu seemed impressive. Unfortunately, the standard chicken biryani was one of the worst I have eaten. The chicken pieces were scanty and minuscule . The masala was inadequate. It appeared that the cook was skimping on the ingredients. The noise in the restaurant was so loud that it was not possible to conduct a proper conversation in such an environment. For some reason the acoustics in the restaurant was poor and appeared to magnify or echo sound. I would not recommend this restaurant unless there are significant changes made to the standard of the dishes and the acoustics.

Author: jmptripsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Cannot even connect to reserve?
Review: I heard good things and love French food, so I wanted to treat two local pals.I spent 40 minutes on line, on the phone, calling their numerous numbers, calling Alila hotel operators, front desk, then finally...after 22 dialings...one gal, one guy, the manager of Entier...only to be told that every Saturday I asked about was full? Most every call (22 in total), either rang and rang, disconnected quickly or the guest background noise is so LOUD...they cannot hear me (I am screaming into my phone on a RM1500 mic/headset...and I can barely hear them.I read previous negative reviews about bad service and lazy staff attitude, so will take that all in and NOT pursue any further.

Author: MargaretMag
Title: Decent food, reasonable price
Review:
Good decent food at reasonable price. Portions are huge esp the starters which is too much for two ladies to share. 

Overall good experience and will visit again.

Author: glassgazer19
Title: Bad quality food
Review: Overall disappointing experience as we came in for the 4 stars but the food served dont even deserve 1 star.Ordered beef shabu shabu but the meat is so rubbery i forced myself 2 slices out of the 5pcs. Order a plate of suzuki raw fish and it was served on a big plate without ice at all. The fish is not fresh and worse, it is in room temperature.

Author: MarcusTan94
Title: Nothing special
Review: Small place with limited seats, mediocre and overpriced food. Lady there was being a little pushy when selling her food, not the greatest experience.

Author: BournvilleBackpacks
Title: My favourite KL kopitiam
Review: I've been coming to Lai Foong since I first travelled to Malaysia 16 years ago. It's clean, friendly, efficient and good value, and the quality of food is superb - I've enjoyed the various noodle soups, char kway teow (nearly as good as you'll find in Penang), excellent pau and char siu and duck rice. I travelled with my two young children on my recent visit - they were welcomed in the restaurant, and absolutely loved the chicken rice. Long may this place thrive!

Author: reensworld
Title: Overrated, gimmicky and food was disappointing
Review: With so many videos on Le Petit Chef featuring a Michellin-starred chef, we decided to celebrate my husband's birthday here, expecting a great culinary experience.Unfortunately, the soup was bland, the prawns were not fresh, the chicken was just all right, the dessert was meh. My husband said that the steak was quite good. But overall, it did not give us a pleasurable dining experience. The gimmick with the video is fun but more important is the food that you serve. It does not live up to all the hype and I know of neighbourhood cafes that serve much better food this this, at better portions and better prices. Needless to say, I did not recommend it to my friends when they asked me about it because it was disappointing dinner.

Author: RachHKHong Kong, China
Title: love their banana leaf rice
Review: Their banana leaf rice was so delicious that I went back again last time when I was in KL, just couldn't forget that spicy and savoury taste. This time I had yellow rice and drumstick instead of plain white rice. The drumstick was cooked beautifully, the deepfried bitter gourd and squid were as good as I remembered..couldn't help but took it all down!

Author: nellielim
Title: Quick cheap Indian meal
Review: An Indian restaurant good for a quick lunch. Popular with the working crowd and can be packed at lunch hours. Good for a quick cheap meal. I can't say much for the service as this is a relatively cheap joint so can't complain.

Author: Huzaini H
Title: Hmmm..average jer
Review: Cant even remember what i had. Good ambience. Busy at lunch time. Good to have private room for discussion

Author: zettyzing69Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice place!
Review: Come again for a quick dessert. I__e ordered their promotion dessert. Buche de noel if im not mistaken the name. Its was so moist, not so sweet, just how i like it. The service also very good, very attentive as usual.

Author: debubhatnagarGurugram (Gurgaon), India
Title: Nyonya ah!
Review: We visited this restaurant largely due to its internet reviews and we were not disappointed. The good was great from the start. The summer rolls were fairly good and the soft crab was crunchy. The beef was a bit disappointing but the fish was simply great. Don't order the fried rice just stick with the steamed. The chicken came in a rich gravy sort of like what you find in Kerala so one could see the fusion of culture right there on the plate.We ate a lot. This is a restaurant that we had to queue up to get into in the hot weather. But it was worth the wait. Great food.

Author: ngofamSingapore, Singapore
Title: Crowded but below expectations
Review: This place you need advanced booking otherwise you might have to wait for 1 hr to get a seat during peak hours. The food choices were like the menu in their own premises. The meat dish with 'bucalak' was tough(probably not cooked Long enough). The chicken dish was covered with a layer of oil and saltish. Keep to the usual fare. When crowded you have patrons standing just next to you. Could have been better. Won't be returning. Below expectations.

Author: Ian_70_UK
Title: Great restaurant!
Review: Beautiful little restaurant that serves great food. We went for the Malaysian menu but also caters for Western tastes. The food was delicious and the service excellent. Very reasonably priced considering the all round quality of everything. A must visit!

Author: KLTokyoKuala Lumpur
Title: Authentic Thai Restaurant
Review: I have been visiting this restaurant for many many years but I believe that the restaurant over the years havehad ups and downs but recently their food is again on up swing. I think the new chef from Bangkok is doing a great job and they are serving an authentic Thai food as opposed to Fusion Thai. The service is always good and the ambience is very nice.

Author: Wilson CIpoh
Title: One of the good watering hole in IPoh
Review: One of the good watering hole in Ipoh. Good Happy hour deal, not too noisy ( when band not around) , suitable for catching up and having fun with friends. Food takes time so pls order asap. Pork ribs is one of the best in the menu.

Author: viraz122Singapore
Title: Overrated Briyani
Review: I've been here a number of times and have always found their briyani rather lousy. I'd give it a miss as it's definitely not worth the price. The only good thing here is actually their naans, Romali roti, Battered Fried Cauliflower and Potato Slices, Masala Tea and Kulfi. Otherwise the other okay dish would be their Chicken Tikka. None of their curries are outstanding or memorable and likewise their side dishes. I'd go here only if I wanted an Indian restaurant with decent ambience, friendly service and would like to impress guests by paying a huge bill. If I wanted a good Briyani then I'd cross the border to Singapore and get some anywhere on Serangoon Road or for a more specific spot, at Bismillah Restaurant at Dunlop Street.

Author: wallawSingapore, Singapore
Title: Average fare. Can find much better satay all over Melaka.
Review: Went there after reading all the good reviews and quite disappointed with the food.Satay (Pork and Chicken) are dry (not sure how they heat the satay as did not smell/see any charcoal fire). The satay are quite small too.The rice is a little wet and mushy.The sauce is quite mild (need extra chili) and the amount of pineapple is very little. Not much peanut too.Overall not worth the effort and the price is not that cheap (RM0.90/stick).

Author: Clement Yi Chen... CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Not the best nonya food, and relatively poor service standards
Review: Called 5 days to a week in advance to book a big table to sit 16 persons. Person over the phone agreed to the reservation and the seating arrangements. However upon arrival, they said there no such seating available and we either had to settle for what they have, or leave. Pretty bad customer service I would say. I've been to a number of nonya restaurants and Nancy's Kitchen is by far the least authentic. Probably contrary to the many that have said otherwise, Nancy's kitchen is really nothing to shout about. The buah keluak dishes are so-so in terms of taste - probably more dark soya sauce than anything else. Even more surprising to me was the fact that there were additional charges if I wanted buah keluak in the dish. This is probably the strangest thing and I would only reckon that the restaurant wants to make a quick buck of it. Imagine you having to pay extra for chicken to be added to your rice.The fish otah while meaty, was small in portion and it was lost in its own spice so much so that if you're not a fan of chili, you will probably be downing glasses of water instead. Pongteh dishes were so-so. The chup-chye actually tasted like mixed cabbage. The only saving grace is the chendol, which was delectable to a good extent and just the right amount of sweetness.

Author: leeannquek
Title: Nice ambience and food (although relatively expensive) , would recommend for a special night out!
Review: A trendy bar and restaurant serving drinks and western food. I had a calamari salad and G&T - food was very tasty, if a bit pricey compared to local restaurants, would recommend to couples or friends looking for a nice dinner out. Staff were attentive and friendly also :)Would love to try out the backstage and live music section, unfortunately didn't have time this trip.

Author: sophylee
Title: Halal dim sum
Review: Probably the cleanest food establishment in Ipoh. Was so happy to see the restaurant ,toilets and even the back of the house was clean .Good was average and food value for money. Cashier was friendly and attentive.

Author: KANJICORPCape Town, South Africa
Title: Famous Malaysian chain
Review: Extremely busy on a a Friday afternoon. Not much service even though there were so many staff. Nobody checked on my meal, or whether I was happy with it. I tried the Fruit Rojak with Soft Shell Crab. Too syrupy with a sweet, tangy black shrimp paste. Hardly any crab, felt like I was eating soft shell and no crab. The lychee and lemon cooler was refreshing. Thereafter proceeded to order a Char Kway Teow. A sort of mixed seafood and chicken with noodle. Although this dish did save the day, it looked nothing like the photo in the menu and I had to go on a hunting trip to find the seafood amongst the chicken.

Author: dunyaoistanbul
Title: Tastes good
Review: After reading a lot of good reviews, we booked a table for 2. We were a bit dissapointed with the area. This area is one of the worst smelling places in the world that I have seen, and I have seen a lot. However, the restaurant was ok, nothing special, no atmosphere. Only thing good about thls place is, the food was tasty (not cheap), and Raj is very friendly and helpful (good service)

Author: Legal_itinerantKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A long standing favourite still going strong
Review: Food here is good and sufficiently authentic. We didn't make any reservations and managed to get a table the last 2 times we were here even though they seem to turn over a reasonable crowd. Well located in the heart of KL with competent and friendly staff. Good atmosphere.

Author: 63jayf
Title: dim lights, few selection
Review: Food selection needs to be improved as well as the lighting. Ambiance is not impressive. Food is bland.

Author: ChristyChinN
Title: Anniversary Dinner
Review: We came here to celebrate our anniversary. The foods here & their service is beyond the 5 star!!! The wagyu tomahawk that we ordered is amazingly scrumptious & tasty; staffs here were so attentive and friendly. Adli the manager was superb friendly as well as others like Edward, David, Poon & Chef Steven. Chef Steven even invites us to have a fantastic watch on the cooking proces for the beef on charcoal. So impressing. Definitely we will pay visit again when we return to town. Kudos Chamber's!!

Author: KentuckyBob
Title: Best food of my whole trip
Review: This place has authentic Indian and Lebanese food that's every bit as good as what I know from long experience in Dubai, India and Lebanon. Three of us stuffed ourself for $25 total, drinks and all,  including a couple of beers.

Author: desmondl138
Title: Great service
Review: Friends booked this place to celebrate my birthday. Seafood was fresh and the view is great notwithstanding KL__ haziness. Jacob, Bella and John provided great service and special shoutout to Jacob for being extra attentive. Overall great night.

Author: U6750UVdavidh
Title: Dreadful service
Review: We were staying at the Shangri La so thought we'd try this for a simple meal. After being seated no one came back to the table for 15 minutes, despite three people not doing anything in the bar area. Shame, the hotel itself is excellent, but the restaurant's service is just shoddy.

Author: Anne Mary STaunton, United Kingdom
Title: Terribly disappointed with cashew curry
Review: I saw very good reviews on this Restuarant and as we are staying just across road at Hard Rock Hotel thought we would go tonight to have a curry. As I only ever enjoy a mild curry I chose a curry with cashew nuts and creamy sauce described as 'mild'. It didn't have one cashew nut in it or taste anything like cashew nuts - it tasted so hot, just like someone had just thrown curry powder into some cream and added some pieces of chicken breast. I couldn't eat it because it had no infused flavours at all and I can't take a very hot curry. When I ask where the cashew nuts were, the waiter just said the nuts were just blended in! There was absolutely no infusion of cashew nuts in there. Very very disappointed as I love a really creamy mild curry with cashew nuts back in the UK. Definitely the worst 'curry' I have ever tasted. Also the table cloth was really filthy so all in all a disaster meal here in Batu Ferringhi!

Author: 222anjanar
Title: Terrible experience
Review: We waited 45 mind just for a coffee and honey lemon. Finally ended up cancelling. Will never come back

Author: oneooneeastShinjuku, Japan
Title: Overrated
Review: I was was brought to this restaurant by my colleges , its was supposedly to be a fine dining restaurant but I don't really see it from my experience . Well its has nice ambience but the food was not really filling but its average . What I can say is, to pay that kind of price I would preferred to eat in hotel restaurant. Its a place you can definitely try out but would not be a place that I would bring a group to dine.

Author: Maya762015Le Havre, France
Title: NIce place for Dinner or lunch
Review: Very attentive staff with quite large menu for food. Very good atmosphere at Casa del Mar as this hotel is quite small one. Food is not amazing but you enjoy eating some seafood there.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: mathews k
Title: chicken with a difference
Review: nando's chicken taste very different.especially with its sourish very spicy sauces of different levels of spiciness!!!!!

Author: Gerard R
Title: __ea Time!_
Review:
We enjoyed our tea time at the newly renovated outlet in KLCC; especially for their yummy cakes. 
The food was delicious but it took a reasonable amount of waiting time_but I wouldn__ mind coming back again for their cosy ambience!

Author: luckylyn777Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: I hope, not too pursuit of profit
Review: About 8 years ago, Satay Station AT Titiwangsa the price was RM0.90, I like to buy take-away packs at least 50 pcs. Since prices were increased several times, now for the chicken satay RM1.60, beg satay RM2.20, and heart satay rm2.50 pc. I still buy. but I don't know Why the taste is changing. although its size is now bigger but more expensive, I do not like to enjoy it anymore because of their large size to be less tasty and less appetizing to eat. The management should think about the customer's ability to make all customers can afford to enjoy it and I hope, not too pursuit of profit.

Author: Caren LKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Moist Pork Ribs..
Review: Wah!!! The place is fully booked and crowed. Must made reservation if wanna have dinner there especially Friday and Saturday night.We order few dishes for sharing. Pork rib is their signature dish, is a must to order. Can't denied, the pork ribs is delicious and moist. Love it.Besides that, other dishes just so so only. We have oriental pork belly salad, chicken wing, fried rice, Indonesian style mee goreng and sausage platter.

Author: Pretticila
Title: Delicious nyonya dishes
Review: Comfortable with Air-conditioned and clean eating place. The staffs are friendly and polite. This is my 2nd return to this restuarant. I missed almost all the Nyonya dishes here.

Author: world73world
Title: Average.
Review: Had dinner here after being recommended by a friend. Tried the seafood pasta and salmon fillet. Average at most. Price was a bit steep but I guess the location and decor had something to do with it. Parking around the restaurant can be difficult as there's limited parking but a few other eateries.

Author: wy-li t
Title: Unfriendly Waitresses and Poor Service
Review: We went to this restaurant recently to celebrate a birthday. We were planning to bring a durian cake as the birthday cake. Hence, before we booked this place we called to enquire. Was told that we are allowed to and was not informed that we need to be seated outdoor instead of aircon area. When we arrived, an unfriendly waitress insisted we sit outside or have us to be seated outside during cake cutting session and even reluctant to let our cake refrigerated. After we finished the dinner, the waitress told us there wasn't any empty table outside. She is like not giving any option to us or forcing us to cut our cake somewhere else. In the end, we ended cutting the cake outside the reception area before entering the aircon area of the restaurant. This is very embarassing. If at the first place, durian is not allowed even if it is a cake they should have told us upfront or let us know the terms. In fact, when we leave after the short cake cutting and eating session we saw few empty tables outdoor. With such services and unfriendly waitress, i would not want to come back to this restaurant anymore and would not recommend peope to choose this restaurant. Furthermore, the food is just normal and nothing great.

Author: WengCS
Title: Cheap buffet dim sum but disappointing food and service
Review: The buffet Dim Sum was utterly a disappointment. Most of the dim sum dishes had very thick skin/wraps and very little substance. Overall service was also bad from the receptionist to the service staff who were absolutely not attentive

Author: Webbywabbit
Title: Generous Portions
Review: Portions sizes were huge. We struggled to finish the one salad, soup and mains between two persons. Taste of food was great especially the roast beef! Lobster bisque was too salty, heavy hand with the salt I guess. Price-wise, it would be considered high in Malaysia but by European, Australian or American standards, its very affordable for good food in a hotel restaurant setting. Live band comes on later at night but otherwise its piped in music. Concept is more of a sports bar in the front and restaurant at the back.

Author: 756chunglSeoul, South Korea
Title: Best in town seriously!
Review: Ive tried so many restaurants in jalan alor! And this one is the best! They resnovated inside building and its so clean! Also convenient with clean restroom and wash station and hand dryer! It costs little more than Other restaurant but it is worth it ! Really trust me you pay 10ringgit more and get better food ! *causion : when you order beer the lady is going to bring you some water chestnut! Dont eat that ! It costs 24RM ! Tell her you dont need it (they say its a set but it really isnt! ) Last year They rebuilt the whole restaurant and its so cleaaan and busy so that is you can get the most fresh crab in this alley !

Author: Idah H
Title: Quite Enjoyed It
Review:
Had a late dinner with our large family members. Food was okay - quite enjoyed it. The kids ordered ice cream which taste we did not really like.
Ambience was quite okay but some tables were not cleared after guests left.
Service was fast.

Author: MaxStaysPhilippines
Title: Dissapointed with his 5 Star Rating
Review: We went to Shang Palace for dinner with 3 pax.We order ( 2 set dinner (Set C) and 1 Vegetarian Set) We spend Rm 1000.00 for this dinner.The Good Point Service, Atmosphere 5 Star.The Soup for Set C was fantastic.The other meal was disappointing and the outlook has not impressive and it look poorer then the normal restaurant.The Prawn they serve wasn't fresh, I expect they should at least serve with passion but the presentation was not their priority.However, we had an expensive and disappointing dinner. what a shame Shang Palace

Author: 928yumieong
Title: Nice bak kut teh in town!
Review: I came here with friends...  Nice bak kut teh that I tried in KL so far...  We came here midnight..  We will be back  again for sure...

Author: janeE8384SOKuching, Malaysia
Title: Poor management
Review: I had a very very bad experience having dinner there. We know the business is good and thus we called to make reservation. When We arrived there, the table was not ready and the waiter asked us to wait meanwhile he will clean a table for us. But right after he cleaned it, other customers sat down and the waiter not dare to tell them the table is reserved. The waiter then walked to us and asked us to wait for him to clean another table. We knew the cause of it is he didn't put the reservation tag on the table. So, we quickly ask him to put the reserved tag with our name on the table. BUT, once the table is cleaned, another new family came and sat down ignoring the reserved tag. Once again, the waiter not dare to tell that family, and came back to us to wait for him to clean the Third table for us. Dear friends, who on earth have that patience to wait and give away the tables to others?!! What is the purpose for Reservation then?!!! Advise: Please treat all of the customers equally and FYI, we are not trouble maker, Four of us consists of 2 old parents and a married couple with the bills of RM155++.

Author: FarazilaSahid
Title: Delivery Hari Raya Set Menu
Review: I had delivery for Hari Raya for Talam Set Menu from Makan Kitchen, JB . It was very good set with variety of dishes and valuable to spend for 6 persons. All dishes are very tasty which included dessert of pengat pisang, and all of my family love it. Makan Kitchen, JB is also providing good delivery service and packaging. I will continue my next order for festival of Aidilfitri/Aidiladha. Makan Kitchen, JB ..Thank you with your good service.
Restaurant: Makan Kitchen at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: Gary XOcean View, Delaware
Title: Great for biz lunches...
Review: This is a really great Chinese restaurant located on the second floor of the Shangri-la Hotel in KL. I like it for the service, the food and how conducive it is for business discussions. The menu is quite extensive and my omnivore guests have raved about meat and seafood each and every time. My veg orders have been just fantastic... Tofu and fresh greens (and tigers and bears oh my!) are just awesome. Prices are ok- good value received. Enjoy!

Author: meaningremissionSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Dinner among friends
Review: They used to be located at the former Cold Storage complex in PJ, approximately 20 years ago before there moved to this area. A normal Chinese restaurant with a couple of nice dishes. We ordered 8 dishes and like their stewed duck soup and Yong Zhou fried rice.

Author: Bernard CKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worst Hard Rock Cafe experience
Review: Hard Rock Cafe Melaka is the worst I ever tried of this famous chain. The beef rib was the toughest I have ever eaten while the seafood marinara was dry and lack favour. Oh yeah, a word of advice to other patrons, apply some mosquitos repellent before you visit this restaurant.

Author: YalitanSingapore, Singapore
Title: Felt cheated
Review: I first visited in early Dec 2017 and for the spending the restaurant issues a coupon for redeeming a bottle of wine at the next visit valid till 31 Jan 2018. When I visited again on 14 Dec 2017 with a friend I was told by the waiter that the coupon could only be used in Jan 2018. I wonder if the restaurant had written wrongly on the coupon, or pure cheating customer.

Author: Winston1831Singapore
Title: First visit
Review: The place popular to the local and tourist. Need to wait about an hour before get a table. We need to write out name to get a table ( which is ridiculous). Some items we ordered was salty and some is not tasty. Maybe due to the crowd on that day which they need to rush thru the cooking.

Author: Zetster
Title: Very Average
Review: The pizza was just okay and the breaded chicken (tangy chicken) was not what i expected. my brother inlaw had the crispy chicken bbq, his' tasted better. Service was quite fast.
Restaurant: George & Dragon Cafe at Taman Tasek

Author: Spaidem
Title: The owner tried to save$ on MSG soup
Review: The owner tried to save$ on MSG soup, they are very stingy to top-up soup. 1st top-up = add half soup, half water, 2nd top-up=add quarter soup,3 quarter water. don't believe, go try it out.

Author: dunmetielBandar Puchong Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Stuffy but ok for late night supper
Review: Suzi's Corner is a crowded late-night supper place for young adults who wish to grab an inexpensive meal after clubbing or a night out. Service can be slow and food is just so-so, but it seems that the crowd keeps coming. Location is strategic enough, especially for those in the Ampang area.

Author: Laura TMiddlesbrough, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious satay sticks, fast & friendly service, high touristy prices
Review: We stopped here for lunch after a busy morning touring the Butterfly Park and Bird Park and before heading onto Perdana Botanical Gardens for a wander around the park (all within walking distance). The restaurant is located right next to the Bird Park and accessible from inside the park, but you don't need to visit the park to eat here.We had a delicious lunch here of mixed satay sticks (chicken and beef) with stir-fried vegetables and rice. It is great that in Kuala Lumpur you can buy the satay sticks with the peanut sauce on the side, I have a nut allergy but even I can enjoy the food here :-) although I didn't realise the vegetables are stir-fried in sesame oil so hubby had to eat them all - fellow allergy suffers be warned. We ordered 24 mixed satay sticks (which came with a little salad on the side), vegetable and rice meal, with 4 soft drinks and the total came to 111.80MYR, including the tip that is always included, so just over Â£25. This is expensive for a meal in Malaysia, but it is a toursity area so to be expected. However note 3 times the price of our meal in Little India the next day!Great air conditioning inside, but also seating outside on the terrace overlooking the bird park and trees. We opted for inside after a morning spent in the sun!The food is super tasty! Delicious food, fast and friendly service and clean toilets. Staff speak excellent English, which is very helpful for us tourists. Just a shame the prices are high, but this is a touristy area so to be expected.

Author: Joyce S
Title: Disappointing Chicken Madhbi (Takeaway)
Review: I ordered takeaway from Saba Restaurant. Chicken Madhbi (1/2 chicken with no rice) priced at RM16.00. The chicken piece I received looked shriveled and dried. The char is overly done. I wouldn__ recommend this as it__ not value for money.

Author: duane-woodGlossop, United Kingdom
Title: Memorable Marini's
Review: probably the best view in town only had drinks this time, but the GM Selva very helpful and showed us around the different bars and restaurants as I am looking to revisit in March. Which I definitely will. Also worth noting a happy hour between 5-7 so get a day and night view of the city! Also it Tower 3 and can be 3 separate lifts so not the most obvious way in but worth doing.

Author: Joyce SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great service and nice vibes
Review: We had a family dinner to celebrate my nephew__ birthday. Great casual ambience and the food was fairly good too. The staff especially was very attentive and obliged us with a birthday song and a family photo which was immediately printed and given to us as a souvenir. Was very thoughtful.

Author: VinceYjwSarawak, Malaysia
Title: This establishment is no longer operating
Review: Called the number as listed & the receiving end greeted with "Bla Bla Bla". I asked if Living Room is under the same management of Bla Bla Bla, he said yes. Apparently the number is linked there but still the receiver took our reservation for 5 pax. Funny thing is upon our arrival at Living Room, the gate was closed!So, off we go to Bla Bla Bla which is just 2 shops away & as expected, my name was on the reserved table. There is nothing to talk about a Living Room now.Is it under renovation?

Author: Denzel L
Title: DISAPPOINTED
Review: Food getting from bad to worst...dal & spinach served were tasteless. Other family members & friends also complaint the same. Would stop patronage this place once & for all if food were found to be inferior in quality come the next visit.

Author: doreenl201Kota Kinabalu, Malaysia
Title: Salty Affair!
Review: Ipoh to a certain extent earns a reputation for good tim sum! There are a few popular outlets and Ming Court was introduced to us. We went with high expectations and the long queue on a public holiday got us more excited! After standing outside the shop under the sun for 10 mins, we realised that there was no one controlling the crowd nor was there anyone to see who came first. Then we later realised that we were supposed to enter the shop and just stand next to a table which we thought the diners were going to finish their food soon! I felt so ridiculous just stalling away next to a family who just continued enjoying their tim sum oblivious of our presence and intrusion at the privacy of their meal! Some of them even put our patience to test when they continued sipping their tea after finishing their meal and settling their bills without any consideration of us waiting to nurse our stomachs after a wait for 45 mins! Finally when we managed to take over the table, the elderly waitresses just came around in trays with stacks of tim sum served in little aluminium containers instead of the usual wooden ones! A peek into the containers expose the tiny portion within! Everything came in small portions...far from money's worth! And one bite into them is enough to sting your tongue so badly that even 2 cups of Chinese tea will not quench your thirst! So all of you who have high blood pressure, look out!The siew mai, har kow( prawn dumplings), the glutinous rice, the steam meat dumplings....etc without exception was totally disappointing! To go back again..sorry....NO!
Restaurant: Ming Court Hong Kong Tim Sum

Author: Spyer2015Singapore River, Singapore
Title: Not worth the price!
Review: I had went there for the winter Buffet over the weekend expecting it to be a Buffet with alot of varieties as they charged RM138,but sadly the varieties were not much,very disappointed.N they only serve plain water n hot drinks,there is no juices or cordial drinks.You have to pay for the cold drinks which is ridiculous and never come across such.Nonetheless,the staffs were very friendly and attentive. It's not worth the money for the variety n type of food.
Restaurant: Makan Kitchen at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: MohdSufianA3
Title: A must visit cafe
Review: A must visit cafe. Delicious food. Make sure you come with your empty stomach. The price is reasonable.

Author: TheWoody
Title: French Food in Taman Tun
Review:
Went for dinner. My wife and me ordered slow roasted lamb while my son took roasted pork ribs. We have to wait for quite a while as the lamb took some time to prepare. 

The lamb was OK only and my son love the pork.

Author: BizT
Title: Average food at best but great service
Review: We were so looking forward to our meal at this highly rated restaurant but we rather disappointed with the food. Friend ordered the spring roll on the menu but it was not available! Already a bad start. Our starters - The oxtail soup was bland and the oxtails itself were chewy. My beef salad was average. Duck was cooked pink but the meat was so tough we really couldn__ eat it. The menu is vast though but all our six items chosen were really sub par. Crepes were excellent however, or should I say the sauce was divine. The crepes themselves were not cooked enough! What a disappointment. Oh well, service was great. There are many better options. Hopefully food quality improves. We won__ be back anytime soon though.

Author: yamashitareina
Title: Average food with long waiting time
Review: Honestly wasn't the best I've tasted though it wasn't poor cooking. My drink took half an hour to be served. The food my friends and I ordered was served more than an hour later. Overall, I felt the menu was overpriced too.

Author: rubydiamondNewcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
Title: Don't waste your time and money
Review: The idea of sitting and eating from the highest point in malaysia sounds pretty awesome.Different prices based on where you sit.We paid to sit very close to the window.I must say...customer service was pathetic. I have. Ever been so disappointed in my life. I had to ask 5 times for a cup of tea and even then it was brought out very slow.The waiters were not good at rotating the plates for the buffet.It was very difficult to get a waiters attention.The food was not amazing. Average very Average!!

Author: miraclenTorremolinos, Spain
Title: Very reasonably-priced dinner with friendly but not so professional services
Review: We came here for dinner. As we are from HK, we found that the price for food is very reasonable. We had the lobster bisque, baked barramundi, a bottle of Chardonnay, and two pieces of cake. The lobster bisque was delicious. The barramundi fish is a bit under-seasoned and dry. In fact I could bake and fry better fish. The cake was good. As many have complained, the staff was not so professional though very friendly. For example, they brought two very wet wine glasses to us but the waiter offered to dry them for us. Less than 5 minutes after they served us the lobster bisque, they brought us the fish. No fine dining restaurant would do that in any parts of the world. When we finished the soup, no one picked up the dishes but we had to place them on the next table. They also forgot our side dishes. The ambiance of the restaurant is very good. It is very quiet. We did enjoy the dinner as it is really very cheap.

Author: shulamiteyang
Title: Terrible food with average environment
Review: Environment average. Seafood not fresh & smelly, flaming beer chicken not fully cooked, steak so thin yet so hard, lamb was hard too. The only thing you can eat here is their smoked duck pizza.

Author: TravelerFarnhamUKLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent restaurant in Casa del Mar - creative food and great service
Review: Ate here a few times during our one week stay in Langkawi. Good menu with some interesting Malaysian dishes and some that are little more fusion. When the weather is fine eating on the beach is lovely. Good choice of wines and all the staff are very friendly and professional.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Kevin TKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good night out for a quiet dinner
Review: As promised, the view was spectacular. We had chosen the lower deck because it had more privacy and we ended up enjoying it. Service was excellent. Staff spoke good English & was attentive. We ordered the Ikan bakar/skewered fish with asam/tamarind sauce. The fish was fresh but the sauce was a bit on the flat side. The sesame maguro salad was good though. The mojito & Long Island tea was delicious. At the end, we enjoyed a 20% discount! ; )

Author: MrGoh
Title: Good variety and nice ambience
Review: This place offers good variety of food and nice ambience.  However, the quality of the food is just OK, not great.

Author: Wittynam3
Title: Its all HYPE
Review: We waited an hour to get our meal, it was a long delay due to some party outside. Mic inside the room not working. Price is so high and yet the quality is so so, really disappointed, probably wont be back for a while.

Author: Michele F
Title: Best Indian food in Melacca
Review: We have been here for a quick lunch, the food was really good. They have different menu during the day. Good quality and well cooked

Author: eddyt970
Title: Poor Management
Review: I have brought friends, both local and overseas to Hakka Restaurant 4 times in the last 6 months. There's many good dishes though pricey. However, everytime there is a mistake made from the kitchen. Even their supervisors and captains cannot help.Yesterday 6 Oct, I took my French business friends there. Again a dish was missed and we waited rather long. When I called to the boss (elder brother) he was not friendly and had bad attitude. He almost wanted to quarrel with me. He then yelled to one of his captain without hearing me out.No matter how good your food is, we do not deserved this kind of attitude andcesoecuslly from the boss himself. I have to commend on his staff who are more cultured than this old guy.He should retire if he cannot manage and just let his brother Danny to handle.

Author: kgokulkKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Big let down after going with high expectation
Review: After reading lots of articles, planned for a dinner with two friends. Excellent ambience, perfect sit out after a short rain showerOrdered the following:Bruchette Alla funghi : with mushroom and sauce - tatted average. Not a mushroom fan but had an excellent one at Bangsar South a month backFettuccine carbonara veg - customized for us. Tasted goodRicotta and spinach ravioli - tasted very good, tomato sauce was homemade and excellentVegetarian calzone - allowance was very good but taste was averagePrice : costed around RM 200+Overall not great food tasting experience and will not visit again

Author: KentTai
Title: Birthday celebration with my lovely wife
Review: Excellent food, excellent service! Is a good place to enjoy food. Good environment with free jockey service .

Author: LL721Kuala Lumpur
Title: Bad customer service... overall not worth it!
Review: We made reservations for 10 persons. 5 of us arrived there first and they made us wait outside because they told us that they cannot seat us until all 10 of us have arrived! But we had made reservations earlier! Why couldn't we wait inside on our reserved table? This was so bad customer service!We had to wait almost 25 mins until the rest of our party arrived.We ordered the food - the salted egg yolk custard bun was delicious, tea was pricey at RM3 per person, congee was average, prawn and chicken dumplings were average, fried rice was very expensive. We spent almost RM400 there eating average food, with bad customer service. Never once did the waiters and waitresses smiled at us. They must so hate working there. And, they even asked us to fill up the customer comment sheet and we spoke the truth.Was our first and last visit.

Author: Jamesy008
Title: Sawarak Laksa
Review:
Love the Sarawak Laksa all around Kuching....
Some of us have second helpings..
We had Kolok mee too.

Author: anu26
Title: Baddd
Review: To serve our taste pallette, we decided to go to Sagar.. The food here contains too much of colour and the taste too is not good at all.. The quality of paneer is not good, its very hard.Overall not a satisfying experience

Author: TravellingJ80
Title: Heart of MiriÂ´s nightlife
Review: This place is MiriÂ´s most popular and famous bar/cafe and whether you are there to eat, drink or watch football its got a good vibe. The best thing is the menu of Malay, Western and Indian food, so something for everyone.

Author: JeltsSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good value and good service
Review: I went there for lunch on Sunday and it was packed to the gills. The service is attentive and they also have a bell at the table that you can ring so that you can get service immediately. Our order was taken quickly and the food was delivered promptly. The sashimi is fresh, and the cuts are very even but thick - just the way it's supposed to be. The presentation is very pretty also. Many people stop to take photos of their food because the presentation is so good. It's value for money food and I will be visiting more regularly.

Author: yeaharry
Title: The cafe is good the restaurant for Dinner is not worth the price
Review: Coffee and Pastries are great at the Cafe across from the Sofitel. The dinner that we had at the restaurant on the 3rd or 2nd floor was average. Pizza was good but everything else was just average. Overall it was not worth the price.

Author: Jia H
Title: Out of expectations
Review: I am a Malaysian. I live in Penang and I've been there to taste the food too.But actually you can get crispy duck at particular place in Penang.You can actually ask local residents too.I'm sure they are willing to help too.Besides that, I think its not worth to spend your money there.You can get the food with the same name but more delicious food at a lower price.I think the portion is small too.

Author: M3146BYandrewa
Title: Disappointed
Review: Very disappointed in the service. the food was ok but we where rushed they served mains before starters. We had some soups that had no flavour. The fresh sushi Is nice but that__ about it. 800rm for 2 people I expected better service and quality of food. Also it would help if the waiter could explain the food better as the menu is massive

Author: Traveller31177
Title: Delicious food with affordable price
Review: This restaurant starts open from 6pm. It is highly recommended to come to this place 15 minutes before opening hence you will be in queue about 5-10 people.This restaurant serves good quality of food and affordable price .

Author: adzwanm2021Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very bad service on restaurant ikea cheras.
Review: Very bad food for chicken chop..chicken wings and other...Need to upgrade the restaurant staff... and sent staff go to training for upgrade during attend the customer.. When asking the chef..the reason not make me happy...But the staff give new portion food as me revise fo them...But ikea Johor Bahru is the best in Malaysia...I hope.. need to improve...Thanks.

Author: Andrew998Seoul, South Korea
Title: Money Spent on Decor...?
Review: Finally there is a decent looking place in Mt Kiara to chill and kick back and have a drink while snacking or having a mea. However thats where it all ends. The service level is atrocious, there are so many bodies there but none working or able to speak and comprehend. Wine selections is half decent but the 'cellar' is warm and white wine is not chilled. Hence you would need to wait if you ordered white wine. Ask for a decanter and you get a blank stare. One of the owners proudly proclaimed that all the wines are "so good you can drink it all straight out from the bottle"... guess he doesn't drink much of wine. The bar looks friendly but is too small. The bartender is 'cutesy' if you are into that; but she doesn't know how to mix any cocktails... Must have come from a different school of bartendering. Finally, if you are really adventurous, order some food. This is the most blatant display of false advertising. The food doesn't look anything like in the menu, worst still it doesn't taste like food most of the time.So if you are around the area, and really have nothing to do, grab a beer which is safe and go off to your next appointment.

Author: Ronan Ray F
Title: Overrated and Meatless
Review: I have been here twice and felt ripped off all the time. The servings have no meat, only bones. With the price we are paying, its not really worth it. Dont come here hungry or you will just get disappointed.

Author: SureshR710
Title: Good and kind
Review:
Best Indian food in town...Good and kindness service a bit expansive and high class best north india food available in JB
Located in grand blue wave hotel.
People are good friendly 
Must try at least once..

Author: Relax40436864427
Title: Forbidding
Review: The visit was to savour good food at reasonable pricesThe experience was excruciatingly expensive and the food mediocre

Author: AnnaM8984
Title: Terrible Masala tea, bad service
Review: I was disappointed with the service. First, I'd asked to make my chicken extra spicy but it came rather very mild, even though I asked the waiter which style would be spicier. Second, when i ordered hot masala tea & asked not to add any sugar, waiter started arguing with me telling that they are making it only with condensed milk & it would be sweet by default. Finally they agreed to make it with normal milk but it came almost cold. When i asked to hit it up they told me that they can't make it hot as they can add only cold milk in tea which means they don't even know how to make it. It took them 40 min to customize my tea & it still wasn't very good.I'd not recommend this place.

Author: Thiben76Singapore, Singapore
Title: Lou..sy
Review: Food test is nowhere near the hype, roasted chicken quality is poor, pork is oil soaked & cold. bean sprout just soaked in soy sauce . Overall 2 out of 5.The cashier is more interested in collecting money then anything else.... While customers are eating. Overpriced for the quality served.

Author: Loh T
Title: Excellent customer service!
Review: Was welcomed by Mr Ravee and his team. Came in a group of 22 and asked for a discount. They are willing to work on a price tailored to your budget. Excellent customer service and a huge diversity of food choices. Really enjoyed the night with my friends!.

Author: Guavara
Title: Nice place
Review: very good food here, great service, And I love the cocktails, THANK YOU archie, I will definitely come again, pure France style
Restaurant: Chez Papa French Bistro and Wine Bar

Author: syamilmsc
Title: saturday night live
Review: celebrated my wifey's b'day there with buddies... had dinner, the waiter was very accommodating but struggled with english, a foreigner for sure. being a regular there, i can say the food quality is inconsistent. we had pasta, steaks and some asian cuisine. some of the pastas were a bit too salty. they have a live band performing too. my advise is do not put high expectations when you come here. it's good to just chill out and enjoy....

Author: Hwee Mean T
Title: Not worth to spend time here
Review:
Came all the way to see Mamee Museum, ticket cost RM5 per person. The museum is less than 300sf. Nothing much here.
Think twice before you come.

Author: etwy
Title: Over-rated and Over-priced
Review: Frankly speaking, this Banana Leaf Rice is not best in town. Seriously, there are better restaurants that serve Banana Leave Rice in Klang Valley. This restaurant is over-rated and over-priced!

Author: Annuschka16Melbourne, Australia
Title: Little Gem
Review: This little cafe is a gem in a quiet street run by a lovely family who I had the privilege of meeting, especially the mother who does most of the cooking. It is a cosy, well air conditioned clean cafe which doesnt open for dinner only breakfast and lunch. Also the prices are very reasonable and they have lovely pressed juices and smoothies.As I had arrived in Penang very tired from an early start in Singapore I was looking for an early dinner and as they closed at 6.00 they kindly said I could have an early dinner and stay as long as I liked and not to be rushed. I had the Nasik Lemak which was prepared tastefully and beautiful by the mother and very very delicious I would have returned the next day but it was closed for the day. It is a nice place to chill out during the day, have a juice, lunch etc and check email etc. It is not licenced which is a shame as sitting out on the verandah with a beer or gin and tonic would be nice, especially after all the walking around Georgetown in the heat.I recommend this cafe for its great service and lovely home made food by a loving family.

Author: RusnitaUS
Title: Nice ambiance but pricey and limited menu
Review: I loved the deco and the soft jazzy music playing in the background but the menu was rather limited, pretencious and pricey

Author: 131pangp
Title: Decent rice balls chicken rice
Review: It only the rice been rolled on as a hard ball. Really nothing special. But as to compares with Zhong Hua , of cos no way. Personally I felt this is normal chicken rice lah.. Nothing really fantastic or nice. Hmm if u want some real nice solid chicken rice Chilli, shld try Zhong Hua. Ee ji ban -- so so only lah. That my thoughts. You can give it a try...

Author: sfll
Title: A lot of choices
Review: International cuisine, however quality just pass my requirement.

Author: stormlccIpoh
Title: The WORST place in Ipoh
Review: Yup, that says it all. This place is a pure fart house. Inside is a breeding ground for mosquitoes. And it's DIRTY, and it serves food (if you can call it that).The only reason it is still running is because it's considered cheap, selling cheap (disgusting) drinks to young people who can't afford a decent bar with real drinks.Having your meals inside this place is like having it in a toilet, it's THAT bad.

Author: Madeleine L
Title: A wonderful start to a brand new day
Review: The breakfast buffet at Latest recipe is amazing with their vast spread and choices.... The food was fresh and was constantly top up leaving nothing bare.Their staffs were attentive and warm with a special shoutout to Mr. Hafizi.Definitely a good place to start a brand new day.

Author: shima2227
Title: friendly staff
Review: friendly staff,tejah,thilagesan,aaron,chef sherly,sam,faizul rio.very helpful and friendly.the food was great.the antipasto and pizza also cheese room so fantastic.will sure to come here again.
Restaurant: Tosca Trattoria Italiana at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: RogerRamjetLondonSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very good quality Thai
Review: Visited this place not long after it opened its doors for business. At the time, it seemed relatively quiet.Very glad i did come along as i was pleasantly surprised. The food was uniformly well executed and compared very favourably to the type of thing you would get from an upmarket restaurant in Thailand.The chicken skin crisps were (particularly!) good as was the spicy chicken itself. Other dishes were also executed very well and the menu is a little different to what you would normally see in a restaurant in Bangkok. Overall a classy place for a business dinner or romantic meal as it is more higher end than other places in the city. Having said that i though it struck a nice balance on also not being too stuffy. I went for a family meal and didnt feel out of place at all.Somewhere to go and treat yourself to something slightly different. Will definitely return next time I am in KL.

Author: AileenleeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not that great food
Review: Went there for lunch. The staff was not observant and we found our own tables and had to call the staff to give us menus. Service was slow as the staffs were busy and running around. The food was slightly on a higher price (for a local) and the quality was not there. The food had a reasonable portion. I tried the curry ramen which lacks the oomph I was looking for. They actually just put in the normal 'yellow noodles' and called it ramen. It was very ordinary and seems to be lacking something in my opinion. It is quite tasteless and is neither spicy or thick or delicious.I also tried the Jonker fried rice which is very normal. The fried rice had an overall better taste than the curry noodle.It had an egg on the rice and came with 2 sticks of satay and a blop of salad. Satay and salad was okay tasting. Nothing great nothing bad. The ambience is ok, it can get quite hot if you sit outside in the afternoon even though they have many fans running. I had the asam juice drink (green color) which is very expensive than the normal ones you can get by the street, The size of the juice was surprisingly big. I also tried the Melacca local coffee which is nothing to brag about. Just the normal black coffee. Overall, the food was just okay with nothing to brag about. Maybe the drinks might fare better, however I did not order any alcoholic drinks to try there.

Author: HarvardCatCatSingapore, Singapore
Title: Average fare with small portions and relatively high price
Review: Place is popular with tourists so do make reservations. We ordered the fish head, omelette, Ayam buah keluak (chicken dish cooked using the unique nuts), ladies fingers, chap chay (cabbage) and 2-3 other dishes. Food was served relatively fast as we were there before the lunch crowd came in. The Assam fish head was a disappointment. They only served 1/2 a fish head and it was small with little meat. The rest of the dish was average. I consider the price to be high for the small portion of food (our meal came up to about RM400). I would not recommend this place. There are other better peranakan restaurants in Melaka.
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: annwongsy
Title: Confirm sedap
Review: Authentic nyonya cooking. fresh seafood especially the prawns. please give it a try. We visited during CNY 2015. Even with the holiday season the quality of the food was not compromised.

Author: 809neilf
Title: Great food and staff
Review: Really nice meal in a nice setting. Staff were great, would  recommend a table outside in the evening.

Author: kinosraj15
Title: Bland Food
Review: Had Lamb Briyani. The lamb was ok. However, the briyani rice taste very bland .The rice use for briyani was normal rice instead of basmati rice.

Author: syaerdeanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: What happen to the old WhupWhup?
Review: I used to loved this place especially after I found that they serve the carbonara pasta they way it supposed to be (no cream involved) and have keep coming back for it if we are in the area.But the recent visit left my friend and I puzzled. What really happen to this place?The carbonara pasta were runny and they put parmesan powder on top of it. My friend ordered the salmon dish and spesifically asked the waiter that he wanted it raw a bit in the middle (the way salmon should be cooked) but it came overcooked. What really matter was this joint is supposed led by a culinary students and this shouldnt happen. The waiters prefer to talk to each other behind the rack than being vigilant of the customers whereas the previous set of waiters were good and attentive. This is just sad. They do need proper management and training.

Author: Kiang Chiok S
Title: Excellent Western Restaurant.
Review: Excellent western food with great steak and dessert located in the older central part of Kuching with many cafe, pubs and restaurants  area.

Author: eugenegwcKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Does American food taste like this ??
Review: Not too sure is it we are too "Malaysian taste" or is the food is too "American taste"? We really don't like the taste of the food and feel is not worth this kind of price at all....not trying to criticise just our own feeling and taste. Firstly the appearance of the food is doesn't open our apertize at all. The appearance and food is totally feel like made from a "fast food"Secondly we order a "country chicken" which we honestly we think Mc Donald or KFC Chicken did a better job than it. Thirdly the taste of source is so greasy. We order 2 different meat dishes but the source and side dishes is both the same (just with this kind of price we expected will hv different taste of it) The good one is The portion of the pork chop is big . But with tht source, we hope is better small portion so we can finish it faster. While we were eating then we try checked the reviews. We guess everyone hv their own taste but just not for us at all.

Author: castiel21
Title: not suitable for family outing
Review: the place still smokers' haven..they can smoke anywhere they want.no restrictions. not suitable for family with small kids. not a healthy place.really disturb with the hazard environment. nothing change since my last review couple of months back..highly not recomended for family dinner

Title: take mozzie repellent for this place

Author: kamal segaran B

Author: ClareiceMelaka, Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Your tastebuds dancing....
Review: Love their service, food are delicious and fast too. You don't need to wait very long to get your food. The atmosphere of the place very nice. But then I think this place is abit too dark...for some of peoples. Especially for a senior citizen (my parents) having difficulty to enjoy the food.

Author: MFKadyKota Kinabalu, Malaysia
Title: Good food, unprofessional staffs
Review: I admit, their food, it's good. We had cod fish with crab meat sauce, baked prawns, risotto and salmon steak, they were all good. The set up, I am not so crazy about the ambience, I personally think its eerie. I almost always never had any problem with serving staffs anywhere, and I personally did not have any issue with the staffs in this restaurant. The staffs however had problems with other staffs due to a customer's complaint, we were told. There were shoutings at the bar or kitchen. Glasses or plates were broken or rather smashed in front of customers. I just hope that nobody had to drink or eat pieces of broken glass and plates.  If a supervisor had to bawl out a waiter, please do it in the backroom, or your office or virtually anywhere except in full view of your customers. The same applies to staff arguing openly amongst themselves. Customers are usually not entertained by this behavior. If a staff needs __orrection,_ take it outside__ecause its embarrassing for me having to witness bosses and staffs losing their cool. It gives me indigestion.

Author: Connie wIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Good food good ambience
Review: Loved the duck!! Simply delicious!! Dim sum is good too. Family and kid friendly, regular visits planned.

Author: jesuisenamourez
Title: When you found hair and plastic in your meal
Review: It was a late afternoon meal when there wasn't any crowd. Ordered several dishes including the fried spinach. To our surprise there was hair and a strip of long plastic inside. The PIC wasn't apologetic...and said the kitchen crew didn't see it.

Author: workingnomad20
Title: No meat in the Burritos - Rip off
Review: I have dined here three times and this will be the last. The food undoubtedly tastes good but there is hardly any meat in the burritos. It's all lettuce and stringy cheese!The place gets super busy so they can get away with ripping customers off. It will no doubt continue as they chase bigger profits but hopefully they'll read this and take note.Chicken is cheap in Malaysia so there is no excuse for being this mean customers like this.Drinks are also horribly overpriced. Avoid.

Author: Vectra228Singapore, Singapore
Title: They lost the special __aste_

Author: Philip G
Title: Great Western food served with warmth
Review: Great service at Chili's. Staff go out of the way to make sure you have a great dining experience. The Western food is great and their sauces are 'to die for'. However price of beer is pretty steep.

Author: PSGOH1Ampang, Malaysia
Title: POOR SERVICE!!!
Review: I went to the Mid valley branch of Absolute Thai. One of the waiter took my order sheet and take my order... i waited for 20 minutes and the table who come after me get their food and drinks first but not us! Well, it's ok... that might be some miscomunication between the team... And wait a while more, one staff come and ask me," Sir, you haven't get your food yet? Absolutely NOT!!! There is no food and drinks on my table! Even though i order only a SPRITE!!!
