The staff who come and ask whether i got my food or not, that he just ignore!! he go and continue on other job! TERRIBLE SERVICE!!! WILL NOT GO AGAIN!!!

Author: SANDEEP AIndia
Title: Hopeless, no taste at all.
Review: This was the second restaurant provided to us for dinner on day two of our malayasia tour, i would say food was tasteless, with no flavour. Its seem they dnt care as well as food was pathetic to core, be it dal, rice, vegetables, nan (bread) .If there is no respect for food making, for customers and there attitude towards hospitality, i would suggest to shut it down and do something else. Strictly no to buffet here, ask your tour operator not to give this as your dinner option, you will regret.

Author: ttyynnggSkudai, Malaysia
Title: OMG... A worst experinece at Grill Bar Johor Bahru
Review: Today just took my lunch at Grill Bar Steakhouse Johor Bahru will my colleague. I am very disappointed on the restaurant cleanliness, as I found a BIG cockroach hide inside the glass of putting napkin. While I am yelling, the waitress came to kill the cockroach immediately in front of us by her leg and quickly pickup the dirty things and throw it away. Their service is even worse, the PIC/manger was never come to apologize and explain on this matters. OMG, I can__ image all these is happened in a restaurant!!!!!

Author: Farida PMinneapolis, Minnesota
Title: Good stop
Review: Reviewing restaurants in Malaysia is hard because people come from all parts of the world and have different expectations. I__ a U.S person who have travelled most of Asia and lived in Indonesia and China for many many years, and these are my expectations. We stopped here on the way to our Airbnb. Not Cheap for Malaysian standard. Definitely not a place where locals would come to eat. But We liked the food. We had the garlic bread first. They__e very buttery goodness!! We had the spring roll, meh... just ok. next time we would try the samosa instead. We had chocolate and mango milkshakes. Both were serviceable. obviously, we__e not at a malt shop, so, take that with a grain of salt. For main course we had butter chicken and sambal prawns. The sambal prawns is not on the menu. They made it for us upon request, and both were tasty but the sambal prawn was our favorite. The meals came with a big pot of white rice. I had Indian masala tea for the 1st time ever, so I can__ make recommendations because I have nothing to compare it with, but basically, it__ black tea with milk and added some spices, though I didn__ taste much spice to the drink, I liked it, would order again. Note that the portions are not big at all. The 3 of us (2 adults and 1 kid) didn__ leave feeling very full but also not hungry. For 3 adults, though, you__ need 1 more entrÃ©. All that... a little over RM 200 = +\- $50. Like I said, not cheap, but nothing was disappointing us.

Author: Till577
Title: Unreal
Review:
Really good authentic food for a really fair price! 
Nice service and especially the buttered chicken is unreal! 

Definitely recommend this place!

Author: ceemohanJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: The Spice of Life
Review: I've been visiting this restaurant for about 10 years now. It started off serving lovely Indian food at reasonable prices. However, over some years, the food quality deteriorated, prices shot up, some unordered items were surreptitiously added to our bill on several occasions....and so we stopped going. Fortunately for us, friends had started to whisper about how this restaurant had made a comeback. We decided to give the place a try last year, and we're glad we did. Since that visit a year ago, we have returned time and again. We have celebrated birthdays and anniversaries, sat in and dined, ordered take-aways on numerous occasions, and have always felt satisfied. Service is near faultless, staff (Manas, Ulfa, Ani, Veera, Mani, etc) can't seem to do enough to please us, turning dinner here into an almost fine-dining experience. The food itself is a mouth-watering array of both North and South Indian dishes. In fact, in my opinion, the North Indian dishes here are the best in the JB city area. The all Indian menu also has an extensive number of dishes. Prices are fairly reasonable. More recently, some food items have become increasingly spicy. Order wisely or risk scorching your tastebuds. This pork-free restaurant serves wine by the bottle. They also serve beer. Finally, this is an old bungalow which has been converted into a restaurant. Some of the dining-rooms are small and awkwardly built. Parking too, can be an issue. Don't, however, let that deter you from visiting. This is an Indian experience not to be missed while in JB.

Author: fOODSLOVEr668Malaysia
Title: Disappointing
Review: We reached there around 10.45pm, the greeter told us that no more dinner serve, which there is no sign or any information. We have no choice and have to go to the restaurant beside the river to settle our dinner. When we are back to the cafÃ© at around 11.15pm, the greeter again told us they are closing, but the sign clearly stated they are closing at 12.00 am. After we begging him, only he allowed us to enter to have drink, and the greeter showing us his kind of sour face, just like we are drinking for free.We are asked to sit at the tables outside, whereby in the cafÃ© was having full blast of air-cond without a single guest? We are in the group of 6, asking to join 3 tables or more, so that easy for us to talk, Hence, our request was rejected due to social distancing. However, another high table with high stools were allowed for 6 persons, not even 1 meter distance? Maybe the manager was in the table with the group, therefore they are allowed to sit together without social distance.

Author: mrmin1
Title: Must have visited on a off day.
Review: Based on the review we were eagerly anticipating eating at this little restaurant.We visited on a Monday, however felt the food was only average. Maybe after the busy weekend there were different chefs working on the weekend. The Pork was tough and not at all tender, and the Chicken smelt like it had been reheated.The highlight was the freshly prepared spring roll which was bursting with flavour.

Author: mabel sKuching, Malaysia
Title: terrible
Review: Brought family there as the shop name is special. The decoration of the shop is attractive too. However, if u look around while waiting for the foods...u may found it is dirty and messy... The foods served are not fresh. We ordered:1) ayam penyet - it took long hour to arrive, the meat not fresh and smelly. RM12.90 but nothing special 2) rice - pickles served as side dish with terrible smell. 3) Noodle - over cooked turn "soft and sticky" 4) coffee - as recommended but out of our expectation.After few days, we been told the same from friends' experience ..Hope the quality of the foods and drinks can be improved to match the pricy cost.

Author: profmelfiky
Title: Dinner
Review: We had dinner there with a friends. We had nice food but not comparable to other places in Langkawi. The service was slow. The weather was not the best that night, it was about to rain so the waiter moved us inwards. The food was not as tasty and gave me personally discomfort the next day. The place had many foreigners which should imply a good cuisine but it was average as I said to other restaurants we tried.The prices were average for seafood in Langkawi. I personally did not enjoy the experience that day.

Author: sheila1026109Penafiel, Spain
Title: I have very mixed feelings
Review: I have very mixed feelings about this place. The food was hit and miss. Pizza was ok and chicken quite below average with a very poor sauce. It was so poor that we could not be sure if it was intended for the chicken or the side salad. The warm bread was actually nicer than the chicken. No one asked us how the food was so I guess the chef is not interested. After serving us, no one asked if we want to order anything else. Also, another surprise. The ambience was ordinary and I had to sit facing some big equipment. No music, making the ambience even more dull. Their saving grace is their very polite staff and general hygiene.We reserved by phone directly to the restaurant at around 5pm but when we arrived, our reservation was not found. That was disturbing and probably the reason I got a machine facing seat.During phone reservation, the staff asked if it__ a special occasion and I said __t__ my birthday_. I have seen in previous reviews and there is complimentary birthday cake given to other guests. I did not get any cake. The staff serving also asked if any special occasion and I said __irthday_ and if there was any promotion for birthday. He said he will check and came back to say there was none. It sounds odd that some guests get recognized and some ignored. Not sure what is the discrimination policy here. Would it really hurt their pockets that much to give a tiny piece of cake or tart or macaroon? It__ just a small personal touch. Also odd that I am asked twice about special occasion yet it means nothing, causing me to believe more of being discriminated. Maybe because we are not big spenders as we don__ eat beef or drink alcohol. We then left to have dessert and coffee at Les Bouchons where we were treated far better than here, though it was just a small spend.
Restaurant: Tosca Trattoria Italiana at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: MO glaucoma 2 M
Title: Amazing Tauhu Bakar
Review: Visited this place last night. Went to Gerai Ayong (Chinese Halal Food) as suggested on Trip Advisor. Had the best Tauhu bakar and laicikang the ikan bakar's sauce was very tasty.. ordered tomyam and mee goreng from the next door stall and that also tasted amazing! Even as I'm typing this, I'm salivating would definitely return again..

Author: AleerakVarsity Lakes, Australia
Title: Great Vegetarian Set - Not on the Menu
Review: Bijan is a short walk up Changkat Bukit Bintang and is well worth the visit.Once I stated that I was a vegetarian they offered me a vegetarian set, which is not on the menu, so it was a pleasant surprise to be able to sample many vegetarian dishes. The set included spring rolls as an entrÃ©e, but when I asked for something different and they were happy to swap it for another item on the menu. The set came with the afore mentioned entrÃ©e, as well as rice, fermented tofu (which was definitely not my favourite) and two delicious curries. Unfortunately, they had forgotten about the curries, so I had to remind them, but they were worth the wait.I have been to Malaysia many times and love the street food, but for a nice, authentic meal in a restaurant just off Bukit Bintang, you can't beat Bijan. Plus, they have an excellent wine list!

Author: Sid8886Birmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Terrible food made us both ill
Review: Went there for the views and thought may as well enjoy a meal. The government who own this building should be ashamed for such poor food. Buffet was a disgrace and service was something to be desired. Not once did anyone ask us for drinks or if food was ok. I could have had better service at Jimmy Spices!Both of us were suffering on the toilet the minute we got back from there. Go for views not food, trust me.

Author: pauljerSingapore, Singapore
Title: KL__ worst dining experience
Review: I want to do you the nigh-priceless service of telling you somewhere it__ imperative you don__ visit.Some meals can feel like a punishment, and if that__ your bag, I can__ recommend Nasi Kandar Pelita enough. The nasi goreng and fried chicken were nothing to trouble Instagram with. The Maggi goreng was challengingly bland. It is profoundly awful. This is truly Malaysia__ capital__ worst dining experience, just short of eating broiled peanuts from a stall at Chow Kit Road run by a man with weeping dermatitis.There are several words I can drum up to describe the treatment we received from the wait staff, but let me limit it one: shoddy. No, wait, remembering the wrong food they__ served despite reminders, I would add: uniformly bad.We left hungry, of course we did, and RM60 poorer. This is the true truth as I say it as it is_

Author: Snowy_ShahDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Avoid if you can!!!
Review: We popped in for a late night dinner at about 10pm. Ordered a few dishes and waiter kept asking to serve water despite having told him we were ok for the moment. Ordered a Cocktail which was watered down at best. The pani puri came with only one small piece of potato in each puri!! Mains was average quality and taste. Finally came time to pay. Despite having asked at the start if they accept card, to which they said yes.... In the end the machine was apparently not working all of a sudden. Staff were more interested in getting out and closing shop at 11pm. By the time we left the parking lot the whole place was shut down like a well trained crack commando unit!

Author: James201410
Title: Not bad for the price
Review: Good food but the waiter was a bit rude. Price is affordable but the food is slightly too salty. Overall not bad

Author: Nicholas GKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delivering Excellence
Review: Kudos to Raja Adli and Jackson for their impeccable attention to service. Recent visit to Graze for the Pio Cesare Wine Dinner was a lovely experience. Keep up the wonderful attitude and service.

Author: RudieVenMuar, Malaysia
Title: So let me set the scene.
Review: So let me set the scene. My daughters birthday. We drive 110km ( round trip ) to get to Hard Rock Melaka ( my daughter sees herself as a rocker ) . Get there around 8pm and lucky it__ not full. On the contrary there are only 6 tables with people. We want to order we have to look and call for a waiter. We order. 3 by drinks1x Nachos starterMains:One chicken satay for the princessOne Fajita DuaOne striploin with a extra side of onions rings & garlic bread. So we wait and wait and wait. No drinks comes. All of a sudden here is my onions rings. Then comes 2 Milkshakes. Then comes the nachosThen the garlic bread and then my steak. All of a sudden the table looks small. I ask them is it possible for us to have the starter and then you bring the mains out. The waiter looks confused and says but I am bringing your Fajita now. This is where I got upset. I said keep it in the kitchen and take my steak back as well. Once we done with this we will have the rest. STILL I DID NOT RECEIVE MY DRINK!!!!!We are done and ask them for the mains and I also ask where is my drink. Reply ........ oh they forgot to make it!!!!!! Never one of us was asked if we wanted another drink or anything else. We paid and left. Went I get dessert outside from another shop. I have to congratulate the management on FÂ£&@ing up a special night by not training their staff properly and for not knowing how to run a restaurant ( I__e been in the food business at many levels and I know crap when I see it). I would never ever set foot in Hard Rock again. It__ a disgrace the service we got. You were almost empty you should be pampering the tables and selling more and more to them. We would have easily still have dessert and coffee. But I guess it__ your loss Hard Rock.

Author: jenny1tyrrell
Title: Holiday
Review: I have visited Andrews kampung for many years excellent food and value for money lovely idea to serve half portions gets very busy so advisable to book Andrew is a star as are all his staff lovely gesture of a rose on Valentine__ Day

Author: RatingDuoMerak, India
Title: Okay!
Review: Positives:- the staff is friendly and have the right attitude- they serve local tastes as well as western ones- good selection of drinks, ice lemon comes for free with all dishesNegatives:- a bit pricey when compared with average local prices- as it is a helal place the drinks_ menu is limited to non-alcoholic drinks

Author: Jamster1593
Title: Only go if you__e happy to be treated differently for the colour of your skin
Review: I went to this bar last night with my girlfriend. She is brown and I am white, and the difference in the way we were treated was disgusting. When staff came over or brought drinks for us they addressed me as sir but completely ignored my girlfriend, despite the fact that we were sat right next to each other. This happened throughout our time at the bar but the most awful moment was when I went to the toilet. I went there and literally 3 different people gave me directions to the toilet before I was even able to ask where the toilet was! I came back and my girlfriend asked where the toilet was and I told her, but said don__ worry, there__ lots of people at the door who will show you where it is. She went to the toilet and not a SINGLE person helped show her where the toilet was and they just ignored her. This is despite the fact that the venue was extremely well staffed and literally had 3 people standing at the door. If you come to this restaurant you are just supporting a racist business that treats people differently for the colour of their skin, rather than just treating people equally as human beings. Would not recommend.

Author: TopherchanIpoh, Malaysia
Title: It's worth its salt :)
Review: Many people ask me "How can you stand to eat such a salty thing?"... but it is actually the way it is cooked that gives it this name. It is virtually baked with an intermediary of salt rocks. Together with some family-secret herbs and spices, it gives it just that extra ummph that I have yet to find elsewhere.AND... there's a "drive-through" service too :)

Author: Khadijah AJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: 5 stars it is
Review: Came here for a conference. Service were fantastic from the moment we parked our car to room experience to buffet spreads. My first time here and already hoping to come back same time next year. Keep up the good works! Two thumbs up!

Author: driPJPetaling Jaya
Title: Overrated
Review: Menu is limited, only grilled meats, briyani and salads/appetisers. Not even selection of breads. We ordered the mixed grill, tasted ok but portion is small. Food quality is medium, but price is quite premium.The hummus was great, though. Such a shame. All the hype but we could name a dozen or so other middle eastern restaurants in KL serving better food.

Author: Jamal AKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Affordable meals with variety
Review: I had lunch here after Friday prayers. A bit crowded, but good choices on the menu - local rice and dishes or fast order items such as noodles and Indian Rojak, drinks a plenty to choose from.THE CROWD is friendly. I share the table with a local gent. You can either eat inside or outside. Service is ok.This is an Indian Muslim shop.

Author: RosiePerth123
Title: Nothing to get excited about
Review: We had to queue to get in this place so thought that was a good sign as other nearby places were empty....staff had a bad attitude, food was bland and tasteless and it was noisy and not a great experience and wouldnt rush back.....

Author: DrShawnPaul
Title: Overpriced Malaysian street food for tourists
Review: May be convenient to have malaysian street food here but I would suggest the Lot 10 Hutong Food Court(underground) nearby for more authentic and reasonable malaysian food

Author: wui1990
Title: Japanese dinner
Review:
Good place to chill and can watch how chefs prep food whilst enjoying meals. 

Don't mind to revisit again in future.

Author: CiahasherHouston, Texas
Title: Good food but slow service
Review: This restaurant is located above Malone's. its a good place to go with a group for a function. As night falls, you have a great view of the colorful fountains overlooking KLCC park. Service, however, is slow which is what i remember from my last visit 18 months ago.

Author: JessicaC9223
Title: Food not so good
Review: Ok place is very nicePlating is very niceService is good butRather than that not good anymore Food quite disappointed duck with mango so.so. Nothing special of taste. (Just duck with mango)Lamb not fresh and very Taft.Sea cucumber soup nothing special very normalTofu seafood not badMidin(pako)- salad not nice (nothing special Butter prawn to sweet nothing special too! Only can taste a condense and evaporated milk. Lousy butter prawn I tried ( whole family not happy)Sad even my kids don__ like it say to much sugar. Finally the fried (money chai) is only ok! Order Chinese tea for a group give us so small pot like just for 2 people! So just need to drink once for small cup then need to ask People to refil again . Nice place but lousy food! Over price for the quality of food.

Author: Mommicaliphs
Title: Lunch @33
Review:
Love that the place really follows the social distancing SOP. 
Very friendly waiters from the greet and service and the farewell. Thanks April for waiting our table really wonderful and helpful  :)

Author: ChanMLPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Average food quality
Review: Was highly recommended by grab driver n hotel to have seafood dinner. We ordered prawns, fish and crabs besides vegetables. Only the crabs we're above average, prawns average but the steam fish was way below average. U will not recommend this place again, I am sure there are other better places to eat around Kucing town

Author: RSCheokSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very Average
Review: For lunch, this place is usually frequented by guests attending conferences and meetings at the hotel. There were not many other walk in guests. Not surprising, because, whilst it may be considered a good spread by Western standards, I have had many other much better ones in the Middle East and in other hotels in KL. Salad were basic (no shrimp, mussels, oysters, sashimi), mains were OK, the dessert selection was quite good. There was a pasta, sandwich and noodle counter. About RM110 per person after tax, not good for what you get. Quality of food was just average.By 2PM, 90% of the desserts were untouched - not sure what happens, but I do hope it is not wasted ......Try elsewhere.

Author: junghaeyenKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Twice experienced and not really impressed
Review: Food and drinks are so so, good location but staff were too tired at 11:30pm and not attentive enough....We ordered a coctail and a beer and wanted glass as we were having dinner not wanting to fill up with only beer, staff brought a pint and it went all warm till dinner..

Author: honkieexpatkuala lumpur
Title: Unique must try...
Review: I first went to Sek Yuen in the early 60s when my father was stationed in Malaya as it was known then. We were the guests of a senior civil servant. I was about 10 years old and I still remember the taste of their fried rice and sweet & sour pork (which was all my uneducated palate took) vividly. Sek Yuen is substantially less grand than I remember but the food is still very good. The cold chicken which is an advance order is excellent as is both the 'Pei Par' Duck and the 8 Treasure (Part Por) Duck. The stewed pork, stuffed pork trotter and the steamed parrot fish are also excellent. To finish off the meal order their signature wok fried noodles. The aroma of the firewood they use in the noodles is something else. Do bring your own wine but be content to drink it out of a normal water tumbler. Its a restaurant that you must try before they close their doors.

Author: whiterose39Sri Kembangan, Malaysia
Title: Sataying for Lunch
Review: I followed my colleague for lunch, they serve nasi lemak, nasi lemak ayam, satay daging, ayam and kambing. My colleague had the normal nasi lemak. I had the nasi lemak ayam goreng. The rice was nicely done, sambal was damn nice, ayam goreng looked like KFC but tasted better than KFC, we also had the daging satay which very tasty, only meat and no fat, served with kacang sauce that was also very good. Overall it was a very filling and satisfying lunch, intend to bring my other lunch buddies here too.

Author: JimmyKL
Title: Good Yamen Arabic food
Review:
First went to this place 2 years ago and visited recently and still good. The mendi rice of beautifully cooked. And the thin crispy bread has always been my favourite. 

Will always come back for good Arab food.

Author: JohnKL89Kuala Lumpur
Title: Okay coffee but great ambience
Review: I can't really review the food as I only ordered coffee, which was only average -- bitter and a little sour, as usual, not brewed very well. The rustic ambience is great, however, lovely place to hang out with friends. We went there for coffee after dinner but the menu looks interesting as well.

Author: VLim6115
Title: Nice Seafood Restaurant
Review:
This restaurant was previously from Top Spot where you can find many seafood stalls.
The food was good and reasonable. I like the way that you can specify the portion that you order. The noodles was good.

Author: Clarke1013Stockholm, Sweden
Title: No common sense or warmth - poor service to say the least
Review: I live just round the corner and have frequented 'SOULed Out' on a number of occasions. Unfortunately I can say that each visit gets worse & worse, and I doubt I will return any time soon. Some of the service is just laughable. On my most recent visit I had to ask for my drink to come twice. I waited 10 minutes for a Pepsi despite there being 5 guys behind the bar doing nothing. My food arrived before my drinks. Dining with a friend we asked for our food to come out together (which you would assume is the norm in a restaurant anyway) and yet french fries came out first then my starter and then my main which I had wanted to eat with the French fries. My friend's food didn't come out until 10 mins after mine, by which stage I was almost finished. That is a joke. Can the chefs, or kitchen staff not produce food in a timely manner? Over-priced and with poor service, I have no reason to want to come and eat here.

Author: Sarraahhhh
Title: No good.
Review: Tried dinner here. Biriyani rice with chicken.. undercooked chicken and rice having no taste. Would not recommend

Author: SivaTheDonKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excited at first
Review: Was excited to dine here for a while now. Brought a friend along too. The portions are big and ordering a starter and a main dish is more than enough to have a full stomach. The food is nice but the mac and cheese was a bit too dry for my liking. The Pavilion branch is better according to my friend. Perhaps I will head there the next time.

Author: travelandshop2014Montreal, Canada
Title: Blah Blah Blah food, Wow Decor
Review: Went for dinner. Was disappointed given all the positive reviews on TA.Pros:1. beautiful decor - lots of thought was put into this restaurant. It is an impressive place to dine.Cons:1. This is a seafood heavy restaurant. There are not many veggie options. You have to speak with your waiter to create something for you. The veggie options they do have come in large plates and are meant to be shared with 2-3 people. I ordered a plate of Midin (which is a fiddlehead) and some noodles. The noodles were somehow drenched in some sort of weird sauce yet some of them managed not to be cooked. That is an impressive feat. I really didn't care for anything I had. Even the dessert, which I hoped would save the meal (a matcha cake), was nothing memorable other than its price. I can't even say the presentation of any of the meals was exceptional. What I had was in a family style presentation.2. Service - the level of English was decent. Our waitress worked to try and accommodate my allergies. Problem was that she was not overly friendly, but did her job. She seemed a bit annoyed with all of our questions. Walking into the restaurant, you are not greeted by anyone. You have to wait around and flag someone down to be seated.3. Leaky roof- there was a downpour which revealed that some tables are under a leaky roof. Some customers had to be relocated to alternate tables. I also felt that I was getting beaten by mosquitoes. 4. location - it was a bit difficult to find as it is sort of tucked away at its back entrance and has a very high signage at the front entrance. Hard to identify the place unless you ask or look way up. Overall, this was a blah, overpriced dining experience, but the decor is first rate. Would not recommend to a vegetarian.

Author: Wanderer648675
Title: Perrier Jouet Brunch at Graze
Review: Thank you to Adli - Manager and team - Chef Brett, Azu, Fajar, Stephanie, Steven, Haziq and Eshan for a fabulous brunch at Graze Restaurant. We were really looked after, gluten free and seafood free meals were handled with such care. We can__ wait to return. Class A service!

Author: Ruo Lin LSingapore, Singapore
Title: Average Hakka food, poor service
Review: Refer to http://rollingwrites.blogspot.com/2011/11/restoran-hakka.html for pictures. I write this review in relation to Hakka food only, not normal Chinese food. I see the whole point of going to a Hakka restaurant as trying some Hakka food, but the food was average and the service was horrible. We ordered æ¢___£è_ which is thick slices of pork belly with mustard green, cooked with soy sauce and sugar. The marinate was pretty good and the mustard green was salty and a good pairing with rice. I guess this is enough for my dinner. But note, there's PLENTY of fats, so remove it if you don't eat that amount of fats. We also ordered a è±__ç¾ which is basically like toufu with lots of minced meat. Nothing interesting.The ç®__å­ is the epitome of Hakka food. It's made of tapioca/yam and made into the shape of abacus beads. It is soft on the outside and chewy in the inside. I don't eat this but my mum does. Her verdict about it? There are better ones around. The ___ é¸ which is salty chicken was okay and not overtly salty. In all, I didn't really like this place much. For one, I really don't like the service here. For this, I probably differ from a lot of other reviewers where they enjoyed good service. Nobody bothered about us when we started walking into this place. The lady captain (I suppose) looked as we walked closer and closer to the air-con room and didn't say a word. And suddenly she finally said, "You all have to sit outside". Fine, I'll sit outside, along with all that smoking in the open air. I appreciate you killing my lungs.They weren't very friendly overall. Food wise, not the best around I think- at least for Hakka food. For this, we paid around 120 Ringgit (around $48). Would probably be better eating some other thing! Oh and try to refuse the wet towels they give you after the meal if your hands are not dirty- they charge for it without telling you. Also, if you don't eat the nuts, return it to them! All the deceptive charging policies- Don't get tricked!

Author: edmund430
Title: Food
Review: It was nonsense. Can find better food at Subang Jaya

Author: willjones6
Title: Great Cafe
Review:
Perfect location.  Good food and cold beers.
Fun place to stop in and meet people from all over the world.

Author: Po1019Seoul, South Korea
Title: Fantastic lunch
Review: Wife and I ordered a feast because we left our hotel early in the morning without eating a proper breakfast. Ended up at this restaurant after a great shopping trip through Central Market.We ordered the fried butter shrimp, seafood pad thai, morning glory, beef rendang, and fried rice. The entire meal was fabulous. Definitely not the cheapest meal in KL, but well worth a visit if you crave a scrumptious Thai meal. I will definitely be returning in the future.

Author: Tsb_foodhunter
Title: Mosquito place and low quality food
Review: The localization is nice...near the river but is infected by mosquito. The menu is a mix about asean and western but the quality is very low. We order spagguetti thats come cold and dry...the frozen spring rolls very bad and other dishes that better no remember.The menu card is horrible in design and full in fat and oil. Forks and spoon need clean well.The best think is the staff but no enought for have a good experience there

Author: YeohS57
Title: Kim
Review: Delicious food, many choices, nice decoration and friendly and help staff. Good place to hang out, will come again.

Author: stormlccIpoh
Title: Don't know what the fuss is about
Review: Usually I will remember the good ones and the bad ones too (especially the bad ones) because the bad ones at least have some character and madness to their cooking. This place is just.....forgettable. And this is one of the worst traits of a restaurant, blandness, lack of character, lack of excitement. I can't even recall what we ordered and what specific dishes we don't like, the only thing I remembered was it was NOT worth the price they charged, the place was very tight because the tables were too close together with all those useless decorations that pretended to be antiques. Oh and the service sucks (it's that bad I was forced to use this word, sorry).I don't understand why so many people come here and claimed that they were "consistent". Consistent of what may I ask? Boringness? Ah, I finally remembered something about it's food after ranting for so long in this review, we had a deep fried fish with "assam" sauce. The sauce was OK (mediocre, nothing special, BORING.........) but that fish is a piece of frozen rock. They literally took it out of the freezer and then fry it IMMEDIATELY and it is the WORST piece of fish I have ever eaten.So now that I have remembered something about it's food, I retract my previous comment about it's blandness. It was SO BAD that I unconsciously forget all about that piece of fish / frozen rock.

Author: idpigments
Title: Horrid services and noisy establishment
Review:
Dun bother coming here, food is average, and price on the high side. Service is so so, The wait for 1 hour for food to arrive is nonsense.
Trust me, i wont be back here.

Author: Attilio D
Title: Average place to eat lunch
Review: Maybe better at dinner but I doubt it. Nothing special, food was fine, but the place seems unfinished and lack of character. Where did they put the cover of the roof? Exposed cables and cement beans.

Author: susantay27
Title: Bouncy West saury fish balls
Review: Hand made fish balls using west saury fish. The balls were bouncy. You can eat it plain with soup or with noodles. The noodles does were not those like Singapore, which has the alkaline taste. They also have laksa and normal breakfast toast. Coffee was so-so.
Restaurant: Tian Xiang Yong Peng Fish Ball

Author: herbaceousMalaysia
Title: A is for Awesome!
Review: My two previous visits here did not dissapoint me. I have tried their entree of beef carpaccio and salmon something-something. both were delightful. my money is on the beef carpaccio - simply FANTASTIC! The pizza was crusty yumm! the lasagna though small in portion but had a lot of meat in it. now, I AM a big eater and if I said the lasagna is filling, it means it IS filling. the lamb shank was ok, I liked the one at Secret Recipe better. The pasta olio was nothing to shout about. Try their cheesecake - it's worth your every penny. They have seats outside and also inside. i heard that the upper floor is really nice and romantic, but have yet to check it out. in terms of price, it's quiet costly, so save it for special occasions. Overall, satisfying experience!!

Author: Kevin W
Title: Dinner
Review:
Awesome Pasta and Hawaiian Chicken also good environment. 
Sadly fish and pork out of stock. Visiting wrong day.

Author: Travelicious_KKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Poor experience
Review: The service is really slow. Food took over 20 minutes to arrive. Wait staff were not very professional or responsive. No apology for the food arriving late. Certainly below par of the kind of service you would expect fron an eatery located within a five star hotel.

Author: Nivle
Title: Average food but good ambiance
Review: Love the hospitality but mediocre food. Grilled fish was not so much a grilled fish, doesn't taste like one. Was really expensive.

Author: kirbzzzzzLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Incredible experience!
Review: We have never experienced anything like Dining in the Dark and thoroughly enjoyed it. I was much more nervous about eating in a pitch black room than I expected, but our server AK was brilliant, and really put us at ease. The food was amazing - really high quality with lots of variety, and thankfully there were no unusual meats, which we were a little scared of! Absolutely great experience that id thoroughly recommend, and definitely worth the Â£20 price tag.

Author: poopshooterPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: awesome sports bar!
Review: This is like my 2nd home. Being a hardcore football fan any sports bar becomes a favourite but this place takes the cake. If not mistaken they have 32 LCD screens showing every game possible. It is not closed up hence isn't smoky and has a nice ambiance to it. No loud music to annoy or dance floor to take up space. Just a typical hangout sports bar. If its intimate setting you are looking for their outdoor area would fit the bill.They serve up a handful of draft options (guiness, tiger & kilkenny) and all the liquor you can imagine. They make good strong cocktails as well so the ladies have something. Not all about drinks though as they have really good food to boot. Their steak sandwich, shepherd's pie, chicken wings and fish n chips are awesome. Good quality and consistently yummy.Service is attentive and prompt. Most folks I bring here will end up returning and making it their 2nd home too. There aren't many sports bars around especially one that really focuses on the theme. Must visit!

Author: Stanislaw1972
Title: Upper level of HRCs
Review: One of the four Hard Rock Cafes in Malaysia, nice venue, friendly staff, great ambience. Food - 80% as usual, but also some local dishes. Beverages - as usual. Generally speaking,good place to go.

Author: Starry-niteKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Poor staff training
Review: On 18 August 2018, we went for dinner at Morganfield's in the Midvalley MegaMall (the Midvalley branch is not listed under Tripadvisor listing above but I'm writing my review under their Pavilion KL heading here). The beer which I ordered only came AFTER I finished my main course! I had earlier asked the waiter what happened to my beer and he kept saying "it's coming, it's coming". 20 mins later, after asking him twice, I demanded to speak to the captain who finally came and said their system did not record my order because their system "sudah jammed". Beer finally came with my dessert. My dessert was a small piece of cake of sorts, but when the waiter brought it, he gave me 2 small plates and 2 small forks, with the cake all cut up!! What was his problem?? The dessert was for me, why did he cut up the tiny piece of cake for 2 persons? Boggles my mind.....never, never will we go back to this restaurant, ever.....

Author: Alfonso77Amsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Bad service from foreign waiters
Review: Been there to watch the world cup and tried ordering drinks from 1 foreign waiter however all information given by him was incorrect. After consulting him again about the mistakes, he declined the entire thing. Thanks to the Lady Manager who saved our day otherwise this would have been our last visit to this place.

Author: Muawwiz P
Title: Great authentic food
Review: Tried most of the menu on a week trip and was never disappointed with anything on the menu. Highly recommended.

Author: Tiffany T
Title: Romantic Place for Dinner
Review: Dinner at the beach and facing the sea. Food was good. Place was relaxing. Very Romantic place for dinner.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: Muid LKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Busy and slow
Review: Whilst Nando without a doubt gives you samba dance in your tummy, unfortunately the patience to wait don't lift any dancing feet. You have to prompt the waiter least an interval of 5 minutes to check on your order is being prepared. Avoid lunch time or week of pay-day by end of the month so that you get a seat. Nando staff are friendly so remember not to be shady while ordering and treat waiter with respect because they don't earn as much as we do. Yelling and throwing tantrum to waiter is not cool which often display here. If we are civilised, we should lead by example to not be higher and superior than others, after all, it's Nandos! Get extra hot because the spicy the chicken is cook, the best you get out of it. Recommend the peri chips with salsa powder sprinkle on top.

Author: limjyin
Title: Below average
Review: We came based on the good review we saw on trip advisor. The moment we arrive we were shocked by the amount of customers and it's super crowded. None if the staff will try to seat you so you have to actually stand beside the tables and watch the diners eat. Here's a thing as well, I felt so stressed when people are staring when i eat. Also we have to share our tables with others and unfortunately we shared with the loud ones. The dim sums are not impressive at all, from the outlook to the taste. None of them worth the wait. The attitude of the waitress were terrible as well, keep asking us to take the dishes that we don't want and still keep on nagging when we refused to do so. Me and my friends all agreed that we will NEVER come back to this place.
Restaurant: Ming Court Hong Kong Tim Sum

Author: Serendipity20Kuala lumpur
Title: Everything but mexican food
Review: I reckon I didn't expect to have proper mexican dinner, I was just craving for some simple mexican dishes (or at least some good tex mex).Quesadilla was horrible and enchilada tasteless, totally below my expectations. The only dish I liked was the ribs my friend had, but unfortunatelly that wasn't a mexican one.I could enjoy the beers, tough, outside by the terrace, since the location is quite nice, in a quiet street by ampang point where you cannot feel the noise of the cars

Author: Brammers68
Title: High budget prices, low budget setting
Review: After seeing such rave reviews I really am at a loss to see what the fuss is about. Perhaps it's because of the season and the fact that we couldn't have dinner on the beach, but I was disappointed with our visit.Very expensive for this area, especially the wine, bearing in mind it's duty free here.The setting is ok, but more like a decent cafÃ© than a classy restaurant. Nothing special.As a Yorkshireman I could have choked on my starter after paying RM48, unfortunately there was not enough to choke on. Two prawns and two tiny scallops. You can do better than that, surely.To be fair, both our main dishes were very nice but again, really rather expensive for what they were.Service however was good, the waiters were polite, friendly and helpful.Walked along the beach, found a cool bar called Thursday bar, had a couple of drinks and a dessert, live music, right next to the beach, wish we had eaten there.
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: awun80Hong Kong, China
Title: Local, authentic, just best in Ipoh
Review: Prefer something local? authentic? less tourist-y? Here you go, come here for Authentic Ipoh Bean Sprouts Chicken. Queue up for a table (suggest head there earlier than 6:30pm). Once seated, don't stress, the uncles won't come to take your order, instead they kept in mind which table they have to serve first, as they simply only serve chicken, bean sprouts with rice noodle, hence every table gets served the same thing, based on how many heads in your group. Other than the basic dishes, do order some sides such as chicken feet. It is not far from the tourist-y chicken shops, definitely worth the walk. Take note they don't serve rice here.
Restaurant: Restoran Cowan Street Ayam Tauge & Koitiau

Author: Drsusanf
Title: Quite nice
Review: We dined here Christmas night as a family of five, and enjoyed our meal. The service was very friendly, and the atmosphere nice. All our dishes were very much what we would expect from an Australian style Chinese restaurant , and I'm wondering if this is why the place is so popular. The dishes were nice, but probably not necessarily "authentic" Chinese such as you would find in the hawker's markets. I can see why perhaps European visitors might be attracted to this tasty but safe option of cuisine in Penang. There were also western dishes on the menu, which I noticed were popular with quite a few of the patrons tonight. Our meal of 5 mains and rice, plus entrees of samosas and salt and pepper squid, including ciders and beers for five, cost around MR 140 (roughly $50AUD), so not really that expensive unless you are comparing to the markets.All in all, certainly not a bad option when in Batu Ferringi.

Author: rafflesoSingapore
Title: Wonderful experience
Review: I and my wife ordered the steamboat style for my crab. It was accompanied by a whole set of vegetables, mushrooms, scallop, prawns, meat balls, cheese tofu, etc. My wife claims that it was the best crab she has eaten as it was fresh and sweet. We liked it in this form as we could eat it in its purest form. After the crab was cooked, the soup was wonderfully sweet and flavoured. Just makes you go ahh....The entire set was a bit too much for me and my wife and we tried our best to finish all the food.

Author: Islandgal09Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointed
Review: I have been to Geographer's many times and unfortunately was very disappointed with the service and the "live band"I have always felt that the food is good at this joint coupled with the atmosphere. Last Saturday I was there with a friend and was not happy with the service we received. We ordered food and drinks, my friend had 3 beers... one hour into our time there, the waiter came with the bill. We were surprised as we had not call for the bill and were enjoying our conversation. The comment from the waiter was its Cash on Delivery on Friday and Saturday?? Like I said we were already there an hour, it felt that they were rushing us out of the place. I called the supervisor and he repeated the same thing... By the way there were many empty tables in the room behind the glass door.The resident band was also disappointing, the singer at least. I think retirement is beckoning for him. He was off beat ,used a computer for the background music, attempted to play the keyboard and was mumbling most of the words. Boring!!We paid for the bill after the rude encounter with the wait staff and went across the road to Ringo cafe. Ringo was superb, his quality of music. He actually plays the guitar and sings!! True to the word live band! Ringo is only open on Fri & Saturday.

Author: vivienatengKuching, Malaysia
Title: celebrating a nephew's birthday
Review: It was Saturday, 20 December 2014 at 7.30 pm and the place was jam packed. We all huddled upstairs in our table. We love the old deco, they framed i think old Cap Ayam mangkuk which i think belonged to their great grandmother. They have antique gasoline lamps hanging from their ceiling. love that "lesong table candles. since it was a 100 plus building in an historic site, cant do much for the old stairs. The food was great but small portion wouldn't be enough for a group to share. just maintain the old shoplot.

Author: hsienhuitSingapore, Singapore
Title: An expensive place to chill near Jonker Street
Review: We came here for dinner after arriving as it was a familiar and comfortable brand which offered air conditioned comfort after the long ride. The menu is pretty much the same as in any Hard Rock Cafe with perhaps a few dishes which are unique to the location such as Nasi Lemak. I must admit that by Hard Rock standards, the prices are very reasonable and the service is top class with attentive waiters always on hand. They have live music after 10.30 but others along Jonker Street such as Geographers Cafe and Bistro Year 1673 do so as well. After visiting other establishments along Jonker and elsewhere, we did not come back for the rest of our trip but that has more to do with us wishing to savour the local fare than because of anything bad about the place.

Author: Kerwin T
Title: Ipoh Famous Dim Sum
Review: You need to go their at 6:00 am the Dim sum is fresh, no crowded. The price is very moderate. The parking usually is hard to get. So better travel together.

Author: horling
Title: overrated, a place for tourist but not for local
Review: nothing special on the dim sum really, maybe the building itself make you wow due to it size and food not really cheap, there are many dimsum shop at ipoh far better than this Foh San, difficult to get parking too.

Author: Best127Singapore, Singapore
Title: Not As Expected
Review: Their supposedly signature one bite Durian puff is not as addictive as expected. It didn__ deliver the kind of aroma and oozing texture instead I found it watery and the cream puff is put it bluntly totally disappointing!The Durian Chendol is just too sweet and the staffs are not welcoming at all. They are busy with their own works despite we are the first few customers to arrive. Nice ambiance unfortunately is also a hot spot for mosquitoes!

Author: DrAviliaRichmond-upon-Thames, United Kingdom
Title: Awful...
Review: Tried the salmon Caesar salad. Not really a caesar at all, no dressing. Salmon burnt. Potatoes tasted off, they had a really unpleasant smell and taste and were cold and over cooked. Wedges burnt and not tasty. Really expensive, 145MR for 1 starter, two mains and two cokes. Go to fierce curry down the road- much better and much cheaper too!

Author: mjyatesSwadlincote, United Kingdom
Title: Disappointed
Review: We went to this restaurant for a lunch time meal and was really impressed with the service, the food and the pricing.However we decided to take friends there for an evening meal and this was not as impressive.We booked and outdoor table for 4, and because we were not having the buffet, were told that we could not eat until 8.45PM.We arrived shortly before 9PM and were escorted to a table, which still had the last users food remnants all over it.We ordered the food, which included the signature dish of Lamb Hanith (shoulder), and when it arrived it all looked amazing. The food however was not hot, and the Lamb Hanith was ribs and not a shoulder. We paid and left, with me feeling embarrassed as I had raved about this places food to my friends. Apart from being being made to wait for not having the buffet and wanting the Al a Carte menu, the dirty table on arrival (even though we booked the day before) set the tone for our evening.

Author: Sue G
Title: Evening meal
Review:
Lovely setting along the river with very friendly staff. Meal was traditional and interesting. Nutmeg ice is a novel drink to try if not done so before!
Thankyou all for an enjoyable evening.

Author: Dave430Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very poor!
Review: Very disappointed on a number of levels, my tea cup was so small the tea bag was standing two thirds proud of the cup, by the time it was brewed the water was luke warm, delivering 2 mouth fulls of disappointment. The fish and chips - for some bizzare reason served with corn on the cob - was equally poor, the fish was only just cooked and the chips were dry and tasteless, probably oven chips! The staff were also far too busy reviewing paper work rather than serving customers, however if salt, pepper and sugar had been delivered with the drinks and food I would not have needed them. In conclusion, Jarod & Rawlings have nothing to fear.

Author: Passport811186
Title: Staff are not care to customer
Review:
We ordered the drink and some foods. 
But not come in about 15 minuets. And they don__ have hospitality. We are very disappointed to this restaurant.

Author: BeenConned2019
Title: xtremely xpensive.
Review: The small size rice ball priced at RM0.40 each is really truly and shockingly expensive. The chicken is also much pricer than most restaurants selling the same food. Just because its the only halal restaurant, the owner is taking advantage by selling at exorbitant price. This is clearly cheating the customers. The authorities should take action against this unscupulous seller.

Author: tsashiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Changed ownership, better environment, food can be improved further
Review: The nostalgic place is now being managed by new owners, who've managed to keep the place the same way it was before, however much cleaner and with no pungent smell of burnt meat anymore. That's a plus for environment, the service is prompt and food somewhat have seen better days before. My last visit was 5 years ago, and I remember the place was dark and damp, with uninspiring lighting. The place now looks brighter, cleaner and more appealing. For the food, perhaps they need to work on the taste area, nevertheless their portions are always big. Give it a try, you may like it.

Author: Muhammad K
Title: mixed feeling
Review: i was stayed in a hotel nearby and saw this restaurant. my first visit was ok. i ordered cheese naan bread, kashmir naan and drinks. in my opinion it was good enough. my second visit was a disaster. i ordered tom yum soup with lots of prawn. at first i guess it was quite good until i saw a small caterpillars in the soup...i told them about the caterpillar but they only gave the option of giving me new soup. hell no. the worst part is i still need to pay the soup.

Author: ScorchedSun
Title: Reasonable price
Review: Food quality: is a mamak, what can you say more?Maggie goreng, mee goreng and all the goreng standard change every time depends on who is frying.Tandoori is not bad at least the taste is consistent.The sup kambing (mutton soup) is actually quite a good deal, a hearty bowl of soup with generous servings on meat with a plate of rice is actually very filling and worth the price.Good place to be when you need a supper.

Author: BushymartinKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Cold beer and air conditioning
Review: Dropped in for a beer while walking around jonker st.Really nice room. Staff were excellent The beer was very cold and fresh, they have a good selection of beers on tap.The room was very cool thanks to good air conditioningThe menu looked great even though we didn't eat.I don't normally mention toilets but it's hard find clean public toilets in malaysia so the toilets here were very clean

Author: carsam ckuala lumpur
Title: Fresh Yong Tau Foo
Review: If you are going to Subang Airport or its vicinity or returning from a trip, do drop by this Subang Perdana which is about 10 minutes drive away from the Subang Airport. Here, in this Restoran or Coffee Shop, you can find one Yong Tau Foo Stall selling freshly made Yong Tau Foo. You can choose your own vegetables - Brinjal, Lady's Finger, Bitter Gourd, Green & Red Chillies, Fried & Soft Taufu. The spinach is exceptionally on the young variety as in Subang Village, you find alot of vegetable farms.Once you have chosen, he would add in fresh pork & fish fillings onto the vegetables & fry for you. It was so good that we went for our second order. Stall open at 12.00p.m & ends at 10.00p.m but do call as rest day is once, biweekly.

Author: pissedandunsatisfied
Title: Terrible food and service
Review: Just had dinner at secret sanctuary this evening and found a dead fly in the soup I ordered. When I brought this up with the staff and instead of apologising their mistakes, they had the audacity to say that it wasn't a fly and was just a piece of burnt garlic. They must have using some pretty special garlic complete with wings and a head in their kitchen. It is insulting that they take their paying customers as idiots. Will never return to this place ever again. Terrible.
Restaurant: The Secret Sanctuary Restaurant and Lounge

Author: sher1208Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Still tastes the same after all these years!
Review: Definitely my favourite restaurant ever. It's the ONLY restaurant in SS17, Subang Jaya that survived.... That has to mean something :) It's tasty, and it still tastes the same after so many years of operation. The staff are friendly, food is delicious, and the price is very very reasonable compared to other Japanese restaurants in the nearby neighbourhoods. Teppanyaki, Wakayama Ramen & Katsu Curry Rice (sauce is loaded with shredded beef!!) are my favourite dishes! I always recommend this place to people I know...

Author: Alex_Lim_WJ
Title: Overrated
Review: I visited this cafe due to the fact that it was on the top ten list to visit in Melaka. Staff was friendly, environment and atmosphere was good. However the food was totally overrated, normal tasting and sour coconut juice. Was pretty disappointed with the food and drink.

Author: 89stuarte
Title: Great Food
Review:
I thought this was excellent value for money with a good choice of food.

It was good to eat outdoors, particularly on this occasion as there is a great sea breeze to keep you comfortable. 

Very enjoyable.
Restaurant: Tosca Trattoria Italiana at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: CSLonna
Title: Birthday dinner
Review: Had a really good dinner here. Atmosphere is great, food is really delicious and the waiter (Jeeva) has been very attentive. He shows familiarity towards the menu and has provided great recommendations.

Author: Lachlan84Melbourne, Australia
Title: Didn't get what I asked for..
Review: Have been here in the past and enjoyed some peaking duck. Decided to try again this trip. Ordered just a half duck and some dumplings along with some filtered water. We were advised 20 min wait on our duck and waited 30 before following up. was told another 5-10 mind and waited again and then told another 4-5mins...at this point we walked out as a table of 6 seated 30 mins after us (?!) Had just been served their Peking duck. Very very poor. We left and were charged for both the (awful) "filtered" tap water and the towelettes we did not use. A disaster outing and won't be going back.

Author: trondspain
Title: Avoid. Worst burger I ever had
Review:
Burger full of hard fat bits. Unchewable.
Told staff. Still paid full price.
Never again.
If u want western food go to Pavillion.

Author: howee2019Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Bad menu signage
Review: I was working in midvalley that day n pass by this cafe so decided to give it a try. The food was just ok and nothing to shout about but i like the wild mushroom. Their service was good but he price is high as their breakfast doesn't comes with a coffee and u need to order separately. The seating space was very pack. The worst thing is their menu which is written on a black board hanging on the wall and it's difficult to see. You need to raise up your head and squeeze in to the middle of the diners and embarrassing your self because your others companion might be standing there as well browsing at the angle from 160degree up to 50degree down and because of that you might just simply pick a dish n order itand worse if you hv dhort sighted or your vision is not good than u better forget about this cafe. Will i return here again? Definitely no no unless they change their menu style. May be for a first timer will do but not for repeated customer.

Author: Kim OMelbourne
Title: A la carte menu average / Buffet breakfast excellent
Review: When dining here for dinner during our stay at the Traders hotel we opted for the a la carte menu over the buffet as we weren't overly hungry. We were disappointed with the presentation, taste and quantity of our meals. However, we were more than happy with the buffet breakfast available. Recommend to definitely eat in for the breakfast choices but perhaps find somewhere else for dinner.

Author: JoelB2424
Title: Not super impressed
Review: View of the sunset is nice! But:Drinks are expensive by Malaysian standards: 18RMY for a can of Tiger and cocktails up to 40 RMY. Food prices not much better though the food itself was OK. Music is terrible and blasting loud, even after we asked twice for it to be turned down a little bit. Staff were much more interested in playing with their phones and chatting in the corner than paying any attention to customers. Also some were very rude in their approach ("Here is bill. Pay now." - 2 minutes after delivering drinks!).Go downstairs to the Escape Beach Bar, it has exactly the same menu but is 20% cheaper for some reason. And although the music still blasts, at least it's just reggae rather than obnoxious rap music!

Author: Ivy L
Title: Disappointed
Review: This is the most disappointed Western steak I had in my life. Cool and not tasty. The first and last for dinner.

Author: Khemo FCopenhagen, Copenhagen, Denmark
Title: Worst restaurant ever, stay away its a tourist trap!
Review: I have tried countless restaurants in Kuala Lumpur and this is THE WORST RESTAURANT IN KUALA LUMPUR! A staff member with long beard kept looking weird at me from the time i stepped in, and I am Pakistani by ethnicity and found the taste of the food very unauthentic and bad - and they served me HOT mango juice! There are a lot of noise in this restaurant and I saw many homeless and weird customers who kept yelling at each other, and two of the customers got into a fight - so eating there gave me head ache and having a normal conversation is next to impossible due to all the noise. So I decided to get out of this place as quickly as possible, so I asked for the bill and got shocked: they charged me 13 ringgit for one small plate of rice with sabzi vegetables (which you can get tastier for only 5 ringgit in Indian restaurants) + 2.5 ringgit for chapatti (which costs less then 2 ringgit in Indian restaurants)+ 10 ringgit for the HOT mango juice (the same mango juice can be bought COLD from nearby Malaysian shops for less then 2 ringgit)!!!! I suspect that they highly overpriced me because I am a tourist. When I finally managed to get out from this terrible restaurant I began vomiting. So take my advice: Avoid this place and please go for an south-Indian restaurant instead.

Author: carolinafzsdKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not special
Review: I've read many reviews and I was pretty excited to come here. We ordered a bruschetta as starter and it was a lazy piece of bread with a thick slice of tomato on top. I ordered a oil and garlic spaghetti, which had a spicy warning in the menu. Ok, it was supposed to be spicy but it had so much chilli that I could not taste the garlic. Anyways, it is a pleasant place but not a fantastic Italian restaurant.

Author: DayanaIzyan
Title: Sunday outing @ TheTaste Project Cafe
Review: It was my first visit to TP on last Sunday afternoon..=)My family was having an awesome brunch at the Taste Project cafÃ©. The ambience of the cafÃ© was suitable for those who have kids like me and the food was superb. Thumbs up for the Spicy Buttermilk Pasta, a must try one! Other menus like Mushroom soup, Bacon Carbonara, Crispy Chicken Chop and Capsicum Rice with Stew Chicken were delicious too, with good portion and reasonable price. Surely will come again..

Author: FizahRomanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Over price and food just average
Review: We went dinner here for first time, first of all my experience at this bar just pretty average, music was loud, during that time almost was dinner time,I did ordered fish & chips, and the price was RM28.00, with 2 fillet fish, 1 brocoli, carrot and bit of fries, I don__ see the value for this price, it should be RM18.00 reasonable.Which is not, some more my order came with hair on it, I was returned my food and denied to pay and their ok with that, my partner ordered pizza, but his lucky his food quiet nice.Overall, expensive! Cleanliness

Author: TamuSgSingapore, Singapore
Title: Over Priced
Review: Looks like they have a supplement menu for foreigners. The price of the steaks are marked out with a sharpie on the main menu, then they bring you a separate price list. I suspect it's different for different guests. 300rm for a steak ! It would not be this much in the Mandarin Oriental in Singapore's marina bay!! What planet are you living on. We will warn all our fellow ex pats in the area! Good luck !

Author: Arne JRoskilde, Denmark
Title: Worst food and service in Damai.
Review: We have tried more or less every place in Damai. When we went to escobar we ordre pizza and burger. The burger was under medium standard and the kitchen dropped the pizza on the ground. And the vetriest told that had to wait 30 minuts more for a new pizza. On top of that the food was not served at the same time to begin with. We cannot not recommend escobar.

Author: ethan m
Title: like a trusted old friend..
Review: the food at this original outlet is still the best, but like an old friend, the service is sometimes too slack!

Author: H0ngTKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Cheated
Review: I generally do not give bad reviews but I feel this time I have to. If you are going to just go and buy a chicken rice then it's o and it's pretty tasty BUT.. if you are going to buy a whole chicken or half a chicken, you MUST watch them. They have their chicken disassembled meaning they have separated out the drumsticks, the wings, the breast portion. So, if you go and order either half or a whole chicken, they DO NOT actually give you the actual half a chicken or whole chicken. I made a mistake today because I was on my phone and when I got back home, I was shocked, there was NO drumstick or thigh meat. They have me the breast meat, a wing and a few pieces of meat from the rib portion. I was charged RM23. I felt cheated ! So, please be careful the next time you are there..

Author: KR_EDINBURGH
Title: Traditional chinese cuisine
Review: Nothing to fault it really, no surprises, just good quality chinese dishes.

Author: chungbpeng
Title: Not as good as what is used to be
Review: The quality of the cendol is no where near what it was when the owner of the restaurant was selling from a three wheel motor cycle. The restaurant surrounding is not conducive at all.

Author: fridaynic99
Title: Dim sum lunch
Review: Disappointing food. Dim-sum comes in with weird tase, was told that it May not cooked or heat up long enough.  Not authentic. Tea is as pale as water, taste-less. Disappointing with their dim sum but their normal food was quite ok.

Author: DiscerningDoyenneMelbourne, Australia
Title: Beaut beer and fab fries
Review: The Guinness was served nice and cold, the fries were hot and delivered soon after ordering, the atmosphere was great _ we sat at a street-level table overlooking the Malacca river which added to the ambiance _ and the service was friendly and efficient. The prices weren't bad either and the toilets were clean (at least the ladies were - the men's remain unchartered by this female reviewer). With easy access from Dutch Square and Jonker Street, this was a great place to relax at the end of the day having pounded the pavement all over Malacca. Highly recommended.

Author: heidi1982Birmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Chicken & mushroom risotto = food poisoning
Review: I have previously been to this restaurant on more than one occasion. Every other time the food has been ok, however the service is always lacking.This time however, both my dad and myself got chronic food poisoning from the chicken and mushroom risotto. We both had the same dish and we were both severely ill. Mine was made worst as I was flying back to the UK the next day.I certainly will not be returning and neither will my dad who lives in KL.

Author: smothie_lover
Title: The worst
Review: I believe thats the worst place to eat in entire city.The food is dry and no taste at all. Have never experienced such awful service. Al-Amar in Pavilion is defenitely last in the list of visit. waste of money/

Author: devikar_13
Title: Average!
Review: We had buffet dinner.. spread was limited.. taste was fine.. Guest approach could be improvised.. Nice ambience though..

Author: RachaelL787
Title: Awful service
Review: The service here is awful! Waited over 20 minutes for garlic bread which we requested to come out with the meal and then a further 45 minutes for our main course. We also had to ask four times for water and waited around 15 minutes for that. There seems to be no system and the waiters don't know what they're doing, with food being taken to wrong tables and some members of the table being served and not others. Would not recommend.

Author: trippingJBJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Not at all impressed
Review: Someone told us about this place and after checking the reviews here I decided to give it a go. We were terribly disappointed. First I was told it was a nyonya restaurant but the menu was a hodge podge of various cuisines. Even then their nyonya dishes were not very authentic. Secondly the staff was not very helpful and could not answer even basic questions. He was not at all friendly and had a couldn't care less attitude. Honestly there are better places to go for better food, better ambience and better service. I would not recommend this place to my friends.

Author: babyborrego
Title: Worst
Review: The food is the worst! Tasteless. The service is okay, but I can__ believe I paid for the worst food. Don__ recomend at all.

Author: Asma B
Title: Disappointed
Review: I didn't like it at all except the service and staff working there who were kind. Not like expected at all

Author: World_Traveller_838Melbourne, Australia
Title: Bak Kut Teh
Review: My wife and I had brunch here, with a few friends. This restaurant is very popular and very busy all the time. Klang is famous for Bak Kut Teh, which is a type of Hokkien food, using special spices for the broth.Food here is tasty. Service is awful. Hygiene is questionable, but the food is well cooked and boiled.
Restaurant: Restoran Seng Huat Bak Kut Teh

Author: Eric TKuala Lumpur
Title: 2nd visit was just as disappointing as the last visit
Review: We decided again to give Sushi Zanmai another chance - since we live just down the road.I ordered the sashimi salad - and it came out 25 minutes later, and I swear I could count the number of small sliced pieces of fish in the dish. There was so little raw fish, it was ridiculous.The Myanmar waiters offered very very bad service.Heavily disappointing meal.I would never come back again.And I warn all other guests - think twicw (then stop, and think once more) befoe you decide to eat here.

Author: Expedition714581
Title: Family diner
Review: Waitereses is not so friendly, food is not so tasty as expected,my sea food pasta was really less quantity of the sea food only pasta,my sweetmellon juice was absolutely taste less i ask them to change it, they did it but they charge me double, when I ask why is that, manager start to argue with me keep interrupting and telling that I suppose to ad sugar in it, but the mane idea of the juice is to be fresh and healthy I guess he is not aware of this. So guys think twice before deciding to visit this place.

Author: AcuraMelody
Title: Disappointed
Review: I have been to Melaka for few times & heard good review about Nancy kitchen hence we decided to try! We order paitee, asam fillet fish, braised pork & also cincaluk egg. Their paitee is awesome taste good. The fish is not fresh & you can know it was taken from freezer where is soft. The egg is salty & the braided pork is cold when they serve. I will not return to the restaurant

Author: danny87ngu
Title: Din Tai Fung is Much Better Than Dragon-i
Review: The service poor. The food sucks and the portion very small. Never liked this restaurant and will never like it.

Author: Heyyitsreb
Title: Chynna restaurant
Review: Emiley was such a nice waitress!! Good service and really friendly! Food was really really good and we loved it!!

Author: thefoodwizardKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Hearty fuss-free Mexican food
Review: A rare trip to Subang Taipan for some banking chores randomly brought us to this charming Mexican restaurant. The interior was a little kitschy but it felt cozy and inviting, with sufficient Mexican accents to keep it in theme. Charming!If I had to sum up the meal, it was hearty and tasty. The ingredients may not be as refined and authentic as La Mexicana but at a price range with most dishes well under RM30, it's more than decent.The mussels were a great start; the thick, creamy broth with fresh cilantro and habanero doubled equally good as a soup. I liked the thoughtfulness of the folded tortillas; perfect for soaking up the bowl of deliciousness. If they had been toasted slightly, even better.The seared marks on the charbroiled sole was a good indication of the rustic smokey flavours that followed. The fish retained its succulence and the flavours were light, yet rich. I am still contemplating if the baked potato was really necessary.Chili con corne was next, it was hard to resist checking out this classic Tex-Mex dish. It passed with flying colours. Old school yumminess. Love the fluffiness of the rice and the meaty chilli stew was lip-smacking. A personal preference - a bit more heat would have been perfect.Overall, the food is good enough to warrant a repeat visit. Las Carretas is a little gem in an unassuming location with lots of Mexican pleasures at reasonable prices.

Author: nami8319
Title: Dinner
Review: Salmon trout was good and the apple tart was scrumptious. The croissant is huge and soft. Chilled ambience

Author: Sara WWageningen, The Netherlands
Title: Okay food, horrible service
Review: It took a long time before we could order. It was quiet when we were there and the waiters did not feel like working. When the grumpy waiter arrived with our food he did not say anything, he just put the plates on our table and left.Food tasted okay, but the mango lassie was very watery because of all the ice. Compared to The previous food I had eaten in KL this was below average.

Author: Anna S
Title: Waited over 2 hours for my food - half of the order never arrived
Review: I booked on a Friday night, they said they didn't have a table for me but could seat me at the bar. OK. I ordered a bar snack, a main course and a side dish, and proceeded to wait for 2 hours for the food. After about an hour and a half I asked where it was, and was told that there was a problem with the kitchen and they didn't know when it was coming. The waiters then proceeded to ignore me as best they could. There was a woman next to me who walked in 1.5 hours after me and her food arrived straight away which was a bit irritating by that point as I was starving. I was on the verge of leaving when the bar snack finally arrived, however the side orders never materialised. I was so hungry I wolfed it down and then waited a while longer for my main course as it was 10pm and I didn't know where else I could get food at that point. When I asked for the bill I asked for something to be taken off it seeing as I had to wait so long. They didn't really want to and offered me free drinks (which I didn't want.) They reluctantly ended up taking the bar snack off the bill which was not very much considering I left there still hungry and annoyed from only having received half of my order and having wasted 2 hours of my Friday night waiting for half of my dinner.

Author: Adriano8000
Title: Good food but inconsistent service
Review: My family and I enjoyed dining there the previous time where food and service were good. However last night when we went back, all of a sudden most tables were placed with the reserved tag expect for those occupied. It was us 2 (adults) and a infant, the waiter refused to sit us somewhere more comfortable but insisted that we sat at the 2 sitter located at the corner next to the kitchen. I would have to say despite seeing all the empty places (about 60% full) he still put us there. After being squeezed in somewhere so claustrophobic we decided to leave.

Author: JoyCheong
Title: Dinner at Orinea
Review: It was an enjoyable and delicious dinner. Music was relaxing and Akie took time to explain what we were eating which was very helpful. Foie gras and striploin were the highlights for me.

Author: Johntan22
Title: Birthday Dinner
Review: First time come here dinner, food are very tasty. Super good service especially thanks to Mr Johnny for a very nice presentation and We will visit again.

Author: Shinny95
Title: Expensive Nasi Lemak
Review: First time I come is for lunch. Nasi lemak here is RM9... Too expensive for me... But Fried Chicken for nasi lemak is big.... So... Oklah...

Author: John S
Title: Lots of whisky & steaks
Review: Strange Caesar Salad...skip it.  Steaks are good. Served with a selection of salts & mustards.  Food prices are a little high

Author: TheJoinersUKSouthampton, United Kingdom
Title: Pizza Hut is a bit closer, go there .....
Review: What a strange set up. You arrive and it__ literally a shack on the side of the road where you can eat outside, next to the road or inside this very strange nightclub type place blaring out horrible Euro pop. Asking for a menu, this one man band points at five pizzas listed on the board. I chose Margherita, you can__ go wrong with that surely and my wife chose pepperoni. They arrived quite quickly, the topping on mine was lacking anything but garlic. Very little of anything else. The plus point was the base. It was so thin it wasn__ a pizza base. My wife__ was very dry and very salty. Drinking a whole bottle of water with it. If this is the best pizza I__ dread to think what the worst is. Give it a miss or wait til you go somewhere that knows Pizza

Author: MayleneKKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best Italian restaurant in JB
Review: We liked the comfortable surroundings on a recent special occasion. Our shared starter was burrata and bresaola, a great recommendation by the chef, with bread and dips, made in-house. It was light and flavourful, an ideal beginning.We had a veal chop from the specials board, a seafood pizza, a whole roast seabass and a porcini risotto for our main courses. The cooking was perfect, risotto and veal were timed well, and the ingredients were high in quality. We enjoyed each dish down to the last mouthful. For dessert, we had stracciatella gelato, tiramisu AND tiramisu gelato. For me, the stracciatella was a clear winner. I'd happily come again just for the dessert.Throughout the evening, the staff were very attentive, yet allowed us to dine at our leisure, and in private. They made sure our wine and water glasses weren't left empty.Dining is not only about food. Tosca excels in its outstanding service and welcoming atmosphere, as well as delicious Italian dishes. This is our favourite in JB by far.
Restaurant: Tosca Trattoria Italiana at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: MLI_MLI
Title: Average Restaurant
Review: Tried the duck, homemade tofu and soup. Average as we have tried better ones at KSL at the same price. Noodles and rice can be ordered separately.

Author: Angel House UUbud, Indonesia
Title: From Bali - KL for the duck ;)
Review: Travelled from Bali to KL, just for the duck and pork at this fab place. Also had the most divine eggplant. And...the fried rice was just as it should be; flavoursome and not oily. Good serving sizes and price was good also. 5* from me and thank you Mr Kevin front of house, great service :)

Author: zinit2015Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Slow in service and many times reminder
Review: We asked for order and it took them at least 15 mins to attend to us, passing on from one waitress to another. We ordered the housewine and it did not come until we ask again.... Food is slow to serve, the restaurant is not even full house....

Author: shish57Shaldon, United Kingdom
Title: Avoid like the plague
Review: Waited an hour for someone to give us a menu. Nothing couldn't even catch anyone's eye to get bill for two beers we had. Even though we booked there was great reluctance to seat us and then we were put by a tank of dirty half dead fish and next to the loos and elevators. It was foul. Like some greasy spoon cafe.
