We finally walked out lfeeling very embarassed eaving the equivalent of 10 pounds sterling which was far too much but covered our backs. Many 'locals' came in and were served after us. Can only assume we were the victims of racism (my first time and very uncomfortable it was too) as we were white caucasian and not Asian. DO NOT UNDER ANY CIRCUMSTANCES GO THERE. it appears in tourist reviews and on maps and we were recommended it by our tourist guide - it was an awful experience and we were so happy to return to our lovely Shangri La Hotel.

Author: Jcfl09
Title: Value for money
Review: Patronized this place for both dinner and lunch. Food spread is quite extensive and worth the price you pay. Great and attentive service. However its not recommended for repeated visits as the menu remains the same.

Author: arvinzz
Title: Expensive and overly priced
Review: An empty Koew teow soup is RM5. It's a normal steamed chicken but price is ridiculously stated. Tourist hyped place. The only thing, asam boi drink is nice..

Author: patrick074Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Worst high end japanese restaurant in kl
Review: My recent visit to the branch in pavilion was referred. The quality of food served is comparable to any japanese restaurant that fetching 1/5 of kampachi price. For a plate of shashimi worth close to RM300, no tuna belly was included n only common fishes. The salmon shahimi was from fish farming and not wild salmon, at this price! Total rip off and to me is close to cheating. Will never sat foot again

Author: klfoodloverkuala lumpur
Title: the most authentic northern indian food
Review: One of the best if not THE BEST Tandoori food I have eaten. The tandoori chicken is so succulent and the best thing about it is, there are no artificial coloring and the meat is so tender. The palak paneer is the most unique dish I've tasted! Must recommend this dish to all! The owner himself is a testament to what good food is all about!! Service could be a bit slow but believe me, it is well worth the wait!!

Author: rahul91Pune, India
Title: Loved the place & live Band
Review: Fantastic place. The live Band on 25th Dec was simply awesome. the place is open till 2 am in the morning . Has the usual good collection of food and drinks as any other HRC. Conveniently located in the concorde hotel in KL city center. Service was a bit slow though. Has a lot of seating options. Overall a must visit if you want to have good time

Author: ChrisT7153
Title: Dinner
Review: The restaurant is situated centrally, the staffs were well trained and friendly. Food was great and real value for money. However most of the seating tables does not have a good view.

Author: Butterflyz6491Seria, Brunei Darussalam
Title: Good! good!
Review: The Tom yam is amazingggggggggg! Of all the place i went to have steamboat this is the only place that their tom yam really taste good..they serve alcohol drinks just that im dissapointed with one thing they should have serve alcohol cocktails drinks..other than that its s recommended place

Author: Rgw18762019
Title: Enjoyed until forced to review with staff member leaning over our shoulder
Review: Went for dinner last night. Enjoyed the shisha and the cocktails were nice enough. Ordered food, food was good and enjoyed the atmosphere after they opened the roof and we ate in the shadow of the twin towers. However a staff member asked us to review our time there, which we were happy to do and told him that, he then proceeded to ask for our phones and when we refused he insisted on looking over my girlfriends shoulder while she wrote a review. It is one of the most awkward situations we have been in and found it completely unacceptable! Mihad the staff member may have taken this upon himself however if this is policy it cast doubt on the previous reviews if they have been gained in the same manner!

Author: Tiwari2509Singapore, Singapore
Title: "So-so"
Review: Visited here in Middle June 2010. Ordered some Asam Pedas, Ayam Buah Keluak & a few more dishes. We expected them to be spicy, as what is was supposed to be for Nyonya Cuisine's dishes. Food turned out to be just "so-so". Other restaurants in Taman Melaka Raya would probably be better.

Author: temogaguaOdessa, Ukraine
Title: Terrible
Review: Terrible. Very terrible_ and very dossapointed. First of all waited around 30 minutes and only after they told that food is not available, finished already. Then finally they brought Tom Yam and chicken meet...It tasted liked gabage, guess it was old meet and not well cooked. Never will visit this place again. Very angry

Author: plumstones1997Metro Manila, Philippines
Title: Disappointing
Review: The food was excellent but they ran out within 45 minutes of opening. The service was abominable. Getting water required 3 waiters and ultimately intervention from the manager. The bill was wrong and correcting it required another 30 minutes. Likely will not go back and would be hard pressed to recommend it to anyone.

Author: fridrichhVasteras, Sweden
Title: May the time be with you
Review: You need time for this one... if you are unlucky it takes almost 30 min for a lunch appetizer.... and an excuse i line with __ am sorry_, nothing else....Well I have not had much luck... but the taste is good so I sometimes come back. Service rating 2....food taste rating 4... but as I like service overall rating is 2.

Author: chelseastormborn
Title: Great company with Great Service!
Review: Good service with chilling ambience. Good news is that they opened until 11:30pm especially when you want to beat the car park congestion. Nice coffee and desserts as well.

Author: Afny90
Title: Nice place for seaaafoooddd lovers
Review: The food is good, the otak2 soooo delicious, price is affordable... i enjoy my dinner here... eventhough it's quite hard to find a car parking however its worth the wait.. no wonder there are so many people here..

Author: carynjen13Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice Ambiance, Food So So & Price is over on the Pricey side
Review: Cafe was quite empty, about 3 tables. I walked in, seated myself towards the left side of the restaurant. Seeing that I walked in and seated myself, the natural thing to do would be to get me a menu but no I still had to wave my hands to get it and not many waiters/waitress come to the left side so it took a while before I managed to get one's attention. Didn't wait long for the food.Squid taste is so so, the spicy sauce that came with it is nice.Claypot tofu was too big for one person, taste wise it's okay nothing to shout about. I've had better Chinese food elsewhere.When it's time to get the bill, again I had problem getting their attention. Nobody comes to this side or even bother to look to see if us customers need anything.Okay for a quick stop place to have lunch but not a place that you will patron frequently.

Author: 809vivienv
Title: Appetizing
Review: Yummy vegetarian food in a peaceful ambience. Happy to be able to eat oyster omelette without the oysters

Author: Paradise32800111488
Title: Great food & ambience
Review: The food was delicious and our server (Arif) was very attentive to our needs. This is the 2nd time I__e been here and it__ consistently good. Highly recommend the Foie Grais.

Author: imthejessicatKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fun chillaxing night!
Review: Went there with a colleague on a Sunday, so it was pretty quiet in terms of crowd. Music was awesome - the live band played some epic rock songs from the past and present. When the band was off, they played pop-rock songs.Lovely decor; strong DNA of the Hard Rock Cafe chain. Smoking area with high chairs and tables available. Two glasses of wine and two pints of Carlsberg: RM144

Author: Keith MSingapore, Singapore
Title: Musty smell, dirty tables and average food
Review: I was surprised given the relatively high ranking it has on trip advisor. We were staying in the hotel and thought we'd give it a try. If it's raining outside and you fancy listening to some music and having a beer and a burger then this place is probably ok. Not the place to sit down for a nice meal. Musty smell from old cigar smoke greets you on entering. Crumbs and a hair on the table when we sat down. Salt grinder that was clogged with old salt. I had the fish and chips.... Stingy portion of fries and the fish was greasy. From the bland tasteSuspect the fish was frozen

Author: Winston LPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Rather average joint
Review: Went there in December 2015 after learning of its good rating on Trip Advisor. Ordered the Lazy Bone pasta and roast pork. Unfortunately, the pasta contained pieces of bone. The roast pork was pretty average; some parts were slightly burnt. I find the food prices on the high side given the quality served. I might consider returning if the food quality is improved.

Author: John RCowbridge
Title: City centre Thai food
Review: There are two branches of this chain of reataurants in Kuching; the one I went to is quite close to the river and the large hotels, on Bukit Mata which is off Jalan Padungan. The food is well cooked and certainly not as spicy as might have been expected. Service was quick, although as the staff are dressed in 'civvies' it was hard to know who to beckon for help or to order another beer. Strangely they do not have Thai Beer (Singha), but a fair range of other brews. Prices were moderate fore the food, a little dear for drinks.

Author: EuwinKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: NOT WORTH IT
Review: You only pay purely for the animation, the food were terrible and not worth for the money that you paid. The prawn served was as big as my "pinky finger" which I think was a totally rip off. But the service staffs were excellent and friendly.

Author: R2246PUmichaelfSingapore, Singapore
Title: The manhattan fish market in terbau city is thr worst place i been
Review: When to this place the serve was poor... then no food arrived its was 45 minit plus the manager don't give a damn attitude. I would not recommend anyone to go. If all the Manhattan fish market was like this I suggest just close the damn restaurant and don't open again.

Author: Julianackl
Title: Birthday Celebration
Review: Had a great and awesome birthday lunch at Favola with my family. Thank you Chef Domenico for the delicious food. And big thanks to Mr. Reuben, Ms. Christy, Anela, Aen and the team for their friendly and enthusiastic services. They are full of warmth and always ready to help. They also have prepared birthday cake for me which was really touched and heart warming! Overall, Favola is the best Italian restaurant that I have tried before. I highly recommend it and I__ love to come visit again!

Author: Cathy1080
Title: For anyone who likes to eat after 9pm.
Review: This place was still opened and teeming even after 10pm when we took my late visitors out.This place is for anyone who like to have late supper..everything is there,sate ,fried noodles ,chicken wings

Author: nthooiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Bad service, horrible food, overpriced drinks
Review: Spent RM 140 for two pancakes dishes with bacon and 4 coffees.Pancakes were dry and cold by the time it came to us. I asked for maple syrup when ordering, they missed it and I had to ask again when the food was served. 5 mins later, out came a tiny little saucer of it. I asked for more, another 5 mins wait for a tiny ass saucer.Waiters loiter around being non responsive and when we ask for the bill, another 10 mins wait. Waiter prints the bill, stops to talk to his friend before passing the bill to table.Not worth the visit.

Title: Still one of the best in town...
Review: I was hunting for good wanton noodles around Klang Valley when it suddenly hit me to try this place again. Turns out that it didn't let me down. For those who are not familiar with what wanton noodles is, "wanton" is a Cantonese word for small pork dumplings. Wanton noodles are small pork dumplings cooked with noodles and barbequed pork and vegetables. The noodles can either be mixed with soy sauce or in soup. Recommended food: Wanton noodle and "sui kow" (bigger pork dumplings). Give it a try!

Author: Albert K
Title: Convenient food court near hotel
Review: Typical Malaysian food court with some good food. BBQ chicken wings, curry fish head, come to mind. This visit, the BBQ chili fish store was closed so cannot comment. Prices are reasonable and place is quite clean with no noxious smells nearby.

Author: Chris MSeoul, South Korea
Title: Classy and Friendly! Fantastic!
Review: I was travelling KL alone, and came here for scotch. My waiter was Ariff, and man was he great! He knew every whiskey, brought me free samples, gave me many recommendations, gave me a tour of their 500+ different whiskies, and showed me a demonstration of how they make the distinct ice ball. Waiters will give you their FULL attention if you want it, and will give you space to enjoy things at your own pace. The prices are fair, and the selection is unbeatable - including rare and old spirits. The comfortable leather chairs make it easy to stay for hours. There is a cigar menu, too.Ask for Ariff! He is like a personal concierge on your scotch/whiskey tasting experience. For about $50 USD, you can drink and drink and drink. For $25, you can still have a good time.

Author: wwwt56Victoria, Australia
Title: One of limited choice in this hotel
Review: Choices are buffet or very ordinary a la carte? Not much here to tempt - but very few options for dinner within this hotel.

Author: billionnairebabePadang Rengas, Malaysia
Title: Paying Through Your Nose For Something That Came Out Of Your Nose
Review: If you want to pay a lot for bad Middle Eastern food, this is definitely where you should go.We ordered the fries, but it never came.The hummus and olive oil was stale & runny and came with a thick Arabic Sesame Naan Bread that tasted stale and old without any sesame flavour.The lamb kebab sandwich was too small and the lamb tasted like cheap, frozen, satay flavoured meat and the whole sandwich tasted like a MYR 2.00 kebab you get in the Night Markets. Didn__ taste Middle Eastern or like a lamb kebab at all. The sauces were out of a cheap bottle.The mint tea was the only thing that was okay.They didn__ give us any ice with the water, although it was mentioned during the order, and we had to ask again.The total bill was 45.45 but we received food for the quality of RM 10.00.Rip off.

Author: MuralZ
Title: Love the Pavilion area. Good Spanish food place
Review:
Good place for some Spanish tapas and paella. 

Sunday's they have a paella special ..Good paella for a great price..

Friendly staffs.. Will come again..

Author: ugob634
Title: Italian fast food style
Review: The restaurant is located in a food court. The menu is nice, lot of tipical Italian local dishes, but same grammar mistakes also: it wasnt written by an Italian chef. I had a salad with mozzarella di bufala. I am almost sure The mozzarella wasnt bufala, but it was ok. Then I had pizza margherita. Nothing special, a bit mushy, and the cheese a bit tick. I found it hard to digest. It wasnt cooked in a wooden fire oven: look around for much better pizza in KL!

Author: IsaacGoh90Ipoh, Malaysia
Title: It's On The Dime!
Review: We were brought to this place by a friend of mine who is a big fan of it. She invoked the idea of giving this bar a try after the morning exercise, and we never say NO to good food, ended up we had our very later brunch over here.This place was dimly lit, soft music was played, furnished with the red couches and murals of those legendary pop stars, like Micheal Jackson, Beatles, etc. providing a really perfect, comfortable and splendid environment for not only dining purpose, but also best spot to hang out after a hectic day, to spend time with pals and to have some pints of beer.We gave it a go for few main courses found in the menu. If it happens that you're being indecisive in making a choice, do ask the waiters, they are so ready to help, will give you the best recommendation based on your favor. It's well known of its pork-based dishes, I didn't order it though, ordered for myself a course of All Day Breakfast instead. The food was way heavenly good, super delicious, and they were so generous in giving to their customers very large portion of food. It's advisable to share if you are not able to eat much.

Author: David Ignatius LMelaka, Malaysia
Title: First and Only Visit
Review: Brought my party of 20 friends to Palazzo for dinner during Chinese New Year last week as the other eateries in town were either fully occupied or closed for the festive week. It was everyone__ first trip to Palazzo and were all in high hopes of having a nice dinner in all it's glitter. However, lo and behold, the food was not up to expectation at all. We had a variety of dishes among my party and all of them were not one would expect of a fine dining restaurant. The food was bland, some salty, some not fully cooked and the portion was rather inadequate which in turn made them slightly overpriced. The only consolation was the premises was quite well designed and decorated. Sadly, my party and I made an agreement never to visit Palazzo anymore in the future.

Author: jeaniecylPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: NOT a pleasant experience
Review: Space is very tight and cramped. Tables are small, walking space is narrow. Although it is supposedly a non-smoking establishment, they allowed customers to smoke inside. Staff were indifferent when we pointed this out to them. Within such an enclosed and cramped area, this was torture for me and my non smoking friends. Non alcoholic drinks : NBT Special ice coffee was watered down and diluted. You're better off getting a hot tea, and that's only if you can find an attentive waiter to refill your cup with hot water. Cover charge ranges between RM 42 to RM 53 per person, and does not include any drink. The performance was average. Overall it was NOT a pleasant experience.

Author: Larry0078
Title: Best place
Review: Amazing moment I had at canopy..they are following sop strongly. Service is good definitely.. you can see klcc view from canopy too.

Author: OgierChrisLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Coffee kind of guy
Review: There is a friendly little greasy spoon cafe, tucked away in the corner on the ground floor of Holiday Place Hotle.I'm a English man who misses a good sausage and a nice cuppa in the morning, so when I stumbled across this little diamond it made my trip to Malasya that bit more enjoyable.Great food & friendly staff.

Author: Ivy C
Title: Above average
Review: Ippudo Hakata used to be my favourite ramen restaurant, however the occurrence of Bankara Ramen makes me hesitance. Ippudo Hakata's soup is definitely better, but beside of the soup, Bankara Ramen overwhelms them in everything. Both of them are definitely not the best ramen in the world nor in KL. I was hoping that Bankara Ramen would give me a sense of wow, but it didn't. It makes me kind of disappointed though. Or maybe it's because I've higher expectation towards it, and it makes me sad now. *The tofu pudding is good. =)

Author: Kerry SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great Place for a Drink or to Dine
Review: We love it here whenever we are at KLCC. The view of the fountain in an air-cond place, plus a drink and a bite - at reasonable prices, is just what your soul prescribed. Service is good, not perfect; and the food is generally acceptable by the young and old. Nachos are quite good portions, but I do complain about the standard pouring drink. Could be a little more generous. Otherwise, a good place to be in.

Author: yimin516Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overrated
Review: Tried Hainanese Chicken Chop and 4in1 Chicken with my friends, but they turned out badly.The chicken is not handled well, so it's kind of smelly and we couldn't finished the meal.Absolutely not what we expected, and I ended with supper at Petaling Street, it's even more satisfying than my dinner at this restaurant.Surprise to see many (look) happy customers, perhaps others of their dishes are not bad? But definitely a big NO for the 2 dishes mentioned above.

Author: dawn oShanghai, China
Title: Appalling service
Review: I wish I could review the food but the staff spent so long walking back and forth in front of us while studiously ignoring us that, when they did eventually deign to seat us, the additional ten minutes of absolutely no service was sufficient encouragement for us to leave without eating.

Author: CarolGerryBournemouth, United Kingdom
Title: Atmoshpheric !!!
Review: The "fairy light," Bohemian, open air atmosphere, attracted me! Huge menu offering great exciting traditional food!, with the added, " I wander what that's like", type of cuisine!! Go on try it !! Should it rain, the the ambiance is preserved with an electric closing canopy. For the vast size of this venue , the service was spot on.!! Don't be frightened to ask for advice, the waitresses are only to glad to advise. Oh, and just wait for the TEA LADY to pop up!!! Superb meal, with good company, under the stars!!! Brill !!

Author: ExpatKL88Western Ireland, Ireland
Title: Limited Menu Choice - Poor Service
Review: Waiter struggled to understand us, one of our group was veggie & choice for her very limited but eventually got them to agree to make a veggie rissotto...made our selections then told some not available as kitchen had run out! Back to perusing the menu and eventual final selection was made...food quite good when it arrived although sliced lamb for me was mediocre, meat was bland and minimal veg to accompany the dish.No chance to order dessert or coffee - we were presented with the bill without warning and it was apparent that they wished to close the restaurant and we were no longer welcome!Not the best dining experience and will not be returning!

Author: pilch_999Auckland, New Zealand
Title: Beautiful location - just don't have the Tapas
Review: We saved the restaurant for our last night and I wish I'd read a few reviews first! The service was great, the location beautiful but the Tapas a REAL let-down! My husband ordered from the specials menu and his meal was good, but not amazing. The Tapas were POOR. The fish was dry and it all tasted like it had been re-heated. Try 'Sagar' near the Franjipani Resort for the best Indian food on the Island!
Restaurant: La Sal at Casa Del Mar

Author: TommyMell
Title: The banana leaves rice is way below expectation. Charges for vege top up and serve in metal plate???????
Review: Very dissapointed with my visit. Have been loyal customer for many years, and today I found out they have change their banana rice serving "policy"...... no vege top up!!!!!! First time I ever heard!!! Have to charge extra for simple vege top up, and serve in metal plate....... paying at premium banana rice ....Totally dissapointed, as a loyal customer, they have lost another customer.

Author: GranTheKiwiBirdInsch, United Kingdom
Title: Poor service
Review: Went for a late night stroll and decided to stop at the Hard Rock Cafe for a late dinner. Checked with the Maitre D that they were still serving meals at 10pm and he confirmed they were and led us to a table in the middle of a very large room. We sat there for 15 minutes waiting for someone to attend to us but all they did was walk past us so we up and left. When asked why we were leaving at the door, we told them but the Manager couldn't have cared less and there was no apology. We were loath to go there in the first place, think battery hen mentality, and this only served to affirm my earlier views. Shame because I really like American cuisine.

Author: Bryan H
Title: Disappointment
Review: The beef carpacio is good but unfortunately steak was done medium well (while I requested medium rare). Waitress told me it was last piece of beef (was lunch time and I was the only one in restaurant) and forced me to take it. To pay such a price for a meal to get such service is disappointing. Not gonna go anymore.

Author: A7043FLdavidf
Title: Decent food and service
Review: One of the better options in the area. Good food (we had Malaysian) and good service - worth a visit of staying nearby....

Author: remusang
Title: Educational tour Mamee
Review: Visited in 30Dec. Nice education tour for young kid to learn to make Mamee noodles and understanding process of making noodles. Free goodie bags. Highly recommended. Young Kid will love it . :) Go 4 it.

Author: 408yukaa
Title: Good seafood restaurant
Review: I had Butter fried prawn (S) 20 RM, Baby kailan (S) 10 RM and Tiger Beer 5 RM. It's great and staff were good. All dishes looked good :) They open at around 18:00.

Author: shirshirr
Title: Reasonable price
Review: Good place for having a lunch. Food is so tasty, staff is so friendly. The environment of the place also good, with outside for smoking zone. Drink too much ice, need to fix this. Overall this restaurant is good.

Author: CdikoKoConroe, Texas
Title: Not as expected
Review: We came to enjoy the dinner as we thought of Fogo de Chao in Atlanta. The food is great but the service is very poor. Although we made reservations and arrive on time we found that our table was taken! The staff arranged to make a table near the loud speakers. The restaurant hosted a quiz night event and it was very loud and unpleasant. We complained and complained along with other French and English couples with kids. Good copy but no really similar to Fogo de Chao.

Author: Sharmeel KKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nothing to shout about !
Review: We went to have dinner at this restaurant based on reviews....got there & there was hardly any crowd...tried their food, apart from the Kapitan Curry & the fried chicken, nothing great about their food, taste wise average. Would I come back again, probably not as Penang has far more better restaurants than Boatman....

Author: Noibirrr
Title: Fantastic ambient lovely Japanese food
Review: Food was superb, excellent service, couldn__ recommend enough! Sashimi very fresh, just like having it in Japan

Author: Joanna WSingapore, Singapore
Title: Different treatment and the food used to be good
Review: Been to this restaurant many times, used to be my fav stop between KL and Singapore. It is always very crowded when I visit the restaurant; the serving staff has never been the most friendly bunch, but for good food, I will give leeways. Just went there again this Sunday, as usual, receive a "curt instruction" to sit outside to wait under the scorching sun at 1 pm, this time round I am not following direction, I pointed at a table with the patrons that are about to finish their food. But again, I was curtly told that that is for other guests.I saw the server ushered a group of patrons of the same race from him, smiling (I had never seen the particular server smiled at me ever before, even though I was always polite and smile when I talk to him). It is not the first time I saw him cherry pick who to get to sit inside the air-conditioned restaurant and who sit outside.Well, another table became available, and I just sit down. Ordered my usual chicken chop but frankly, it is not as tasty as before. It made the differential treatments harder to swallow, pun fully intended. I guess I am not coming back here anytime soon.

Author: MikOrgShanghai, China
Title: Some of the best Satay in Kuching
Review: If you're in town you need to stop by the Green Hill corner and pick up a few sticks of satay from the young dude making it on the corner. Its the best I tried on the my trips around Malaysia, ate it pretty much every day I was in Kuching. So cheap (.75RM for a stick) and just delicious. Not sure if it technically counts as the Hawker Center, but its right outside).Nice folks too.

Author: Trvlbug1974Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Will not be back
Review: Location / setting : Originally a house that has been converted into a restaurant with many office buildings around. Backyard is surrounded by trees & plants, nice if properly maintained and if mosquitoes do not like you.Food : menu features mainly pub grub. Food is not too bad. Portions medium. Drinks - draft beers are ok, draft guiness good. Cranberry juice, they have added water before adding ice, therefore extremely diluted, unacceptable when charging RM9.90 for a small glass. Service : Bad. Firstly they got my order wrong. I asked for my steak to be medium but it arrived well done and hard. My steak comes with mushrooms, chunky vegetables & sauteed potatoes. I asked if I could switch the sauteed tatoes for fries and the waiter said yes. I did get my fries but there were no chunky vegetables. I didn't bother asking because they seem quite thick. The 3 boys were busy chattering among themselves that they fail to notice when customers are trying to get some service. Failing to catch their attention, we walked up to the till to pay, and the guy gave us an unhelpful look saying I'm not a waiter, I'm a kitchen crew. We had to wait quite long before we got our bill. Will not be back, for the price, I can get better service & food anytime. There was an a/c section but was closed for some strange reasons. The place has got potential, spoilt by incompetent staff. Some tables had tealights and some none - inconsistent!

Author: PatienceginKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great service but food was nothing to shout about
Review: We visited the Mandarin Grill recently and it was my first time. The service was very attentive and the ambiance was very nice. Overlooking the greens was rare in Kuala Lumpur and having to experience it was an added advantage to our lunch. For our dining experience, it was just average as I expected more from the grill. I ordered the porterhouse steak, the size was awesome however the the tenderness could have been better event at medium rare done. We will definitely visit the Mandarin Grill again to have another try.

Author: WchouseTric
Title: Lost electronic gadget at the restaurant
Review: We were having a family meal at this restaurant which we frequently visit. One of the family meal, we lost our gadget. Efforts to view the cctv wasn__ successful and gadget was never found.

Author: CharissaC728Coventry, England, United Kingdom
Title: Unpleasant Visit
Review: (+) Overall food and drinks are decent. Ambience is nice and cosy. Food was served pretty quickly. (-) Place is very crowded just like any other cafes. However, the service crew are a little impolite and inconsiderate as they try to __hase_ you away since there is a queue. We were there for under an hour and they started asking whether we wanted to order anything else for a couple of times and eventually asked if we wanted the bill. I understand that they want to serve the waiting customers soonest possible, but they shouldn__ do it at the expense of other dining customers. I__e been to many other cafes and never had I ever experienced this. It__ quite a big turn off at the end of a meal and when you__e catching up with friends after a long time. Very unlikely to return as you could easily go somewhere else where you can eat and chill at ease.

Author: 15alicialSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice food
Review: Ambience: comfortable n home feel.The staff attending to us was very friendly. He approached us and gave recommendation on their food.First to be snap up is the nachos. There are 3 sauces provided to go along with.Waffles with ice cream and banana. My little ones do not like the waffle. They prefer orignal ones. But I do like its crispyness. Nice combination though.Tiramisu cake: abit sweet. But i do like that its non alcohol.Chocolate nuts cake: ordered this @50% discount with every main course ordered. Soft on top, crispy below. Should be the oreo biscuit at the base.Its my favourite for that day. The staff also recommended matcha cake. Did not order as i do not like matcha.Teriyaki chicken rice - good. Separate teriyaki sauce for you to mix. Generous with the sauce. Sunny side up egg on top of the rice. Good.Minus point: the staff forgot about our teriyaki chicken rice order. All came except for this. Till we asked another staff, realised the order was not captured into their system for their chefs to prepare.This upset my hubby abit as he had waited for about 15mins and another 5mins to be ready.While waiting, did notice other patrons food order. Portion is good and looks nice too.Nevertheless, worth the try and if there is chance, will go back there again.

Author: Gail B
Title: Good Steak
Review: had a great steak sitting outdoors in a pleasant patio bar area. Very lively, lots of expats, decent service.

Author: vernmadden
Title: Fail as a restaurant
Review: Ignore the menu most of it was not available. Beer is warm. Service is cold. Go anywhere but here in malacca.

Author: DelsonMooSingapore, Singapore
Title: Food is great
Review: The chicken is soft, juicy and tender. The beansprouts are fat, crunchy and tasty. Their sauce for both are very appetizing, but a bit too salty for my taste. Their Hor Fan is just ok, a bit bland, and a hint of sweetness. But overall everything adds up perfectly !
Restaurant: Restoran Cowan Street Ayam Tauge & Koitiau

Author: Denise2300
Title: Authentic food in an authentic setting
Review: Gorgeous Malaysian style restaurant, fantastic chef and staff, wonderful and authentic Malaysian food.  Fresh seafood caught daily displayed in the fridge for your selection and cooking style.  Great food, great service, stunning dÃ©cor.

Author: Roy O
Title: Convenient for the Sheraton, with street-side ambience
Review: We enjoyed the attention, good quality food, and the ambience in this small cafe/restaurant next door to the Sheraton. It gives one a chance to get away from the "hotel syndrome" and experience more of the KL public scene.

Author: CFEIIIAustin, Texas
Title: Nice restaurant, good food and drink
Review: I stopped by here about 1:30 pm on a hot day, didn't realize they close about 2:30, then open back up...They were very hospitable and served me, prepared a hot meal, all the time as nice as you can be. Its a great location, especially for people watching, but this is a nice place.

Author: juanh187Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Extremely disappointing dinner
Review: This was an extremely disappointing dinner. Food was bland, and I mean really bland. The best thing we had was the chendol, which I would say was only slightly above average. And what made it worse was that as soon as they had served us, they were more interested to get us out of there so that they can fill the table again with other guests (and we actually made reservations!). This restaurant is often ranked high in many reviews, but I don__ understand why

Author: angelineo99
Title: One of the best traditional and real Italian restaurant
Review: Ciao! Tucked away on a busy buzzing Lucky Garden, Bangsar backstreet is where Portofino Italian Restaurant located, you__l enjoy authentic Italian recipes at this restaurant. Here at Portofino, majority of their menu items are made from scratch. Everything you could ever want in an Italian restaurant, from convenience of location, atmosphere and all your favourite authentic Italian dishes includes a range of antipasti, salads, pasta, pizza and grilled meat (Portofino serves halal meat), and it__ great value to boot. Simply fantastic from start to finish, and well worth a visit.Head Chef Keli, began cooking at age 14 and perfected his craft at five-star Italian hotels over the past decade. Portofino__ key selling point is its excellent customer service. Staff are by far the most polite we__e ever come across and treat you with the warmth and love the Italians are renowned for. This transfers to their dishes, which is hearty and full of flavour. Portofino's offers two types of pasta, where one is dry pasta and homemade pasta.

Author: Lee S
Title: Taste average but expensive
Review: Food portion is small. The asam fish sauce is watery and a bit tasteless. Price is expensive. Will not come back again.

Author: welselKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A place to chill out
Review: Their price was reasonable and food was not too bad.But one of their staffs came and took something from our table just without asking, we were interrupted and disturbed in a middle of a conversation, and we have personal belongings on the table as well, in any normal circumstances, staffs or waiters will ask before they act. This was only one of their staffs, the rest were fine. Still it is a decent place to chill out after work.

Author: Sbi77
Title: Good service
Review: Good service from the staff and warm smile.put us in a private corner to having lunch and small meeting.appreciated it

Author: Happyhippofoodie123Singapore
Title: Flies Aplenty
Review: We stayed in Cove 55 which is a 10 min drive but because the hotel didn't have a kitchen, we took the car into Damai to pick up some food and water for our 2 day stay. Also had no other options to eat elsewhere as we forot to withdraw cash from Kuching City and Damai had all of 1 ATM that did not accept our overseas cards. Escobar accepts credit card payments, the 7-11 next door did not.Food took about>20min to arrive even for simple starters like the fried chilli lamb. The taste was actually pretty ok for most of our dishes in generalBut what really turned us off is the sheer amount (not number) of houseflies you encounter when trying to have a meal. We had 2 lunches there and during the 2nd one, Chris got up to ask for some flypaper.This photo depicts the aftermath of our 30min lunch: 20+ flies stuck on our flypaper. The bar counter has another flypaper with is literally covered with flies. I find it hard to recommend this place to anyone, because of the hygiene implications.Next time if we visit Damai again, we will make sure we pack our own food from Kuching city and withdraw plenty of cash in advance. Lesson learnt.However , horror stories aside, If you do eat there by any chance, ask for salad dressings on the side as they do drown the greens in sauce. Try the chilli.And oh, that being said, service was attentive and the staff do try to accomodate your requests to a reasonable level.

Author: Sepehr e
Title: Terrible food.
Review: Terrible food.Ordered the Agli olio pasta with turkery ham I believe. It was extremely SALTY, the pasta was hard and worse than all it had a fishy smell. Informed the staff the about it aswell.We also order the dilwale pizza. Mostly paste and bread. Counted 5-6 tiny pieces of minced lamb on the whole pizza.

Author: Woowoo101Singapore, Singapore
Title: Fast became a regular eating place.
Review: Being a regular commuter to KL, I'd been up and down the hotel menu for evening dinner before I found this wonderful restaurant in the Food court section of the Pavillion. I just fancied the mixed kabab at 24 Ringitt and it was worth every bite. It came with a mixed salad and a yoghurt thing that even if sold on it's own is a lovely meal. Since the first time I went, I have been back every week, my last meal tonight being just as good as the first. The guys working there now know me and the order is placed without me having to say anything. I indulge in a bit of banter with the staff who are all extremely pleasant and my meal is fresh and ready in next to no time. I bring mine back to the hotel as I much prefer to sit and just enjoy at my leisure. There are tables for this restaurant but they're a little isolated from the food court seats so you feel you are on display to other shoppers. Heck why shouldn't they see me enjoying the meal.If you are just not interested in Hotel buffets/al a carte menus and want to try something a little different then give this place a try. Even if only for a kebab wrap.I would take a photo but I have the meal to go and the photo wouldn't do it justice. Search the place out in the Pavillion and give the mixed kebab a try, you will certainly enjoy it.

Author: kAkaLow
Title: not a preferred choice
Review:
walked quite a distance to locate this shop, was recommended by a friend that we must try.

this is something special which i've never tried before, but due to it's location and the queue, I guess visiting once would be enough..

Author: 943DavidCKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice, simple breakfast buffet, shame about the music
Review: The breakfast buffet for Rm23 is pleasant enough, cereals, toast, pastries, nasi lemak and fruit juice, but only one tea or coffee, ,not unlimited refills.The most annoying part was the ridiculous and loud music they insisted on playing which completely ruins the ambience. Its a restaurant, not a night club!

Author: 164h_l_nep
Title: Good place for a quick breakfast
Review: Good place for a quick breakfast or lunch but it is still a very touristic cafÃ©. The service was quick though, much appreciated.

Author: RedKitty_12Seattle
Title: BEST restaurant Melaka
Review: Excellent tapas and cocktails! We had dinner here and enjoyed the ambiance and attentive service. The sangria and spanish gin drinks were the best. We liked this place so much we returned for lunch the next day. Inadvertently left my credit card behind. We were walking back to our hotel after the Jonker Night Market and walked past the restaurant. Our server came running out with the credit card I didn't realized I had left behind. Love this place. Would highly recommend for a memorable Melaka experience.

Author: AmirYusof
Title: A very nice cosy place to have a quiet family lunch in the city
Review: A quick lunch menu with quite a number of choices. Very friendly staffs and their helpfulness is really a plus

Author: DaveKarunSemarang, Indonesia
Title: Meh..
Review: In short just meh.. we ate omakase chef table. they tried hard to combine many different ingredient to become sophisticated dished. Ended up something that taste weird or even tasteless. There are a few dishes which they kept simple and they were very good. The desert is amazing. Japanese melon, and marshmallow and coffee pudding is the star of the dish.

Author: Abhimanyu APetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Looks a bit run down
Review: Been to this restaurant 2 years back and we had some nice authentic sarawakian dishes such as Nasi Goreng Dabai which is commendable but this year's trip, I was a bit disappointed as the place looked untidy and cleanliness have gone down. Im not sure if the operator has changed or the premise is just a bit run down.

Author: NgKS9368
Title: Friends Birthday Dinner
Review:
This is Nyonya fusion, been there many times.
Great place to having dinner over there & really love their desserts.

Author: john m
Title: Great food and service
Review: The beef curry was absolutely delicious. Best curry I've had. My wife loved the chicken cashew do much that we went back another night for it. Excellent service and very friendly staff. Highly recommended.

Author: Harry_Einis
Title: Good, reliable, travellers cafe & bar.
Review: Popular with travellers.  Good place to stop for lunch or drinks when walking around Jonkers.  Evenings there is sometimes relaxed live music. Food & drinks all of decent quality.

Author: coyok
Title: another typical mamak restaurant
Review: As the tittle suggest, this place is typical of mamak restaurant which is fast service, good food and drink. Only the location makes it stand out from the rest.

Author: ScorchedSun
Title: Losing the touch
Review: Used to be one of the finest Thai restaurant, great Tom yum, otah, fried pandan chicken, pineapple fried rice. The hut is well design, very windy even there__ no air con, a very cozy place to have a gatherings.Recent years, the place is run down, those pillow with foul smell, no maintenance , no cleaning on the huts, food standard drop drastically.You will be out from the race of Thai food as there__ so many Thai restaurant booming. Improve to stay on the game.

Author: Aleksandar J
Title: friendly, affordable and very good !
Review: I had a great time with my family. The staff is very friendly and the food is just delicious. Nice place to go in Kuala Lumpur

Author: Jennifer VKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: C'mon Let's Celebrate!! Celebrate!!
Review: To celebrate our daughter's exam results we asked her to choose her favourite dining place. I was thrilled she chose one of our favourites Koyaku. We arrived late and found our fav spot. The kind waiter reminded us that the kitchen closes at 10pm, we got there at 9.45pm and ordered our late late dinner. A platter of sashimi, different slices of fresh fish on a bed of finely cut white radish with seaweed, cheesy scallops, vegetarian soba noodles, grilled fish head for my other half washed down with refreshing green tea. Everything ordered was a visual delight. To top it all our kind waiter and waitress truly know the meaning or good service. Keep this up!

Author: RickeywkSingapore, Singapore
Title: Over-rated though price is ok
Review: Went as a family withb7 adults and 4 children. Their BBQ stingray with belacan, homemade tofu, belacan midin are nice but the steamed prawns were not fresh and almost half a plate was left uneaten. Oyster pancake was only crispy on edge and its bottom was soaked in oil. We ended up paying only RM307 but not quite satisfied.
Restaurant: Top Spot Ling Loong Seafood No.6 & 33

Author: Marisa L
Title: rude waitress doughy pizza
Review: Had lunch there with my kids. It was a promo lunch menu and we will not be going back... Wait staff were rude, disinterested and impatient. Our set came with a free gelato and the waitress gave us all chocolate gelato without checking with us on preferred flavour. When I enquired she rudely replied in Malay that it was the only flavor available although I had seen other tables being served otherwise. Pizza crust was thick and doughy and lacks flavor. The beef dish ordered by my husband was not to bad however, and the mash potatoescomplemented the beef well.

Author: Marcuslct
Title: Triplex Cowboy Burger
Review: Extremely salty. Not a good taste of the cowboy Burger. need to be improved on the taste. maybe had been changing the chef.

Author: Rafael W
Title: "Most authentic Indian food in KL"
Review: That's the message on a chalkboard just outside Khan's. Well, if that's true, then Kuala Lumpur is in dire need of authentic Indian food, because Khan's ain't it. Don't get me wrong, the price seems good. But the food leaves much to be desired. The naan was terrible. That wasn't genuine naan at all. It was crispy and doughy. The butter chicken was good (as it always is), but nothing special. The homemade chicken masala or whatever was decent, but it had bones, which is a pain. And the menu... the menu was tiny. Where's the korma? Where's the vindaloo?Anyway, bottom line is, terrible naan = terrible Indian restaurant. I've been to five Indian restaurants in Saigon and every single one of them runs circles around Khan's.

Author: T5196BGmarksWellington, New Zealand
Title: Mediocre tourist trap
Review: My wife and I should have taken heed of the ratio of tourists to locals in this place located just a street away from the well known Jalan Alor tourist food street. We orderwd a seafood mee goreng and a lamb curry meal. What was served to us was very mediocre - plain flavour despite requesting spicy when asked, and little of the aromatic punch we've experienced at almost every other restaurant in KL that we tried during our three day stay.

Author: thedevilwalksin
Title: Overrated Outlet
Review: Restaurant had about 25 pax and about 6 tables empty. Me and my youngest were greeted at door and given menus with ordering done quite fast. Drinks were served within 5-8 minutes but our starters - popia & chicken wings took more than 30 minutes with the main course coming about 10 minutes later. The wait staff apologised to the table opposite us for the delayed food delivery yet neglected to inform us that there would be a 30 to 40 minutes delay on food delivery when they took our order or when the drinks were served. The food was average or below average to say the least - Nyonya food is not prepared on the spot but prepared earlier to encourage the amalgamation of the herbs, spices and other ingredients. The popia was made using an egg batter but sadly my local food court popia wins hands down - flavourful, crunchy, tasty while the serving @ Bulldog was just ....nothing to write home about. The chicken wings was hot ...and thats all i can say about it. The main chicken dish was average while the kangkong belacan loses hands down to the local makan shop.The restaurant was clean, bright and had a pleasant atmosphere with wait staff replenishing your water glass quite quickly but as we were there because of the food reviews, i was very disappointed. After asking for the bill and paying it, only then did the wait staff ask if "everything" was alright - it wasn't but i was already going to leave - and apologised for the long wait. As per our family credo - we try once but we wont try again.

Author: AmyWoon
Title: Good for ribs lover!
Review: Taste good!  I have been hearing of this restaurant for quite sometime, and finally i got a chance to tried out last month. No disappointment and it taste good! not too dry & juicy, portion also just nice for 2 pax.

Author: DesLangfordYorkshire
Title: Good food in a relaxed ambiance
Review: Ate here twice and the food was good and the ambiance relaxing- quirky furniture and quiet music. If you sit near the entrance there are great views of the river and the fountain light show at night in the distance. It is also one of the few places to serve beer, as many local restaurants frequented by locals are dry.

Author: 1MingSingapore, Singapore
Title: Value lunch deal
Review: Makan kitchen at Doubletree jB has a value weekday lunch deal at only 48RM nett. At this reduced price, don't expect premium quality food. From what I observed, most are leftovers from their more extensive buffet breakfast, sans traditional breakfast items. Nonetheless it is still extremely good value, with a selection of Indian, Malay and Chinese dishes and western desserts. Coffee and Tea included too.
Restaurant: Makan Kitchen at DoubleTree by Hilton Johor Bahru

Author: BoonBNE
Title: Still keeping up with the good taste of the few items served
Review: I visit this eatery every time I am in Melaka. The quality and taste of the food served are still good. The Po Piah was firmly wrapped and not soggy as what I had in the food centre.

Author: IshiIsmailKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not value for money
Review: The first time we dined here was because boy suggested it. I too was taken by the hype of the original equatorial hotel sushi buffet. So we went for his birthday with the folks. Service was attentive as it should be in this type of joint. My mom can't drink cold water and needed her hot or warm drink and felt obligated to explain ; and the waitress was patient. The ambience was suited for a quiet family dinner. . . Absent was the din as is the experience of dining at say sushi tei... Or sushi king.. Not to say they are bad, certainly not but the dining hall of the latter does not support quiet conversations. Inspite of the pleasant ambiance the meal was mediocre at best. Certainly the price was for the location and ambiance. I certainly am no connoisseur of Japanese food and can't see why the price would differ so much between this place and the kaiten belt store. Cert cheaper does not translate into worse quality. I have not yet been sick as a result of bindging at the kaiten belt. As if that first experience was not enough warning, I found myself having yet another dinner with client there as a result of miscommunication with a colleague . Yes we could talk business because it was not noisy but the food leaves a lot to be desired. I am sure the other party went away looking for some thing else to snack on after. It turns out that the colleague wanted to dine at the Japanese restaurant across the road in starhill.... Oh well.

Author: ttye0Central Melaka District, Malaysia
Title: Super sweet
Review: This hype stall was always crowded with customers queuing along roadside.Since when we liked over sweet stuffsï¼_he gula melaka was totally out.Lack of aroma and flavour,only sweet,sweet and sweet(sweet from the extra sugar, not from the original gula melaka.ok).Sorry,not for me to queue.If u like super sweet putu,go there.

Author: Tooens
Title: Good food, pleasant decor.
Review:
Entry by steppingstones over a pond was interesting & the semi-outdoor setting added ambience.
We found the menu a bit limited but the food was good & presentation excellent. Service was good.
The "sister restaurants" of Junk & Living Room had very similar menus.

Author: DeeanRaySingapore, Singapore
Title: Bad impression
Review: It started from call reservation 2 weeks ago, I called to book a reservation for 2 Pax by the window/good view table etc. for 3 Aug 2019 (Dinner buffet). After all the arrangement, I realised the lady who took my reservation did not ask for my email to confirm my reservation but I took leap of faith that they have my reservation done as it's 2 weeks before the date.(#1) So the next day, I decided to call back the reservation team As I need to add another 2 pax which sum up to table for 4, and I've got to know that there is no reservation done under my name. Upon arrival, it was presentable, pretty fancy, approached the host (man & lady) and the man at the door walk us in to the restaurant. (#2) This is the part where I was stunned, the moment the guy walked out from the counter, just a few steps (while me following behind his back), he turned his head (while walking) looked at me from down the leg all the way up to my face (Bear in mind, I wasn't wearing appropriately), and turn back as he saw I was watching his gesture. (I'm not too sure is he being very judge-y or he thinks that I don't have money to dine in at your restaurant)He brought us in straight away to the center area, on the left first table near the asian food area and told me this is the table. So I started questioning him and said, I asked for window table with a view upon reservation; And he did move me straight away to the window table. (#3) I would like to suggest that you should be more attentive with reservation details, it really matter when it comes to service. There's a reason it's called "reservation".After settling down, we walk down the isle of the main course sections, and I decided to take western on my plate first. I took the beef/steak, shepherds pie & potatoes. (#4) The beef/steak went down my empty stomach right away and it tasted horrible ! (If you have high blood pressure I suggest you better not take it), it was so salty ! So I decided to call the waitress, and the guy from the host came to me and I ask politely whether the beef/steak is really salty or that's the way it's suppose to taste. Without any hesitation on his face he answered me, "that's how it's been marinated" but if you want a bit less salt, we can request to the Chef to do a new one. (#5) so if you are looking for good main course spread, they don't have appetising type of main course. The asian food look so-so. What is amazing about this place is just their desserts bar (which I know that is what their famous for). Their deserts tasted so good and a lot of spread !! If you guys have sweet tooth, this is the place ! Besides, you just have to be more patient with the staff as they kept coming to you every 5-10mins to check on your table. The whole atmosphere is so fancy, I love it ! Other than that just meh. It's a one-time dine in, would I repeat again ? No, definitely not. Thank you for such nice experience. Hope this comment will help you improve your service and salty beef/steak cooked.
Restaurant: Curate At Four Seasons Hotel Kuala Lumpur

Author: satwantpool
Title: Tasty food
Review: Had our dinner here tonight after touring the city & KLCC. The food was nice and the desserts wonderful. The seating arrange could be improved.

Author: yisiewt
Title: Short trip
Review: Nice place to chill . A variety of chocolate desserts . Combinations of chocolate , crepe and brownies.

Author: MadamkMelbourneMoreland, Australia
Title: Bland food a disappointment
Review: We were visiting Malacca and relied on TripAdvisor to find authentic nyonya food for dinner for the one night we stayed. We finally found Amy's and were delighted to get a table, although it was a Tuesday night. We went through the menu and asked advice from the waiter (maybe Amy's husband). He recommended one main dish, which was a chicken dish with potatoe and mushroom, in a nyonya gravy. We were looking foward to a nice, tasty, spicy meal using the local spices. The appetiser was very nice (the little chef's hats), the chicken wings were simply fried chicken, which was a little disappointing. However, the chicken main meal was very disappointing - as soon as I tasted it, it was exactly like an apricot chicken dish we used to make at home (chicken cooked ina tin of apricot juice with a packet of dried French onion soup). Maybe we chose the wrong meal, but it was disappointing.

Title: Nice view not so nice food
Review: Restaurant is located on high floor and provides good views of KLCC but food is nothing extraordinary but outrageously expensive with a minimum price of MYR 300/head (when we last went) for a window side table.

Author: evilnesz
Title: Fine dining Ipoh
Review: It as nice restaurant with great food. The service was excelent. However was left a little bit dissapointed as there was no wine selection here . A very simple fine dining experience with good food,

Author: 18bsr
Title: Crowded place
Review: We were a little bit curious to try out this restaurant, as we had heard so much about it.3 of us came in Saturday before 1pm, this place already full of ppl. We waited for about 15 mins to get seats. We were lucky as we saw some diners were turn away(ask to come the next day).Food we ordered:1) 2 rolls of popiah (fantastic)2) 2 servings of Pai Tee(fantastic)3) Chap Chai (average)4) Ngor Hiang (poor)5) Assam fish (average)6) Udang Lemak (average)The price is reasonable, service is good and fast. We bought the Love letter and kueh Bangkit back home. Was a little disappointing.Hope to be back and try some others dishes.

Author: Adrian D
Title: Not recommended
Review: The rice don't have the chicken rice taste like normal white rice and costly ... totally not recommended ...

Author: strung_out80Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: a hidden gem....
Review: Cafe Cafe is tucked away at the corner of a building on a major road in KL, and you probably would miss it....but it is definitely one of the restaurants that is not to be missed. Food is good, service is great and for a couple of hours, you'll feel you are not in KL.I myself am a fan of their truffle pasta. Just the aroma as the dish is placed in front of you is reason enough to order it. To add to the ambience, the lights are dim, and the decor is reminiscent of an old French restaurant with chandeliers and crystals hanging from the ceiling.It is a romantic restaurant and I've been here several times with my boyfriend, and not once have we had any complaints.

Author: thattravelitchJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Excellent food - personally not my favorite
Review: We haveucky enough to have dined in a couple of fine dining in South East Asia with similar price tags.The booking online and the exchanges were smooth and done easily. We already knew where to find the restaurant (we had been to Marini's before) but I would understand some client can be lost a bit, I think some explanation in the email would be a good improvement to add.We ordered two special omakase and I can say that you can taste the quality of the ingredients chosen. The otoro was great, the wagyu of a good marbling and the ebi was very smooth. I think the supply of scallops may not have been the tastiest compared to other experience.The service was good and fast. Yet I feel like even if warm, it lacked something that could make the overall experience a little more fine dining. The explanation of the dish was made too fast and the prononciation was sometimes hard to get. In previous experience, the cocktail /wine were served first, then a pause before the first dish arrived. Here both beverages arrived at different time and we had to ask for the cocktail when the 2nd omakase arrived. I come to a fine dining for somehow a certain experience and a little ceremony. I felt that the dish were served a little fast - that it lacked a certain personal feel.Personally, I had a good dÃ®ner, maybe I was expecting too much but I come to a fine dining not to feel like I had a good diner but to come out of it with questions. Such as, hey "this texture was interesting", that pairing was audacious or "I am not even sure I like that..." - I come for an experience. I didn't felt such surprises and I didn't feel like there was any risk taking in the menu that was presented to me.I would say this, the quality of the food was good, the service was good. But it felt a like short for my expectations. It must remain an expensive price but at THAT price tag, I was expecting a more audacious offer.

Author: madgescotlandMonifieth, United Kingdom
Title: First class meal, great service and reasonably priced
Review: My wife and I fortunately came across Havana as a matter of chance as it is quite well camouflaged on a corner site. We were not disappointed, great welcome and reasonable selection on the menu. Clearly a lot of money had been invested in what appeared to be two new high tech charcoal ovens and my T-bone steak was cooked to perfection in one of them. Lovely jacket potatoes and creamy coleslaw coupled with ice cold Tiger, perfect!

Author: Pasupathy S
Title: Pretentious
Review:
I last ate there some time ago and found both the service and food lacking.
I asked about the house wine and was told to read the menu myself. That put me off and I haven't been there since

Author: NMPRASAD
Title: Very rude staff
Review: This restaurant is classic example of arrogance of success. Since their restaurant is doing good business they are not bothered about customer service. Discourage such nuts by not eating there. Pl don__ eat there

Author: IanSZGDShenzhen, China
Title: That was not a beef rendang!
Review: Nice cosy place, nasi lamak was ok, sambal very delicious. But we went specifically for the much touted beef rendang.The beef rendang, mentioned on various blogs and rated excellent by Time Out, was something else. Maybe rendang flavored stir fry beef? Beef rendang should be cubes of beef slow cooked till it falls apart. I got thin strips of beef stirfried in a sauce reminiscent of rendang flavors. It was pale and didn't have any browned coconut that gives rendang its texture and taste. The meat was dry and at times chewy. Was super let down.

Author: Best127
Title: Nothing to Shout About
Review:
Other than is reasonably priced and speedy service, the dim sums here are really nothing to shout about. 

Undoubtedly it is popular among locals and tourists alike due to there are not many dim sums restaurants available in Malacca.

Author: Mohammed_Al-Taweel
Title: Madam Kwan's
Review:
I went with my friends to this restaurant in KLCC. It has more branches in KL
It's Malaysian restaurant, and they provide  a lot of dishes.

The food and juice were so nice.

Author: Muhahas7
Title: Dinner
Review: Thank you very much to Ain, Chirsty and Anila for provided a great service to us and not to forget very excellent food from Chef Domenico expecially funghi pizza.

Author: ngivie
Title: Not bad
Review: It was too long a wait. I enjoyed the soup, but didn't find it that good and not so sure what's the hype about.

Author: shima_okinawa
Title: Highly recommended Chinese restaurant in ipoh
Review: Visited this restaurant twice this month. 1st visit with my family on 23 for dinner. Food and services are so good that we came for lunch today with 2 Japanese couples. They complimented on the food and services too. Smoked duck is a must try dish. Restaurant staffs are attentive to customers needs. Services of Ron is highly commendable.

Author: alex tLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Over hyped Chinese pork satay place
Review: We had this satay as our first stop in Melaka and were not to impressed - the skewers of pork, liver & intestines were well cooked but minuscule in portion per skewer. If you like this version of satay, the stall beside the Kong Heng coffee shop in Ipoh does it far better.

Author: De87De87Sydney, Australia
Title: Disappointing !
Review: Had dinner with my boyfriend last night , the place wasn't packed as it was quite late , my meal was just warm and my steak had a huge vein of fat and gristle running through it so consequently could only eat half of it ! My bf had a Tbone and he said it was nice . Nice atmosphere and service also but overpriced I think

Author: junp308Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Food-wise.. a let down...
Review: Visitied this Restaurant (The branch in Pavillion). I'd dined before in this chain-restaurant and used to frequent it at the Sunway branch and went it with high expectation.Ordered xiao long pao, braised pork belly with preserved veg and pork rib with sauce. My personally opinion.. ie Xiao long pao - frankly, I prefer Din Tai Fung instead, braised pork belly with preserved veg (a big let down, so bland, watery and tasteless) and the pork rib with sauce (Well, ok only) ... Anyway, I will give this Restaurant a try again soon ...

Author: JocLYT
Title: Disappointed
Review: Four of us dine there on 10th Nov 2019. First serving was the kueh pie tee which was delicious. Then comes the disappointment. The chap chai was tasteless. The otah is just a fish cake with otah paste. Sambal kang kong was too salty. The chendol has no red beans.

Author: rzinger
Title: Great food
Review: Nice menu, great service. Shish Tawook was cooked perfectly. Salad was very nice along with fresh pita. Nice and clean inside. Strong recommendation.

Author: aydens2014Singapore, Singapore
Title: excellent food and service
Review: when there on 29th April 2017 with my hubby.no reservations done but waiting time was just 5minutes. excellence service and staff.food was awesome especially the bbq flavour.one of the staff even help us to cracked the crab shell..will definitely return here if i happen to be in kl again..

Author: WunicTexas
Title: Worst burger!!!
Review: I just ordered take away via food panda. I saw the chefs recommend the Moroccan beef burger IT WAS ONE OF THE WORST BUGER I EVER TASTED! there was so much chunks of fat in the burger, every bite I took I had to be spitting out inedible pieces. i should have ordered mc or king it would not have cost 36.90RM I wasted money. (photo attached)

Author: Sharon C
Title: Family
Review: Price expensive  compare to next door,  ex: tauge Rm8, next door big one only cost RM5. In term of taste OK,  more or less the same with others.

Author: Pedro J
Title: Very expensive
Review: The same as all HRC but double the price. Even charge you 10us = 40rm at the door. And food and drinks are about the double price. Wont be back here again

Author: Musab A
Title: Small portion sizzed cake and fries  .....expensive
Review: Really nice place , relaxing, yet the cake was 18 with a scoop adding up to 21 coming with the size of a  cupcake with fancy chocolate shaving

Author: JP35467556Larnaca, Cyprus
Title: Went there with my wife for
Review: Went there with my wife for breakfast. Ordered a hot tea but the water was cold. I asked for it to be heated which seemed to cause them a lot of trouble. My wife__ breakfast came after 10-15mins and I had to wait another 20 for mine even though I chased it. Not sure what__ going on. Maybe a manager on the floor would be a good addition. Disappointed.

Author: PreezNickMiri, Malaysia
Title: Yumminess in the Heart of Suria, KLCC
Review: With fast and good service and nice and tasty food. My 1st try was the Penang Assam Laksa and it was very tasty and tasted as good as it should be (unlike some restaurants which are too commercialised and lose the autenticity of the dish) and they did not spare on the fish ingredient which was a pleasant surprise to me. I would definitely go there for my assam laksa fix soon.

Author: H3847LLlaurawLondon, United Kingdom
Title: This is the place if you ...
Review: ... want to eat crap food, drink crap wine, get crap service and listen to crap music. We went there in a group and I handed a cake to the waitress and asked her to bring the cake out at a certain time and lit the candles which came with it. When the time came, she took out the cake and was planning to put the cake on the table together with the box it's in, with the candles and plastic knife on top of the box. Fortunately someone in the party stopped her just in time. When told she needed to lit the candles and serve without the box, the waitress got all defensive and fierce. I gave her a tip when we left because we felt sorry for her ignorance. I will never return!!!

Author: Daydream825711
Title: Inauthentic peranakan cuisine
Review: Food lacked flavour, small quantity and pricey. Best to skip this  restaurant if you are looking for authenticity.

Author: poopshooterPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: average japanese fusion...
Review: Popular with the lunch crowd. Specialising in Japanese fusion. Interesting decor with private booths for groups. Lucky we made reservations as there was still a queue at 1pm. Service is hit & miss. Prices a bit on the high side.The 4 of us shared a salmon yee sang being Chinese New Year. Pretty good with fresh ingredients & decent amount of salmon. The sesame dressing was addictive. For mains we had the chicken teppanyaki garlic rice, chicken katsu curry rice, teriyaki chicken omu rice & the salmon lunch special. They were all decent portions & tasted good but just average. Nothing really standing out. I have also tried their pasta fusion dishes before which was okay but not something I would return for.Overall a decent lunch. The crowd & slow service is a bit of a deterrent.

Author: paulrT9924BFBracknell, United Kingdom
Title: Well presented food
Review: The food was well presented and nice cool restaurant, but was a little disappointed with the flavour of the Biryani we had (Chicken and Mutton). Maybe it was toned down for the tourist trade, as i am used to eating these in local towns in Malaysia

Author: sitimanisahSeri Kembangan
Title: Just like it should be
Review: Came here for a treat of laksa Sarawak during my first ever visit to Kuching and Sarawak in Jan 2020. I had once had this laksa cooked by a sarawakian who lived in Semenanjung. The first taste was superb and I can never get the same taste around Semenanjung after that. The laksa at this restaurant brought back memories. And even better as it was served with seafood (other than the shredded chicken). I chose laksa sarawak with sotong, my favourite seafood.The service was quick, the presentation was nice and the waiter and waitresses were pleasant. Some says they cooked using the same recipe as their mother's (thus Mom's Laksa), generation after generation.Will definitely recommend this and will come back whenever we visit Kuching in the future.

Author: Fun8888Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Huge Disappointment
Review: We had high expectations especially experience chef Isadora at Antara Restaurant which we fondly remembered. Thus the reason for trying Bistro a Table. The ambience is great & the service is excellent. We had no issue with the degustation 4 meal couse but the ala carte Roasted quail stuffed with foie gras & truffle cream was given half cook where the rawness can be seen. Sent it back unfortunately towards the end of the same dish it was also not cooked properly.Certainly we will not come back .

Author: jokl78
Title: Delicious food
Review: Went there for lunch with family. Food is awesome and waitresses are friendly. Will come back again for sure

Author: EggEggEgg
Title: Used to be better
Review:
Was one of my regular places to visit whenever I was at KSL - however recent visits have been underwhelming.

Generally speaking the quality seems to have gone down - while prices have gone up. So, may not visit again in future.

Author: KarenBonavitaU.S.
Title: Very good and recommend
Review: In the Indian section of Malacca and away from the bulk of tourists, we tried Selvam and were very pleased. A banana leaf was placed on the table and our order was so efficiently taken. The food was delicious. My nutrition is mainly Mediterranean, followed closely by Indian cuisine which we eat as often as we can, and my husband and I both found Selvam to be excellent.

Author: BeemertooCalifornia
Title: Different than others. Worth a visit
Review: We were a group of 9 and they accommodated us on time. No air conditioning but the fan was relatively adequate. Service was quite good. Food is very good and drinks are __xotically_ named and presented. Very good food choices. The outside street gets quite busy due to the many many bars and restaurants around there visited by expats. Quite a unique restaurant in my opinion worth visiting.

Author: MandW108
Title: Amazing ribs!!
Review: We discovered this place towards the end of our stay, the ribs are tasty!! Portions are very generous, that is something o keep in mind!! Service is good too. Must try if u like American sized food and ribs. It is also halal

Author: tpeipingKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Wide spread, good quality & delicious roti!
Review: When it's a YTL, naturally the expectations are higher! And this restaurant doesn't disappoint, though it's not fantastic. The first thing one notice is how big the place is! There are 2 main islands of main dishes, and the drinks and dessert counter are near the entrance. Sashimi, sushi, miso soup, variety of pasta, local noodles, local dishes, oyster, chilled prawns, dim sum, meats, etc. so there is something for everyone. And I found joy and satisfaction in the roti canai! Yes, freshly made roti canai! Which is so unexpected to have such delicious roti in a international spread and a five star hotel! Drinks are coffee and plenty choices of tea such as jasmine, camomile, earl grey, peppermint etc. Free flow of beer and wine with some additional charge. Worth to pay if one wants a relaxing long dinner. I wasn't too happy that the dessert spread hasn't vast choices, and they sit in a counter, so the waiter picks them for you. So you can't just load your plates high! Anyhow looking so exclusive, unfortunately nothing catches my taste buds.It's a busy place with mixture of tourists, locals, families, couples and friends. So not a place for romantic dinner please. Service is ok, and a couple of staffs works hard to flash smiles around. Will I be back? Maybe yes, maybe no...

Author: jas0nikeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Seafood buffet dinner
Review: Seafood were fresh and yummy, please keep up the good quality. Desserts were not so interesting and less variety, need to improve. Coffee was not good.Overall satisfied with the buffet and will come again with friends and family.

Author: ikcsoo
Title: Worth a try for first timer.
Review: Ever come across your mind that porridge can be fried?? For those who have not tried 'Fried Porridge', it's all worth for a new experience. Go early (probably by 6pm) to avoid long queue. And yes, super long queue! The 'ä¸_±¤____ is kinda good. The popular Fried Meehoon with crab, personally it's not so so, kinda lack of __ok' æ°. Taste wise, perhaps could be better too.Overall, generous portion (standard portion). So, if you are going in one or two person kind, do be mindful of the number of dishes to be ordered. Else, tabao jeee....

Author: ShaunK568
Title: Terrible food
Review: Drinks were overdone. Food was over flavored. Horrible. Bikers everywhere. Smoking in nonsmoking area. Mediocre service. Never coming back. Don't even stop for a drink

Author: howf2017Singapore, Singapore
Title: Overrated
Review: Arrived early around 4:30pm plus and was surprised that the queue wasn't that long (there were 4 paxs ahead of us). Good thing is that it started early for business (normally 5:30pm), hence did not waited for long. Ordered 2 of their signature dishes; Cheese Bee Hoon and Sweet Vinegar Cui Hua Fish.Didn't try their Crab as there is a minimum order of 2 crabs(RM120 per kg). Strictly my opinion...Beehoon do not have that cheesey taste, kinda of using powder cheese, however the beehoon was soft to my liking. Fried fish, nothing to rave about except it is boneless, good for kids and senior. Reasonably price but won't be back as it overrated.

Author: Zeref B
Title: Below average
Review: After hearing so much reviews abt this restaurant we finally check this place out but the food in general was  dissappointing and below average.

Author: Rex_lee0623
Title: Bad attitude services
Review: Not as good as advertised, especially bad and terribek attitude services, was not recommend to friend.

Author: lovebug163Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Authentic French breads & pastries
Review: If you are looking for a restaurant that represents what is French cafe in taste and ambience, then this would be the place to go in KL. Love the bread and pastries, esp the apple turnover. There are many cafes and bread shops in Bangsar but this cafe earns a thumbs up from me for its consistent taste and quality. Servings are French/continental style so dont expect otherwise. Parking can be a challenge along this road so its best you park elsewhere and walk. You cant miss this place as its outer facade is bright yellow in color.

Author: 254timothyt
Title: Best bak kut teh in Klang
Review: They serve in small individual bowls. The soup is thick and delicious. However due to its popularity, there is a queue after 9.30 and they usually sold out quite early. You may ask for refills but too many refills are frown upon on. However despite of of these, I felt the taste make up for all the drawbacks.

Author: widespreadvisitorMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Avoid!!
Review: I am a Malaysian of Indian origin. Hence, I know what Malaysian Indian food is like. We went to this restaurant last Saturday, around 4.00 pm. Firstly, the workers seemed very unwelcoming. They don't seem to be interested in attending to their customers. We had to pick a seat ourselves. Secondly, the food was horrible, and that's putting it mildly. At 4.00 pm, they have a huge lunch spread, with not much snacks left, which, by the way, we had to help ourselves to. From whatever that was there, we took some popiah, vadai and curry puff and also some pakoras. All tasted terrible. Then comes the waiter taking our drink orders. He wasn't very polite either. Finally, we decide to just leave everything and go the to the opposite restaurant. We of course have to pay for whatever miserable "food" we had, and the lady at the counter was again very unpleasant. All in all, not a good Malaysian Indian restaurant.

Author: ev0nye
Title: Rude, and terrible
Review: I would not bother, such a poor customer service, forgot one of our meal and did even worried about it...

Author: Ladan BShiraz, Iran
Title: Nice Japanese restaurant
Review: Had a good meal there. Enjoyed sushis and sukiyaki a lot. We also enjoyed our Japanese green tea after our meal. Accessing to the place is quiet convenient as it is located in a mall connected to KL sentral. Just consider their working hours which is 9:30 pm in week days & 9:55 pm in the weekends.
